words.expression: a specific instance comes to mind
words.lemma: a specific instance comes to mind
words.enDefinition: An expression introducing a particular event you have just remembered
acceptedEnVariants: a specific instance comes to mind

examples.en: I said "A specific instance comes to mind." Then I described the day we lost the bookings.
examples.zh: 我说「我想起一个具体例子」，然后讲了预订记录丢失的那一天。

examples.en: The student said "A specific instance comes to mind." Her example was from a group assignment.
examples.zh: 这位学生说「我想起一个具体例子」，接着讲了小组作业的经历。

collocations: say "A specific instance comes to mind."
begin with "A specific instance comes to mind."
respond with "A specific instance comes to mind."

words.enDefinition: a notice telling the relevant people that someone will be absent from work

examples.en: I sent an absence notification to the person who managed the reception rota.
examples.zh: 我给管理接待台排班的人发了「缺勤通知」。

examples.en: The instructions said the absence notification should include the shift I would miss.
examples.zh: 说明说，「缺勤通知」应写明我会缺哪个班次。

words.enDefinition: A formal role in teaching, research, or academic administration

examples.en: The sample CV listed each academic appointment with the institution and dates.
examples.zh: 简历样本为每个「学术职位」都列了机构和任职日期。

examples.en: I asked why the academic appointment appeared separately from the author's degrees.
examples.zh: 我问为什么「学术职位」和作者的学位是分开列的。

collocations: an academic appointment at a university

words.enDefinition: A detailed record of someone's education, research, teaching, and academic achievements

examples.en: I added a conference talk to my academic CV before meeting my supervisor.
examples.zh: 见导师前，我把一次会议报告加进了「学术履历」。

examples.en: The lab asked for an academic CV with a list of recent publications.
examples.zh: 实验室要求提交一份列有近期发表成果的「学术履历」。

words.enDefinition: Formal recognition for strong academic work or achievement

examples.en: The adviser suggested moving my academic honors below the education entries to save space.
examples.zh: 为了节省空间，顾问建议把我的「学术荣誉」移到教育条目下方。

examples.en: The template had a single line under academic honors for prizes and distinctions.
examples.zh: 模板在「学术荣誉」下只留了一行来填写奖项和表彰。

words.enDefinition: Field-related practical experience authorized for certain US J-1 students

examples.en: The exchange office discussed Academic Training as part of its employment workshop.
examples.zh: 交流办公室在就业讲座中介绍了「美国J-1专业实践」。

examples.en: I asked how the dates for Academic Training appeared in the sponsor's letter.
examples.zh: 我问担保机构的信里怎么写「美国J-1专业实践」的起止日期。

words.enDefinition: To agree to take the job offered

examples.en: Can I accept an offer through the portal or do I need to reply directly?
examples.zh: 我能通过门户「接受录用通知」吗，还是需要直接回复？

examples.en: I took a day to accept an offer because I wanted to confirm the hours.
examples.zh: 我想确认工时，所以隔了一天才「接受录用通知」。

collocations: be ready to accept an offer

words.zhGloss: 在门户上确认接受录用
words.enDefinition: To agree to an offer using the employer's website
acceptedZhAnswers: 在门户上确认接受录用

examples.en: The university asked me to accept through the portal instead of responding by email.
examples.zh: 学校让我「在门户上确认接受录用」，不用回邮件。

examples.en: Can I accept through the portal today and sign the letter on Monday?
examples.zh: 我今天能先「在门户上确认接受录用」，周一再签录用函吗？

collocations: choose to accept through the portal
be able to accept through the portal
applicants can accept through the portal

words.enDefinition: Documents recognized as valid evidence for a particular verification process

examples.en: The US hiring office linked to the list of acceptable documents for verification.
examples.zh: 美国的招聘办公室发来了核验环节「可接受的证明文件」清单链接。

examples.en: I asked which page explained acceptable documents for the identity check.
examples.zh: 我问哪一页说明身份核验中「可接受的证明文件」有哪些。

words.enDefinition: Rules about permitted use of an organization's devices, networks, or services

examples.en: The acceptable use policy covered the shared computers in our student office.
examples.zh: 「设备与网络使用规定」适用于学生办公室的共用电脑。

examples.en: I asked whether the acceptable use policy also covered the tablet I was issued.
examples.zh: 我问「设备与网络使用规定」是否同样适用于单位发给我的平板电脑。

words.enDefinition: The latest time an offer can be accepted

examples.en: I noted the acceptance deadline while reading the message on my way to class.
examples.zh: 上课路上看消息时，我记下了「接受录用的截止时间」。

examples.en: What time zone does the acceptance deadline use for candidates who currently live abroad?
examples.zh: 目前住在海外的求职者，要按哪个时区计算「接受录用的截止时间」？

words.enDefinition: The formats an upload system can receive

examples.en: I checked the accepted file types before exporting my transcript from the records site.
examples.zh: 我从档案网站导出成绩单之前，先看了「支持的文件类型」。

examples.en: The help page lists the accepted file types below the instructions for uploading documents.
examples.zh: 帮助页面在材料上传说明下方列出了「支持的文件类型」。

collocations: one of the accepted file types

words.enDefinition: the point at which permission to open an online file or resource ends

examples.en: I checked the access expiration date before sharing the project with the panel.
examples.zh: 把项目分享给评审组前，我查看了「访问权限到期日」。

examples.en: The team asked me to move the access expiration date beyond the final interview.
examples.zh: 团队请我把「访问权限到期日」延到最后一轮面试之后。

words.enDefinition: the ability to use a vehicle when needed

examples.en: The fieldwork assistant role requires access to a vehicle for occasional visits outside town.
examples.zh: 野外工作助理偶尔要去城外走访，因此要求「有车可用」。

examples.en: I asked whether I needed access to a vehicle every day or just on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我问是每天都得「有车可用」，还是只需要周五用车。

words.enDefinition: a PDF designed so that people using assistive technology can read and navigate it

examples.en: I exported an accessible PDF so the text could be read with a screen reader.
examples.zh: 我导出了「无障碍PDF文档」，这样屏幕阅读器就能读出文字。

examples.en: The guide asks applicants to submit an accessible PDF with a clear reading order.
examples.zh: 指南要求申请人提交阅读顺序清楚的「无障碍PDF文档」。

words.enDefinition: A brief description of an action and the result it achieved

examples.en: I turned the duty into an accomplishment statement by describing what improved afterward.
examples.zh: 我写明了工作之后有哪些改进，把岗位职责写成了「成就陈述」。

examples.en: My accomplishment statement names the problem and shows how the team solved it.
examples.zh: 我的「成就陈述」交代了问题，并介绍了团队怎样解决它。

words.enDefinition: To openly say that you did something wrong or incorrectly

examples.en: My story explained why I chose to acknowledge a mistake during the team meeting.
examples.zh: 我的经历说明了为什么我选择在团队会议上「承认错误」。

examples.en: The practice question asked how I would acknowledge a mistake without blaming a colleague.
examples.zh: 练习题问我会如何「承认错误」，同时避免责怪同事。

collocations: be willing to acknowledge a mistake
acknowledge a mistake in an answer

words.enDefinition: To let an employer know its offer was received

examples.en: I wanted to acknowledge an offer before I had time to read the attachment properly.
examples.zh: 我还没时间仔细读附件，想先「确认收到录用通知」。

examples.en: The portal lets me acknowledge an offer before I decide whether to accept it.
examples.zh: 门户允许我先「确认收到录用通知」，再决定要不要接受。

collocations: acknowledge an offer without accepting it

words.enDefinition: to state honestly where a method, result or conclusion may be incomplete

examples.en: I made sure to acknowledge limitations caused by the small number of survey responses.
examples.zh: 我特地「指出局限性」，说明问卷回复太少会有什么影响。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to acknowledge limitations before proposing my preferred option.
examples.zh: 导师让我先「指出局限性」，再提出我更倾向的选项。

words.enDefinition: at several locations used by the same organization

examples.en: The role involves working across multiple sites, so I checked how far apart they were.
examples.zh: 这个岗位要「在多个工作地点」上班，所以我查了它们相距多远。

examples.en: The technician provides support across multiple sites, including a small workshop outside the city.
examples.zh: 技术员「在多个工作地点」提供支持，包括城外一间小工坊。

words.enDefinition: To use others' comments to make changes or improvements

examples.en: I described how I learned to act on feedback after my first week at work.
examples.zh: 我描述了自己在上班第一周过后怎样学着「根据反馈作改进」。

examples.en: The panel asked how I would act on feedback that I disagreed with.
examples.zh: 面试小组问我，遇到不赞同的反馈会怎样「根据反馈作改进」。

collocations: act on feedback from a supervisor

words.enDefinition: the person accountable for following up and completing an agreed action

examples.en: The notes named an action owner for every task agreed at the meeting.
examples.zh: 纪要为会上确定的每项任务列出了一位「待办事项负责人」。

examples.en: I checked with the action owner before changing the date on the team board.
examples.zh: 改团队看板上的日期前，我先问了「待办事项负责人」。

words.enDefinition: A notice that the applicant must do something

examples.en: I saw Action required beside my application after opening it on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我用笔记本打开申请后，在它旁边看到了「需要操作」。

examples.en: The dashboard showed Action required because I still needed to confirm my preferred test date.
examples.zh: 我还要确认想选的测试日期，所以申请总览显示「需要操作」。

words.enDefinition: A verb that describes what a person did or accomplished

examples.en: I opened the bullet with an action verb so the reader knew what I did.
examples.zh: 我用「动作动词」开启这条要点，方便读者知道我做了什么。

examples.en: The adviser replaced a vague action verb with one describing my actual task.
examples.zh: 顾问把一个含糊的「动作动词」换成了能说明我实际做了什么的词。

words.enDefinition: The things you personally did in a particular situation

examples.en: The practice guide says to focus on the actions you took to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 练习指南说，要着重讲「你采取的行动」怎样解决了问题。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how the actions you took affected the rest of the team.
examples.zh: 面试官问「你采取的行动」对其他队员有什么影响。

collocations: focus on the actions you took

words.enDefinition: A link used to activate a new account

examples.en: The activation link arrived just after I registered for the university's recruitment portal.
examples.zh: 我刚在学校招聘门户注册完，就收到了「账户激活链接」。

examples.en: I requested a new activation link because the first one no longer worked.
examples.zh: 第一个「账户激活链接」失效了，我重新申请了一个。

words.enDefinition: Careful attention to a speaker combined with responses showing understanding

examples.en: The group exercise showed how active listening helped us notice overlapping ideas.
examples.zh: 小组练习展示了「积极倾听」怎样帮助我们发现彼此观点中的共同点。

examples.en: The adviser discussed active listening before we tried a paired interview exercise.
examples.zh: 我们两人一组练习面试之前，顾问先讲了「积极倾听」。

collocations: use active listening in a discussion

words.enDefinition: To adjust how you act when conditions become different

examples.en: I talked about learning to adapt to change when our supervisor left midsemester.
examples.zh: 我谈到了主管在学期中途离开后，自己如何学着「适应变化」。

examples.en: The panel asked how I would adapt to change during a busy term.
examples.zh: 面试小组问我在繁忙的学期里会怎样「适应变化」。

words.enDefinition: Documents requested beyond those already submitted

examples.en: The dashboard showed a request for additional documents after the first review of my application.
examples.zh: 我的申请初审后，申请总览提示需要「补交材料」。

examples.en: I sent the additional documents through the portal and checked that both appeared in the list.
examples.zh: 我通过门户「补交了材料」，并确认两份都显示在列表里。

words.enDefinition: to show in an application how one's evidence meets the published requirements

examples.en: The guide explains how to address the selection criteria for a university position.
examples.zh: 指南介绍了申请大学的岗位时怎样「逐项回应筛选条件」。

examples.en: I added examples from my lab placement to address the selection criteria more directly.
examples.zh: 为了更直接地「逐项回应筛选条件」，我加上了实验室实习的例子。

collocations: address the selection criteria in writing
use examples to address the selection criteria

words.enDefinition: the person or organization a letter or other item is addressed to

examples.en: I checked the addressee against the name given on the application page.
examples.zh: 我对照申请页面上的姓名，核实了「收件人」。

examples.en: The addressee on my letter was the head of the recruitment team.
examples.zh: 我这封信的「收件人」是招聘团队的负责人。

collocations: address it to the correct addressee

words.enDefinition: To change the way you do something as circumstances develop

examples.en: In this example, you need to adjust your approach when the team size changes.
examples.zh: 在这个例子里，团队人数变化时，你需要「调整自己的做法」。

examples.en: The sample prompt asks how you would adjust your approach after negative feedback.
examples.zh: 样题问你收到负面反馈后会怎样「调整自己的做法」。

collocations: adjust your approach to a problem
be ready to adjust your approach

words.enDefinition: help with the routine paperwork and organization of an office

examples.en: The role involves administrative support for a small department that runs courses in the evenings.
examples.zh: 这个岗位为一个开设夜间课程的小院系提供「行政事务支持」。

examples.en: I asked what administrative support meant in a department where most forms are online.
examples.zh: 这个院系的大部分表格都在线上，所以我问「行政事务支持」具体指什么。

words.enDefinition: To settle together on the first day of work

examples.en: We could finally agree on a start date once my last exam was confirmed.
examples.zh: 我的最后一场考试时间确定后，我们终于可以「商定到岗日期」了。

examples.en: Can we agree on a start date after I check my university timetable?
examples.zh: 我核对学校的课程表后，我们再「商定到岗日期」可以吗？

collocations: meet to agree on a start date
agree on a start date by phone
work with someone to agree on a start date

words.enDefinition: to decide together what actions should be taken after a discussion or event

examples.en: We stayed a few minutes after the meeting to agree on next steps.
examples.zh: 开完会我们多留了几分钟，来「商定接下来怎么做」。

examples.en: I asked whether we could agree on next steps before sending the summary.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在发送摘要之前先「商定接下来怎么做」。

collocations: meet to agree on next steps
agree on next steps with the team
agree on next steps before leaving

words.enDefinition: To accept the stated conditions of an arrangement

examples.en: I could agree to the terms once the department confirmed my Thursday evening shift.
examples.zh: 部门确认了我周四晚的班次后，我就可以「同意所列条款」了。

examples.en: The page asked me to agree to the terms before opening the signature screen.
examples.zh: 页面要求我先「同意所列条款」，才能打开签署界面。

collocations: be willing to agree to the terms
click to agree to the terms
agree to the terms in writing

words.enDefinition: The hours both sides have accepted for a job

examples.en: The letter listed the agreed working hours next to the name of the department.
examples.zh: 信把「商定的工作时间」列在部门名称旁边。

examples.en: I checked that the agreed working hours didn't overlap with my Tuesday evening class.
examples.zh: 我确认了「商定的工作时间」不和我周二的晚课冲突。

collocations: set out the agreed working hours
work beyond the agreed working hours

words.enDefinition: to agree which tasks or goals should receive attention first

examples.en: We took five minutes to align on priorities before starting the afternoon shift.
examples.zh: 下午班开始前，我们花了五分钟「就优先事项达成一致」。

examples.en: The manager asked both teams to align on priorities for the busy week.
examples.zh: 经理让两个团队「就优先事项达成一致」，准备度过繁忙的一周。

collocations: align on priorities for the week

words.enDefinition: text describing an image's content or purpose when it cannot be seen

examples.en: I added alt text to explain what each chart showed in the portfolio.
examples.zh: 我添加了「替代文字」，说明作品集里的每张图表展示了什么。

examples.en: The reviewer checked whether the alt text made sense without seeing the photographs.
examples.zh: 评审核实了在看不到照片的情况下，「替代文字」能不能讲清楚。

words.enDefinition: A searchable list of people who attended a university

examples.en: I found an editor in the alumni directory who took the same course as me.
examples.zh: 我在「校友名录」里找到一位和我读过同一门课的编辑。

examples.en: The alumni directory lets graduates choose which contact details they share with other members.
examples.zh: 「校友名录」让毕业生自行选择向其他成员公开哪些联系方式。

collocations: be listed in an alumni directory

words.enDefinition: A former student who guides a current student

examples.en: My alumni mentor told me how she switched from university radio to editing podcasts.
examples.zh: 我的「校友导师」告诉我，她是怎么从校园电台转去做播客编辑的。

examples.en: I met my alumni mentor online while I was still exploring three different industries.
examples.zh: 我还在了解三个不同行业时，就在线上见到了我的「校友导师」。

collocations: be paired with an alumni mentor
get advice from an alumni mentor

words.enDefinition: checks the identity of the person who answered

examples.en: Hello, am I speaking with the person who arranged my call for this morning?
examples.zh: 你好，「请问您是给我安排今天上午那通电话的那位吗」？

examples.en: Am I speaking with the hiring manager for the position at the student radio station?
examples.zh: 「请问您是学生电台那个岗位的用人经理吗」？

collocations: am I speaking with the recruiter
am I speaking with the hiring manager
am I speaking with someone from recruitment

words.enDefinition: To examine survey responses for patterns, differences, or useful findings

examples.en: I used spreadsheets to analyze survey data from three first-year student groups.
examples.zh: 我用电子表格「分析调查数据」，问卷来自三组大一学生。

examples.en: My CV mentions that I helped analyze survey data for a local charity.
examples.zh: 我的简历写道，我曾帮助当地一家慈善机构「分析调查数据」。

collocations: analyze survey data for a report

words.enDefinition: an example of work with notes explaining its features or the author's contribution

examples.en: I added arrows to the diagrams to create an annotated work sample for reviewers.
examples.zh: 我给图加了箭头，做成一份「带注释的作品样本」供评审阅读。

examples.en: The annotated work sample shows which images I created and which came from teammates.
examples.zh: 「带注释的作品样本」标出了哪些图片是我做的、哪些来自队友。

collocations: an annotated work sample with context

words.enDefinition: Time away from work allocated each year

examples.en: The staff booklet explained how to request annual leave after the first week.
examples.zh: 员工手册说明了第一周结束后怎么申请「年假」。

examples.en: I asked whether my annual leave could be taken during the university's reading week.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在学校的阅读周休「年假」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of annual leave a worker is allowed

examples.en: I checked the annual leave entitlement before deciding whether the longer contract suited me.
examples.zh: 在决定较长的合同适不适合我之前，我查了「年假额度」。

examples.en: The employer listed the annual leave entitlement separately for full-time and part-time staff.
examples.zh: 雇主分开列出了全职和兼职人员的「年假额度」。

collocations: the annual leave entitlement for part-time staff

words.enDefinition: Taking annual leave before earning the needed balance

examples.en: My new employer in Australia explained how annual leave in advance worked at the museum.
examples.zh: 我在澳大利亚的新雇主解释了博物馆的「预支年假」安排。

examples.en: I asked whether I could request annual leave in advance before the holiday I'd booked.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在已预订的假期之前申请「预支年假」。

collocations: an agreement for annual leave in advance

words.enDefinition: A salary amount stated for one year

examples.en: The offer quotes an annual salary even though I would be paid every month.
examples.zh: 尽管每月发薪，录用通知写的是「年薪」。

examples.en: I found the annual salary in a separate table below the list of duties.
examples.zh: 我在职责清单下方的一张单独表格中找到了「年薪」。

words.enDefinition: to alter a sample so that its people or sources cannot reasonably be identified

examples.en: I asked how to anonymize a sample from interviews conducted for the community project.
examples.zh: 我问如何「将样本匿名化」，这些样本来自社区项目中的访谈。

examples.en: We had to anonymize a sample before we could include it in the portfolio.
examples.zh: 我们必须先「将样本匿名化」，才能把它放进作品集。

words.enDefinition: To respond using language you choose instead of repeating a script

examples.en: The practice sheet encourages you to answer in your own words after reading the prompt.
examples.zh: 练习单鼓励你读完题目后「用自己的话回答」。

examples.en: You can answer in your own words even when you have rehearsed the story before.
examples.zh: 即使之前练习过这段经历，你也可以「用自己的话回答」。

collocations: try to answer in your own words
feel free to answer in your own words
take time to answer in your own words

words.enDefinition: an outline of the operations, inputs and outputs that a software interface could provide

examples.en: My API sketch showed how a student might request a list of available rooms.
examples.zh: 我的「接口设计草图」展示了学生如何请求可用房间列表。

examples.en: The interviewer reviewed the API sketch before asking about how I would test it.
examples.zh: 问我会怎样测试之前，面试官先看了「接口设计草图」。

words.enDefinition: A formal statement an applicant confirms as true

examples.en: The applicant declaration asked me to confirm that the information I had entered was accurate.
examples.zh: 「申请人声明」要求我确认已填写的信息准确无误。

examples.en: I read the applicant declaration before ticking the box at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 我先读了「申请人声明」，然后才勾选页面底部的方框。

words.enDefinition: All people being considered for a particular opening

examples.en: The applicant pool included students from three universities with similar library training programmes.
examples.zh: 「应聘者群体」包括三所大学的学生，这些学校都有类似的图书馆培训项目。

examples.en: The report described the applicant pool without showing anyone's name or personal details.
examples.zh: 报告描述了「应聘者群体」的情况，没有显示任何人的姓名或个人资料。

words.enDefinition: Software that helps employers organize and manage job applications

examples.en: Our adviser explained why an applicant tracking system might read a CV differently from a person.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「招聘申请管理系统」读取简历的方式为什么可能和人不一样。

examples.en: The workshop showed how an applicant tracking system displays names and education details.
examples.zh: 讲座展示了「招聘申请管理系统」如何显示姓名和教育背景。

collocations: an applicant tracking system parses resumes
software for an applicant tracking system

words.enDefinition: An inactive application has been moved into storage

examples.en: The portal showed Application archived beside the library job I applied for last year.
examples.zh: 在我去年申请的图书馆职位旁边，求职门户显示「申请已归档」。

examples.en: I saw Application archived on the old form but could still open a copy.
examples.zh: 旧表单上显示「申请已归档」，但我还能打开副本。

words.enDefinition: A list of steps or materials for applying

examples.en: I used the application checklist to make sure I hadn't skipped any questions.
examples.zh: 我用「申请事项清单」确认自己没有漏答任何问题。

examples.en: The application checklist includes one document I can get from the student records office.
examples.zh: 「申请事项清单」中有一份材料可以到学生档案办公室领取。

words.enDefinition: A list of a user's past applications

examples.en: I found my spring application in the application history after signing in again.
examples.zh: 重新登录后，我在「申请历史记录」里找到了春季提交的申请。

examples.en: My application history shows the two library roles I applied for last year.
examples.zh: 我的「申请历史记录」显示了去年申请的两个图书馆职位。

collocations: an entry in your application history

words.enDefinition: Directions for completing and sending an application

examples.en: The application instructions explained which documents could be uploaded after the form was submitted.
examples.zh: 「申请填写说明」写明了哪些材料可以在提交表单后再上传。

examples.en: I reread the application instructions because I wasn't sure how to enter my degree.
examples.zh: 我不确定学位该怎么填写，所以又看了一遍「申请填写说明」。

words.enDefinition: A link that opens a job application

examples.en: The application link on the library website opened the correct job in the portal.
examples.zh: 图书馆网站的「申请入口链接」在门户中打开了对应的职位。

examples.en: I copied the application link so I could open it on my laptop later.
examples.zh: 我复制了「申请入口链接」，方便之后用笔记本打开。

words.enDefinition: An application can no longer be edited

examples.en: The portal showed Application locked when the department started reviewing forms on Monday.
examples.zh: 部门周一开始审核表单时，求职门户显示「申请已锁定」。

examples.en: I saw Application locked when I tried to replace a file after the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止后我尝试更换文件时，看到「申请已锁定」。

words.enDefinition: Progress on an application is temporarily paused

examples.en: The dashboard showed Application on hold while the employer checked the staffing plans.
examples.zh: 雇主核对人员安排期间，申请总览显示「申请暂缓处理」。

examples.en: I asked what Application on hold meant for the library role I had applied for.
examples.zh: 我问申请的图书馆职位显示「申请暂缓处理」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Applications waiting to be processed

examples.en: The department said my form was still in the application queue after the holiday.
examples.zh: 部门说，假期结束后，我的表单仍在「待处理申请队列」中。

examples.en: The portal showed when my form had been added to the application queue.
examples.zh: 求职门户显示了我的表单什么时候加入「待处理申请队列」。

collocations: an application still in the queue

words.enDefinition: An employer's system has recorded the application

examples.en: The dashboard showed Application received beside the role I'd applied for that morning.
examples.zh: 申请总览在我当天上午申请的职位旁显示「申请已收到」。

examples.en: I took a screenshot when the portal displayed Application received after I refreshed it.
examples.zh: 刷新后，门户显示「申请已收到」，我就截了图。

collocations: show application received on the dashboard

words.enDefinition: A number used to identify an application

examples.en: I wrote down the application reference number while the confirmation page was still open.
examples.zh: 确认页面还开着时，我记下了「申请编号」。

examples.en: The application reference number appeared next to the title of the role I'd chosen.
examples.zh: 「申请编号」显示在我所选职位的名称旁边。

words.enDefinition: One step in the process of evaluating an application

examples.en: The dashboard shows the current application stage for each role I have applied for.
examples.zh: 申请总览显示了我所申请每个职位当前的「申请流程阶段」。

examples.en: I asked whether the application stage shown online changed immediately after the team reviewed documents.
examples.zh: 我问招聘组审核材料之后，网上显示的「申请流程阶段」是否会马上更新。

collocations: advance to the next application stage

words.enDefinition: The employer is currently evaluating an application

examples.en: The portal changed to Application under review two days after the deadline for the role.
examples.zh: 该职位截止两天后，门户状态变成了「申请正在审核」。

examples.en: I saw Application under review beside the vacancy when I checked the portal on Friday.
examples.zh: 我周五查看求职门户时，职位旁显示「申请正在审核」。

collocations: mark an application as under review

words.enDefinition: The period when applications may be submitted

examples.en: The library's application window opens just after our last exams of the term.
examples.zh: 图书馆的「申请开放期」从我们这学期最后一场考试结束后开始。

examples.en: I checked the application window because the opening date fell during the holidays.
examples.zh: 我查了「申请开放期」，因为开始日期碰上了假期。

words.enDefinition: An application has been taken out of consideration

examples.en: The portal displayed Application withdrawn after I confirmed I could not work those shifts.
examples.zh: 我确认无法上那些班次后，求职门户显示「申请已撤回」。

examples.en: Application withdrawn appeared on my dashboard, but the original form was still visible.
examples.zh: 申请总览提示「申请已撤回」，但原来的表单仍然可见。

collocations: an application withdrawn by the candidate

words.enDefinition: Applications are no longer being accepted

examples.en: The portal said Applications are closed even though the original listing was still visible.
examples.zh: 尽管还看得到原来的招聘信息，门户还是提示「申请已关闭」。

examples.en: I went back the next morning and found Applications are closed on the job page.
examples.zh: 第二天早上再打开职位页面时，我看到了「申请已关闭」。

collocations: a message saying applications are closed
applications are closed for this role

words.enDefinition: put knowledge gained in class into practical use

examples.en: The placement let me apply classroom learning when drafting a short guide for library visitors.
examples.zh: 在实习中为图书馆访客写简短指南时，我有机会「运用课堂所学」。

examples.en: The course wants students to apply classroom learning during projects with local arts groups.
examples.zh: 课程希望学生在和本地艺术团体合作的项目中「运用课堂所学」。

words.enDefinition: To submit a request for a job electronically

examples.en: Can I apply online for the museum job from a university library computer?
examples.zh: 我能用大学图书馆的电脑「在线申请」博物馆的工作吗？

examples.en: I chose to apply online because the department's office closes before my last class.
examples.zh: 我选择「在线申请」，因为最后一节课还没结束，部门办公室就关门了。

words.enDefinition: someone learning an occupation through supervised work and instruction

examples.en: As an apprentice at the studio, I spent some weeks working with the production team.
examples.zh: 我在工作室当「学徒」时，有几周和制作团队一起工作。

examples.en: The apprentice went to college on Fridays and worked with the workshop team on other days.
examples.zh: 这位「学徒」星期五在学院上课，其他日子和工坊团队一起工作。

words.enDefinition: practical training in an occupation through supervised work and study

examples.en: My cousin chose an apprenticeship to learn how to maintain the equipment at a studio.
examples.zh: 我表弟选择参加「学徒培训」，学习怎么维护工作室的设备。

examples.en: The apprenticeship included study time as well as work next to experienced technicians.
examples.zh: 「学徒培训」既安排了学习时间，也安排了跟有经验的技术员一起工作的时间。

words.enDefinition: A person's usual method for identifying and addressing a difficulty

examples.en: The interviewer asked how my approach to problem-solving changed when information was missing.
examples.zh: 面试官问我，在信息不足时，「解决问题的方法」会怎样调整。

examples.en: My approach to problem-solving involved checking what the users needed before changing anything.
examples.zh: 我「解决问题的方法」是先确认用户的需求，再作改动。

words.enDefinition: a drawing showing the main parts of a system and the relationships between them

examples.en: I drew an architecture diagram to show how the booking service used the database.
examples.zh: 我画了一张「系统架构图」，展示预约服务怎样使用数据库。

examples.en: The panel asked why the architecture diagram showed two separate data stores.
examples.zh: 评审组问，「系统架构图」里为什么画有两个独立的数据存储。

words.zhGloss: 你在某个时间仍然有空吗
words.enDefinition: checks whether someone remains available at the proposed time
acceptedZhAnswers: 你在某个时间仍然有空吗

examples.en: Are you still free at four, or would you rather talk tomorrow morning instead?
examples.zh: 你「四点仍然有空吗」，还是更想明天上午聊？

examples.en: Are you still free at our original time now that the room has changed?
examples.zh: 房间换了，「原定时间你还有空吗」？

collocations: are you still free at noon?
are you still free at the agreed time?
are you still free at five today?

words.enDefinition: A skill or aspect of performance that someone could develop further

examples.en: I named delegation as an area for improvement and explained what I had changed.
examples.zh: 我说分派任务这方面「有待改进」，并解释了自己作了哪些改变。

examples.en: The feedback identified my pacing as an area for improvement for the next interview.
examples.zh: 反馈指出，我的语速是下次面试时「有待改进之处」。

collocations: an area for improvement in communication

words.enDefinition: parts of someone's work or a process that could be made better

examples.en: The feedback note listed two areas for improvement in my handling of enquiries.
examples.zh: 反馈记录列了我处理咨询时两个「可以改进的方面」。

examples.en: We picked one of the areas for improvement to discuss at our next meeting.
examples.zh: 我们选了一项「可以改进的方面」，准备在下次开会时讨论。

collocations: focus on specific areas for improvement

words.enDefinition: used to refer back to points agreed or mentioned in an earlier conversation

examples.en: I opened the email with “As discussed” and listed the two agreed dates.
examples.zh: 我在邮件开头写「正如之前谈过的」，接着列出商定的两个日期。

examples.en: As discussed, the bookings desk will stay open until seven on Friday.
examples.zh: 「正如之前谈过的」，预约柜台周五会营业到七点。

words.expression: as we discussed on the phone
words.lemma: as we discussed on the phone
words.enDefinition: introduces something previously agreed or mentioned by phone
acceptedEnVariants: as we discussed on the phone

examples.en: As we discussed on the phone, I'll be away until the end of term.
examples.zh: 「正如我们电话里说的」，我到学期结束前都不在。

examples.en: As we discussed on the phone yesterday, I've included my availability for both days.
examples.zh: 「正如我们昨天电话里说的」，我把两天空闲的时间都附上了。

collocations: as we discussed on the phone this morning
as we discussed on the phone yesterday
as we discussed on the phone earlier

words.enDefinition: to request another person's assessment before relying on a decision or answer

examples.en: I decided to ask for a second opinion before changing the event schedule.
examples.zh: 改活动安排前，我决定先「征求另一人的意见」。

examples.en: The supervisor said it was fine to ask for a second opinion about the figures.
examples.zh: 主管说，关于这些数字，可以「征求另一人的意见」。

collocations: ask for a second opinion on a draft
decide to ask for a second opinion
encourage someone to ask for a second opinion

words.enDefinition: To request that someone put you in touch

examples.en: I wanted to ask for an introduction to someone who works in local radio.
examples.zh: 我想「请人引荐」，认识一位在本地电台工作的人。

examples.en: Did you ask for an introduction when your tutor mentioned the graduate working there?
examples.zh: 导师提到有毕业生在那儿工作时，你有没有「请他引荐」？

collocations: ask for an introduction to an alumnus
ask for an introduction by email

words.enDefinition: To request someone's comments on how something went or could improve

examples.en: I learned to ask for feedback after meetings rather than guessing what people thought.
examples.zh: 我学会了在会后「征求反馈」，而不是猜测别人的想法。

examples.en: My example explained why I chose to ask for feedback halfway through the project.
examples.zh: 我举例说明了为什么选择在项目进行到一半时「征求反馈」。

collocations: ask for feedback on an answer
ask for feedback from a supervisor

words.enDefinition: To request a later time to respond

examples.en: I wanted to ask for more time because I hadn't received my exam schedule yet.
examples.zh: 我还没收到考试安排，所以想「请求多给一些时间」。

examples.en: Could I ask for more time to check the new hours against my timetable?
examples.zh: 我能不能「请您多给一些时间」，让我核对新工时和课程表有没有冲突？

collocations: decide to ask for more time
ask for more time to decide

words.enDefinition: a recruitment event in which candidates are assessed through several activities or exercises

examples.en: The assessment centre included a written task and a discussion with three other candidates.
examples.zh: 「集中测评环节」包括一项书面任务，以及和另外三名应聘者一起讨论。

examples.en: The recruiter sent a timetable for the assessment centre the day before it began.
examples.zh: 招聘人员在「集中测评环节」开始前一天发来了日程表。

words.enDefinition: The last time an assessment can be submitted

examples.en: The assessment deadline appeared next to the invitation on my dashboard on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五，我的申请总览在邀请旁显示了「测评截止时间」。

examples.en: I checked the time zone listed beside the assessment deadline before starting the test.
examples.zh: 开始测试前，我查看了「测评截止时间」旁标注的时区。

words.enDefinition: Directions for taking and completing an assessment

examples.en: The assessment instructions explained where to find the timer after opening the test.
examples.zh: 「测评说明」解释了打开测试后去哪里找计时器。

examples.en: I read the assessment instructions before clicking the button to begin on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我先读了「测评说明」，然后才在笔记本上按下开始按钮。

words.enDefinition: A request to take an assessment

examples.en: An assessment invitation appeared on my dashboard after the hiring team reviewed my application.
examples.zh: 招聘小组审核申请后，我的申请总览上出现了「测评邀请」。

examples.en: I opened the assessment invitation to check which dates were available that week.
examples.zh: 我打开「测评邀请」，看看那周有哪些日期可以选。

words.enDefinition: A link giving access to an assessment

examples.en: The assessment link opened a welcome screen with the instructions for the test.
examples.zh: 「测评入口链接」打开的是一个带有测试说明的欢迎页面。

examples.en: I couldn't open the assessment link on my phone, so I used my laptop.
examples.zh: 手机上打不开「测评入口链接」，所以我改用了笔记本。

words.enDefinition: Information about how someone performed on an assessment

examples.en: The portal displayed my assessment results alongside the status of my application for the role.
examples.zh: 门户把我的「测评结果」和该职位的申请状态列在一起。

examples.en: I could see my assessment results, but the recruitment team was still reviewing my documents.
examples.zh: 我已经能看到「测评结果」，但招聘小组还在审核我的材料。

words.enDefinition: A document formatted so application software can extract its information

examples.en: The adviser showed me an ATS-friendly resume with simple headings and clean text.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了一份「适合系统解析的简历」，标题简洁，文字清晰。

examples.en: I saved an ATS-friendly resume alongside the more colorful version for the fair.
examples.zh: 除了招聘会上用的彩色版，我还保存了「适合系统解析的简历」。

words.enDefinition: the habit of noticing and checking small important details

examples.en: The archive asks for attention to detail because missing labels can make items hard to find.
examples.zh: 档案馆要求「注重细节」，因为少一张标签就可能很难找到物品。

examples.en: The description stresses attention to detail when checking names on event bookings each morning.
examples.zh: 岗位说明强调，每天早上核对活动预订上的姓名时要「注重细节」。

words.enDefinition: The span of time during which a person has permission to work

examples.en: The administrator checked the authorized employment period before recording my placement dates.
examples.zh: 行政人员先核对「获准工作的期限」，再登记我的实习日期。

examples.en: I asked which page showed the authorized employment period for my current placement.
examples.zh: 我问哪一页写有我目前实习的「获准工作的期限」。

collocations: dates of the authorized employment period

words.enDefinition: A site or area where a person is permitted to work

examples.en: The employer asked which authorized work location appeared on my Canadian permit.
examples.zh: 雇主问加拿大许可证上写的「获准工作的地点」是哪里。

examples.en: I checked the authorized work location in the document before meeting my adviser.
examples.zh: 见顾问之前，我核对了文件上的「获准工作的地点」。

words.enDefinition: Software-based filtering of applications

examples.en: The workshop described how automated screening can flag applications with unanswered questions.
examples.zh: 工作坊介绍了「自动筛选」如何标出有未答问题的申请。

examples.en: The employer uses automated screening before its staff review the remaining applications.
examples.zh: 该雇主先用「自动筛选」，再由员工审核剩余申请。

words.enDefinition: able to make time with little advance warning

examples.en: I can be available at short notice on Friday if the panel has a cancellation.
examples.zh: 如果评审组周五有人取消，我「接到临时通知也能抽空」。

examples.en: The recruiter asked if I was available at short notice to talk the next morning.
examples.zh: 招聘人员问，第二天上午如果「临时通知，我能不能抽空」聊聊。

words.enDefinition: able to attend an interview at the requested or offered time

examples.en: I mentioned that I was available for an interview on most weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 我提到，大多数工作日上午我都「可以参加面试」。

examples.en: The recruiter asked if I would be available for an interview during reading week.
examples.zh: 招聘人员问我在阅读周期间是否「可以参加面试」。

collocations: available for an interview next week
confirm you are available for an interview

words.enDefinition: A status showing documents are still needed

examples.en: The application stayed at Awaiting documents while I waited for an official transcript.
examples.zh: 我在等正式成绩单时，申请一直显示「等待补交材料」。

examples.en: The portal showed Awaiting documents beside the role until my revised certificate went through.
examples.zh: 我更正后的证书上传成功之前，门户一直在职位旁显示「等待补交材料」。

collocations: mark a submission as awaiting documents

words.enDefinition: a quick approximate calculation made without detailed data or tools

examples.en: I used a back-of-the-envelope estimate to see whether the shuttle could break even.
examples.zh: 我用一次「粗略估算」看看接驳车能否收支相抵。

examples.en: The case interviewer asked for a back-of-the-envelope estimate before showing actual figures.
examples.zh: 案例面试官先要我做个「粗略估算」，再出示实际数字。

words.enDefinition: meetings scheduled one immediately after another

examples.en: The recruiter had back-to-back meetings in the morning but was free after three.
examples.zh: 招聘人员上午「会议一个接一个」，三点以后才有空。

examples.en: I've got back-to-back meetings for my group project, so Friday afternoon is much easier.
examples.zh: 我的小组项目「会议一个接一个」，所以周五下午要方便得多。

words.enDefinition: to provide facts or examples showing why a statement should be believed

examples.en: I used visitor survey results to back up a claim about improving our information desk.
examples.zh: 我用来访者的调查结果「支持了我的主张」，即信息台的服务有所改进。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to back up a claim about organizing a large student event.
examples.zh: 顾问要我「用证据支持主张」，说明我确实组织过一场大型学生活动。

collocations: back up a claim with evidence
back up a claim with figures
use an example to back up a claim

words.enDefinition: Permission for someone to obtain and review relevant background records

examples.en: The agency asked me to read the background check authorization before confirming my details.
examples.zh: 机构让我先读「背景核查授权」，再确认个人资料。

examples.en: I kept a copy of the background check authorization with my placement documents.
examples.zh: 我把「背景核查授权」的副本与实习文件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: A document presenting results from a review of an applicant's records

examples.en: I asked who could review the background check report for my library placement.
examples.zh: 我问谁能查看我图书馆实习的「背景核查报告」。

examples.en: The date on my background check report differed from the one in the portal.
examples.zh: 我的「背景核查报告」上的日期与平台显示的日期不同。

collocations: a copy of the background check report

words.enDefinition: Reviewing selected records to verify information about a prospective worker

examples.en: Human resources explained which parts of my record the background screening covered.
examples.zh: 人力资源部门说明了「背景筛查」涵盖我档案的哪些部分。

examples.en: The coordinator told me where to ask questions about the background screening.
examples.zh: 协调员告诉我去哪里咨询「背景筛查」的问题。

words.enDefinition: a task listed for future work that has not yet been scheduled or completed

examples.en: The broken printer was added as a backlog item after the temporary repair.
examples.zh: 打印机临时修好后，后续维修被列为「积压待办项」。

examples.en: I checked whether the backlog item had been assigned to anyone that week.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，那周有没有人领到这项「积压待办项」。

words.enDefinition: extra slides kept outside the main presentation for use if more detail is requested

examples.en: I kept two backup slides in case the panel asked about the survey method.
examples.zh: 我留了两张「备用幻灯片」，以备评审组问到调查方法。

examples.en: The interviewer asked a question that I could answer using my backup slides.
examples.zh: 面试官问了一个问题，我能用「备用幻灯片」回答。

words.enDefinition: a simple case in a recursive solution that can be handled without further recursion

examples.en: I named the base case first before explaining how the function called itself.
examples.zh: 我先讲「基本情形」，再说明函数怎样调用自身。

examples.en: The reviewer asked what the base case returned when no items remained.
examples.zh: 评审问，当没有剩余条目时，「基本情形」会返回什么。

words.enDefinition: a presentation showing the condition of something before and after a change

examples.en: The before-and-after comparison made the improvement in the poster layout easier to see.
examples.zh: 「改动前后对比」让海报布局的改进更容易看出来。

examples.en: I used a before-and-after comparison to show what changed on the sign.
examples.zh: 我用「改动前后对比」展示标识上都改了哪里。

words.enDefinition: introduces one last point before ending a call

examples.en: Before I let you go, could I check where the main entrance is?
examples.zh: 「挂电话前我再问一句」，能确认一下正门在哪里吗？

examples.en: Before I let you go, I'll read back the time I have written down.
examples.zh: 「挂电话前我再说一句」，我把记下的时间念一遍给你听。

collocations: one more thing before I let you go
before I let you go, could I ask something?
just before I let you go

words.enDefinition: An interview focused on what someone did in past situations

examples.en: In the behavioral interview, I described how I handled a disagreement at work.
examples.zh: 在「行为面试」中，我描述了自己如何处理工作中的一次分歧。

examples.en: The adviser ran a short behavioral interview using examples from my campus jobs.
examples.zh: 顾问参考我的校内工作经历，组织了一场简短的「行为面试」。

words.enDefinition: A question asking for an example of someone's past actions

examples.en: The behavioral question asked for an example of a disagreement with a colleague.
examples.zh: 这道「行为面试题」要求举例描述与同事意见不合的经历。

examples.en: I used my student job to answer a behavioral question about giving feedback.
examples.zh: 我用校内工作经历回答了一道关于如何给反馈的「行为面试题」。

words.zhGloss: 对解法做性能基准测试
words.enDefinition: to measure a solution's performance under defined conditions so it can be compared
acceptedZhAnswers: 对解法做性能基准测试

examples.en: I used the same test data to benchmark a solution against the original version.
examples.zh: 我用同样的测试数据「对解法做性能基准测试」，以便比较它和原来的版本。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how we would benchmark a solution when inputs varied in size.
examples.zh: 面试官问，输入规模变化时，我们怎样「对解法做性能基准测试」。

collocations: benchmark a solution against a baseline
benchmark a solution on larger inputs
use test data to benchmark a solution

words.enDefinition: A form naming who should receive a specified workplace benefit

examples.en: I asked which plan was listed on the beneficiary designation form in my packet.
examples.zh: 我问资料包里的「受益人指定表」写的是哪个福利计划。

examples.en: The office confirmed it had received the updated beneficiary designation form last Tuesday.
examples.zh: 办公室确认上周二已收到更新后的「受益人指定表」。

words.enDefinition: A sum available to spend on specified benefits

examples.en: The benefit allowance for this role was listed beside the options I could choose.
examples.zh: 我可以选择的项目旁边列出了这个岗位的「福利津贴额度」。

examples.en: I asked whether the benefit allowance could be used for both courses and memberships.
examples.zh: 我问「福利津贴额度」能不能同时用于课程和会员费。

words.zhGloss: 已选的员工福利项目（美国）
words.enDefinition: An employee's formal choices among available benefits
acceptedZhAnswers: 已选的员工福利项目（美国）

examples.en: The U.S. university's portal let me review my benefit elections before confirming them online.
examples.zh: 那所美国大学的门户允许我在线确认前先查看「已选的员工福利项目」。

examples.en: The email said I could save a copy of my benefit elections for my records.
examples.zh: 邮件说，我可以保存一份「已选的员工福利项目」记录，方便以后查看。

words.enDefinition: Whether someone meets the conditions for benefits

examples.en: I checked the page on benefits eligibility because I was offered a part-time role.
examples.zh: 因为我拿到的是兼职岗位的录用通知，我看了「福利资格」那一页。

examples.en: The adviser explained how working hours affected benefits eligibility for this particular library role.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了在这个图书馆岗位上，工时如何影响「福利资格」。

words.enDefinition: Signing up to receive offered employment benefits

examples.en: The guide said benefits enrollment would open after my account appeared in the system.
examples.zh: 指南说，我的账户在系统里出现后，就会开放「员工福利登记」。

examples.en: I asked whether benefits enrollment could be completed on a phone before my first day.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在第一天上班前用手机完成「员工福利登记」。

words.enDefinition: A document recording an employee's choices about workplace benefits

examples.en: I asked which section of the benefits enrollment form applied to student employees.
examples.zh: 我问「员工福利登记表」的哪一部分适用于学生员工。

examples.en: The office returned my benefits enrollment form because one section was missing.
examples.zh: 由于漏填了一个栏目，办公室退回了我的「员工福利登记表」。

words.enDefinition: A guide describing employee benefits and their conditions

examples.en: The benefits handbook explained how I could check my leave balance after starting work.
examples.zh: 「员工福利手册」解释了开始工作后怎样查看剩余休假额度。

examples.en: I saved the benefits handbook so I could read it before signing the offer letter.
examples.zh: 我保存了「员工福利手册」，准备签录用函前读一下。

words.enDefinition: the set of non-wage benefits offered with a job

examples.en: The listing outlines a benefits package that includes a discounted bus pass and paid leave.
examples.zh: 招聘启事概述了「综合福利待遇」，其中有公交月票折扣和带薪假。

examples.en: I checked the benefits package because the employer and the agency described it differently.
examples.zh: 雇主和中介说法不一样，所以我仔细读了「综合福利待遇」。

words.enDefinition: The date on which employment benefits begin

examples.en: The benefits start date in the guide was not the same as my first workday.
examples.zh: 指南上「开始享受福利的日期」和我第一天上班的日期不同。

examples.en: I asked whether changing my first shift would also change the benefits start date.
examples.zh: 我问改了第一班的时间，会不会也改动「开始享受福利的日期」。

words.enDefinition: A brief description of the benefits offered

examples.en: The benefits summary showed which support was included with the weekend library role.
examples.zh: 「福利概览」列出了图书馆周末岗位包含哪些福利项目。

examples.en: I read the benefits summary before asking whether I could claim a travel allowance.
examples.zh: 我先读了「福利概览」，再询问能不能申请交通补贴。

collocations: a benefits summary for new staff

words.enDefinition: Time before an employee's benefit eligibility begins

examples.en: The guide lists a benefits waiting period for some of the options it describes.
examples.zh: 指南给部分福利选项列了「福利等待期」。

examples.en: I checked when the benefits waiting period would end after receiving my updated start date.
examples.zh: 收到更新后的到岗日期后，我查了「福利等待期」什么时候结束。

collocations: the end of the benefits waiting period

words.enDefinition: A form recording an employee's decision to decline specified workplace benefits

examples.en: I asked which plan the benefits waiver form referred to in my packet.
examples.zh: 我问资料包里的「福利放弃登记表」指的是哪个计划。

examples.en: The administrator confirmed receipt of my benefits waiver form after the orientation session.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会结束后，行政人员确认收到了我的「福利放弃登记表」。

words.enDefinition: Time off following the death of someone close

examples.en: The handbook listed bereavement leave separately from the standard annual leave allowance for staff.
examples.zh: 手册把「丧假」和员工标准年假额度分开列出。

examples.en: The manager explained who to contact about bereavement leave if the office was closed.
examples.zh: 经理解释了办公室关门时该联系谁申请「丧假」。

words.enDefinition: to reserve a period of time for a particular task or activity

examples.en: I decided to block off time on Friday to prepare for the workshop.
examples.zh: 我决定周五「在日程上预留时间」准备培训。

examples.en: The supervisor asked us to block off time for the new starter's orientation.
examples.zh: 主管让我们「在日程上预留时间」，参加新同事的入职介绍。

collocations: block off time for a meeting
block off time on your calendar

words.enDefinition: Information communicated through posture, gestures, or facial expressions

examples.en: The practice video helped me notice my body language while I listened.
examples.zh: 练习录像让我留意到自己在倾听时的「肢体语言」。

examples.en: We discussed how body language can change a listener's impression of an answer.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「肢体语言」怎样改变听者对回答的印象。

words.enDefinition: To save a job link to revisit later

examples.en: Can I bookmark a vacancy from the results page without opening the entire advert?
examples.zh: 我能直接在结果页「收藏一条招聘信息」，不用打开完整启事吗？

examples.en: I wanted to bookmark a vacancy before my phone lost its connection on the train.
examples.zh: 火车上手机断网之前，我想先「收藏一条招聘信息」。

words.enDefinition: to separate a complicated problem into smaller parts that are easier to handle

examples.en: I drew two boxes to break down the problem before attempting a solution.
examples.zh: 我先画了两个方框来「拆解问题」，再尝试求解。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how I would break down the problem for a new teammate.
examples.zh: 面试官问，我会怎样为刚加入的队友「拆解问题」。

collocations: break down the problem into steps
break down the problem before coding
help someone break down the problem

words.enDefinition: a calculation of the approximate level at which income would cover costs

examples.en: My break-even estimate showed how many tickets the student theatre needed to sell.
examples.zh: 我的「收支平衡估算」显示学生剧场得卖多少张票。

examples.en: The interviewer asked which assumptions mattered most for the break-even estimate in my notes.
examples.zh: 面试官问，我笔记上那项「收支平衡估算」最依赖哪些假设。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚过桥签工作权
words.enDefinition: Permission to work while holding an Australian bridging visa
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚过桥签工作权

examples.en: The Australian adviser explained where to find my bridging visa work rights in VEVO.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的顾问解释了怎样在签证查询系统中找到「澳大利亚过桥签工作权」。

examples.en: I asked whether the example listed bridging visa work rights in a separate field.
examples.zh: 我问样本是否用单独一栏列出「澳大利亚过桥签工作权」。

collocations: information about bridging visa work rights

words.enDefinition: to give a group the essential information they need before acting

examples.en: The supervisor stopped to brief the team before the doors opened to visitors.
examples.zh: 大门对访客开放前，主管停下来「向团队做简要说明」。

examples.en: I used the first minute to brief the team on the room change.
examples.zh: 我用第一分钟「向团队做简要说明」，告诉大家场地变更了。

collocations: brief the team on a change
brief the team before a shift
ask someone to brief the team

words.enDefinition: To move the planned first working day earlier

examples.en: The manager asked if we could bring forward the start date to the second of July.
examples.zh: 经理问能不能「把到岗日期提前」至七月二日。

examples.en: Would it be possible to bring forward the start date now that my course has ended?
examples.zh: 现在我的课程已经结束了，能不能「把到岗日期提前」？

collocations: ask to bring forward the start date
agree to bring forward the start date
bring forward the start date by two days

words.enDefinition: to give someone enough current information to understand a situation and take part

examples.en: Could you bring me up to speed on the new rota before lunch?
examples.zh: 午饭前你能让我「了解一下新排班的最新情况」吗？

examples.en: I can bring you up to speed on the bookings before the desk opens.
examples.zh: 柜台开门前，我可以「让你了解预约的最新情况」。

collocations: bring someone up to speed on changes
quickly bring someone up to speed
offer to bring someone up to speed

words.enDefinition: move a planned call to an earlier time

examples.en: Could we bring the call forward to Thursday morning while the manager is in the office?
examples.zh: 能不能趁经理在办公室的时候，「把通话时间提前到周四上午」？

examples.en: We can bring the call forward if you need to catch the last train home.
examples.zh: 要是你得赶回家的末班火车，我们可以「把通话时间提前」。

collocations: bring the call forward by an hour
bring the call forward to Wednesday
ask to bring the call forward

words.enDefinition: To look for jobs across more areas

examples.en: Did the careers adviser suggest that you broaden your job search beyond the city?
examples.zh: 就业顾问有没有建议你「扩大求职范围」，也看看市外的岗位？

examples.en: Would you broaden your job search if few nearby firms were hiring this term?
examples.zh: 如果这学期附近没几家公司招人，你会「扩大求职范围」吗？

collocations: decide to broaden your job search
help you broaden your job search

words.enDefinition: a straightforward method that tries all or many possibilities instead of ruling them out efficiently

examples.en: I described a brute-force approach before showing how to avoid checking every possible pair.
examples.zh: 我先讲「穷举式解法」，再说明怎样省去对所有可能组合的逐一检查。

examples.en: The brute-force approach worked on the examples but took too long on larger inputs.
examples.zh: 「穷举式解法」能通过示例，但处理较大的输入时耗时太长。

words.enDefinition: To make an early version of something for testing or demonstration

examples.en: I helped build a prototype of a tool for booking study rooms.
examples.zh: 我协助给自习室预订工具「制作原型」。

examples.en: Our research group used paper sketches to build a prototype before writing any code.
examples.zh: 写代码之前，我们科研小组用纸上草图「制作原型」。

words.enDefinition: To create a friendly connection based on mutual understanding

examples.en: I found it easier to build rapport after we discussed the campus café.
examples.zh: 我们聊过校园咖啡馆之后，我觉得比较容易「建立融洽关系」。

examples.en: The adviser showed how a genuine question can help build rapport.
examples.zh: 顾问示范了一个真诚的问题能怎样帮助双方「建立融洽关系」。

words.enDefinition: A document requesting permission to enter a workplace or particular building

examples.en: The building access form asked which rooms I would need during my placement.
examples.zh: 「楼宇门禁申请表」问我实习期间需要进哪些房间。

examples.en: I checked whether my supervisor had received the building access form for the lab.
examples.zh: 我问主管是否收到了实验室的「楼宇门禁申请表」。

words.enDefinition: an overlap or clash between events on someone's schedule

examples.en: I noticed a calendar conflict after my supervisor scheduled the training for Thursday.
examples.zh: 主管把培训安排在周四后，我发现有「日程冲突」。

examples.en: The calendar conflict meant I could attend only the first half of the meeting.
examples.zh: 因为有「日程冲突」，我只能参加会议的前半段。

words.enDefinition: to tell your workplace that you are ill and cannot come in to work

examples.en: I had to call in sick before the library desk opened on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一图书馆柜台开门前，我得「打电话请病假」。

examples.en: The handbook lists the number to use if you need to call in sick.
examples.zh: 手册列出了需要「打电话请病假」时该拨的号码。

collocations: call in sick for a shift
call in sick at short notice

words.enDefinition: a quick test to verify that a camera works and the video is framed suitably

examples.en: I did a camera check before starting the recorded presentation on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我开始用笔记本录演示前，做了一次「摄像头测试」。

examples.en: The camera check showed that the light behind me made my face too dark.
examples.zh: 「摄像头测试」发现，我身后的灯让脸显得太暗。

words.enDefinition: A college service listing jobs for students

examples.en: The campus job board had even more listings when the new term began.
examples.zh: 新学期开始时，「校园招聘信息板」上的职位比之前还多。

examples.en: My roommate found the weekend library role on the campus job board.
examples.zh: 我室友在「校园招聘信息板」上找到了这个图书馆的周末岗位。

collocations: post on the campus job board

words.enDefinition: Someone who recruits students through university events

examples.en: A campus recruiter from the museum explained which sites were easiest to reach by bus.
examples.zh: 博物馆的一位「校园招聘人员」介绍了哪些场馆坐公交最方便到达。

examples.en: My classmate met a campus recruiter who also studied in our department years ago.
examples.zh: 我同学见到了一位「校园招聘人员」，对方多年前也在我们系读过书。

collocations: a campus recruiter visits a university

words.enDefinition: Recruitment aimed at students through a university

examples.en: The company usually starts campus recruitment when students return for the autumn term.
examples.zh: 学生秋季学期返校时，那家公司通常开始「校园招聘」。

examples.en: I first heard of that publisher because it took part in campus recruitment last year.
examples.zh: 我最早知道那家出版社，是因为它去年参加了「校园招聘」。

words.expression: can we keep the original time
words.lemma: can we keep the original time
words.zhGloss: 我们能保留原来的时间吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether the time already arranged can stay the same
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们能保留原来的时间吗
acceptedEnVariants: can we keep the original time

examples.en: Can we keep the original time if we just switch from video to phone?
examples.zh: 如果只是把视频通话换成电话，「我们能保留原来的时间吗」？

examples.en: My lab was postponed, so can we keep the original time for our call?
examples.zh: 我的实验课推迟了，「我们能保留原来的通话时间吗」？

collocations: can we keep the original time on Friday?
can we keep the original time for now?
in that case, can we keep the original time?

words.enDefinition: A login used to access a recruitment portal

examples.en: I created a candidate account to apply for the job at the museum.
examples.zh: 我注册了一个「求职者账户」，用来申请博物馆的工作。

examples.en: Can I use the same candidate account for openings at both university libraries?
examples.zh: 我能用同一个「求职者账户」申请两家大学图书馆的职位吗？

collocations: sign in to a candidate account

words.enDefinition: A page summarizing a candidate's applications and tasks

examples.en: The candidate dashboard showed a request for one more document when I logged in.
examples.zh: 我登录后，「求职申请总览」提示还需要补交一份材料。

examples.en: I checked my candidate dashboard to make sure both roles were listed there.
examples.zh: 我查看了「求职申请总览」，确认两个职位都列在上面。

collocations: a notification on the candidate dashboard

words.enDefinition: A website where applicants manage their applications

examples.en: The candidate portal shows all the applications I started with the same employer.
examples.zh: 「求职申请门户」列出了我向同一家雇主发起的所有申请。

examples.en: I signed in to the candidate portal to check whether my attachment appeared.
examples.zh: 我登录「求职申请门户」，看看附件有没有显示出来。

collocations: log in to the candidate portal

words.enDefinition: The applicant details saved in a recruitment system

examples.en: My candidate profile still shows the email address I used before graduation.
examples.zh: 我的「求职者资料」里还是毕业前用的电子邮箱地址。

examples.en: I updated my candidate profile before opening a new application at the same university.
examples.zh: 在同一所大学发起新申请之前，我先更新了「求职者资料」。

words.enDefinition: A US extension bridging certain F-1 and H-1B transition periods

examples.en: The adviser explained what the cap-gap extension referred to in my notice.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了我的通知里「美国身份衔接延长」指什么。

examples.en: I asked whether the cap-gap extension was recorded in my latest school document.
examples.zh: 我问我最新的校方文件是否记录了「美国身份衔接延长」。

collocations: period covered by a cap-gap extension

words.enDefinition: estimating available time or resources and deciding how to use them for expected work

examples.en: The team used capacity planning to prepare for longer opening hours during exams.
examples.zh: 团队通过「人力与工作量规划」为考试期间延长开放时间做准备。

examples.en: During capacity planning, we checked whether everyone could work their usual shifts.
examples.zh: 进行「人力与工作量规划」时，我们核实每个人能不能上平时的班。

collocations: use capacity planning for busy periods

words.enDefinition: The kinds of work or achievements someone hopes for long term

examples.en: My career aspirations changed after I worked on a student outreach project.
examples.zh: 参加学生推广项目之后，我的「职业抱负」变了。

examples.en: The interview gave me a chance to explain my career aspirations in education.
examples.zh: 面试给了我机会说明自己在教育领域的「职业抱负」。

words.enDefinition: A tool exploring interests and strengths related to work

examples.en: I took a career assessment before choosing which employer events to attend that term.
examples.zh: 决定那学期参加哪些雇主活动之前，我做了一次「职业方向测评」。

examples.en: The careers adviser asked what I thought of the results from my career assessment.
examples.zh: 就业顾问问我对「职业方向测评」的结果有什么想法。

words.enDefinition: Learning about possible fields and types of work

examples.en: I used the first semester for career exploration while I tried different electives.
examples.zh: 我第一学期一边试着上不同的选修课，一边「探索职业方向」。

examples.en: The careers office set up a series of career exploration talks for first-year students.
examples.zh: 就业办公室为大一学生办了一系列「职业方向探索」讲座。

words.enDefinition: An event where job seekers meet employers

examples.en: I took the early bus so I could visit the career fair before class.
examples.zh: 我搭了早班公交，好在上课前先去逛「招聘会」。

examples.en: The career fair brought employers from the city and several neighbouring towns to campus.
examples.zh: 「招聘会」把本市和周边几个小镇的雇主请到了校园。

words.enDefinition: Areas of work a person finds appealing

examples.en: I wrote down my career interests before meeting the adviser at the student centre.
examples.zh: 去学生中心见顾问之前，我先写下了自己的「职业兴趣」。

examples.en: My career interests changed after I spent a semester working at the gallery.
examples.zh: 在美术馆工作了一个学期后，我的「职业兴趣」变了。

words.enDefinition: A short statement describing the work an applicant seeks

examples.en: I rewrote my career objective to name the kind of internship I wanted.
examples.zh: 我重写了「求职目标」，明确写出我想找哪类实习。

examples.en: Her career objective helped the reader understand why she was applying to a museum.
examples.zh: 她的「求职目标」让读者明白她为什么要申请博物馆的职位。

words.enDefinition: A group discussion where speakers share career experience

examples.en: The career panel included a librarian, a local journalist and two recent graduates.
examples.zh: 参加「职业经验交流座谈会」的有一位图书管理员、一位本地记者和两位应届毕业生。

examples.en: I asked a question at the career panel about moving between museums and galleries.
examples.zh: 我在「职业经验交流座谈会」上问了一个关于在博物馆和美术馆之间换工作的问题。

words.enDefinition: The direction a person's working life takes

examples.en: The speaker described her career path from campus radio to a local news station.
examples.zh: 演讲者介绍了她从校园广播电台到本地新闻台的「职业发展道路」。

examples.en: I spoke to two graduates who had taken a completely different career path.
examples.zh: 我和两位走上截然不同的「职业发展道路」的毕业生聊过。

words.enDefinition: a route through roles and experiences towards a career aim

examples.en: My placement supervisor showed me a career pathway from cataloging work into museum conservation.
examples.zh: 实习带教老师给我介绍了一条「职业发展路径」，可以从编目工作转向博物馆文物保护。

examples.en: I compared each career pathway after hearing how the graduates moved between teams over time.
examples.zh: 听过毕业生后来如何在几个团队之间调动后，我比较了各条「职业发展路径」。

words.enDefinition: A deliberate move into a different kind of work

examples.en: My mentor talked about her career pivot from book design to museum education.
examples.zh: 我的导师谈到她从书籍设计转向博物馆教育的「职业转向」。

examples.en: I wanted to hear how graduates managed a career pivot after their first job.
examples.zh: 我想听听毕业生在第一份工作之后是怎么完成「职业转向」的。

words.enDefinition: An employer's web page showing job opportunities

examples.en: The careers page listed a new library role that hadn't appeared elsewhere yet.
examples.zh: 「雇主招聘网页」列出了一个其他网站还没发布的图书馆新岗位。

examples.en: I saved the careers page to check for summer openings again next week.
examples.zh: 我收藏了「雇主招聘网页」，下周想再找找有没有新的暑期岗位。

words.zhGloss: 把未休假期结转到下一期
words.enDefinition: To move unused leave into a later period
acceptedZhAnswers: 把未休假期结转到下一期

examples.en: I asked whether staff could carry over leave from one year to the next.
examples.zh: 我问员工能不能「把未休假期结转到下一年」。

examples.en: The policy explained when we could carry over leave that we hadn't been able to use.
examples.zh: 政策介绍了什么时候可以「把没能休的假期结转到下一期」。

collocations: be allowed to carry over leave
carry over leave into the next year

words.enDefinition: a conversation that examines one particular situation as a learning exercise

examples.en: The tutor used a fictional example from community work to start our case discussion.
examples.zh: 导师用了社区工作中一个虚构的例子，开始了我们的「案例讨论」。

examples.en: Our case discussion focused on how the fictional team had communicated about its decisions.
examples.zh: 我们的「案例讨论」着重分析了虚构团队在作出决定时是怎么沟通的。

words.enDefinition: an organized set of questions or categories used to analyze a case

examples.en: I suggested a case framework organized around demand, capacity and the available budget.
examples.zh: 我提出了一套「案例分析框架」，从需求、运力和可用预算三个方面分析。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to adapt the case framework to the information provided.
examples.zh: 导师让我根据给出的信息调整「案例分析框架」。

words.enDefinition: an interview in which a candidate analyzes a scenario and explains their reasoning to an interviewer

examples.en: The case interview asked me to estimate demand for an evening campus shuttle.
examples.zh: 「案例面试」让我估算校园夜间接驳车的需求。

examples.en: I practised a case interview with another student who was applying for consulting placements.
examples.zh: 我和另一名也在申请咨询岗位实习的同学一起练习了「案例面试」。

words.enDefinition: the documents, figures or other evidence supplied for a case exercise

examples.en: The case materials included a map and last year's travel survey results.
examples.zh: 「案例资料」包括一张地图和去年的出行调查结果。

examples.en: I highlighted two figures in the case materials before presenting my recommendation.
examples.zh: 给出建议之前，我在「案例资料」里标出了两个数字。

words.enDefinition: the description of the situation or question to analyze in a case exercise

examples.en: I read the case prompt again to check which city the example used.
examples.zh: 我又读了一遍「案例题目」，确认示例设在哪个城市。

examples.en: The case prompt asked us to consider both cost and access for students.
examples.zh: 「案例题目」要求同时考虑学生的费用和使用便利性。

words.zhGloss: 无持续聘用承诺的用工
words.enDefinition: an Australian employment category without a guarantee of ongoing work
acceptedZhAnswers: 无持续聘用承诺的用工

examples.en: The Australian stadium advertised casual employment for people who could take shifts on match days.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这家体育场招能在比赛日上班的员工，采用「无持续聘用承诺的用工」。

examples.en: At the Australian museum, I asked how shifts were offered under its casual employment arrangement.
examples.zh: 我在澳大利亚那家博物馆问了，这种「无持续聘用承诺的用工」是怎么安排班次的。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚随需用工说明
words.enDefinition: An Australian document explaining rules and entitlements for casual employees
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚随需用工说明

examples.en: The Australian employer listed the Casual Employment Information Statement separately from the staff handbook.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这家雇主把「澳大利亚随需用工说明」和员工手册分开列出。

examples.en: I found the Casual Employment Information Statement in the folder for casual employees.
examples.zh: 我在临时用工人员的文件夹中找到了「澳大利亚随需用工说明」。

collocations: provide the Casual Employment Information Statement
read the Casual Employment Information Statement
a copy of the Casual Employment Information Statement

words.zhGloss: 英国工作签证担保证明
words.enDefinition: An electronic reference record used for sponsored work visa applications in Britain
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国工作签证担保证明

examples.en: The UK employer checked the job details on the Certificate of Sponsorship.
examples.zh: 英国雇主核对了「英国工作签证担保证明」上的岗位信息。

examples.en: I asked which reference number belonged to the Certificate of Sponsorship in the email.
examples.zh: 我问邮件里的哪个编号对应「英国工作签证担保证明」。

collocations: the Certificate of Sponsorship reference number
details on a Certificate of Sponsorship

words.enDefinition: the hierarchy through which authority and instructions pass in an organization

examples.en: The handbook explained where the shift supervisor sat in the chain of command.
examples.zh: 手册解释了班次主管在「逐级汇报体系」中的位置。

examples.en: I checked the chain of command before forwarding the issue to the department manager.
examples.zh: 把问题转给部门经理前，我查了「逐级汇报体系」。

collocations: go through the chain of command

words.enDefinition: The maximum number of characters allowed

examples.en: I shortened my answer because the application box had a character limit of five hundred.
examples.zh: 申请里的答题框「最多允许输入五百个字符」，所以我缩短了回答。

examples.en: The character limit includes spaces on this form, according to the note below the box.
examples.zh: 按输入框下方的说明，这份表单的「字符数限制」把空格也算在内。

words.enDefinition: A statement from someone describing another person's conduct or trustworthiness

examples.en: My volunteering coordinator offered to write a character reference for the placement.
examples.zh: 我的志愿活动协调员主动提出为这份实习写一封「品行推荐信」。

examples.en: The character reference described how I had worked with younger students.
examples.zh: 「品行推荐信」说了我过去怎样与低年级学生相处。

words.enDefinition: to find out when someone or something is free for use or an event

examples.en: I offered to check availability for everyone before booking the meeting room.
examples.zh: 订会议室之前，我主动帮大家「核实空闲时间」。

examples.en: We had to check availability because some team members worked only on weekends.
examples.zh: 有些成员只在周末上班，所以我们得「核实空闲时间」。

words.enDefinition: to contact your manager briefly to share an update, ask something or confirm a plan

examples.en: You can check in with your manager before changing the reception schedule.
examples.zh: 调整接待排班前，你可以先「找主管简短沟通」。

examples.en: The handbook says to check in with your manager at the start of training.
examples.zh: 手册说，培训开始时应该「找主管简短沟通」。

collocations: check in with your manager regularly
check in with your manager about a change
remember to check in with your manager

words.enDefinition: To select a particular event that relates directly to the topic

examples.en: I took a moment to choose a relevant example before answering the question about teamwork.
examples.zh: 回答团队合作的问题前，我花了点时间「选择相关例子」。

examples.en: The worksheet helped me choose a relevant example from three different jobs I had held.
examples.zh: 这张练习表帮我「选择相关例子」，有三份做过的工作可供选择。

collocations: choose a relevant example from your experience
choose a relevant example for each question
take time to choose a relevant example

words.enDefinition: to send a meeting's written record to the people who need it

examples.en: The chair asked me to circulate the minutes once she had checked them.
examples.zh: 主持人请我等她核对完再「分发会议纪要」。

examples.en: I waited until Friday to circulate the minutes because two names needed correcting.
examples.zh: 有两个人的名字要改，所以我等到周五才「分发会议纪要」。

words.enDefinition: to make it clear which tasks should be handled first or given most attention

examples.en: I asked the coordinator to clarify priorities before assigning tasks to volunteers.
examples.zh: 给志愿者分任务之前，我请协调员「明确优先顺序」。

examples.en: We used the meeting to clarify priorities after the delivery date moved.
examples.zh: 交付日期调整后，我们通过开会「明确优先顺序」。

words.enDefinition: to check what limits or requirements apply before proceeding with work

examples.en: I asked about the dataset size to clarify the constraints before writing code.
examples.zh: 写代码前我先问数据集有多大，以「确认限制条件」。

examples.en: The candidate took a moment to clarify the constraints with the panel.
examples.zh: 应聘者花了一点时间向评审组「确认限制条件」。

collocations: ask questions to clarify the constraints
clarify the constraints with the interviewer

words.enDefinition: To explain what the conditions or details mean

examples.en: I asked the manager to clarify the terms because the schedule mentioned two different sites.
examples.zh: 排班表提到了两个地点，所以我请经理「澄清条款」。

examples.en: Could you clarify the terms for taking leave during the first month of work?
examples.zh: 您能把第一个月的请假「条款澄清一下」吗？

collocations: ask someone to clarify the terms
clarify the terms of an offer

words.enDefinition: Short advertisements grouped by subject in a publication

examples.en: My neighbour found the café opening in the classified ads of the local paper.
examples.zh: 我邻居在当地报纸的「分类广告」里看到了咖啡店招人。

examples.en: The shop in the classified ads was just around the corner from our flat.
examples.zh: 「分类广告」里那家店就在我们公寓附近的拐角处。

collocations: find a job in the classified ads

words.enDefinition: a driving history without relevant violations or serious incidents

examples.en: The delivery listing asks for a clean driving record, so I checked what they meant.
examples.zh: 送货岗位的招聘启事要求「无不良驾驶记录」，所以我去问了具体指什么。

examples.en: I asked how the employer defined a clean driving record before filling in the form.
examples.zh: 填表前，我问雇主怎么定义「无不良驾驶记录」。

collocations: show proof of a clean driving record

words.enDefinition: easy to understand and expressed without unnecessary words

examples.en: The reviewer said my opening was clear and concise after I cut the background details.
examples.zh: 我删去背景细节后，审阅人说我的开头「清楚简洁」。

examples.en: I tried to keep the project summary clear and concise for the hiring team.
examples.zh: 我尽量把给招聘团队看的项目摘要写得「清楚简洁」。

collocations: keep the wording clear and concise
make your answers clear and concise

words.enDefinition: a project that involves communicating directly with a client

examples.en: The client-facing project gave me practice explaining design choices to people outside our team.
examples.zh: 这个「直接对接客户的项目」让我练习了向团队以外的人解释设计选择。

examples.en: My mentor prepared me for the first meeting on the client-facing project at the studio.
examples.zh: 我在工作室做「直接对接客户的项目」，导师帮我准备了第一次会议。

words.enDefinition: work completed for a real client who has requested or commissioned it

examples.en: I asked the studio before adding any client work to my public portfolio.
examples.zh: 在公开作品集里放「为客户做的项目」之前，我先问了工作室。

examples.en: The portfolio separates client work from the projects I completed for class.
examples.zh: 作品集把「为客户做的项目」与课程项目分开列出了。

words.enDefinition: a supervised period of learning in a clinical setting

examples.en: My clinical placement was based at a hospital, and my tutor checked in each week.
examples.zh: 我的「临床实习」在医院，导师每周都会跟进情况。

examples.en: The university let me know which site would host my second clinical placement.
examples.zh: 学校告诉我第二段「临床实习」由哪个机构接收。

collocations: a clinical placement at a hospital

words.enDefinition: a practitioner who guides a learner during a clinical placement

examples.en: My clinical preceptor in Canada met me at reception and showed me the team's office.
examples.zh: 我在加拿大的「临床实习带教老师」在前台接我，带我看了团队的办公室。

examples.en: The clinical preceptor set aside time to talk about what I had learned that week.
examples.zh: 「临床实习带教老师」专门留了点时间，和我聊这一周学到了什么。

words.enDefinition: a period of supervised training in a particular clinical service

examples.en: I checked where to meet my supervisor before the clinical rotation began on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一「临床轮转」开始前，我确认了在哪里和带教老师碰面。

examples.en: My next clinical rotation is at a different hospital on the same bus route.
examples.zh: 我下一段「临床轮转」在另一家医院，还是坐同一条公交线。

collocations: a clinical rotation at a hospital

words.enDefinition: the final slide in a presentation, often used to recap or invite questions

examples.en: The closing slide listed two findings and invited the panel to ask questions.
examples.zh: 「结尾幻灯片」列了两项发现，还请评审组提问。

examples.en: I added my contact details to the closing slide before exporting the file.
examples.zh: 导出文件前，我把联系方式放在了「结尾幻灯片」上。

words.zhGloss: 合作教育的工学交替顺序
words.enDefinition: the order of study and work terms in a co-op degree
acceptedZhAnswers: 合作教育的工学交替顺序

examples.en: My Canadian university's co-op sequence puts a work term just before the final study term.
examples.zh: 按我在加拿大那所大学的「工学交替顺序」，最后一个学习学期之前紧接着一个工作期。

examples.en: I checked my co-op sequence to see whether I would be working during the winter.
examples.zh: 我查了自己的「工学交替顺序」，看冬天是不是安排了工作。

words.enDefinition: a student who alternates academic study with work placements

examples.en: As a co-op student in Canada, I returned to classes after working at the archive.
examples.zh: 在加拿大作为「参加合作教育的学生」，我在档案馆工作一段时间后就回去上课了。

examples.en: The library hired a co-op student to help its publications team during the work term.
examples.zh: 图书馆招了一位「参加合作教育的学生」，在工作期内协助出版团队。

words.enDefinition: a period spent working within a cooperative education program

examples.en: During my first co-op term in Canada, I joined a small team at a public library.
examples.zh: 在加拿大的第一个「合作教育工作期」，我加入了公共图书馆的一个小团队。

examples.en: My next co-op term starts in May, so I'll return to lectures in September.
examples.zh: 我的下一个「合作教育工作期」五月开始，所以九月再回来上课。

words.enDefinition: A Canadian permit for certain approved study program placements

examples.en: The Canadian adviser explained why an older guide mentioned a co-op work permit.
examples.zh: 加拿大的顾问解释了旧版指南为什么提到「加拿大课程实习工签」。

examples.en: I compared an older co-op work permit with the current student placement guidance.
examples.zh: 我把以前的「加拿大课程实习工签」与现在的学生实习指南作了对照。

collocations: a copy of a co-op work permit
conditions on a co-op work permit

words.enDefinition: a small placeholder for a program part whose full behaviour is not implemented yet

examples.en: I replaced the code stub with a function that returned the required result.
examples.zh: 我把「代码桩」替换成了一个能返回所需结果的函数。

examples.en: The editor included a code stub showing the expected parameters and return type.
examples.zh: 编辑器里有一个「代码桩」，显示了预期的参数和返回类型。

words.enDefinition: a guided explanation of how a program or change works

examples.en: I used the code walkthrough to explain where each input value was handled.
examples.zh: 我在「代码流程讲解」里说明了每个输入值会在哪里处理。

examples.en: The interviewer asked me to start the code walkthrough at the main function.
examples.zh: 面试官请我从主函数开始做「代码流程讲解」。

words.enDefinition: the software and settings in which a person writes or runs code

examples.en: The instructions listed the programming languages available in the coding environment for the test.
examples.zh: 说明列出了测验的「编程运行环境」支持哪些编程语言。

examples.en: I opened the coding environment early to check that the sample program would run.
examples.zh: 我提前打开了「编程运行环境」，确认示例程序能运行。

words.enDefinition: a task requiring someone to write or modify a program to practise or demonstrate a skill

examples.en: I worked through a coding exercise about grouping survey responses by date.
examples.zh: 我做了一道「编程练习题」，把调查回答按日期分组。

examples.en: The coding exercise asked us to read a list and return one number.
examples.zh: 这道「编程练习题」让我们读取一个列表并返回一个数字。

words.enDefinition: To work jointly with people who belong to different teams

examples.en: Our final project taught me to collaborate across teams without losing track of individual tasks.
examples.zh: 结课项目让我学会了「开展跨团队协作」，同时照看好各自任务。

examples.en: The placement gave me opportunities to collaborate across teams during two campus events.
examples.zh: 这次实习让我在两场校园活动中有机会「开展跨团队协作」。

collocations: collaborate across teams on a project

words.enDefinition: A labor agreement negotiated between an employer and workers' representatives

examples.en: The Canadian campus office explained which collective agreement applied to student staff.
examples.zh: 加拿大这所学校的办公室说明了学生员工适用的是哪份「集体劳动协议」。

examples.en: My supervisor pointed to the scheduling section in the collective agreement.
examples.zh: 主管指给我看「集体劳动协议」里关于排班的章节。

words.enDefinition: A document featuring grouped skills and a dated employment history

examples.en: The combination resume opens with skill highlights and then lists my recent jobs.
examples.zh: 「混合型简历」先突出我的技能，再列出近期工作经历。

examples.en: The adviser showed me a combination resume with a short skills section above the dated roles.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了一份「混合型简历」，上面简列技能，下面按日期列出各个职位。

words.enDefinition: set at a level that reflects someone's experience

examples.en: The listing says pay is commensurate with experience, but it doesn't give a figure.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着薪酬「与经验相匹配」，但没给具体数字。

examples.en: We discussed what pay commensurate with experience meant for applicants who were changing careers.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了对转行求职的人来说，薪酬「与经验相匹配」具体是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: people's preferred ways and times for sending or receiving work messages
