examples.en: I checked everyone's communication preferences before sharing the handover notes with the team.
examples.zh: 把交接记录发给团队前，我先核实了每个人的「沟通方式偏好」。

examples.en: Our new supervisor asked us about communication preferences at the first team meeting.
examples.zh: 新主管在第一次团队会议上问了我们的「沟通方式偏好」。

words.enDefinition: An employer-provided benefit for travel to work

examples.en: The benefits guide listed a commuter benefit that covered part of my bus pass.
examples.zh: 福利指南列了一项可以负担部分公交月票费用的「通勤福利」。

examples.en: I asked whether the commuter benefit would still apply if I changed my work location.
examples.zh: 我问如果换了工作地点，「通勤福利」是否仍然适用。

collocations: sign up for a commuter benefit

words.enDefinition: A distance that can reasonably be traveled to work

examples.en: I wanted to find work within commuting distance of the flat I had just rented.
examples.zh: 我想找一份从刚租的公寓出发「可以通勤」的工作。

examples.en: Only two of the campus bookshops were within commuting distance of my new place.
examples.zh: 我从新住处出发，只有两家校园书店在「可通勤距离」内。

words.enDefinition: The shared habits and values of a workplace

examples.en: The graduates on the panel described the company culture at two very different studios.
examples.zh: 参加交流会的毕业生介绍了两家很不一样的工作室各自的「公司文化」。

examples.en: I asked about company culture because I wanted to know how the staff worked together.
examples.zh: 我问了「公司文化」，因为我想知道那里的员工是怎么合作的。

words.enDefinition: The purpose an organization says it serves

examples.en: The company mission was explained on the first page of the studio's booklet.
examples.zh: 工作室的宣传册在第一页介绍了「公司使命」。

examples.en: I wanted to know whether the company mission had changed after the merger last year.
examples.zh: 我想知道去年合并后，「公司使命」有没有改变。

words.enDefinition: Recent developments that an organization makes public

examples.en: I checked the company news for updates about the studio before attending its open day.
examples.zh: 去参加工作室的开放日之前，我看了「企业近况」，了解它的最新动态。

examples.en: The company news on the website included plans to open an office near campus.
examples.zh: 网站上的「企业近况」提到，他们计划在学校附近开设办公点。

words.enDefinition: An event where a company welcomes visitors inside

examples.en: We signed up for the company open house after meeting its staff at the fair.
examples.zh: 在招聘会上见过那家公司的员工后，我们报名参加了「企业开放日」。

examples.en: At the company open house, graduates showed us where they worked and answered questions.
examples.zh: 「企业开放日」上，毕业生带我们参观了他们工作的地方，也回答了问题。

collocations: invitations to a company open house

words.enDefinition: A brief summary of an organization's activities

examples.en: The company overview explained what the studio makes and where its teams are based.
examples.zh: 「公司概况」介绍了工作室制作什么作品，以及它的团队分布在哪里。

examples.en: I read the company overview before joining the firm's online careers session on Friday.
examples.zh: 参加公司周五的线上招聘说明会之前，我先读了「公司概况」。

words.enDefinition: tools or devices supplied by an employer for work

examples.en: The remote role includes company-provided equipment, so I wouldn't need to use my own laptop.
examples.zh: 这个远程岗位有「公司提供的设备」，所以我不用自己的笔记本电脑。

examples.en: I checked whether company-provided equipment included a headset for answering calls from home.
examples.zh: 我查了「公司提供的设备」里有没有用于在家接电话的耳麦。

words.enDefinition: How large an employer is, often measured by staffing

examples.en: The site lets me search by company size as well as by industry.
examples.zh: 这个网站除了能按行业搜索，还能按「公司规模」搜索。

examples.en: Company size mattered to me because I wanted to learn how a small studio operates.
examples.zh: 我在意「公司规模」，因为我想了解小型工作室是怎么运作的。

words.enDefinition: A guided visit to an employer's work premises

examples.en: The company tour included the workshop where they make props for local theatres.
examples.zh: 这次「企业参观活动」包括参观给当地剧院做道具的工坊。

examples.en: I booked the company tour because I wanted to see the studio for myself.
examples.zh: 我预约了「企业参观活动」，因为想亲眼看看那个工作室。

words.enDefinition: Principles an organization says guide its work

examples.en: The website lists the company values beside examples of projects from the past year.
examples.zh: 网站把「公司价值观」和过去一年的项目案例并排列出。

examples.en: I asked how the company values affected the way teams chose new projects.
examples.zh: 我问「公司价值观」是怎么影响团队选择新项目的。

words.enDefinition: to examine the similarities, differences or trade-offs between ways of doing a task

examples.en: The question asked us to compare approaches rather than just give one answer.
examples.zh: 题目要求我们「比较不同解法」，不要只给一个答案。

examples.en: I used the sample data to compare approaches before choosing the simpler one.
examples.zh: 我用示例数据「比较不同解法」，最后选了更简单的一种。

words.enDefinition: An interview assessing specific abilities through evidence from a candidate's experience

examples.en: Each question in the competency-based interview focused on a skill from the job description.
examples.zh: 这场「胜任力面试」的每道题都围绕职位描述中的一项能力。

examples.en: The workshop used a competency-based interview to assess teamwork and communication separately.
examples.zh: 讲座通过「胜任力面试」分别评估团队合作和沟通能力。

words.enDefinition: A question designed to assess a particular job-related ability

examples.en: The competency-based question on planning asked how I had managed several deadlines.
examples.zh: 那道关于规划能力的「胜任力面试题」问我怎样兼顾多个截止日期。

examples.en: I chose an example from the lab for the competency-based question on communication.
examples.zh: 回答有关沟通能力的「胜任力面试题」时，我选了实验室里的一个例子。

words.enDefinition: a list of abilities someone needs to demonstrate

examples.en: The competency checklist helped me see which tasks I still needed to practise on placement.
examples.zh: 「能力核查清单」让我看出实习中还有哪些任务需要练习。

examples.en: My supervisor updated the competency checklist after watching me explain the new filing system.
examples.zh: 带教老师听我讲解了新归档系统后，更新了「能力核查清单」。

collocations: tick items on a competency checklist

words.enDefinition: an organized description of the abilities expected in a role or program

examples.en: The competency framework showed which skills the program expected us to develop during each rotation.
examples.zh: 「能力框架」列出了项目希望我们在每轮轮岗中培养的技能。

examples.en: I checked the competency framework before choosing a project with the museum's visitor team.
examples.zh: 和博物馆访客服务团队选定一个项目前，我查了「能力框架」。

words.enDefinition: a difference between someone's current abilities and the abilities required

examples.en: My supervisor pointed out a competency gap that I could work on during the placement.
examples.zh: 带教老师指出了一处我可以在实习期间弥补的「岗位能力差距」。

examples.en: We added a workshop to address a competency gap across the new trainee group.
examples.zh: 我们增设了一场工作坊，弥补这批新培训生普遍存在的「岗位能力差距」。

words.enDefinition: formal approval that someone has demonstrated a required ability

examples.en: The placement office asked where my competency sign-off was recorded in the online system.
examples.zh: 实习办公室问，网上系统的哪个位置记录了我的「能力达标确认」。

examples.en: I asked my supervisor what evidence she needed for the competency sign-off at our review.
examples.zh: 我问带教老师，回顾评审时「能力达标确认」需要什么证据。

words.enDefinition: A different offer that the same candidate is considering

examples.en: I mentioned the competing offer when the library asked how soon I could decide.
examples.zh: 图书馆问我多快能决定时，我提到了「另一份录用通知」。

examples.en: The theatre's offer deadline was earlier than the one on my competing offer.
examples.zh: 剧院录用通知的回复截止时间比「我收到的另一份录用通知」更早。

words.enDefinition: pay presented as matching or exceeding pay for similar jobs

examples.en: The advert promises a competitive salary without giving an amount for the weekend role.
examples.zh: 招聘启事说周末岗位提供「有竞争力的薪资」，但没写具体金额。

examples.en: I wanted to know what a competitive salary meant for an assistant in this area.
examples.zh: 我想了解在这一带，助理拿多少才算「有竞争力的薪资」。

collocations: a competitive salary for the role

words.enDefinition: To bring information together and organize it into one document

examples.en: I helped compile a report using figures supplied by four departments on campus.
examples.zh: 我利用校内四个部门提供的数据协助「汇编报告」。

examples.en: My CV describes how I learned to compile a report from interviews and observation notes.
examples.zh: 我的简历写了我如何学会利用访谈内容和观察记录「汇编报告」。

collocations: compile a report from survey responses
compile a report for a supervisor

words.enDefinition: an error a compiler detects while translating source code

examples.en: The compile error pointed to a missing bracket on the line above.
examples.zh: 「编译错误」提示，上一行少了一个括号。

examples.en: I fixed the compile error before checking the results with the sample input.
examples.zh: 我先修复「编译错误」，再用示例输入核对结果。

words.enDefinition: finish one planned period of work in a training program

examples.en: I'll complete a rotation in the archives before I move to the exhibitions team.
examples.zh: 我会先在档案部门「完成一次轮岗」，再去展览团队。

examples.en: We each had to complete a rotation at the main branch before choosing another site.
examples.zh: 我们每个人都得先在主分馆「完成一次轮岗」，再选择其他地点。

words.enDefinition: a drawing showing system components and how they relate or connect

examples.en: The component diagram separated the data storage from the part users interacted with.
examples.zh: 「组件图」把数据存储与用户操作的部分分开画了。

examples.en: I added labels to the component diagram so the interviewer could follow each connection.
examples.zh: 我给「组件图」加了标签，方便面试官理解每一条连线。

words.enDefinition: to reduce the amount of storage space taken up by a PDF document

examples.en: I had to compress a PDF before the application portal would accept it.
examples.zh: 我得先「压缩PDF文件」，申请平台才会接收。

examples.en: I asked how to compress a PDF without making the portfolio images blurry.
examples.zh: 我问如何「压缩PDF文件」，同时让作品集图片保持清晰。

collocations: use a tool to compress a PDF

words.enDefinition: the ability to use common computers and software confidently

examples.en: The job asks for computer literacy because orders are entered on a desktop computer.
examples.zh: 这份工作需要「基本计算机使用能力」，因为订单要在台式电脑上录入。

examples.en: I checked whether computer literacy meant using specialized programs or just everyday office software.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，「基本计算机使用能力」是指会用专业程序，还是会用常用办公软件就行。

words.enDefinition: A response that states the main point in few words

examples.en: I gave a concise answer about my coursework before moving to my project.
examples.zh: 我对课程作了「简明回答」，然后谈到自己的项目。

examples.en: The adviser helped me turn a long explanation into a concise answer.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我把一段冗长的解释改成了「简明回答」。

words.enDefinition: A talk or formal presentation given at an academic or professional conference

examples.en: I put the title of my conference presentation below the name of the meeting.
examples.zh: 我把「会议报告」的标题写在会议名称下方。

examples.en: The academic CV listed my conference presentation alongside a link to the abstract.
examples.zh: 学术履历列出了我的「会议报告」，还附上摘要链接。

words.enDefinition: an example of work containing information that may be shared only with authorization

examples.en: I asked my supervisor before showing a confidential work sample to the recruiter.
examples.zh: 把「保密作品样本」给招聘人员看之前，我先问了主管。

examples.en: The employer offered to accept a different example instead of the confidential work sample.
examples.zh: 雇主表示可以收另一份样本，用来替代这份「保密作品样本」。

collocations: permission to share a confidential work sample

words.enDefinition: An agreement requiring someone to protect specified information from disclosure

examples.en: The confidentiality agreement described the kinds of student information we would handle.
examples.zh: 「保密协议」说明了我们会接触哪些类型的学生信息。

examples.en: I asked whether the confidentiality agreement covered work that I did at home.
examples.zh: 我问「保密协议」是否也适用于我在家处理的工作。

words.enDefinition: To record an agreement or detail in writing

examples.en: The manager offered to confirm in writing that I could keep my Wednesday class.
examples.zh: 经理说可以「书面确认」我能继续上周三的课。

examples.en: Could you confirm in writing which branch I'll be working at during the summer?
examples.zh: 您能「以书面形式确认」我暑假要去哪家分店上班吗？

collocations: ask someone to confirm in writing

words.enDefinition: To approve sending an application when prompted

examples.en: The portal asked me to confirm submission after I checked the name and job title.
examples.zh: 我核对姓名和职位名称后，门户让我「确认提交」。

examples.en: Do I need to confirm submission again after going back to change one answer?
examples.zh: 返回去修改一个答案之后，我需要再次「确认提交」吗？

words.enDefinition: says an event has been firmly arranged for a given time

examples.en: Your call is confirmed for Tuesday at noon, and the coordinator will ring you.
examples.zh: 你的通话「已确认安排在周二中午」，协调员会打给你。

examples.en: I checked whether the chat was confirmed for Friday before swapping my library shift.
examples.zh: 我先查了这次聊天是不是「已确认安排在周五」，才调了图书馆的班。

collocations: confirmed for two in the afternoon

words.enDefinition: A statement revealing interests that could affect impartiality

examples.en: The museum asked for a conflict-of-interest disclosure from everyone applying to join the project.
examples.zh: 博物馆要求每位申请加入项目的人填写「利益冲突申报」。

examples.en: I checked the instructions beside the conflict-of-interest disclosure before completing that section of the form.
examples.zh: 填写表单那一栏之前，我看了「利益冲突申报」旁边的说明。

words.enDefinition: Rules for identifying and handling situations where interests may compete

examples.en: The conflict of interest policy included an example about working for two student clubs.
examples.zh: 「利益冲突政策」举了一个同时为两个学生社团工作的例子。

examples.en: I asked the supervisor which section of the conflict of interest policy covered outside work.
examples.zh: 我请主管指出「利益冲突政策」里哪一节讲外部兼职。

collocations: read the conflict of interest policy
follow a conflict of interest policy
review the conflict of interest policy

words.enDefinition: Important tasks competing for the same limited time or resources

examples.en: I used a campus project to explain how I managed conflicting priorities.
examples.zh: 我用一个校内项目来说明自己如何处理「互相冲突的优先事项」。

examples.en: The question about conflicting priorities involved deadlines from two different departments.
examples.zh: 有关「互相冲突的优先事项」的题目涉及两个不同院系的截止时间。

words.enDefinition: a test to confirm that an online connection can support a call or task

examples.en: I ran a connection check before opening the link for the technical interview.
examples.zh: 打开技术面试链接前，我做了「连接测试」。

examples.en: The connection check kept failing until I moved to a room with stronger Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 我换到无线网信号更好的房间后，「连接测试」才通过。

words.enDefinition: Permission for an organization to handle personal information

examples.en: The form asked for consent to data processing before I entered my employment history.
examples.zh: 我填工作经历之前，表单要求我「同意处理个人数据」。

examples.en: The consent to data processing was recorded on the last page of my application.
examples.zh: 我的申请最后一页记录了「个人数据处理授权」。

words.enDefinition: to review my application and decide whether it should progress

examples.en: I thanked the hiring team for taking the time to consider my application.
examples.zh: 我感谢招聘团队抽出时间「考虑我的申请」。

examples.en: I asked whether they could still consider my application for the autumn intake.
examples.zh: 我问对方是否还能为秋季招聘批次「考虑我的申请」。

collocations: take time to consider my application

words.enDefinition: The same visual rules applied throughout all parts of a document

examples.en: The reviewer checked for consistent formatting after I added a second page.
examples.zh: 我加了第二页后，审阅者检查了是否采用「一致的格式」。

examples.en: I used consistent formatting for locations and dates across the whole document.
examples.zh: 我让整份文件的地点和日期都采用「一致的格式」。

words.enDefinition: A document adding terms or information to an existing agreement

examples.en: The contract addendum included a list of sites where I might work.
examples.zh: 「合同补充文件」列出了我可能工作的地点。

examples.en: I checked whether the contract addendum was included in the latest folder.
examples.zh: 我检查了最新的文件夹里有没有「合同补充文件」。

words.enDefinition: A formal change to one or more terms of a contract

examples.en: The contract amendment changed the office address while keeping my other details.
examples.zh: 「合同修订」更改了办公室地址，保留了我的其他信息。

examples.en: I kept the contract amendment with the original paperwork for my placement.
examples.zh: 我把「合同修订」和原实习文件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: The date an agreement says its term comes to an end

examples.en: My placement letter gave a different contract end date from the project schedule.
examples.zh: 实习通知信上的「合同结束日期」与项目安排不一致。

examples.en: I checked the contract end date before returning the key to the supervisor.
examples.zh: 把钥匙还给主管之前，我核对了「合同结束日期」。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement continuing a contract after its original term ends

examples.en: My manager sent a contract renewal notice after the department reviewed staffing.
examples.zh: 院系核定人员安排后，经理发来一份「合同续签」通知。

examples.en: I asked whether the contract renewal changed the dates on my placement records.
examples.zh: 我问「合同续签」是否改变了实习记录上的日期。

words.enDefinition: The conditions and obligations set out in an agreement

examples.en: I asked which of the contract terms covered evening shifts at the library.
examples.zh: 我问哪条「合同条款」涉及图书馆的晚班。

examples.en: The administrator went through the contract terms that applied to our placement.
examples.zh: 行政人员逐一说明了适用于我们实习的「合同条款」。

words.enDefinition: to help a group accomplish its work or achieve a shared goal

examples.en: I explained how my tutoring experience would let me contribute to the team.
examples.zh: 我说明了自己怎样用辅导经验「为团队出力」。

examples.en: The letter shows how I would contribute to the team during busy weeks.
examples.zh: 信里说明了我会怎样在忙的时候「为团队出力」。

collocations: contribute to the team from day one
be ready to contribute to the team
look for ways to contribute to the team

words.zhGloss: 学习与工作交替的合作教育
words.enDefinition: an educational model alternating academic study with supervised work
acceptedZhAnswers: 学习与工作交替的合作教育

examples.en: I chose cooperative education at my Canadian university because I wanted work experience during my degree.
examples.zh: 我在加拿大上大学时选择了「学习与工作交替的合作教育」，想在读书期间积累工作经验。

examples.en: Our cooperative education adviser showed us when we would be back on campus after working.
examples.zh: 「合作教育」顾问给我们看了工作期结束后返校的时间。

words.enDefinition: To organize tasks and communication across a group

examples.en: Running the campus festival taught me how to coordinate a team during busy shifts.
examples.zh: 在筹办校园节庆活动时，我学会了怎样在忙碌的班次里「协调团队工作」。

examples.en: My CV describes how I helped coordinate a team during our research project.
examples.zh: 我的简历说明了我在科研项目中怎样帮助「协调团队工作」。

words.enDefinition: arrange timing so that different people's plans work together

examples.en: The assistant will coordinate schedules for visiting speakers who come from several different campuses.
examples.zh: 助理要为来自不同校区的外来讲者「协调日程」。

examples.en: The department wants someone to coordinate schedules when two tutorials share the same classroom.
examples.zh: 两个辅导课共用一间教室，院系想找个人来「协调日程」。

words.enDefinition: include me as an additional recipient of an email

examples.en: Please copy me in when you send the manager our new date for Thursday.
examples.zh: 把改到周四的新日期发给经理时，「请把我加到抄送栏」。

examples.en: Could you copy me in on your message to the recruiter about the change?
examples.zh: 给招聘人员发邮件说明变更时，能「把我加到抄送栏」吗？

collocations: copy me in on the reply
copy me in on future emails

words.enDefinition: a block of time when everyone must be working

examples.en: The role has core hours from ten until three, with flexibility on either side.
examples.zh: 这个岗位上午十点到下午三点是「必须在岗的时段」，前后都能灵活安排。

examples.en: I checked whether my Tuesday seminar overlapped with the team's core hours for this position.
examples.zh: 我查了周二的研讨课和这个岗位团队「必须在岗的时段」是否重叠。

words.enDefinition: the part of the day during which staff are expected to be working or available

examples.en: The schedule lists core working hours across the middle of the day.
examples.zh: 排班表把每天中间的一段列为「核心工作时段」。

examples.en: Our team tries to hold shared meetings within the core working hours.
examples.zh: 团队尽量在「核心工作时段」安排大家一起参加的会议。

collocations: be available during core working hours

words.enDefinition: The amount of money saved by making a change

examples.en: My CV mentions the cost savings from switching to reusable materials at club events.
examples.zh: 我的简历提到社团活动改用可重复使用的材料后「节约的开支」。

examples.en: I gave a dollar figure for the cost savings in my project entry.
examples.zh: 我在项目经历里写明了「节约的开支」是多少美元。

words.zhGloss: 我能请你转达个口信吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether someone can pass on a spoken message
acceptedZhAnswers: 我能请你转达个口信吗

examples.en: Could I leave a message for the coordinator if she's away from her desk?
examples.zh: 如果协调员不在工位，「我能请你转达个口信吗」？

examples.en: Could I leave a message with you so the recruiter knows I've called back?
examples.zh: 「我能请你转达个口信吗」？让招聘人员知道我回过电话了。

collocations: could I leave a message for the recruiter?
could I leave a message with you?
if she's away, could I leave a message?

words.zhGloss: 我们可以约在某个时间吗
words.enDefinition: politely proposes a time to try to arrange
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们可以约在某个时间吗

examples.en: Could we aim for Thursday afternoon after the campus careers fair has finished?
examples.zh: 「我们可以把时间定在周四下午吗」？那时校园就业展已经结束了。

examples.en: Could we aim for a little after two so I have time to get home?
examples.zh: 「我们可以把时间定在两点过一点吗」？这样我就来得及回家。

collocations: could we aim for the afternoon?
could we aim for next week?
could we aim for around three?

words.expression: could you let me know what to expect
words.lemma: could you let me know what to expect
words.zhGloss: 能告诉我大致会怎么安排吗
words.enDefinition: asks for a brief explanation of what will happen
acceptedZhAnswers: 能告诉我大致会怎么安排吗
acceptedEnVariants: could you let me know what to expect

examples.en: Could you let me know what to expect on the call before I book a room?
examples.zh: 我预约房间前，「能告诉我这次通话大致会怎么安排吗」？

examples.en: Could you let me know what to expect when I get to the main reception?
examples.zh: 我到总前台后，「能告诉我大致会怎么安排吗」？

collocations: could you let me know what to expect on the call?
could you let me know what to expect when I arrive?
before we speak, could you let me know what to expect?

words.expression: could you point me to the right person
words.lemma: could you point me to the right person
words.enDefinition: asks to be directed to somebody who can help
acceptedEnVariants: could you point me to the right person

examples.en: Could you point me to the right person to ask about the change of venue?
examples.zh: 关于场地变更，「能告诉我应该找谁吗」？

examples.en: Could you point me to the right person if a different team handles the bookings?
examples.zh: 如果预约归另一个团队管，「能告诉我应该找谁吗」？

collocations: could you point me to the right person for scheduling?
could you point me to the right person to ask?
if that's not you, could you point me to the right person?

words.expression: could you put that in writing
words.lemma: could you put that in writing
words.zhGloss: 能把刚才说的用文字发我吗
words.enDefinition: asks someone to confirm spoken information in written form
acceptedZhAnswers: 能把刚才说的用文字发我吗
acceptedEnVariants: could you put that in writing
could you send that in writing

examples.en: Could you put that in writing so I can keep the address somewhere handy?
examples.zh: 「能把刚才说的用文字发我吗」？我想把地址存到方便查看的地方。

examples.en: Could you put that in writing about the change to next week's schedule, please?
examples.zh: 关于下周日程的变化，「能把刚才说的用文字发我吗」？

collocations: could you put that in writing for me?
could you put that in writing by email?
could you put that in writing before Thursday?

words.enDefinition: A polite request to hear the same question again

examples.en: I asked "Could you repeat the question?" after the noise outside covered the last few words.
examples.zh: 外面的噪声盖过了最后几个词，我问「您能重复一下问题吗」。

examples.en: We practiced saying "Could you repeat the question?" without starting to answer a different question.
examples.zh: 我们练习说「您能重复一下问题吗」，避免听岔了就答成另一个问题。

collocations: could you repeat the question, please?
sorry, could you repeat the question?
could you repeat the question one more time?

words.enDefinition: A polite request to hear a question expressed another way

examples.en: When the wording confused me, I asked "Could you rephrase the question?" and waited for the reply.
examples.zh: 没理解提问的措辞时，我问「您能换个说法提问吗」，然后等对方回应。

examples.en: My tutor suggested "Could you rephrase the question?" when a question uses an unfamiliar term.
examples.zh: 导师建议，题目中有不熟悉的术语时，可以问「您能换个说法提问吗」。

collocations: could you rephrase the question, please?
sorry, could you rephrase the question?
could you rephrase the question for me?

words.expression: could you spell that for me
words.lemma: could you spell that for me
words.enDefinition: asks someone to say how a word or name is spelled
acceptedEnVariants: could you spell that for me
can you spell that for me

examples.en: Could you spell that for me so I can write down your surname correctly?
examples.zh: 「你能拼给我听吗」？我想把你的姓记对。

examples.en: I missed the last bit of the surname, so could you spell that for me?
examples.zh: 姓的最后几个音我没听清，「你能拼给我听吗」？

collocations: sorry, could you spell that for me?
could you spell that for me slowly?
could you spell that for me before we hang up?

words.enDefinition: To add a signature to a document already signed

examples.en: The department head needed to countersign the offer letter after I signed it.
examples.zh: 我签署录用函后，系主任还需要「再签字确认」。

examples.en: I asked who would countersign the agreement before a copy was sent back to me.
examples.zh: 我问在把副本发回给我之前，谁会在这份协议上「再签字确认」。

words.enDefinition: A copy bearing the required additional signature

examples.en: The university sent me a countersigned copy after the hiring manager signed the letter.
examples.zh: 招聘经理签完函件后，学校给我发了一份「双方已签字的副本」。

examples.en: I saved the countersigned copy in the folder with the rest of my job documents.
examples.zh: 我把「双方已签字的副本」和其他求职材料一起保存在同一个文件夹。

words.enDefinition: a piece of project work completed as part of a class

examples.en: I included a course project that involved producing a booklet for new students.
examples.zh: 我收录了一个「课程项目」，内容是为新生制作一本小册子。

examples.en: The recruiter asked how the course project had been assessed by the lecturer.
examples.zh: 招聘人员询问授课老师是怎样给这个「课程项目」评分的。

words.enDefinition: to work a scheduled shift in place of someone who cannot attend

examples.en: I offered to cover a shift after my class moved to another day.
examples.zh: 我的课改到另一天后，我主动提出「顶替一个班次」。

examples.en: The manager asked if I could cover a shift during the exam break.
examples.zh: 经理问我能不能在考试间歇「顶替一个班次」。

collocations: ask someone to cover a shift
be available to cover a shift

words.zhGloss: 随申请发送的介绍邮件
words.enDefinition: a short email introducing an applicant and the job application documents it carries
acceptedZhAnswers: 随申请发送的介绍邮件

examples.en: I used the cover email to explain which internship I was applying for.
examples.zh: 我在「随申请发送的介绍邮件」里说明了自己申请的是哪个实习岗位。

examples.en: My adviser suggested keeping the cover email brief because the documents were attached.
examples.zh: 顾问建议把「随申请发送的介绍邮件」写短一点，因为申请材料都在附件里。

words.enDefinition: a letter introducing an applicant and explaining their suitability for a job

examples.en: I rewrote my cover letter after learning what the library assistant role involved.
examples.zh: 了解图书馆助理的职责后，我重写了「求职信」。

examples.en: The application asked me to upload one cover letter for each position I selected.
examples.zh: 申请系统要求我为选中的每个岗位分别上传一封「求职信」。

collocations: a cover letter for an internship

words.enDefinition: a preliminary version of a job application letter that may be revised

examples.en: My tutor read the cover letter draft and asked for a clearer opening.
examples.zh: 导师看了「求职信草稿」，建议把开头写得更清楚。

examples.en: I reopened my cover letter draft to update the employer's name before sending it.
examples.zh: 我重新打开「求职信草稿」，在发送前更新了雇主的名称。

collocations: send your cover letter draft for feedback

words.enDefinition: a model that provides a reusable layout or structure for an application letter

examples.en: I opened a cover letter template and replaced the heading with my own details.
examples.zh: 我打开一个「求职信模板」，把开头的信息换成了自己的。

examples.en: The careers team shared a cover letter template for students applying by email.
examples.zh: 就业指导团队给通过邮件申请的学生分享了一个「求职信模板」。

words.enDefinition: work periods that somebody else cannot take

examples.en: The casual role is mainly to cover shifts when other café staff are away.
examples.zh: 这个临时岗位主要是在咖啡馆其他员工不在时「顶班」。

examples.en: I can cover shifts at the library on Thursdays because my classes finish early.
examples.zh: 我周四的课结束得早，可以去图书馆「顶班」。

words.enDefinition: a placement that earns academic credit as part of a course

examples.en: I chose a credit-bearing placement at the museum to connect my work experience with coursework.
examples.zh: 我选了博物馆的「计学分的实习」，把工作经验和课程学习结合起来。

examples.en: The course handbook calls it a credit-bearing placement and gives the deadline for the report.
examples.zh: 课程手册把这项实践称为「计学分的实习」，也注明了报告的截止日期。

words.enDefinition: A review of official records for certain criminal history information

examples.en: The placement coordinator explained which office handled the criminal record check.
examples.zh: 实习协调员说明了由哪个办公室办理「犯罪记录核查」。

examples.en: I asked whether the office had received the criminal record check report.
examples.zh: 我问办公室是否已收到「犯罪记录核查」报告。

collocations: a criminal record check for a placement

words.enDefinition: experience of how different business functions work

examples.en: The program gave me cross-functional exposure through short projects with both finance and operations.
examples.zh: 这个项目通过财务和运营的短期项目，给了我「接触不同职能的机会」。

examples.en: I wanted cross-functional exposure before deciding whether to specialize in product design or customer support.
examples.zh: 决定专攻产品设计还是客服前，我希望有「接触不同职能的机会」。

words.enDefinition: a job that involves working across different teams or functions

examples.en: I applied for a cross-functional role that links the training team with the library.
examples.zh: 我申请了一个连接培训团队和图书馆的「跨职能岗位」。

examples.en: The cross-functional role involves working with both the fundraising team and the events team.
examples.zh: 这个「跨职能岗位」要同时和筹款团队、活动团队合作。

words.enDefinition: training people to perform different roles so they can cover one another's work

examples.en: Our cross-training included time at the returns desk and the main reception point.
examples.zh: 我们的「跨岗位培训」包括在退还物品柜台和总接待处工作一段时间。

examples.en: The manager used cross-training to make sure someone could cover the early shift.
examples.zh: 经理通过「跨岗位培训」确保有人能顶早班。

words.enDefinition: the issue or task considered most important at the present time

examples.en: The current priority is checking the bookings for next week's exhibition at the library.
examples.zh: 「当前优先事项」是核对下周图书馆展览的预约。

examples.en: I confirmed the current priority with my supervisor before starting the long spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 开始制作那份很长的电子表格前，我和主管确认了「当前优先事项」。

words.enDefinition: US training for F-1 students integrated into an established curriculum

examples.en: The adviser explained how Curricular Practical Training related to the course I was taking.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「美国课程内实习」与我正在修读的课程有什么关系。

examples.en: I asked which placement was listed under Curricular Practical Training in my school record.
examples.zh: 我问学校记录里「美国课程内实习」一栏写的是哪项实习。

words.enDefinition: experience doing work that involves direct contact with customers

examples.en: The box office job asks for customer-facing experience, so my time in retail was relevant.
examples.zh: 售票处的工作要求有「直接接待顾客的经验」，因此我做零售的经历正用得上。

examples.en: I gained customer-facing experience when I helped visitors at the university's open day.
examples.zh: 学校开放日我帮忙接待来访者，积累了「直接接待顾客的经验」。

words.enDefinition: A document summarizing someone's education, experience, and skills for employers

examples.en: My tutor in London offered to read my CV before the campus careers fair.
examples.zh: 在伦敦的校园招聘会前，导师主动提出帮我看一下「求职简历」。

examples.en: The careers adviser asked me to bring my CV to our appointment.
examples.zh: 职业顾问让我在预约见面时带上「求职简历」。

words.enDefinition: a task that asks someone to check and correct problems in a dataset

examples.en: The data cleaning exercise asked me to find duplicate entries in a small table.
examples.zh: 「数据清洗练习」让我查找一个小表里的重复条目。

examples.en: I documented how I handled blank dates in the data cleaning exercise.
examples.zh: 我记录了自己在「数据清洗练习」里怎样处理缺失的日期。

collocations: an example from the data cleaning exercise

words.enDefinition: putting information into a computer system or database

examples.en: The job involves data entry for a project that collects feedback from first-year students.
examples.zh: 这份工作涉及一个收集大一学生反馈的项目，需要做「数据录入」。

examples.en: I asked how much data entry was involved before applying for the records assistant role.
examples.zh: 申请档案助理岗位前，我问了有多少「数据录入」工作。

words.enDefinition: a task that tests the ability to explain what data shows and what can be concluded

examples.en: The data interpretation exercise asked why the trend changed halfway through the year.
examples.zh: 「数据解读练习」问趋势为什么在年中发生变化。

examples.en: I described two possible explanations for the chart in the data interpretation exercise.
examples.zh: 在「数据解读练习」中，我描述了图表的两种可能解释。

words.enDefinition: a rough drawing of the main data entities and their relationships in a system

examples.en: My data model sketch showed which fields belonged to rooms and which to bookings.
examples.zh: 我的「数据模型草图」标明了哪些字段属于房间、哪些属于预约。

examples.en: I revised the data model sketch after the interviewer added a new record type.
examples.zh: 面试官加了一种记录类型之后，我修改了「数据模型草图」。

words.enDefinition: The length of time information is kept

examples.en: The notice listed a different data retention period for applicants who joined the talent pool.
examples.zh: 通知对加入人才库的求职者列出了不同的「数据保留期限」。

examples.en: I checked the data retention period before choosing whether to keep my profile active.
examples.zh: 决定是否继续保留有效资料之前，我查了「数据保留期限」。

words.enDefinition: an exercise requiring a chart or other visual display to communicate information from data

examples.en: The data visualization task asked for one chart that showed differences between groups.
examples.zh: 「数据可视化任务」要求制作一张显示各组差异的图表。

examples.en: I chose a bar chart for the data visualization task because comparison mattered most.
examples.zh: 因为最重要的是比较，我为「数据可视化任务」选用了条形图。

collocations: a data visualization task for applicants

words.enDefinition: An option limiting results by posting date

examples.en: I used the date posted filter to see what had appeared since Monday.
examples.zh: 我用了「发布日期筛选」，看周一以来有哪些新职位。

examples.en: The date posted filter lets me hide listings that are more than a month old.
examples.zh: 「发布日期筛选」可以隐藏一个多月前发布的职位。

collocations: choose an option in the date posted filter

words.enDefinition: The dates marking when someone started and finished attending an institution

examples.en: I checked the dates of attendance in the registrar's letter before editing my CV.
examples.zh: 编辑简历前，我核对了教务处信里的「就读起止日期」。

examples.en: The template asks for dates of attendance beside the name of each university.
examples.zh: 模板要求把「就读起止日期」写在每所大学名称旁边。

words.enDefinition: a period of work scheduled during daytime hours

examples.en: I could cover a day shift on Friday because my afternoon lecture was cancelled.
examples.zh: 星期五下午的课取消了，我可以顶一个「白班」。

examples.en: The day shift ends early enough for me to catch the last bus home.
examples.zh: 「白班」下班时间够早，我还能赶上回家的末班车。

words.enDefinition: tasks somebody does regularly as part of a job

examples.en: The day-to-day duties include opening the study room and checking who has booked it.
examples.zh: 「日常工作职责」包括开放自习室，以及查看预订人是谁。

examples.en: I asked what the day-to-day duties looked like when there were no events booked.
examples.zh: 我问没有活动预订的时候，「日常工作职责」具体是什么。

words.enDefinition: A check of criminal record information by Britain's Disclosure and Barring Service

examples.en: My placement coordinator in England mentioned a DBS check for the school role.
examples.zh: 我在英格兰的实习协调员说，学校这个岗位涉及「英国DBS背景核查」。

examples.en: The office explained which type of DBS check the placement requested.
examples.zh: 办公室解释了这份实习要求哪类「英国DBS背景核查」。

collocations: a DBS check for a placement

words.enDefinition: To respond to difficulties that delay or disrupt progress

examples.en: The panel asked how I had learned to deal with setbacks at university.
examples.zh: 小组问我在大学里是怎样学会「应对挫折」的。

examples.en: I used the canceled exhibition to explain how I deal with setbacks without losing momentum.
examples.zh: 我以展览取消为例，说明自己如何「应对挫折」并保持工作进度。

words.enDefinition: a greeting used in a job application addressed to an unnamed person who manages hiring

examples.en: I wrote “Dear Hiring Manager” because the posting did not name a contact person.
examples.zh: 招聘启事没列联系人的姓名，所以我写了「尊敬的招聘负责人」。

examples.en: The cover letter sample used “Dear Hiring Manager” above the first paragraph.
examples.zh: 求职信范本在第一段上方用了「尊敬的招聘负责人」。

collocations: use Dear Hiring Manager as the greeting

words.enDefinition: a task in which someone finds and fixes a problem in an existing program

examples.en: The debugging exercise started with a function that returned an incorrect average.
examples.zh: 「排错练习」从一个返回错误平均值的函数开始。

examples.en: I used a small list of numbers to check the result in the debugging exercise.
examples.zh: 我用一小组数字核对了「排错练习」中的结果。

words.enDefinition: extra information a program prints or records to help explain what is going wrong

examples.en: The debugging output revealed that the function processed the same row twice.
examples.zh: 「排错辅助输出」显示，函数处理了同一行两次。

examples.en: I removed the debugging output before sending in the final version of the exercise.
examples.zh: 我交练习的最终版本前，删掉了「排错辅助输出」。

words.enDefinition: an ongoing record of decisions, often including decisions' dates and reasons

examples.en: I added the revised schedule to the decision log after the team approved it.
examples.zh: 团队批准调整后的排班后，我把它记进了「决策记录表」。

examples.en: The decision log explained why the team chose a smaller room that week.
examples.zh: 「决策记录表」解释了团队那周为什么选了较小的房间。

collocations: record a choice in the decision log

words.enDefinition: the person with responsibility for making or approving a particular decision

examples.en: We named a decision owner for questions about the layout of the reception desk.
examples.zh: 我们为接待柜台布局相关问题指定了一位「决策负责人」。

examples.en: The decision owner listened to the students before agreeing to the timetable change.
examples.zh: 「决策负责人」在同意调整时间表前，先听取了学生的意见。

words.enDefinition: To say that one will not take the offered job

examples.en: I had to decline an offer after learning the hours clashed with my classes.
examples.zh: 发现工时和上课时间冲突后，我不得不「谢绝录用通知」。

examples.en: Did you decline an offer in the portal or reply to the manager's email?
examples.zh: 你是在门户里「谢绝录用通知」的，还是回了经理的邮件？

words.enDefinition: move a placement to a later period before it starts

examples.en: I asked whether I could defer a placement until after the exams in June.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「推迟实习」，等六月考完试再开始。

examples.en: The tutor explained how to defer a placement if the dates clashed with summer classes.
examples.zh: 导师解释了实习日期和暑期课程冲突时如何「推迟实习」。

collocations: defer a placement until next term

words.enDefinition: an apprenticeship combining a job with study towards a degree

examples.en: I heard about a degree apprenticeship at a careers event in England last term.
examples.zh: 上学期我在英格兰的一场就业活动上听说了一个「学位学徒制项目」。

examples.en: She chose a degree apprenticeship because she wanted to study engineering while working in industry.
examples.zh: 她选了「学位学徒制项目」，想一边在行业里工作，一边读工程专业。

words.enDefinition: The formal name of a degree awarded by an institution

examples.en: I checked my transcript for the exact degree title before updating my CV.
examples.zh: 更新简历之前，我查了成绩单上准确的「学位名称」。

examples.en: The degree title was too long for the line beside the university name.
examples.zh: 「学位名称」太长，无法和学校名称放在同一行。

words.enDefinition: to give another person authority and responsibility for a particular part of work

examples.en: Our supervisor decided to delegate responsibility for the late bookings to one person.
examples.zh: 主管决定「委派职责」，由一个人负责处理晚间的预约。

examples.en: The guide explains when a student team lead can delegate responsibility to others.
examples.zh: 指南解释了学生团队负责人什么时候可以把「职责委派」给别人。

words.enDefinition: To give a prepared talk or demonstration to an audience

examples.en: I was invited to deliver a presentation on accessible campus transport for our department.
examples.zh: 我应邀为院系就校园无障碍交通「作报告」。

examples.en: The project gave me a chance to deliver a presentation using two languages.
examples.zh: 这个项目给了我用两种语言「作报告」的机会。

collocations: deliver a presentation to a group
deliver a presentation on a topic
deliver a presentation at a meeting

words.enDefinition: to complete and provide the agreed work by the planned date

examples.en: We used a smaller print run so the supplier could deliver on time.
examples.zh: 我们减少了印量，让供应商能够「准时交付」。

examples.en: I told the supervisor what help I needed to deliver on time.
examples.zh: 我告诉主管，要「准时交付」需要得到哪些帮助。

collocations: be able to deliver on time
work together to deliver on time
make sure to deliver on time

words.enDefinition: a list identifying each item that a task requires the participant to hand over

examples.en: The deliverable checklist included a spreadsheet and a short explanation of my results.
examples.zh: 「须提交的成果清单」包括一份电子表格和一段结果说明。

examples.en: I ticked off the deliverable checklist after saving the last file for submission.
examples.zh: 保存好最后一个待提交的文件后，我逐项勾选了「须提交的成果清单」。

words.enDefinition: a schedule showing when a project or its completed parts will be delivered

examples.en: The delivery timeline shows when each poster must reach the campus print shop.
examples.zh: 「交付时间安排」标明了每张海报必须何时送到校内印刷店。

examples.en: I updated the delivery timeline after the workshop moved to a later date.
examples.zh: 培训延期后，我调整了「交付时间安排」。

words.enDefinition: Employers' need for people to work

examples.en: The report says demand for workers rises near the coast during the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 报告说，暑假期间沿海地区的「用工需求」会上升。

examples.en: I checked demand for workers in local theatres before deciding where to look.
examples.zh: 决定去哪里找工作前，我查了本地剧院的「用工需求」。

words.enDefinition: a web address giving access to a working demonstration or a recording of it

examples.en: My demo link opened a running version of the project without a sign-in screen.
examples.zh: 我的「演示链接」打开的是项目的运行版本，无须登录。

examples.en: The panel asked for a demo link so they could review the project later.
examples.zh: 评审组让我发一个「演示链接」，方便他们稍后看项目。

words.enDefinition: a guide describing what to do or say during a demonstration

examples.en: The demo script reminded me to show the booking page before opening the settings.
examples.zh: 「演示脚本」提醒我先展示预约页面，再打开设置。

examples.en: I shortened the demo script when the recruiter confirmed how much time I had.
examples.zh: 招聘人员确认我有多少时间后，我缩短了「演示脚本」。

words.enDefinition: an ability supported by actual examples or evidence

examples.en: The listing asks for demonstrated ability to organize events, even if they were small.
examples.zh: 招聘启事要求「证明自己有组织活动的能力」，办过小型活动也算。

examples.en: The work calls for demonstrated ability to explain complex material to a general audience.
examples.zh: 这份工作要求「证明自己有向普通听众解释复杂材料的能力」。

words.enDefinition: a planned period of work in one department within a training program

examples.en: My first departmental rotation was in purchasing, where I spent four weeks with the team.
examples.zh: 我的第一段「部门轮岗」在采购部，和团队一起工作了四周。

examples.en: The final departmental rotation helped me decide where to focus my training next year.
examples.zh: 最后一段「部门轮岗」帮我决定了明年要重点学习的方向。

words.expression: describe a time when you worked under pressure
words.lemma: describe a time when you worked under pressure
words.zhGloss: 请描述一次在压力下工作
words.enDefinition: A prompt asking for an example of working in demanding circumstances
acceptedZhAnswers: 请描述一次在压力下工作
acceptedEnVariants: describe a time when you worked under pressure

examples.en: The prompt was "Describe a time when you worked under pressure." I described exam week.
examples.zh: 练习题是「请描述一次在压力下工作的经历」，我选了考试周的一件事。

examples.en: I answered "Describe a time when you worked under pressure" with my experience opening the shop alone.
examples.zh: 我用独自开店的经历回答了「请描述一次在压力下工作的经历」。

collocations: ask "Describe a time when you worked under pressure."
prepare an example for "Describe a time when you worked under pressure."
a response to "Describe a time when you worked under pressure."

words.enDefinition: To explain the tasks and decisions assigned to you

examples.en: The template leaves room to describe your responsibilities below each job title.
examples.zh: 模板在每个职位名称下方留了空，让你「描述自己的职责」。

examples.en: My adviser suggested using one example to describe your responsibilities at the library.
examples.zh: 顾问建议我用一个例子「描述自己在图书馆的职责」。

collocations: describe your responsibilities in a role

words.enDefinition: to explain what responsibilities you held or what work you performed

examples.en: The portfolio form asks you to describe your role clearly for each group project.
examples.zh: 作品集表格要求对每个小组项目清楚「说明你负责的工作」。

examples.en: The adviser suggested that you describe your role before showing the finished product.
examples.zh: 顾问建议先「说明你负责的工作」，再展示最终成果。

collocations: describe your role in a team
describe your role in a project

words.enDefinition: a limit that affects what can be built or how it can work

examples.en: The design constraint meant the prototype had to work on a smaller screen.
examples.zh: 这项「设计限制条件」要求原型能在更小的屏幕上运行。

examples.en: I asked whether offline access was a design constraint in the interview exercise.
examples.zh: 我问在面试练习里，离线访问是不是一项「设计限制条件」。

words.enDefinition: a revised version or cycle of changes made to improve a design

examples.en: Each design iteration changed the size or contrast of the directions on the sign.
examples.zh: 每「一次设计迭代」都调整了标识上指示信息的大小或对比度。

examples.en: I chose one design iteration to show how feedback had changed the layout.
examples.zh: 我选了「一次设计迭代」，用来展示反馈怎样改变了布局。

words.enDefinition: a collection of design projects presented to show a person's skills and approach

examples.en: My design portfolio includes a campus map and a poster for the film club.
examples.zh: 我的「设计作品集」里有一张校园地图和一张电影社团海报。

examples.en: The studio asked me to share a design portfolio before the initial conversation.
examples.zh: 工作室让我在初次沟通前发送一份「设计作品集」。

words.enDefinition: the activities and stages through which a design is planned, tested and developed

examples.en: The portfolio shows the design process from early sketches to the finished map.
examples.zh: 作品集展示了从早期草图到最终地图的「设计过程」。

examples.en: I wrote a brief caption for each stage of the design process.
examples.zh: 我给「设计过程」的每个阶段写了一段简短说明。

collocations: a step in the design process

words.enDefinition: a description of the situation and goal for a design task

examples.en: The design prompt described a website visitors could use to reserve campus equipment.
examples.zh: 「设计题目」描述了一个供访客预约校园设备的网站。

examples.en: I highlighted the user groups in the design prompt before sketching the first version.
examples.zh: 我先在「设计题目」里标出各类用户，再画第一版设计。

words.enDefinition: the reasoning behind the decisions made in a design

examples.en: I explained the design rationale with notes about how visitors read the signs.
examples.zh: 我用访客阅读标识的观察笔记来说明「设计决策依据」。

examples.en: The design rationale links each color choice to a requirement in the original brief.
examples.zh: 「设计决策依据」把每种颜色的选择与原任务说明里的一项要求联系起来。

words.enDefinition: a choice that improves one aspect of a design at the cost of another

examples.en: The case study explains a design trade-off between larger text and fewer directions.
examples.zh: 案例解释了一项「设计上的权衡」，也就是在加大文字和减少指示信息之间取舍。

examples.en: I used two versions of the map to illustrate the design trade-off for reviewers.
examples.zh: 我用两个版本的地图向评审说明这项「设计上的权衡」。

collocations: a design trade-off between clarity and detail

words.enDefinition: To create resources people use to learn how to perform work

examples.en: I helped design training materials for the students running our campus food bank.
examples.zh: 我协助为运营校园食物援助点的学生「设计培训材料」。

examples.en: The job gave me a chance to design training materials for people with different backgrounds.
examples.zh: 这份工作让我有机会为不同背景的人「设计培训材料」。

words.enDefinition: a condition that is preferred but not required

examples.en: Theatre experience was a desirable criterion, so I applied even though I'd never worked backstage.
examples.zh: 剧院工作经验是「优先考虑的条件」，所以虽然没在后台工作过，我还是申请了。

examples.en: The listing treated spreadsheet knowledge as a desirable criterion for the weekend reception role.
examples.zh: 招聘启事把会用电子表格列为周末接待岗「优先考虑的条件」。

collocations: treat something as a desirable criterion

words.enDefinition: a reservation for a shared desk or the process of making it

examples.en: I made a desk booking because my usual seat was taken that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午平时坐的位置有人了，于是我做了「工位预约」。

examples.en: The system sent me a desk booking confirmation with the floor and seat numbers.
examples.zh: 系统发来了「工位预约」确认，上面有楼层和座位号。

words.enDefinition: a discussion about a worker's skills, learning and possible future responsibilities

examples.en: The development conversation helped me choose one skill to practise during my placement.
examples.zh: 「职业发展交流」帮我选定了一项在实习中要练习的技能。

examples.en: I asked about training options during my development conversation with the library manager.
examples.zh: 与图书馆经理做「职业发展交流」时，我问了有哪些培训可以选。

collocations: a development conversation with your manager

words.enDefinition: an activity or experience that helps a person build skills for future work

examples.en: My manager described the extra training as a development opportunity for student staff.
examples.zh: 经理说，额外培训是学生员工获得的「发展能力的机会」。

examples.en: I used the workshop as a development opportunity to practise answering common questions.
examples.zh: 我把培训当作「发展能力的机会」，借此练习怎样回答常见问题。

words.enDefinition: a telephone number used to join a scheduled group call

examples.en: The invite includes a dial-in number in case the video link doesn't work on campus.
examples.zh: 邀请里有「拨入会议的号码」，万一视频链接在学校打不开可以打电话。

examples.en: I saved the dial-in number before leaving home because my mobile data was unreliable.
examples.zh: 我的移动数据不稳定，出门前先存了「拨入会议的号码」。

collocations: the dial-in number for the call

words.enDefinition: asks whether an email was successfully delivered

examples.en: Did my email come through yesterday, or should I send the dates again today?
examples.zh: 「你昨天收到我的邮件了吗」，还是我今天把日期再发一遍？

examples.en: Did my email come through after I used the address you gave me by phone?
examples.zh: 我用了你电话里给的地址，「你收到我的邮件了吗」？

collocations: did my email come through yesterday?
did my email come through this time?
just checking, did my email come through?

words.enDefinition: a number that reaches a person or department without an operator

examples.en: The coordinator gave me a direct line so I wouldn't have to call reception.
examples.zh: 协调员给了我一个「直拨电话」，这样就不用先打给前台。

examples.en: I used the recruiter's direct line when the address in the booking looked wrong.
examples.zh: 预约里的地址看着不对，我就打了招聘人员的「直拨电话」。

words.enDefinition: watching someone perform a task in order to assess it

examples.en: The supervisor used direct observation to assess how I explained a new task to volunteers.
examples.zh: 带教老师用「直接观察评估」看看我是怎么向志愿者讲解新任务的。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether direct observation would happen during a usual shift at the gallery.
examples.zh: 导师问「直接观察评估」是否会安排在美术馆一次正常的班次中。

words.enDefinition: a person who reports directly to a particular manager

examples.en: The supervisor met each direct report to discuss plans for the new term.
examples.zh: 主管与每位「直接下属」见面，谈了新学期计划。

examples.en: I learned that a direct report does not go through another manager first.
examples.zh: 我了解到，「直接下属」汇报时无须先经过另一位经理。

words.enDefinition: employees who report to a particular manager without anyone in between

examples.en: The coordinator role has three direct reports who help run events across different campuses.
examples.zh: 协调员岗位有三名「直属下属」，协助组织各校区的活动。

examples.en: The listing specified that the assistant manager would have no direct reports at first.
examples.zh: 招聘启事明确写着，副经理刚开始没有「直属下属」。

words.enDefinition: A bonus an employer may choose to pay

examples.en: The offer letter described the discretionary bonus separately from the guaranteed monthly salary.
examples.zh: 录用函把「酌情发放的奖金」和保证发放的月薪分开说明。

examples.en: I asked who decides whether to award a discretionary bonus in my department.
examples.zh: 我问我们部门由谁决定是否发放「酌情奖金」。

collocations: be eligible for a discretionary bonus

words.enDefinition: to explain what is gained and what is lost by making a choice

examples.en: The panel asked me to discuss a trade-off between accuracy and response time.
examples.zh: 评审组请我「讨论一项取舍」，即如何在准确性和响应时间之间权衡。

examples.en: I used the two diagrams to discuss a trade-off in the proposed design.
examples.zh: 我用两张图来「讨论一项取舍」，说明拟议的设计有得有失。

collocations: discuss a trade-off with the panel
discuss a trade-off between two goals
use an example to discuss a trade-off

words.enDefinition: a particular matter listed or raised for a group to talk about

examples.en: I added one discussion point about the new opening hours to the meeting notes.
examples.zh: 我在会议记录里增加了一项关于新营业时间的「待讨论的事项」。

examples.en: The main discussion point was whether two people were needed at the desk.
examples.zh: 主要「待讨论的事项」是柜台是否需要安排两个人。

words.expression: do you have any questions for us
words.lemma: do you have any questions for us
words.enDefinition: An invitation for the candidate to ask the interviewers questions
acceptedEnVariants: do you have any questions for us

examples.en: I asked about training when the panel said "Do you have any questions for us?" at the end.
examples.zh: 面试快结束时，小组问「你有什么想问我们的」，我就询问了培训情况。

examples.en: The panel asked "Do you have any questions for us?" I asked about supervision.
examples.zh: 模拟面试最后问「你有什么想问我们的」，我趁机了解了指导安排。

collocations: end with "Do you have any questions for us?"
answer "Do you have any questions for us?"
prepare for "Do you have any questions for us?"

words.enDefinition: To write down the steps people follow to complete work

examples.en: I helped document procedures for the volunteers who opened the lab each morning.
examples.zh: 我协助为每天早上开实验室的志愿者「记录操作流程」。

examples.en: My CV states that I began to document procedures during my summer placement.
examples.zh: 我的简历写明，我在暑期实习时开始「记录操作流程」。

words.enDefinition: A message asking an applicant for a document

examples.en: The document request listed the course certificate I had forgotten to upload the first time.
examples.zh: 「材料提交请求」列出了我第一次忘记上传的课程证书。

examples.en: I opened the document request to find out where to upload the file.
examples.zh: 我打开「材料提交请求」，查看该在哪里上传文件。

words.enDefinition: To save a copy to one's device

examples.en: I clicked to download a copy of the completed application for my own records.
examples.zh: 我点了「下载一份副本」，把填好的申请留档。

examples.en: Can I download a copy of my answers before I submit the form?
examples.zh: 提交表单前，我能「下载一份回答的副本」吗？

collocations: allow applicants to download a copy
download a copy for your records

words.enDefinition: a collection of work provided as a file that viewers can save locally

examples.en: The downloadable portfolio was smaller than the version I used for in-person reviews.
examples.zh: 「可下载的作品集」文件比我带去现场评审的版本小。

examples.en: I tested the downloadable portfolio on a tablet before sharing it with the studio.
examples.zh: 把「可下载的作品集」发给工作室之前，我先用平板测试了一下。

collocations: a link to a downloadable portfolio

words.enDefinition: An application saved before submission

examples.en: My draft application was still there when I logged in again after class.
examples.zh: 下课后重新登录时，我的「申请草稿」还在。

examples.en: The dashboard lists the draft application under the job title I selected last week.
examples.zh: 申请总览在我上周所选的职位名称下列出了「申请草稿」。

words.enDefinition: A version of a contract prepared before signing

examples.en: The manager sent the draft contract for me to read before signing anything.
examples.zh: 经理先把「合同草案」发给我看，再让我签署文件。

examples.en: I noticed that the draft contract still gave the old address for the workplace.
examples.zh: 我发现「合同草案」里的工作地点还是旧地址。

words.enDefinition: To write preliminary versions of documents for an organized program

examples.en: I helped draft program materials for an after-school reading program near campus.
examples.zh: 我协助为校园附近的课后阅读项目「起草项目材料」。

examples.en: We worked with teachers to draft program materials that students could use independently.
examples.zh: 我们与老师合作「起草项目材料」，让学生可以独立使用。

words.enDefinition: a list of items to check when preparing an initial written version

examples.en: I used a drafting checklist to make sure the letter named the correct employer.
examples.zh: 我用「起草检查清单」确认信里写的是正确的雇主。

examples.en: The workshop's drafting checklist includes a reminder to give one concrete example.
examples.zh: 讲座提供的「起草检查清单」提醒写信人给出一个具体例子。

words.enDefinition: to use what you have learned or done in the past to handle something now

examples.en: You can draw on your experience in group projects when writing about teamwork.
examples.zh: 写团队合作时，可以「借鉴你在小组项目中的经验」。

examples.en: The adviser said to draw on your experience outside paid work for the application.
examples.zh: 顾问说，写申请时也可以「用上你在有偿工作之外积累的经验」。

collocations: draw on your experience of teamwork
draw on your experience in class
draw on your experience outside work

words.enDefinition: a Friday when a workplace allows clothes more casual than its usual standards

examples.en: I asked whether dress-down Friday applied to staff working at the main reception desk.
examples.zh: 我问在总接待台上班的人可不可以参加「周五便装日」。

examples.en: The notice about dress-down Friday listed the areas where uniforms were still needed.
examples.zh: 「周五便装日」的通知列出了仍需穿制服的区域。

words.enDefinition: A control that opens a list of choices

examples.en: I picked my university from a drop-down menu near the top of the page.
examples.zh: 我从页面上方的「下拉菜单」里选了自己的学校。

examples.en: The drop-down menu only offered months, so I couldn't enter an exact day.
examples.zh: 「下拉菜单」里只能选月份，所以我没法填具体日期。

collocations: an option in the drop-down menu

words.enDefinition: a practice attempt before the real event, often to check timing or equipment

examples.en: We did a dry run to make sure the video played during the presentation.
examples.zh: 我们做了一次「预演」，确认展示时视频能正常播放。

examples.en: My dry run showed that the final example took longer than I had planned.
examples.zh: 「预演」表明，最后一个例子比我计划的讲得更久。

words.zhGloss: 美国校方指定官员推荐
words.enDefinition: An employment-related recommendation by a US school's designated official
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国校方指定官员推荐

examples.en: The US adviser showed where the DSO recommendation appeared in my student record.
examples.zh: 美国的顾问指给我看「美国校方指定官员推荐」在学生档案中的位置。

examples.en: I asked what the DSO recommendation named in the training notice meant.
examples.zh: 我问培训通知里提到的「美国校方指定官员推荐」指什么。

words.enDefinition: Another application from the same person for the same vacancy

examples.en: The dashboard flagged a duplicate application when I clicked the old link by mistake.
examples.zh: 我误点了旧链接，申请总览提示有一份「重复申请」。

examples.en: The employer only reviewed the first submission and marked the second as a duplicate application.
examples.zh: 雇主只审核了第一份提交的材料，把第二份标为「重复申请」。

words.enDefinition: Another posting for the same advertised role

examples.en: I removed the duplicate listing after noticing that both entries had the same reference.
examples.zh: 发现两条信息的编号一样后，我删掉了「重复发布的招聘信息」。

examples.en: A duplicate listing appeared when the search included both the agency and the employer.
examples.zh: 搜索结果同时包含中介和雇主发布的岗位时，出现了一条「重复发布的招聘信息」。

words.zhGloss: 美国电子就业资格核验系统
words.enDefinition: A US system that electronically checks information from an employment verification form
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国电子就业资格核验系统

examples.en: The onboarding guide explained what E-Verify was before describing the confirmation screen.
examples.zh: 入职指南先解释了「美国电子就业资格核验系统」，再介绍确认页面。

examples.en: I asked the hiring office what the E-Verify notice referred to.
examples.zh: 我问招聘办公室，那份「美国电子就业资格核验系统」通知指的是什么。

words.enDefinition: states your first available time for a meeting or call

examples.en: The earliest I can do on Friday is eleven, just after my lab finishes.
examples.zh: 周五「我最早能安排的时间」是十一点，刚好上完实验课。

examples.en: The earliest I can do next week is Tuesday afternoon because I'm away on Monday.
examples.zh: 我周一不在，所以「下周最早能安排的时间」是周二下午。

collocations: the earliest I can do is Monday
the earliest I can do that day
the earliest I can do next week

words.enDefinition: The soonest date someone is available to begin

examples.en: I entered my earliest start date after checking when my final exam would finish.
examples.zh: 确认最后一场考试什么时候结束后，我填写了「最早可到岗日期」。

examples.en: The portal asked for my earliest start date in the section about my availability.
examples.zh: 门户在询问我什么时候有空的那一栏里，要求填写「最早可到岗日期」。

words.enDefinition: the team that recruits and supports people at the start of their careers

examples.en: A UK employer's early careers team organized a session for current interns and new graduates.
examples.zh: 一家英国用人单位的「职业起步项目团队」给在岗实习生和刚毕业的人安排了一场说明会。

examples.en: I asked the early careers team how mentors were matched with graduate trainees.
examples.zh: 我问「职业起步项目团队」，导师和毕业生培训生是怎么配对的。

collocations: an email from the early careers team

words.enDefinition: an initial working model made to test an idea before final development

examples.en: The early prototype used cardboard so our team could test the shape cheaply.
examples.zh: 「早期原型」是纸板做的，让团队能低成本测试形状。

examples.en: I included the early prototype to show why the final version had fewer parts.
examples.zh: 我放进了「早期原型」，让读者看出最终版本为什么减少了部件。

words.enDefinition: work that begins comparatively early in the day

examples.en: The bakery job has an early start on Mondays to prepare orders for local shops.
examples.zh: 面包店的工作星期一「很早就开始」，要给本地商店准备订单。

examples.en: I checked whether there was a bus because the role involves an early start.
examples.zh: 这个岗位要「很早开始上班」，所以我查了那个点有没有公交。

collocations: be ready for an early start

words.enDefinition: an unusual input or situation at the limits of what a system must handle

examples.en: The interviewer asked whether an empty list was an edge case in my solution.
examples.zh: 面试官问，在我的解法中，空列表属于「边缘情况」吗。

examples.en: I added another edge case before submitting the final version to the platform.
examples.zh: 向平台提交最终版本前，我又加了一个「边缘情况」。

words.enDefinition: To change an application that has already been sent

examples.en: The portal lets me edit a submitted application until the hiring team opens it.
examples.zh: 招聘小组打开申请前，我可以在门户「修改已提交的申请」。

examples.en: Can I edit a submitted application if I realise I entered the wrong telephone number?
examples.zh: 如果发现电话号码输错了，我还能「修改已提交的申请」吗？

collocations: allow someone to edit a submitted application
log in to edit a submitted application
ask to edit a submitted application

words.enDefinition: A copy of a document whose content can still be changed

examples.en: I kept an editable version so I could update the dates next semester.
examples.zh: 我保留了「可编辑版本」，这样下学期可以更新日期。

examples.en: My friend asked for the editable version so she could add comments directly.
examples.zh: 朋友要了「可编辑版本」，好直接加批注。

words.enDefinition: an example showing a person's work in editing or preparing content for publication

examples.en: The student newspaper asked for an editorial sample alongside a short cover letter.
examples.zh: 学生报要求附上一份「编辑作品样本」和一封简短求职信。

examples.en: My editorial sample showed how I shortened a feature while preserving its main argument.
examples.zh: 我的「编辑作品样本」展示了我怎样缩短一篇专题稿并保留它的主要论点。

collocations: an editorial sample from your portfolio

words.enDefinition: Individual records describing studies or qualifications within an education section

examples.en: I corrected the education entries after finding the dates of my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 查到交换学期的日期后，我更正了「教育经历条目」。

examples.en: The education entries appeared above my recent jobs in the new version.
examples.zh: 新版简历把「教育经历条目」放在近期工作经历上方。

words.enDefinition: A part of a CV listing degrees and academic qualifications

examples.en: I added my exchange semester to the education section below my current degree.
examples.zh: 我把交换学习的学期加进「教育背景栏」，放在目前就读的学位下面。

examples.en: The education section lists the university names before the degrees in this template.
examples.zh: 这个模板的「教育背景栏」把学校名称列在学位前面。

collocations: list degrees in the education section

words.enDefinition: Checking study records or qualifications with the institution that issued them

examples.en: The agency asked which university should receive the education verification request.
examples.zh: 机构问「教育经历核实」请求应该发给哪所大学。

examples.en: My old department passed the education verification inquiry to the registrar.
examples.zh: 我原来的院系把「教育经历核实」的问题转给了教务处。

words.enDefinition: The date an agreement begins to apply

examples.en: The offer letter showed an effective date that differed from the day I signed it.
examples.zh: 录用函写的「生效日期」和我签署它的日期不同。

examples.en: Could you confirm the effective date for the new working hours in the agreement?
examples.zh: 您能确认协议里新工时的「生效日期」吗？

collocations: the effective date of an agreement

words.enDefinition: says that both suggested times are convenient

examples.en: Either time works for me, so please choose whichever suits the hiring manager best.
examples.zh: 「两个时间我都可以」，请选用人经理最方便的那个。

examples.en: Either time works for me on Tuesday because my seminar has been moved online.
examples.zh: 周二「两个时间我都可以」，因为我的研讨课改成线上了。

collocations: either time works for me tomorrow
either time works for me next week
either time works for me, so feel free to choose

words.enDefinition: A very short spoken summary of what you offer

examples.en: I practised my elevator pitch with my roommate before we went to the fair.
examples.zh: 去招聘会之前，我和室友一起练了「简短自荐」。

examples.en: My elevator pitch mentions the three months I spent working at the local museum.
examples.zh: 我的「简短自荐」里提到，我在本地博物馆工作过三个月。

words.enDefinition: A check that an applicant meets minimum requirements

examples.en: The eligibility check looked at whether I would still be enrolled next term.
examples.zh: 「申请资格核查」查的是我下学期是否仍然在读。

examples.en: I was asked for proof of enrolment so the team could complete the eligibility check.
examples.zh: 对方让我提供在读证明，以便招聘组完成「申请资格核查」。

words.enDefinition: How often alert emails are sent

examples.en: I changed the email alert frequency after receiving messages every morning during exams.
examples.zh: 考试期间每天早上都收到消息，我就改了「邮件提醒频率」。

examples.en: The portal shows the email alert frequency next to each search I have saved.
examples.zh: 平台在我每条已保存的搜索旁显示了「邮件提醒频率」。

words.enDefinition: a repeated block at the end of an email with a sender's name or details

examples.en: My email signature includes my name, course and a link to my portfolio.
examples.zh: 我的「邮件签名档」包含姓名、专业和作品集链接。

examples.en: I removed my old telephone number from the email signature before contacting the recruiter.
examples.zh: 联系招聘人员前，我从「邮件签名档」里删掉了旧电话号码。

collocations: include a link in your email signature

words.enDefinition: a series of email replies linked to the same conversation

examples.en: I kept the recruitment emails in one email thread so the earlier dates were easy to find.
examples.zh: 我把招聘相关的沟通放在「同一串往来邮件」里，这样之前的日期比较好查。

examples.en: The email thread included two sets of directions, so I asked which was current.
examples.zh: 「这串往来邮件」里有两套指路说明，所以我问哪一套是最新的。

collocations: keep to the same email thread
add someone to an email thread

words.enDefinition: A form recording whom an organization should contact in an emergency

examples.en: After moving, I changed the phone number on my emergency contact form.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我改了「紧急联系人表」上的电话号码。

examples.en: Our department asked us to review the emergency contact form during orientation.
examples.zh: 部门在入职介绍会上让我们核对「紧急联系人表」。

collocations: fill out an emergency contact form

words.enDefinition: A formal statement an employee makes about specified information

examples.en: I read the employee declaration before confirming that my information was correct.
examples.zh: 我先阅读了「员工声明」，再确认自己的信息无误。

examples.en: The office said the employee declaration would be stored with my original forms.
examples.zh: 办公室说，「员工声明」会和我的原始表格一起保存。

words.enDefinition: a reduced price an employer offers to its staff

examples.en: The bookshop offers an employee discount that I could use to buy course books.
examples.zh: 书店有「员工折扣」，我买课程用书时也能用。

examples.en: I asked whether the employee discount also applied to items ordered online for collection.
examples.zh: 我问网上订购后到店自取的商品也能不能用「员工折扣」。

words.enDefinition: A form recording basic details about a person employed by an organization

examples.en: I updated the employee information form after moving out of my residence hall.
examples.zh: 我搬出学生宿舍后更新了「员工信息表」。

examples.en: The office sent me a blank employee information form with the welcome email.
examples.zh: 办公室随欢迎邮件发来了一张空白的「员工信息表」。

words.enDefinition: A document explaining how an employer uses employees' personal information

examples.en: I checked who could access my records in the employee privacy notice.
examples.zh: 我在「员工隐私告知书」中核对了谁能查阅我的档案。

examples.en: The organization included a separate employee privacy notice in the induction pack.
examples.zh: 机构在入职资料包里另外附了一份「员工隐私告知书」。

words.enDefinition: A recorded set of details about an employee and their work

examples.en: I asked human resources to correct the spelling in my employee record.
examples.zh: 我请人力资源部门改正「员工信息记录」里的姓名拼写。

examples.en: The portal showed my employee record next to the department's contact information.
examples.zh: 人事平台把我的「员工信息记录」显示在部门联系方式旁边。

words.enDefinition: A recommendation made by a current employee

examples.en: The museum's website explains how an employee referral is recorded in its system.
examples.zh: 博物馆网站说明了系统会如何记录「员工内推」。

examples.en: Someone I worked with before offered an employee referral for the museum's education role.
examples.zh: 一位前同事主动提出帮我「内推」博物馆的教育岗位。

words.enDefinition: An account of an employer written by a worker

examples.en: I read an employee review from someone who used to work at the branch.
examples.zh: 我读了一篇「员工对公司的评价」，作者曾在那家分店工作。

examples.en: The employee review focused on the training offered to staff during their first month.
examples.zh: 这篇「员工对公司的评价」主要讲了入职第一个月有哪些培训。

words.enDefinition: The part of a benefit's cost paid by the worker

examples.en: The table listed the employee share and the amount paid by the employer.
examples.zh: 表格列出了「员工自付部分」和雇主支付的金额。

examples.en: I asked whether the employee share would come out of each month's pay.
examples.zh: 我问「员工自付部分」是不是从每个月的工资里扣。

collocations: the employee share of the cost

words.enDefinition: An employer's table or stand at a fair

examples.en: I stopped by the employer booth to ask about work at the local theatre.
examples.zh: 我去了「招聘单位展位」，询问本地剧院的工作机会。

examples.en: The queue in front of the employer booth wrapped around the central hall.
examples.zh: 「招聘单位展位」前排起的队伍绕了中央大厅一圈。

words.enDefinition: A UK Home Office service for employer checks on work permission

examples.en: The UK employer mentioned the Employer Checking Service in its explanation of the delay.
examples.zh: 英国雇主解释延误原因时提到了「英国雇主核验服务」。

examples.en: I asked whether the Employer Checking Service was the office named in the email.
examples.zh: 我问邮件里提到的服务是不是「英国雇主核验服务」。

collocations: a response from the Employer Checking Service

words.enDefinition: Money an employer pays toward an employee benefit

examples.en: The benefits summary listed the employer contribution beside the employee's share of the cost.
examples.zh: 福利概览把「雇主缴款」和员工自己承担的费用并排列出。

examples.en: I asked whether the employer contribution shown in the guide included the pension plan.
examples.zh: 我问指南上列出的「雇主缴款」包不包括养老金计划。

words.enDefinition: An organized list of employers to look up

examples.en: I searched the employer directory for museums within an easy train ride of campus.
examples.zh: 我在「雇主名录」里查有哪些博物馆从学校坐火车容易到达。

examples.en: The employer directory lists companies that have taken part in events at the university.
examples.zh: 「雇主名录」列出了参加过学校活动的公司。

words.enDefinition: A meeting where an employer tells candidates about opportunities

examples.en: The employer information session took place in the library shortly after our afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午的讲座刚结束没多久，「雇主招聘说明会」就在图书馆开始了。

examples.en: After the employer information session, I knew which of their offices had student roles.
examples.zh: 参加完「雇主招聘说明会」，我知道了他们哪些办公室有学生岗位。

collocations: register for an employer information session

words.enDefinition: An employer payment linked to an employee's contribution

examples.en: The leaflet explained how the employer match would appear in the retirement account.
examples.zh: 传单解释了「雇主配缴款」会怎样显示在退休储蓄账户里。

examples.en: I asked where the rules for the employer match were listed in the benefits guide.
examples.zh: 我问福利指南哪里列出了「雇主配缴款」的规则。

words.enDefinition: An employer's formal nomination of a position or worker for immigration

examples.en: The Australian adviser explained the employer nomination part of the sample application.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这位顾问解释了申请样本里的「雇主提名」部分。

examples.en: I asked which job title appeared in the employer nomination record.
examples.zh: 我问「雇主提名」记录里写的是哪个职位名称。

collocations: an employer nomination for a position

words.enDefinition: Looking up information about places you might work

examples.en: I did some employer research before deciding which stands to visit at the fair.
examples.zh: 确定先逛哪些展位之前，我先做了些「雇主调研」。

examples.en: The library guide links to public records that students can use for employer research.
examples.zh: 图书馆指南提供了公开资料的链接，学生可以用来做「雇主调研」。

words.enDefinition: A Canadian permit restricting a worker to the employer listed

examples.en: The Canadian adviser checked the employer listed on my employer-specific work permit.
examples.zh: 加拿大的顾问核对了我的「加拿大指定雇主工签」上列出的雇主。

examples.en: I asked where the work location appeared on the sample employer-specific work permit.
examples.zh: 我问这张「加拿大指定雇主工签」样本上哪里写着工作地点。

collocations: conditions on an employer-specific work permit

words.enDefinition: Health insurance arranged through an employer

examples.en: The offer included employer-sponsored health insurance, with the plan details in a separate attachment.
examples.zh: 录用通知包括「雇主提供的医疗保险」，具体方案另见附件。

examples.en: I asked when employer-sponsored health insurance would begin if I accepted the library's offer.
examples.zh: 我问如果接受图书馆的录用通知，「雇主提供的医疗保险」什么时候开始。

words.enDefinition: An agreement setting out the terms of an employee's work

examples.en: I checked the work location listed in my employment agreement before orientation.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会前，我核对了「劳动合同」上的工作地点。

examples.en: My employment agreement named the department where I would start that semester.
examples.zh: 我的「劳动合同」列明了那学期入职的部门。

words.enDefinition: Permission under immigration rules for someone to take paid work

examples.en: I asked which document the office needed to confirm my employment authorization.
examples.zh: 我问办公室需要哪份文件确认我的「就业许可」。

examples.en: The adviser explained the difference between my student status and my employment authorization.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了我的学生身份和「就业许可」之间的区别。

words.enDefinition: A USCIS card showing a person's authorization to work in the US

examples.en: My adviser showed where the dates appeared on the Employment Authorization Document.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了「美国就业许可卡」上显示日期的位置。

examples.en: I asked whether the office had recorded my Employment Authorization Document correctly.
examples.zh: 我问办公室是否正确登记了我的「美国就业许可卡」。

collocations: the dates on an Employment Authorization Document

words.enDefinition: A category indicating the type of employment a worker has

examples.en: The onboarding form listed my employment classification beside my department name.
examples.zh: 入职表在院系名称旁边列明了我的「雇佣类别」。

examples.en: I asked whether my employment classification would change after the placement.
examples.zh: 我问实习结束后自己的「雇佣类别」是否会变。

words.enDefinition: The dates showing when a person started and finished a job

examples.en: I used my old payslips to check the employment dates on my CV.
examples.zh: 我用旧工资单核对简历上的「任职起止日期」。

examples.en: The employment dates overlapped because I kept both campus jobs for a term.
examples.zh: 由于我有一学期同时做着两份校内工作，「任职起止日期」有重叠。

words.enDefinition: Checking someone's identity and authorization to work during hiring

examples.en: The US onboarding packet listed employment eligibility verification separately from the tax forms.
examples.zh: 美国的入职资料包把「就业资格核验」与税务表格分开列出。

examples.en: Human resources explained which office handled employment eligibility verification for campus employees.
examples.zh: 人力资源部门说明了哪个办公室负责校内员工的「就业资格核验」。

words.enDefinition: A period between jobs when someone was not employed

examples.en: I asked how to show an employment gap caused by full-time study.
examples.zh: 我问该怎么在简历上体现因全日制就读造成的「工作空档期」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me write a brief note explaining the employment gap.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我写了一条简短说明，解释这段「工作空档期」。

words.enDefinition: A condition limiting work to a specified site or area

examples.en: The adviser showed where the employment location restriction appeared on the example permit.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了许可证样本上「工作地点限制」的位置。

examples.en: I asked whether the employment location restriction applied to the whole district.
examples.zh: 我问「工作地点限制」是否适用于整个地区。

collocations: an employment location restriction on a permit

words.enDefinition: Specific information about employment terms such as hours or work location

examples.en: I asked which of the employment particulars explained changes to my schedule.
examples.zh: 我问哪条「雇佣条件明细」说明了排班变动。

examples.en: The UK supervisor checked the employment particulars before meeting the new starters.
examples.zh: 英国主管见新员工之前核对了「雇佣条件明细」。

words.enDefinition: An account of someone's employment or performance from a former employer

examples.en: My previous supervisor agreed to provide an employment reference for the placement.
examples.zh: 前任主管同意为我申请实习提供「工作推荐意见」。

examples.en: The office explained what information appeared in its standard employment reference.
examples.zh: 办公室解释了标准的「工作推荐意见」会写哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: Checking whether someone's stated past or current employment details are accurate

examples.en: The former employer provided my start and end dates for employment verification.
examples.zh: 原雇主为「任职经历核实」提供了我的入职和离职日期。

examples.en: The agency asked a question about my summer job during employment verification.
examples.zh: 在「任职经历核实」期间，机构问了我一个暑期工作的问题。

words.enDefinition: a document included with a physical letter, often listed under the signature

examples.en: The reference form was marked as an enclosure at the bottom of my letter.
examples.zh: 我在信的底部把推荐表标注为「随信附上的材料」。

examples.en: I forgot to include the enclosure when I first prepared the envelope.
examples.zh: 我第一次装信封时，忘了放进「随信附上的材料」。

words.enDefinition: finish a placement before its agreed end date

examples.en: I had to end a placement early when the project moved to another city.
examples.zh: 项目搬到另一座城市后，我只好「提前结束实习」。

examples.en: The supervisor asked why I wanted to end a placement early before discussing alternatives.
examples.zh: 带教老师先问我为什么想「提前结束实习」，再和我讨论其他办法。

collocations: decide to end a placement early
have to end a placement early
ask to end a placement early

words.enDefinition: To finish a conversation leaving people with a good feeling

examples.en: I thanked the panel for their questions to end on a positive note.
examples.zh: 我感谢了面试小组的提问，让谈话「以积极的话收尾」。

examples.en: The adviser let me practice how to end on a positive note after a difficult interview.
examples.zh: 顾问让我练习在一场不太顺利的面试中，怎样「以积极的话收尾」。

collocations: end on a positive note after a difficult question
try to end on a positive note
help an interview end on a positive note

words.enDefinition: a job intended for someone new to a field

examples.en: I'm looking for an entry-level position where my experience as a student volunteer will count.
examples.zh: 我在找一个「入门级岗位」，希望自己的学生志愿者经历能派上用场。

examples.en: The university advertised an entry-level position that was open to people changing careers too.
examples.zh: 学校招聘一个「入门级岗位」，转行的人也能申请。

words.enDefinition: Collection of information to assess fairness in recruitment

examples.en: The equal opportunities monitoring section was on a separate page from my application answers.
examples.zh: 「平等就业机会监测」栏和申请问题的答案分在不同页面。
