examples.en: I asked who could see the information collected for equal opportunities monitoring on this form.
examples.zh: 我问谁能看到这份表单为「平等就业机会监测」收集的信息。

collocations: collect data for equal opportunities monitoring

words.enDefinition: A form recording workplace equipment assigned to a particular employee

examples.en: The office listed the laptop and charger on my equipment issue form.
examples.zh: 办公室在我的「设备领用登记表」上列出了笔记本电脑和充电器。

examples.en: I checked the serial number against the one on the equipment issue form.
examples.zh: 我把设备序列号和「设备领用登记表」上的号码核对了一下。

collocations: record a laptop on the equipment issue form

words.enDefinition: A document listing workplace items an employee has handed back

examples.en: I kept a copy of the equipment return form after returning the headset.
examples.zh: 我归还耳机之后，留了一份「设备归还登记表」的副本。

examples.en: The administrator checked that the charger appeared on my equipment return form.
examples.zh: 行政人员核对了我的「设备归还登记表」上是否列有充电器。

words.enDefinition: experience accepted in place of a stated credential or requirement

examples.en: The listing says the lab accepts equivalent experience if you don't have the named certificate.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着，如果没有列出的证书，实验室也认可「可替代资质的经验」。

examples.en: I asked whether two years in the campus workshop would count as equivalent experience.
examples.zh: 我问在学校工坊做两年算不算「可替代资质的经验」。

words.enDefinition: a credential accepted as comparable to the one requested

examples.en: I asked whether my certificate counted as an equivalent qualification for the library position.
examples.zh: 我问我的证书算不算图书馆岗位要求的「同等资格」。

examples.en: The advert lists a local diploma or an equivalent qualification from another country.
examples.zh: 招聘启事列出了本地文凭，或是在其他国家取得的「同等资格」。

words.enDefinition: the route an issue follows to reach people with higher authority or relevant expertise

examples.en: The guide shows the escalation path for complaints the reception team cannot resolve.
examples.zh: 指南写明了接待团队解决不了投诉时的「逐级上报路径」。

examples.en: We agreed on an escalation path before opening the temporary help desk.
examples.zh: 临时服务台开放前，我们定下了一条「逐级上报路径」。

collocations: an escalation path for urgent issues

words.enDefinition: a person or team designated to receive issues that cannot be handled at the current level

examples.en: The duty manager was the escalation point for issues beyond the desk team's authority.
examples.zh: 超出柜台团队权限的问题，由值班经理担任「问题升级对接人」。

examples.en: I checked the schedule to see who was our escalation point that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我查了排班表，看看那天下午的「问题升级对接人」是谁。

words.enDefinition: a condition every suitable applicant needs to meet

examples.en: Weekend availability was an essential criterion, so I checked the dates of my field trips.
examples.zh: 周末能上班是「必备条件」，所以我查了一下实地考察的日期。

examples.en: The museum listed written English as an essential criterion for answering emails from visitors.
examples.zh: 博物馆把书面英语列为「必备条件」，因为这份工作要回复来访者的邮件。

collocations: list something as an essential criterion

words.enDefinition: to approximate how much demand a system or process will need to handle

examples.en: The panel asked me to estimate the workload during the busiest hour of term.
examples.zh: 评审组让我「估算系统负载」，看学期里最忙的一个小时会有多少请求。

examples.en: I used the number of students to estimate the workload for the booking service.
examples.zh: 我用学生人数来「估算系统负载」，看预约服务需要承受多少使用需求。

collocations: estimate the workload for a service
estimate the workload at peak times
use sample figures to estimate the workload

words.enDefinition: the factors used to assess the quality or suitability of something

examples.en: I checked the evaluation criteria to see how much the report's explanation mattered.
examples.zh: 我查了「评估标准」，看看报告中的解释有多重要。

examples.en: The panel discussed the evaluation criteria before announcing how the task would be scored.
examples.zh: 评审组先谈了「评估标准」，然后公布任务怎样打分。

words.enDefinition: the ability to work during the evening

examples.en: The theatre requires evening availability on opening nights, even for people who usually work mornings.
examples.zh: 这家剧院要求首演日「晚间可上班」，平时上早班的人也一样。

examples.en: I checked my evening availability before enquiring about the cinema's two weekday shifts.
examples.zh: 打听电影院工作日的两个班次前，我先确认了自己是否「晚间可上班」。

words.enDefinition: work samples or observations showing someone can perform a required task

examples.en: My supervisor asked which notes I could use as evidence of competence for the assessment.
examples.zh: 带教老师问我能用哪些笔记作为这次评估中「能力达标的佐证」。

examples.en: The assessor accepted the demonstration as evidence of competence for the archive's filing task.
examples.zh: 评估老师认可这次演示为档案馆归档任务中「能力达标的佐证」。

words.enDefinition: To share ways of contacting each other

examples.en: We got a chance to exchange contact details before the exhibition hall closed.
examples.zh: 展厅关门前，我们有机会「交换联系方式」。

examples.en: Did you exchange contact details with the graduate who spoke after the break?
examples.zh: 你和休息后发言的那位毕业生「交换联系方式」了吗？

collocations: exchange contact details after an event
exchange contact details with a speaker

words.enDefinition: A list of organizations with stands at an event

examples.en: I checked the exhibitor list because I only had an hour at the fair.
examples.zh: 我只能在招聘会上待一个小时，所以先看了「参展单位名单」。

examples.en: The exhibitor list showed that two local radio stations would have booths this year.
examples.zh: 「参展单位名单」显示，今年两家本地广播电台会设展位。

words.enDefinition: the result a test or program should produce for a specified input

examples.en: The exercise showed the expected output next to each set of test values.
examples.zh: 练习在每组测试数据旁边列出了「预期输出」。

examples.en: I wrote down the expected output before asking the program to process the empty list.
examples.zh: 让程序处理空列表之前，我先记下了「预期输出」。

words.enDefinition: The part of a document describing previous jobs or activities

examples.en: My experience section includes a campus job and two projects from class.
examples.zh: 我的「经历栏」包括一份校内工作和两个课程项目。

examples.en: I read the experience section aloud to hear where the descriptions sounded repetitive.
examples.zh: 我把「经历栏」念了一遍，听听哪些描述有些重复。

words.enDefinition: An offer no longer open because time ran out

examples.en: The portal displayed an expired offer when I checked the application after the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期后查看申请时，门户显示这份「录用通知已失效」。

examples.en: I asked whether an expired offer would still appear in my application history.
examples.zh: 我问「已失效的录用通知」是否仍会出现在申请历史记录里。

collocations: an expired offer in the portal
an expired offer cannot be accepted

words.enDefinition: A listing past its advertised closing date

examples.en: I bookmarked an expired posting by mistake because it still appeared in the search results.
examples.zh: 我误收藏了一条「已过期的招聘信息」，因为它还出现在搜索结果中。

examples.en: The job board added a grey label to each expired posting in my search.
examples.zh: 招聘平台在我的搜索结果里，给每条「已过期的招聘信息」加了灰色标签。

words.enDefinition: to describe why someone is moving from one kind of work to another

examples.en: I used one sentence to explain a career change from hospitality to museum work.
examples.zh: 我用一句话「解释了转行的原因」，说明为什么从餐旅服务转到博物馆工作。

examples.en: The adviser showed how to explain a career change without dismissing earlier experience.
examples.zh: 顾问示范了怎样「解释转行的原因」，而不低估之前的经历。

collocations: explain a career change in your letter
be ready to explain a career change

words.enDefinition: to describe what a chart shows and how to understand it

examples.en: I took a moment to explain a chart showing the busiest times of day.
examples.zh: 我花了一点时间「讲解一张图表」，上面显示了一天中最忙的时段。

examples.en: The panel asked me to explain a chart without referring to the written notes.
examples.zh: 评审组让我不看笔记，「讲解一张图表」。

collocations: explain a chart to an audience
learn how to explain a chart

words.enDefinition: To describe what happened as a result of an action

examples.en: I used the attendance figures to explain the outcome of our scheduling changes.
examples.zh: 我用出席人数的数据来「解释结果」，说明调整日程有什么效果。

examples.en: The adviser gave me a second chance to explain the outcome of the project.
examples.zh: 顾问又给了我一次机会，让我「解释结果」，说明这个项目最后怎么样了。

collocations: explain the outcome of a decision
explain the outcome to the panel

words.enDefinition: to tell another person what you are treating as true when reaching a result

examples.en: The interviewer asked you to explain your assumptions before writing down an estimate.
examples.zh: 面试官让你先「说明你的假设」，再写下估算值。

examples.en: It helps to explain your assumptions if the prompt leaves some details unspecified.
examples.zh: 如果题目没给齐细节，「说明你的假设」有助于别人理解。

collocations: explain your assumptions about the data

words.enDefinition: To say why you reached a particular judgment or decision

examples.en: The sample prompt asks you to explain your reasoning for changing the meeting time.
examples.zh: 样题让你「解释你的理由」，说明为什么调整开会时间。

examples.en: It is easier to explain your reasoning when you remember what choices were available.
examples.zh: 如果记得当时有哪些选项，就更容易「解释你的理由」。

collocations: explain your reasoning for a decision
invite someone to explain their reasoning

words.enDefinition: a short video explaining what something is or how it works

examples.en: I recorded an explainer video so visitors could see how the prototype worked.
examples.zh: 我录了一段「讲解视频」，让访客了解原型是怎样运作的。

examples.en: The explainer video uses captions for viewers who watch it without sound.
examples.zh: 「讲解视频」配有字幕，方便关掉声音观看的人。

words.enDefinition: to communicate that you want to learn about or be considered for an opportunity

examples.en: You can express your interest in the placement by explaining what you hope to learn.
examples.zh: 你可以说明自己想学到什么，借此「表达你对这项实习的兴趣」。

examples.en: You can express your interest in the archive role by mentioning your cataloguing experience.
examples.zh: 你可以提及目录编制经验，借此「表达对档案岗位的兴趣」。

collocations: express your interest in the role

words.enDefinition: To allow more time to answer a job offer

examples.en: The department agreed to extend an offer deadline because the portal was temporarily unavailable.
examples.zh: 求职门户暂时无法使用，部门同意「延长录用回复期限」。

examples.en: Can the recruiter extend an offer deadline while a candidate waits for a final schedule?
examples.zh: 求职者等待最终时间表期间，招聘人员能「延长录用回复期限」吗？

collocations: agree to extend an offer deadline
request that an employer extend an offer deadline
extend an offer deadline by two days

words.enDefinition: a shorter number that identifies an internal phone line

examples.en: I kept the extension number next to the main line in my notes.
examples.zh: 我把「电话分机号」记在笔记里，紧挨着总机号码。

examples.en: The recording asked for an extension number before it would connect the call.
examples.zh: 录音提示输入「电话分机号」，输入后才能转接。

words.enDefinition: a recruiter hired from outside the employer's own staff

examples.en: An external recruiter contacted me on behalf of a museum looking for weekend staff.
examples.zh: 「外部招聘人员」代表一家博物馆联系我，那家馆正在招周末员工。

examples.en: I asked the external recruiter which organization they were representing before arranging the call.
examples.zh: 安排通话前，我问「外部招聘人员」代表的是哪家机构。

collocations: an email from an external recruiter

words.enDefinition: Participation in organized activities outside formal classes

examples.en: My extracurricular involvement included running the student radio station with two classmates.
examples.zh: 我的「课外活动参与经历」包括与两位同学共同运营学生电台。

examples.en: The adviser suggested describing what I did under extracurricular involvement in one sentence.
examples.zh: 顾问建议我在「课外活动参与经历」一栏用一句话讲清我做过什么。

words.enDefinition: To guide a practical session so participants can participate effectively

examples.en: I helped facilitate a workshop where first-year students practiced giving each other feedback.
examples.zh: 我协助「引导工作坊」，让大一学生练习互相提供反馈。

examples.en: The role gave me a chance to facilitate a workshop with another student adviser.
examples.zh: 这个岗位让我有机会与另一位学生顾问合作「引导工作坊」。

words.enDefinition: a faculty member overseeing the academic side of a placement

examples.en: My faculty supervisor checked that the internship project connected with what I was studying.
examples.zh: 「校方实习指导老师」确认了实习项目和我学的内容有关。

examples.en: I sent the draft reflection to my faculty supervisor before discussing it at the college.
examples.zh: 我先把反思初稿发给「校方实习指导老师」，再回学院讨论。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚雇佣权利说明
words.enDefinition: An Australian document outlining key workplace rights and conditions
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚雇佣权利说明

examples.en: The Australian café included the Fair Work Information Statement with the welcome material.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这家咖啡馆在欢迎资料中附上了「澳大利亚雇佣权利说明」。

examples.en: I read the Fair Work Information Statement while reviewing my orientation documents at home.
examples.zh: 我在家看入职文件时，读了「澳大利亚雇佣权利说明」。

collocations: provide the Fair Work Information Statement
read the Fair Work Information Statement
a copy of the Fair Work Information Statement

words.enDefinition: A listing for a job that does not exist

examples.en: I reported a fake job posting that used the name of a nearby museum.
examples.zh: 我举报了一条冒用附近博物馆名称的「虚假招聘信息」。

examples.en: The careers office removed the fake job posting after a student flagged it.
examples.zh: 一名学生举报后，学校就业办公室移除了这条「虚假招聘信息」。

words.enDefinition: a project given a prominent place in a presentation or collection of work

examples.en: My featured project is a campus wayfinding system developed with the disability team.
examples.zh: 我「重点展示的项目」是和残障支持团队一起开发的校园导视系统。

examples.en: The reviewer opened the featured project first because it matched the agency's work.
examples.zh: 评审先打开了「重点展示的项目」，因为它与机构的业务相符。

collocations: a featured project on the homepage

words.enDefinition: a message or form asking someone to comment on a piece of work or performance

examples.en: I sent a feedback request with one question about the revised room guide.
examples.zh: 我发了一条「反馈请求」，询问新版场地指南的一个细节。

examples.en: The feedback request asked the reviewer to focus on the opening section.
examples.zh: 「反馈请求」请审阅人把重点放在开头。

collocations: attach a draft to a feedback request

words.enDefinition: a planned conversation to discuss what worked well and what could improve

examples.en: The feedback session gave me a chance to ask about my first week.
examples.zh: 「反馈交流会」让我有机会询问自己第一周的表现。

examples.en: I brought two examples of my work to the feedback session on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二参加「反馈交流会」时，我带了两份工作样例。

words.expression: feel free to get in touch
words.lemma: feel free to get in touch
words.enDefinition: invites someone to make contact without hesitation
acceptedEnVariants: feel free to get in touch

examples.en: Feel free to get in touch if you want to discuss another time this week.
examples.zh: 如果你想这周再约个时间，「尽管联系我」。

examples.en: Feel free to get in touch with me again once your course has ended.
examples.zh: 课程结束后，「尽管再联系我」。

collocations: feel free to get in touch by email
feel free to get in touch with me
feel free to get in touch if you have questions

words.enDefinition: a job carried out mainly away from a central workplace

examples.en: The field-based role involves visiting community gardens rather than spending each day in an office.
examples.zh: 这个「外勤岗位」要走访社区花园，不用天天待在办公室。

examples.en: I saw a field-based role collecting water samples on weekdays with a small team.
examples.zh: 我看到一个「外勤岗位」，工作日和小团队一起采集水样。

words.enDefinition: supervised practical training in the setting where a profession is carried out

examples.en: My social work course arranged a field placement with a youth organization near campus.
examples.zh: 我的社会工作课程把「专业现场实习」安排在学校附近的一家青年机构。

examples.en: The field placement gave us a chance to put our classroom discussions into practice.
examples.zh: 「专业现场实习」让我们有机会把课堂上讨论的内容用到实际工作里。

words.enDefinition: A display of a file before it is opened or submitted

examples.en: I used the file preview to check that both pages of my document were visible.
examples.zh: 我通过「文件预览」确认材料的两页都能看见。

examples.en: The file preview showed only the first page until I scrolled down inside the box.
examples.zh: 我在框内向下滚动之前，「文件预览」只显示第一页。

collocations: a thumbnail in the file preview

words.enDefinition: give the job to someone who already works for the organization

examples.en: The manager decided to fill the role internally after a member of staff expressed interest.
examples.zh: 有员工表示感兴趣后，经理决定「从内部选人填补岗位」。

examples.en: We expect to fill the role internally, so the call on Tuesday won't go ahead.
examples.zh: 我们预计会「从内部选人填补岗位」，所以周二的通话取消。

collocations: decide to fill the role internally
opt to fill the role internally
plan to fill the role internally

words.enDefinition: the finished item a project must hand over to a client or other recipient

examples.en: The final deliverable was a set of maps that the school could print immediately.
examples.zh: 「最终交付成果」是一套学校可以立即印刷的地图。

examples.en: I put the final deliverable at the end so readers could see what changed.
examples.zh: 我把「最终交付成果」放在结尾，方便读者看出前后变化。

words.enDefinition: an overall assessment at the end of a placement

examples.en: The final placement evaluation included comments from my host supervisor and my university tutor.
examples.zh: 「实习期末评估」里有实习单位带教老师和学校导师的评语。

examples.en: I read my final placement evaluation before deciding what to work on next term.
examples.zh: 我先看了「实习期末评估」，再决定下学期重点提高哪方面。

words.enDefinition: The last interview in a sequence for a particular job

examples.en: My final-round interview focused on what I wanted to learn during the placement.
examples.zh: 我的「最后一轮面试」主要谈了实习期间我想学到什么。

examples.en: At the final-round interview, I met the person who managed the whole department.
examples.zh: 在「最后一轮面试」中，我见到了整个部门的负责人。

words.enDefinition: The last action sending a completed application

examples.en: The system lets me change my answers right up until final submission of the form.
examples.zh: 在表单「最终提交」之前，系统一直允许我修改答案。

examples.en: I asked whether final submission would prevent me from updating my phone number later.
examples.zh: 我问「最终提交」后会不会无法更新电话号码。

words.enDefinition: To complete the agreed details of a job offer

examples.en: The manager needed the exact start date before she could finalise an offer for me.
examples.zh: 经理需要确定准确的到岗日期，才能为我「敲定录用细节」。

examples.en: Can the department finalise an offer while the work schedule is still being discussed?
examples.zh: 工作排班还在讨论的时候，部门能「敲定录用细节」吗？

collocations: be ready to finalise an offer
need approval to finalise an offer

words.enDefinition: To discover priorities or views both sides share

examples.en: We managed to find common ground by discussing which evenings worked for everyone.
examples.zh: 讨论哪些晚上大家都有空之后，我们总算「找到了共同点」。

examples.en: The manager and I began to find common ground when we compared our weekly schedules.
examples.zh: 经理和我对照了各自每周的时间表后，开始「找到双方都能接受的地方」。

collocations: work together to find common ground
help both sides find common ground

words.enDefinition: Plans for starting one's first day at a job

examples.en: The first-day arrangements included collecting my pass and meeting the rest of the team.
examples.zh: 「首日到岗安排」包括领通行证和与其他团队成员见面。

examples.en: I received the first-day arrangements in an email after agreeing to the new start date.
examples.zh: 商定新的到岗日期后，我收到了一封邮件，里面写了「首日到岗安排」。

words.enDefinition: the first day someone actually works in a new position

examples.en: On my first day on the job, I helped prepare the returns desk.
examples.zh: 「上班第一天」，我帮忙把退还物品的柜台准备好。

examples.en: My supervisor had a short checklist ready for my first day on the job.
examples.zh: 主管为我「上班第一天」准备了一份简短清单。

collocations: prepare for your first day on the job
on your first day on the job
through your first day on the job

words.enDefinition: The first day someone actually works in a job

examples.en: I met the rest of the library team on my first working day there.
examples.zh: 我「第一天上班」时见到了图书馆团队的其他成员。

examples.en: The message explained where to pick up my key on my first working day.
examples.zh: 消息写明了我「第一天上班」要去哪里领钥匙。

collocations: instructions for your first working day

words.enDefinition: working hours that do not change from week to week

examples.en: The role has fixed hours, so I can plan my lectures around the shifts.
examples.zh: 这个岗位有「固定工时」，我可以避开班次来排课。

examples.en: I prefer fixed hours because my evening class always starts at six on Wednesdays.
examples.zh: 我更想要「固定工时」，因为星期三的夜课总是六点开始。

words.enDefinition: an employment agreement for a specified length of time

examples.en: The archive offered a fixed-term contract that would run until the end of August.
examples.zh: 档案馆提供了一份「固定期限合同」，到八月底结束。

examples.en: I checked whether the fixed-term contract would finish before my next placement began.
examples.zh: 我查了一下这份「固定期限合同」会不会在下一段实习开始前结束。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚定期合同须知
words.enDefinition: An Australian document explaining rules and rights for fixed-term contracts
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚定期合同须知

examples.en: The Australian employer included the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement beside my new agreement.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这家雇主在我的新合同旁附上了「澳大利亚定期合同须知」。

examples.en: I printed the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement before discussing the paperwork with my supervisor.
examples.zh: 和主管讨论文件之前，我把「澳大利亚定期合同须知」打印了出来。

collocations: provide the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement
read the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement
a copy of the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement

words.enDefinition: to alert the relevant people that work or delivery might be late

examples.en: I emailed the team to flag a possible delay with the printed guides.
examples.zh: 我给团队发邮件「提前提示可能延误」，说明印刷的指南可能迟到。

examples.en: The supervisor asked us to flag a possible delay as soon as we noticed it.
examples.zh: 主管让我们一发现可能来不及，就「提前提示可能延误」。

collocations: flag a possible delay to the team
use the status report to flag a possible delay

words.enDefinition: Employment benefits that workers can choose among

examples.en: My offer mentioned flexible benefits and listed several options on the next page.
examples.zh: 录用通知提到了「可自选的员工福利」，并在下一页列出几个选项。

examples.en: I asked whether the flexible benefits also applied to people on the weekend schedule.
examples.zh: 我问上周末班的员工是否也能享受「可自选的员工福利」。

words.enDefinition: working hours that can be adjusted to suit different needs

examples.en: Flexible hours would help me fit a campus job around my weekly lab sessions.
examples.zh: 「弹性工时」能帮我把校内兼职安排在每周实验课以外的时间。

examples.en: The employer offers flexible hours but still expects everyone to attend the Monday meeting.
examples.zh: 雇主提供「弹性工时」，但仍要求所有人参加周一的会议。

words.enDefinition: Paid leave taken on a date chosen by the employee

examples.en: The handbook says that I can use my floating holiday on a day I choose.
examples.zh: 手册说，在我选定的那天，可以休「可自选日期的带薪假」。

examples.en: I asked whether the floating holiday had to be taken before the academic year ended.
examples.zh: 我问「可自选日期的带薪假」是不是要在学年结束前休完。

words.enDefinition: the ability to speak or use a language smoothly

examples.en: The campus tour job requires fluency in English because you'll answer visitors' questions as you walk.
examples.zh: 校园导览岗位要求「流利使用英语」，因为你要边走边回答来访者的问题。

examples.en: The notice says fluency in French is helpful for greeting visitors from the partner university.
examples.zh: 启事上说，「流利使用法语」有助于接待合作院校的访客。

words.enDefinition: To subscribe to updates from an employer

examples.en: On this site, I can follow a company and see when it posts openings.
examples.zh: 在这个网站上，我可以「关注一家公司」，查看它何时发布新岗位。

examples.en: Did you follow a company after discovering its page on the careers portal?
examples.zh: 你在就业服务门户上找到一家公司的页面后，有没有「关注那家公司」？

collocations: follow a company on a job board

words.enDefinition: The measurement that determines how large text appears on a page

examples.en: I checked the font size after a friend struggled to read my printed CV.
examples.zh: 朋友看我的纸质简历有些吃力，我就检查了「字号」。

examples.en: The font size of my name was larger than the headings below it.
examples.zh: 我名字的「字号」比下方各栏目标题的更大。

words.enDefinition: provided so that someone can check or consult the information later

examples.en: I attached last week's timetable for reference when proposing the new opening hours.
examples.zh: 我提议延长开放时间时，附了上周的时间表「供参考」。

examples.en: The supervisor kept a copy for reference after removing the old notice.
examples.zh: 主管撤下旧通知后保留了一份副本「供参考」。

words.enDefinition: used to pass along information without necessarily requesting any action

examples.en: I forwarded the change for your information and kept the original email attached.
examples.zh: 我把变更转发「供你了解」，并保留了原邮件。

examples.en: The coordinator marked the update for your information because no reply was needed.
examples.zh: 协调员在更新上标注「供你了解」，因为无须回复。

words.enDefinition: Automatic entry of previously saved information in a form

examples.en: I turned off form autofill after it entered my old address in the application.
examples.zh: 「表单自动填充」把我的旧地址填进申请后，我就把它关了。

examples.en: Form autofill saved me from entering my contact details again on the second page.
examples.zh: 有了「表单自动填充」，我不用在第二页再输入一遍联系方式。

words.enDefinition: The US form for applying for specified employment authorization

examples.en: I kept a copy of Form I-765 in my folder of USCIS notices.
examples.zh: 我把「美国就业许可申请表」副本放进保存美国移民局通知的文件夹。

examples.en: The adviser explained what Form I-765 referred to in the email.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了电子邮件里提到的「美国就业许可申请表」是什么。

words.enDefinition: The US employment form for documenting identity and work authorization

examples.en: I compared the name on my Form I-9 with the employment record.
examples.zh: 我核对了「美国就业资格核验表」上的姓名与任职记录是否一致。

examples.en: The US campus office included Form I-9 in the paperwork for new workers.
examples.zh: 美国这所大学的办公室在新员工的文件中附上了「美国就业资格核验表」。

words.enDefinition: The US training plan form for the STEM OPT extension

examples.en: My supervisor and I reviewed the training goals on Form I-983.
examples.zh: 我和主管一起核对了「美国STEM培训计划表」上的培训目标。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the supervisor's name appeared on Form I-983.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看「美国STEM培训计划表」上主管的姓名写在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: Automatic checks on information entered in a form

examples.en: Form validation caught a missing digit in my telephone number before I could continue.
examples.zh: 我继续之前，「表单校验」发现我的电话号码少了一位。

examples.en: The portal added form validation to check whether applicants had filled in all required details.
examples.zh: 门户增加了「表单校验」，用来检查求职者是否已经填写全部必填资料。

words.enDefinition: Someone a person worked with before

examples.en: A former colleague sent me a link to an opening at the city library.
examples.zh: 一位「前同事」发我一个链接，是市图书馆的空缺岗位。

examples.en: I ran into a former colleague while I was queuing at the career fair.
examples.zh: 我在招聘会上排队时，碰到了一位「前同事」。

collocations: get in touch with a former colleague
a recommendation from a former colleague

words.enDefinition: A box that allows a written answer

examples.en: I used the free-text field to explain the gap between my two courses.
examples.zh: 我在「自由填写栏」里解释了两段课程之间的空档。

examples.en: The free-text field let me describe my schedule in my own words.
examples.zh: 「自由填写栏」让我能用自己的话说明时间安排。

words.enDefinition: A person known through someone you are friends with

examples.en: A friend of a friend told me that the library was hiring evening staff.
examples.zh: 「朋友的朋友」告诉我，图书馆在招晚班人员。

examples.en: I found out about the publishing event through a friend of a friend.
examples.zh: 我通过一位「朋友的朋友」得知了这次出版行业活动。

collocations: hear from a friend of a friend
meet a friend of a friend
an introduction from a friend of a friend

words.enDefinition: a job with the employer's usual full working hours

examples.en: The lab advertised a full-time position that would be difficult to fit around my classes.
examples.zh: 实验室招了个「全职岗位」，我很难兼顾上课和工作。

examples.en: I'm interested in the full-time position once my current course finishes in July.
examples.zh: 我的课程七月结束，之后我对这个「全职岗位」有兴趣。

words.enDefinition: a description of something a system must do

examples.en: I wrote down one functional requirement for checking whether a study room was available.
examples.zh: 我记下一项查看学习室是否空闲的「功能需求」。

examples.en: The panel asked me to show which component handled that functional requirement.
examples.zh: 评审组让我指出哪个组件负责满足那项「功能需求」。

words.enDefinition: a cover letter written broadly enough to send for many different jobs

examples.en: The first draft read like a generic cover letter until I added specific examples.
examples.zh: 加上具体例子之前，初稿读起来像一封「通用求职信」。

examples.en: I saved my generic cover letter as a starting point for later applications.
examples.zh: 我保存了「通用求职信」，方便以后写申请时用作初稿。

collocations: start with a generic cover letter

words.enDefinition: To state what matters immediately without unnecessary introduction

examples.en: The adviser told me to get straight to the point when explaining why I applied.
examples.zh: 顾问让我解释为什么应聘时要「开门见山」。

examples.en: I cut the first two sentences so I could get straight to the point more quickly.
examples.zh: 我删掉了前两句，好更快「开门见山」。

collocations: try to get straight to the point
get straight to the point in your answer
help someone get straight to the point

words.enDefinition: to learn enough about a job or situation to work effectively at the current stage

examples.en: I spent my first morning reading the project notes to get up to speed.
examples.zh: 第一天上午，我读了项目记录，想尽快「弄清情况跟上进度」。

examples.en: The supervisor gave me time to get up to speed before answering calls.
examples.zh: 主管让我先「弄清情况跟上进度」，再开始接电话。

collocations: get up to speed on a project
help someone get up to speed

words.expression: get your foot in the door
words.lemma: get your foot in the door
words.enDefinition: To gain an initial opportunity in an organization or field
acceptedEnVariants: get your foot in the door

examples.en: Did the weekend shifts help you get your foot in the door at the theatre?
examples.zh: 周末班有没有帮你「获得进入剧院工作的机会」？

examples.en: It can take a while to get your foot in the door in local radio.
examples.zh: 要「获得踏入本地广播行业的机会」，可能得花些时间。

collocations: a chance to get your foot in the door
help you get your foot in the door
try to get your foot in the door

words.enDefinition: to describe a particular instance that demonstrates a general point

examples.en: I tried to give a concrete example rather than list all my software skills.
examples.zh: 我试着「举了个具体的例子」，没有只罗列自己掌握的软件技能。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to give a concrete example of working under pressure.
examples.zh: 导师要我就如何在压力下工作「举个具体的例子」。

collocations: give a concrete example from your work
give a concrete example of a skill
ask someone to give a concrete example

words.enDefinition: to tell others about something before it happens, so they have time to prepare

examples.en: I tried to give advance notice before moving my shift to another day.
examples.zh: 我想把班次改到另一天，尽量先「提前通知」大家。

examples.en: The coordinator asked us to give advance notice of equipment needed for a workshop.
examples.zh: 协调员请我们「提前通知」培训需要用哪些设备。

collocations: give advance notice of a change
give advance notice to your supervisor
be able to give advance notice

words.enDefinition: to give specific comments that help someone understand what works and what to improve

examples.en: The supervisor showed us how to give constructive feedback after the practice session.
examples.zh: 练习结束后，主管示范了怎样「给出建设性反馈」。

examples.en: I tried to give constructive feedback by pointing to one moment in the recording.
examples.zh: 我试着「给出建设性反馈」，具体指出录像中的一个片段。

collocations: give constructive feedback to a colleague
give constructive feedback on a draft

words.enDefinition: to acknowledge the contribution a colleague made to a result

examples.en: I wanted to give credit to a colleague who had checked every booking.
examples.zh: 我想「肯定一位同事的贡献」，因为对方核对了每一笔预约。

examples.en: The manager asked me to give credit to a colleague when sharing our results.
examples.zh: 经理让我在分享团队成果时「肯定一位同事的贡献」。

collocations: give credit to a colleague for helping
remember to give credit to a colleague
give credit to a colleague in public

words.expression: give me a moment to check
words.lemma: give me a moment to check
words.enDefinition: asks for a little time to verify information
acceptedEnVariants: give me a moment to check

examples.en: Could you give me a moment to check which days my lab runs next week?
examples.zh: 能「给我一点时间查一下」下周哪几天有实验课吗？

examples.en: Please give me a moment to check the room number before I send the invitation.
examples.zh: 「请给我一点时间查一下」房间号，我再把邀请发出去。

collocations: please give me a moment to check
give me a moment to check my calendar
give me a moment to check the date

words.enDefinition: To add information that helps someone understand a topic or experience

examples.en: I mentioned when the internship started to give some context for my example.
examples.zh: 我提到实习开始的时间，为自己的例子「提供一些背景」。

examples.en: The panel asked me to give some context before discussing the change in attendance.
examples.zh: 面试小组请我先「提供一些背景」，再谈出席人数的变化。

collocations: give some context for the decision

words.enDefinition: To do useful work outside the tasks someone has given you

examples.en: The question asked when you chose to go beyond your assigned duties to help a team.
examples.zh: 题目问你什么时候选择「做超出分内职责的事」来帮助团队。

examples.en: Our adviser asked for an example of when you go beyond your assigned duties at work.
examples.zh: 顾问让你举个在工作中「做超出分内职责的事」的例子。

collocations: go beyond your assigned duties to help
choose to go beyond your assigned duties
learn when to go beyond your assigned duties

words.enDefinition: a group of new graduates taken on by an employer together

examples.en: Our graduate intake met for the first time at the office in Manchester.
examples.zh: 我们这「一批招进来的毕业生」第一次在曼彻斯特的办公室见面。

examples.en: The company plans to move its next graduate intake into smaller teams for training.
examples.zh: 公司计划把下一「批招进来的毕业生」分到更小的团队接受培训。

words.enDefinition: What graduates do after finishing a course

examples.en: The course page listed graduate outcomes from the past five years, including further study.
examples.zh: 课程页面列出了过去五年的「毕业生去向」，包括继续深造的情况。

examples.en: I looked at graduate outcomes to find out which sectors former students had entered.
examples.zh: 我看了「毕业生去向」，想知道校友进了哪些行业。

words.enDefinition: Recruiting people who recently completed a degree

examples.en: The annual report mentioned graduate recruitment in its section on plans for next year.
examples.zh: 这份年报在下一年计划部分提到了「应届毕业生招聘」。

examples.en: I asked when graduate recruitment would begin for students finishing their courses in June.
examples.zh: 我问六月结课的学生什么时候能参加「应届毕业生招聘」。

words.enDefinition: a structured employer program for people who recently finished university

examples.en: The UK graduate scheme lets new graduates work with several teams before choosing an area.
examples.zh: 这个英国的「毕业生培养项目」让刚毕业的人先在几个团队工作，再选方向。

examples.en: I compared the training on each graduate scheme before deciding which ones to apply for.
examples.zh: 我比较了各个「毕业生培养项目」的培训内容，才决定申请哪些。

words.zhGloss: 毕业生培养项目负责人
words.enDefinition: the person who oversees an employer's graduate training program
acceptedZhAnswers: 毕业生培养项目负责人

examples.en: I contacted the graduate scheme manager after noticing a clash between two training days.
examples.zh: 我发现两天培训的时间撞了，就联系了「毕业生培养项目负责人」。

examples.en: The graduate scheme manager arranged a session for people interested in switching training tracks.
examples.zh: 「毕业生培养项目负责人」安排了一场说明会，面向想换培养方向的人。

collocations: email from the graduate scheme manager

words.enDefinition: a recent graduate employed in a formal training role

examples.en: I joined the museum as a graduate trainee and spent a month with its exhibitions team.
examples.zh: 我以「毕业生培训生」的身份进了博物馆，在展览团队工作了一个月。

examples.en: The graduate trainee met her supervisor to discuss what she would learn next month.
examples.zh: 这位「毕业生培训生」和导师见了面，讨论下个月要学什么。

words.enDefinition: a route within a graduate training program focused on particular work

examples.en: I chose the graduate training track in logistics after talking to someone from operations.
examples.zh: 和运营部门的人聊过后，我选择了物流这个「毕业生培养方向」。

examples.en: Each graduate training track has a different mix of projects and classroom sessions.
examples.zh: 每个「毕业生培养方向」安排的项目和课堂培训组合都不一样。

collocations: switch to another graduate training track

words.enDefinition: A UK post-study visa for people who completed eligible studies

examples.en: The UK adviser discussed the Graduate visa at the careers information session.
examples.zh: 英国这位顾问在就业说明会上介绍了「英国毕业生签证」。

examples.en: I asked where the employer's guidance mentioned the Graduate visa by name.
examples.zh: 我问雇主的指南在哪里明确提到「英国毕业生签证」。

collocations: the conditions of a Graduate visa

words.enDefinition: an evaluation in which candidates complete a task together and their participation is observed

examples.en: The group assessment asked us to agree on a proposal within fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 「小组测评」要求我们在十五分钟之内就一份方案达成一致。

examples.en: I asked whether the group assessment would be followed by an individual interview.
examples.zh: 我问「小组测评」之后会不会有个人面试。

collocations: take part in a group assessment

words.enDefinition: An interview in which multiple candidates are assessed together

examples.en: At the group interview, four applicants discussed how front desk shifts might be divided.
examples.zh: 在「多应聘者面试」中，四名应聘者讨论了如何安排前台轮班。

examples.en: Our group interview ended with an opportunity for each applicant to ask a question.
examples.zh: 「多应聘者面试」结束前，每位应聘者都有机会提一个问题。

collocations: take part in a group interview

words.enDefinition: An industry expanding in output, demand, or employment

examples.en: The report called animation a growth industry in the region after several studios opened.
examples.zh: 几家工作室开张后，报告把动画列为当地的「增长型行业」。

examples.en: She wanted to learn whether film production was still a growth industry in the city.
examples.zh: 她想了解影视制作在这座城市是否仍是一个「增长型行业」。

words.enDefinition: A bonus the employer commits to paying

examples.en: The company confirmed the guaranteed bonus in writing before I signed the offer letter.
examples.zh: 我签录用函之前，公司书面确认了「保证发放的奖金」。

examples.en: I checked whether the guaranteed bonus was included in the first year's salary figures.
examples.zh: 我查了首年薪资金额有没有计入「保证发放的奖金」。

collocations: a guaranteed bonus for the first year

words.enDefinition: a minimum amount of work time the employer commits to providing

examples.en: The advert mentioned guaranteed hours, which would make it easier to budget for rent.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到有「保证安排的工时」，这样我更容易做房租预算。

examples.en: I asked if guaranteed hours were included because I couldn't rely on occasional shifts.
examples.zh: 我问有没有「保证安排的工时」，因为我不能只靠偶尔排个班。

words.enDefinition: An employer's request to USCIS for a worker's H-1B classification

examples.en: The employer explained what an H-1B petition was during the information session.
examples.zh: 雇主在说明会上解释了「美国H-1B雇主申请」是什么。

examples.en: I asked which reference number in the letter identified the H-1B petition.
examples.zh: 我问信里的哪个编号对应「美国H-1B雇主申请」。

words.enDefinition: to transfer responsibility for a piece of work to another person

examples.en: I needed to hand over a task before leaving for my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 去上下午的课之前，我需要「把任务交接出去」。

examples.en: The team used shared notes whenever someone had to hand over a task.
examples.zh: 每当有人要「把任务交接出去」，团队就会使用共享记录。

collocations: hand over a task to a colleague
prepare to hand over a task
hand over a task before leaving

words.enDefinition: To respond practically when something challenging or uncomfortable happens

examples.en: I used my café job to show how I handle a difficult situation with customers.
examples.zh: 我用咖啡馆工作的经历说明，与顾客打交道时自己如何「处理棘手情况」。

examples.en: The practice panel asked how I would handle a difficult situation during my first week.
examples.zh: 模拟面试小组问我，第一周遇到问题时会怎样「处理棘手情况」。

collocations: learn to handle a difficult situation
handle a difficult situation at work

words.enDefinition: To respond constructively when people do not share an opinion

examples.en: I described how I had to handle a disagreement between two club members.
examples.zh: 我讲了自己不得不「处理意见分歧」的一次经历，意见不合的是两位社团成员。

examples.en: The adviser asked how I would handle a disagreement on a small team.
examples.zh: 顾问问我在小团队里会怎样「处理意见分歧」。

collocations: handle a disagreement with a teammate

words.enDefinition: work with information that must stay private

examples.en: The office needs someone who can handle confidential information when answering questions about student records.
examples.zh: 办公室需要有人在回答学籍记录相关问题时，能妥善「处理保密信息」。

examples.en: The ad mentions that assistants handle confidential information while preparing documents for private meetings.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到，助理为非公开会议准备材料时会「处理保密信息」。

words.enDefinition: To respond to questions and requests from people buying or using services

examples.en: I learned to handle customer inquiries about textbook returns in the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我在校内商店学会了如何「处理顾客咨询」，比如回答教材退货的问题。

examples.en: My first duty was to handle customer inquiries during the morning shift.
examples.zh: 我的第一项职责是早班时「处理顾客咨询」。

collocations: handle customer inquiries at a desk

words.enDefinition: respond to questions or requests for information

examples.en: The job involves being at reception to handle enquiries from visitors during the mornings.
examples.zh: 这份工作上午要在前台「处理来访者的咨询」。

examples.en: The museum needs someone who can handle enquiries about group bookings over the phone.
examples.zh: 博物馆需要有人能通过电话「处理团体预订方面的咨询」。

words.enDefinition: a meeting for transferring information and responsibilities to people taking over

examples.en: I brought the incomplete bookings list to the handover meeting on my final day.
examples.zh: 最后一天，我带着未办完的预约清单参加了「交接会」。

examples.en: The handover meeting covered the upcoming workshop and the room key arrangements.
examples.zh: 「交接会」谈了即将举行的培训以及房间钥匙怎么交接。

words.enDefinition: written information passed to the person taking over a job or task

examples.en: I left handover notes about the missing keys for the evening desk staff.
examples.zh: 我在「交接记录」里写了钥匙缺失的事，给晚班柜台人员看。

examples.en: The handover notes explained which bookings still needed confirmation after I went home.
examples.zh: 「交接记录」说明了我回家后还有哪些预约需要确认。

words.enDefinition: knowledge gained by actually doing the work yourself

examples.en: The workshop wants hands-on experience with basic tools, rather than just knowledge from lectures.
examples.zh: 工坊看重使用基础工具的「动手实践经验」，光有课堂知识还不够。

examples.en: My course gave me hands-on experience with recording equipment, which the listing specifically mentioned.
examples.zh: 课程让我积累了操作录音设备的「动手实践经验」，招聘启事特意提到这一点。

words.enDefinition: the expected sequence of steps when all actions succeed and nothing unusual occurs

examples.en: I showed the happy path before explaining what would happen if an entry was missing.
examples.zh: 我先展示了「正常成功流程」，再解释缺少一项数据时会怎样。

examples.en: The coding example covers the happy path and one common mistake made by users.
examples.zh: 编程示例涵盖「正常成功流程」，也涵盖了用户常犯的一种错误。

words.enDefinition: a specific time when an activity must finish

examples.en: I have a hard stop at three because the lab requires everyone to arrive early.
examples.zh: 「我最迟三点必须结束」，因为实验课要求大家提前到场。

examples.en: The recruiter mentioned a hard stop at noon, so we kept the call brief.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说「最迟中午必须结束」，所以我们只聊了一会儿。

collocations: have a hard stop at noon

words.enDefinition: asks whether an earlier schedule has been revised

examples.en: Has the timeline changed since we spoke last Friday about the library assistant role?
examples.zh: 上周五聊过图书馆助理岗位后，「时间安排有变化吗」？

examples.en: Has the timeline changed now that the manager is returning later than planned?
examples.zh: 经理比原计划回来得晚，「时间安排有变化吗」？

collocations: has the timeline changed at all?
has the timeline changed since we spoke?
has the timeline changed for this role?

words.enDefinition: employment benefits that help cover health-related needs or costs

examples.en: The advert mentions health benefits and links to a page explaining what they include.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到有「员工健康福利」，还附了个链接说明包括哪些项目。

examples.en: I asked whether health benefits were available to staff working only on weekends.
examples.zh: 我问只在周末上班的员工能否享受「员工健康福利」。

words.enDefinition: Job opportunities that are not publicly advertised

examples.en: The workshop explained how people hear about vacancies in the hidden job market.
examples.zh: 讲座介绍了人们如何打听到「未公开的就业市场」里的空缺岗位。

examples.en: My tutor mentioned the hidden job market when I asked where graduates find work.
examples.zh: 我问毕业生从哪里找工作时，导师提到了「未公开的就业市场」。

collocations: tap into the hidden job market
opportunities in the hidden job market

words.enDefinition: a test whose details are withheld from a candidate or participant

examples.en: A hidden test case failed after my code had passed both visible examples.
examples.zh: 我的代码通过了两个可见示例，随后有一个「隐藏测试用例」没通过。

examples.en: The platform showed a hidden test case result without revealing the input values.
examples.zh: 平台显示了「隐藏测试用例」的结果，不过没有给出输入值。

words.enDefinition: to draw attention to a project that demonstrates a skill needed for the role

examples.en: I used the second paragraph to highlight a relevant project from my design course.
examples.zh: 我在第二段「突出了一个相关项目」，也就是设计课上的一个项目。

examples.en: The form asked me to highlight a relevant project and explain what I contributed.
examples.zh: 表格让我「突出一个相关项目」，并说明自己做了什么。

collocations: highlight a relevant project in the letter
highlight a relevant project from class
use your portfolio to highlight a relevant project

words.enDefinition: To draw attention to something someone does particularly well

examples.en: I used my first campus job to highlight a strength in dealing with visitors.
examples.zh: 我用第一份校内工作来「突出一项优势」，就是擅长和来访者打交道。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to highlight a strength that mattered for this particular job.
examples.zh: 顾问让我「突出一项优势」，这项优势得对这份工作有帮助。

collocations: highlight a strength in an answer
highlight a strength the role requires
use a story to highlight a strength

words.enDefinition: To draw attention to the main differences after something happened

examples.en: I compared two weeks of waiting times to highlight what changed at our desk.
examples.zh: 我比较了服务台两周的等候时间，以「着重说明有哪些变化」。

examples.en: The practice guide asked me to highlight what changed after we rewrote the instructions.
examples.zh: 练习指南让我「着重说明有哪些变化」，指我们重写操作说明之后的变化。

collocations: highlight what changed after the decision
highlight what changed in the process

words.enDefinition: A public notice that an employer is recruiting

examples.en: The theatre shared a hiring announcement on its page before the weekend performances.
examples.zh: 周末演出开始前，剧院在自己的网页上发布了「招募公告」。

examples.en: I saw the hiring announcement while looking up events at the museum on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五查博物馆活动时，我看到了那则「招募公告」。

words.enDefinition: a group that reviews candidates and helps choose who is hired

examples.en: I wrote my cover letter to the hiring committee because no name was listed.
examples.zh: 招聘启事没有给出个人姓名，所以我把求职信写给了「招聘评审委员会」。

examples.en: The application invited me to share three projects with the hiring committee.
examples.zh: 申请说明请我向「招聘评审委员会」展示三个项目。

collocations: address a letter to the hiring committee
a member of the hiring committee
send materials to the hiring committee

words.enDefinition: A temporary stop on taking on new staff

examples.en: The studio announced a hiring freeze just as I started looking for local work.
examples.zh: 我刚开始在本地找工作，那家工作室就宣布「暂停招聘」。

examples.en: The company lifted its hiring freeze shortly before the university's spring career fair.
examples.zh: 学校的春季招聘会开幕前不久，那家公司结束了「暂停招聘」。

words.enDefinition: the manager responsible for hiring someone for a role

examples.en: The recruiter introduced the hiring manager before we arranged a time to talk.
examples.zh: 我们定通话时间前，招聘人员先介绍了「用人经理」。

examples.en: I wasn't sure whether to send my question to the recruiter or the hiring manager.
examples.zh: 我拿不准该把问题发给招聘人员，还是直接发给「用人经理」。

collocations: an email from the hiring manager

words.enDefinition: A period when many employers actively recruit

examples.en: The careers office stays open later during hiring season so more students can ask questions.
examples.zh: 「集中招聘季」期间，就业办公室延长了开放时间，让更多学生能来咨询。

examples.en: I did my employer research before the local theatre's hiring season began in April.
examples.zh: 本地剧院四月开始「集中招聘季」之前，我已经做了雇主调研。

words.enDefinition: A pattern in how employers recruit over time

examples.en: One hiring trend in the report was a rise in part-time evening roles.
examples.zh: 报告提到的一项「招聘趋势」是晚间兼职岗位增多。

examples.en: The lecturer asked whether the summer hiring trend would continue into the autumn term.
examples.zh: 讲师问，夏季的「招聘趋势」会不会延续到秋季学期。

words.enDefinition: To wait before agreeing to an offer

examples.en: I decided to hold off on accepting until I had the updated hours in writing.
examples.zh: 我决定先「暂缓接受」，等收到更新后工时的书面说明。

words.expression: how did you hear about us

practice answering "How do you handle competing priorities?"
prepare for "How do you handle competing priorities?"

roughly how long should I set aside?

I may have misunderstood what you meant

words.expression: I wish you all the best
words.lemma: i wish you all the best

acceptedEnVariants: I wish you all the best

I'm running a few minutes late for our call

words.enDefinition: confirms that your interest in something has continued

examples.en: I'm still very interested in the role even though the campus location has changed.
examples.zh: 虽然工作地点换了一个校区，「我仍然很感兴趣」。

examples.en: I'm still very interested and would be glad to speak after the term ends.
examples.zh: 「我仍然很感兴趣」，学期结束后很乐意聊聊。

collocations: I'm still very interested in the role
I'm still very interested in speaking
I'm still very interested in hearing more

words.enDefinition: says you are occupied until a specified time

examples.en: I'm tied up until four today, but I could talk after my lab finishes.
examples.zh: 我今天「四点前没空」，但实验课一结束就能聊。

examples.en: I'm tied up until Thursday morning because my project group is rehearsing every afternoon.
examples.zh: 我「周四上午前都没空」，因为项目组每天下午都要排练。

collocations: I'm tied up until after class
I'm tied up until the afternoon

words.enDefinition: short text accompanying an image to identify it or explain its relevance

examples.en: The image caption identifies the campus building and the purpose of the new sign.
examples.zh: 「图片说明文字」写明了是哪栋校园建筑，以及新标识的用途。

examples.en: I changed the image caption to note that the photo was taken on opening day.
examples.zh: 我修改了「图片说明文字」，补充说明照片是在开幕那天拍的。

words.enDefinition: a web component that lets viewers move through a series of images in one space

examples.en: The image carousel shows each poster before visitors reach the longer case study.
examples.zh: 访客读到较长的案例之前，可以先在「图片轮播」里看每张海报。

examples.en: I tested whether the image carousel worked when viewed on a narrow screen.
examples.zh: 我测试了「图片轮播」在窄屏上能不能正常使用。

collocations: an image carousel on the project page

words.enDefinition: a record naming the creators or sources of images used in a publication or display

examples.en: I added image credits for the photographs taken by my classmates at the exhibition.
examples.zh: 我为同学在展览上拍的照片加了「图片来源署名」。

examples.en: The reviewer checked whether all the photographs had corresponding image credits on the page.
examples.zh: 评审核对了每张照片在页面上有没有相应的「图片来源署名」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of detail an image can represent, often expressed using pixel dimensions

examples.en: I checked the image resolution before exporting the poster pages for the portfolio.
examples.zh: 导出作品集里的海报页面之前，我检查了「图像分辨率」。

examples.en: The reviewer asked for better image resolution so the tiny labels were legible.
examples.zh: 评审要求提高「图像分辨率」，让特别小的标签看得清。

words.enDefinition: a job arrangement that starts without a waiting period

examples.en: The ad offered an immediate start, but my exams wouldn't finish until next week.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着可以「立即上岗」，但我下周才考完试。

examples.en: I told the gallery I was available for an immediate start once classes finished.
examples.zh: 我跟美术馆说，课程一结束我就能「立即上岗」。

words.enDefinition: To put a set of planned steps into regular practice

examples.en: I helped implement a process for checking returns at the student bookshop.
examples.zh: 我协助学生书店「推行流程」，规范退货检查。

examples.en: My supervisor asked how I would implement a process that new volunteers could follow.
examples.zh: 主管问我打算怎样「推行流程」，让新志愿者也能照着做。

collocations: implement a process across a team
implement a process for checking orders

words.enDefinition: To reduce how long people wait for an answer or service

examples.en: I helped improve response times by setting up separate queues for common requests.
examples.zh: 我为常见请求分别设立队列，帮助「缩短响应时间」。

examples.en: My CV describes one tool we used to improve response times at the help desk.
examples.zh: 我的简历介绍了我们在服务台用来「缩短响应时间」的一种工具。

collocations: improve response times at a help desk

words.enDefinition: within an area of study or work connected to the role

examples.en: The ad asks for a diploma in design or in a related field.
examples.zh: 招聘启事要求持有设计专业或「相关领域的」文凭。

examples.en: I checked whether volunteering in a related field would be enough for the position.
examples.zh: 我查了在「相关领域」做过志愿者是否足以申请这个岗位。

collocations: a degree in a related field

words.enDefinition: a recruiter who works for the company hiring staff

examples.en: An in-house recruiter called to explain which team was hiring for the summer role.
examples.zh: 「公司内部招聘人员」打来电话，说明暑期岗位是哪个团队在招人。

examples.en: I asked the in-house recruiter whether the same person handled all student positions.
examples.zh: 我问「公司内部招聘人员」，学生岗位是不是都由同一个人负责。

collocations: an in-house recruiter at the company

words.enDefinition: A job meeting where the participants are physically in the same place

examples.en: At the in-person interview, I met the staff members who would supervise my placement.
examples.zh: 在「现场面试」中，我见到了将指导我实习的员工。

examples.en: My in-person interview began with a tour of the student services office.
examples.zh: 我的「现场面试」从参观学生服务办公室开始。

words.enDefinition: A phrase introducing how someone would respond in an imagined situation

examples.en: I began "In that situation I would" when the panel asked about an unfamiliar scenario.
examples.zh: 小组问起不熟悉的情境时，我以「在那种情况下我会」开头。

examples.en: We practiced completing "In that situation I would" with one clear and realistic action.
examples.zh: 我们练习在「在那种情况下我会」后面接一个明确而可行的行动。

collocations: in that situation I would check the deadline
in that situation I would speak to my supervisor
in that situation I would ask for more details

words.enDefinition: an assessment requiring someone to prioritize and deal with a simulated set of incoming tasks

examples.en: The in-tray exercise included booking requests, an urgent message and a timetable conflict.
examples.zh: 「待办事项处理练习」里有预约请求、一条急讯和一处日程冲突。

examples.en: I explained why I dealt with the urgent messages first in the in-tray exercise.
examples.zh: 我解释了为什么做「待办事项处理练习」时先处理急讯。

words.enDefinition: To get more people to attend an event or activity

examples.en: I used shorter reminder emails to increase attendance at our weekly study groups.
examples.zh: 我用更简短的邮件提醒大家，帮助每周学习小组「提高出席人数」。

examples.en: The bullet explains how I helped increase attendance at two student events.
examples.zh: 简历要点说明了我如何帮助两场学生活动「提高出席人数」。

words.enDefinition: Space inserted at the beginning of a line or paragraph

examples.en: The indentation for the second bullet changed when I pasted the new text.
examples.zh: 我粘贴新文字时，第二条要点的「缩进」变了。

examples.en: I removed the extra indentation so the headings lined up properly.
examples.zh: 我去掉多余的「缩进」，让标题对齐。

words.enDefinition: The part one person provided within work done by a group

examples.en: I added my individual contribution so the reader could distinguish my work from the team's.
examples.zh: 我补写了「个人贡献」，让读者能看出团队工作中哪部分是我做的。

examples.en: The reviewer asked me to explain my individual contribution to the final report.
examples.zh: 审阅者让我解释自己对最终报告的「个人贡献」。

words.enDefinition: the skills or knowledge a particular person needs to develop

examples.en: We discussed individual learning needs before assigning different tasks to the students on placement.
examples.zh: 给各位实习生分配不同任务前，我们讨论了他们的「个人学习需求」。

examples.en: My mentor considered my individual learning needs when selecting a project for the second rotation.
examples.zh: 导师给第二轮轮岗选项目时，考虑了我的「个人学习需求」。

collocations: adapt training to individual learning needs

words.enDefinition: a schedule of learning tailored to a particular person's needs

examples.en: My mentor used an individual training plan to make room for extra practice with presentations.
examples.zh: 导师通过「个人培养计划」给我留出了更多练习做汇报的时间。

examples.en: I updated my individual training plan after moving from the archive to the publishing team.
examples.zh: 从档案部门转到出版团队后，我更新了「个人培养计划」。

words.enDefinition: a statement from an industry partner outlining what a project should address

examples.en: The studio gave our placement group an industry brief about making its website easier to use.
examples.zh: 工作室给我们实习小组发了一份「企业项目任务说明」，要求改善网站易用性。

examples.en: We read the industry brief before asking the client how they would judge the results.
examples.zh: 我们先读了「企业项目任务说明」，才问客户会怎么评估结果。

words.enDefinition: Someone you know who works in an industry

examples.en: An industry contact told me that theatre jobs are often advertised in the spring.
examples.zh: 一位「业内联系人」告诉我，剧院岗位通常在春季发布。

examples.en: I asked an industry contact where editors in the city usually look for work.
examples.zh: 我向一位「业内联系人」打听，这座城市的编辑通常去哪里找工作。

collocations: keep in touch with an industry contact

words.enDefinition: experience working in a particular industry

examples.en: The audio company asks for industry experience even though the position is listed as junior.
examples.zh: 尽管岗位写的是初级，这家音频公司还是要求有「行业工作经验」。

examples.en: I checked whether my time with a local publisher counted as industry experience.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，在本地出版社工作的那段时间算不算「行业工作经验」。

words.enDefinition: An option limiting results to a selected industry

examples.en: I used the industry filter to see only listings from museums and galleries.
examples.zh: 我用「行业筛选条件」，只看博物馆和美术馆发布的招聘信息。

examples.en: The industry filter grouped publishing and news under media on that job board.
examples.zh: 在那个求职网站上，「行业筛选条件」把出版和新闻都归到媒体类。

words.enDefinition: An informal gathering for people in one industry

examples.en: My classmate invited me to an industry meetup for people working in games.
examples.zh: 同学邀请我去参加一场游戏从业人员的「行业交流聚会」。

examples.en: The industry meetup gave me a chance to ask editors how they found their first jobs.
examples.zh: 这场「行业交流聚会」让我有机会问编辑们是怎么找到第一份工作的。

words.enDefinition: A regular publication about developments in an industry

examples.en: I started reading an industry newsletter to keep up with local studios and vacancies.
examples.zh: 我开始读一份「行业简报」，关注本地工作室的动态和招聘信息。

examples.en: The industry newsletter had a short notice about the theatre's open day in June.
examples.zh: 「行业简报」上有一条短消息，提到了剧院六月的开放日。

words.enDefinition: Expectations about how an industry may develop

examples.en: The guest speaker discussed the industry outlook for publishing over the next few years.
examples.zh: 嘉宾谈了未来几年的出版「行业前景」。

examples.en: I read the industry outlook before choosing a few companies to learn more about.
examples.zh: 选几家公司深入了解之前，我先看了「行业前景」。

words.enDefinition: a project supported with money or resources by an employer or industry group

examples.en: Our industry-sponsored project used sample data supplied by a local transport company during the placement.
examples.zh: 实习期间，我们的「业界资助项目」用到了本地一家运输公司提供的样本数据。

examples.en: I joined an industry-sponsored project because I wanted to see how clients set their priorities.
examples.zh: 我加入了一个「业界资助项目」，想看看客户怎样给各项需求排序。

collocations: take part in an industry-sponsored project

words.enDefinition: A conversation to learn about someone's work

examples.en: I arranged an informational interview with a graduate who works at a book publisher.
examples.zh: 我约了一位在出版社工作的毕业生做「职业信息访谈」。

examples.en: During the informational interview, I asked what a typical day at the museum looked like.
examples.zh: 「职业信息访谈」期间，我问了在博物馆工作的一天通常怎么过。

words.enDefinition: The first review used to narrow down applicants

examples.en: My application went through initial screening before I was asked to take a short test.
examples.zh: 我的申请先经过了「初步筛选」，之后我才被要求做一个简短的测试。

examples.en: The portal says initial screening starts once the employer stops accepting new applications.
examples.zh: 求职门户说明，雇主停止接收新申请后就会开始「初步筛选」。

words.enDefinition: limits on the kinds, size or values of data a program is expected to accept

examples.en: I read the input constraints to see whether repeated values could appear in the list.
examples.zh: 我读了「输入限制条件」，看看列表里会不会出现重复值。

examples.en: I checked whether zero was allowed under the input constraints before testing my solution.
examples.zh: 测试解法前，我核实了「输入限制条件」是否允许零值。

words.enDefinition: the required structure or arrangement of data supplied to a program

examples.en: The prompt specifies the input format above the first example with sample data.
examples.zh: 题目在第一个数据示例上方规定了「输入格式」。

examples.en: I clarified the input format before writing the function to read the values.
examples.zh: 在写读取数值的函数之前，我先确认了「输入格式」。

words.enDefinition: A contract provision about ownership or use of work and inventions

examples.en: The intellectual property clause mentioned materials created during my placement at the museum.
examples.zh: 「知识产权条款」提到了我在博物馆实习期间制作的材料。

examples.en: I asked how the intellectual property clause applied to the designs I created.
examples.zh: 我问「知识产权条款」对我做的设计如何适用。

words.enDefinition: someone doing temporary work to learn about a profession

examples.en: As an intern at the archive, I helped prepare catalog records for a new collection.
examples.zh: 作为档案馆的「实习生」，我帮忙为一批新馆藏编制目录记录。

examples.en: The intern who worked here last summer showed us how she organized her research notes.
examples.zh: 去年夏天在这里工作的那位「实习生」给我们看了她如何整理研究笔记。

words.enDefinition: the share of interns who move into regular jobs with their placement employer

examples.en: The team reviewed its intern conversion rate when planning how many trainees to recruit.
examples.zh: 计划招多少培训生时，团队看了看「实习生转正比例」。

examples.en: I asked whether the intern conversion rate counted people who took jobs at other branches.
examples.zh: 我问「实习生转正比例」里算不算去其他分部工作的人。

words.enDefinition: the transition from an internship to a full-time job with the same employer

examples.en: I asked about intern-to-full-time conversion during my final review at the end of summer.
examples.zh: 暑假结束前的最后一次评审中，我问了「实习转全职」的情况。

examples.en: The recruiter said intern-to-full-time conversion depended on which roles the organization had open.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说，「实习转全职」要看机构当时有哪些岗位空缺。

words.enDefinition: a group of interns who start a program together

examples.en: Everyone in my internship cohort worked at a different branch of the same library service.
examples.zh: 和我「同批实习的同学」都在同一个图书馆系统的不同分馆工作。

examples.en: The internship cohort met on Fridays to compare what we'd learned that week.
examples.zh: 「同批实习生」每周五碰面，交流一周里各自学到了什么。

words.enDefinition: a piece of work assigned to someone during an internship

examples.en: My internship project was to map the public routes between the museum and its storehouse.
examples.zh: 我的「实习项目」是绘制博物馆和库房之间公众可走的路线图。

examples.en: The team reviewed my internship project in a short meeting during my last week.
examples.zh: 实习最后一周，团队开了个短会，评审了我的「实习项目」。

words.enDefinition: a set payment provided to support someone during an internship

examples.en: My internship stipend helped cover the bus pass I needed to get to the gallery.
examples.zh: 「实习津贴」帮我负担了去美术馆所需的公交月票。

examples.en: I checked when the internship stipend would arrive before booking somewhere to stay.
examples.zh: 预订住处前，我先确认了「实习津贴」什么时候到账。

words.enDefinition: the ability to interact effectively with other people

examples.en: The role needs interpersonal skills because students often arrive at the desk feeling confused.
examples.zh: 这个岗位需要「人际交往能力」，因为学生到前台时经常还弄不清状况。

examples.en: I highlighted the line about interpersonal skills when I was reading the residence job description.
examples.zh: 我读宿舍岗位说明时，标出了关于「人际交往能力」的那一行。

words.enDefinition: A discussion reviewing what happened during a job interview

examples.en: During our interview debrief, I wrote down two questions that surprised me.
examples.zh: 我们做「面试复盘」时，我记下了两道出乎意料的问题。

examples.en: My interview debrief focused on which examples were easiest to explain clearly.
examples.zh: 我的「面试复盘」主要谈了哪些经历最容易讲清楚。

collocations: an interview debrief with an adviser

words.enDefinition: Comments on what went well or could improve in an interview

examples.en: My interview feedback mentioned that my examples were clear but sometimes too long.
examples.zh: 「面试反馈」说我举的例子很清楚，但有时讲得太长。

examples.en: I compared the interview feedback from two practice sessions at the careers center.
examples.zh: 我比较了就业中心两次模拟面试给出的「面试反馈」。

words.enDefinition: The way an interview is organized and carried out

examples.en: The interviewer explained the interview format before moving on to the first question.
examples.zh: 面试官先说明了「面试形式」，然后开始问第一道题。

examples.en: Our adviser showed how the interview format affects the kinds of answers expected.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了「面试形式」怎样影响面试官对答案的预期。

words.enDefinition: Anxiety or nervous feelings before or during a job interview

examples.en: A short walk helped me manage my interview nerves before the appointment.
examples.zh: 面试前散了一小会儿步，我的「面试紧张情绪」缓和了些。

examples.en: The first question was straightforward, and my interview nerves soon eased.
examples.zh: 第一个问题很直接，我的「面试紧张情绪」很快就缓解了。

words.enDefinition: Written observations or reminders made during or about an interview

examples.en: After our practice session, my adviser shared the interview notes she had taken.
examples.zh: 模拟面试结束后，顾问把她记的「面试笔记」给我看。

examples.en: I read my interview notes to recall the question I wanted to practice again.
examples.zh: 我翻看「面试笔记」，想起了自己还想再练习的那个问题。

words.enDefinition: The group of people who question and assess a candidate together

examples.en: One member of the interview panel worked in the office I hoped to join.
examples.zh: 「面试官小组」里有一位成员就在我希望加入的办公室工作。

examples.en: I thanked the interview panel before leaving the room and collecting my bag.
examples.zh: 离开房间去取包之前，我向「面试官小组」道了谢。

collocations: a member of the interview panel

words.enDefinition: A statement or instruction inviting someone to respond in an interview

examples.en: The interview prompt asked me to describe a time I changed my approach.
examples.zh: 这条「面试答题提示」让我讲一次自己调整做法的经历。

examples.en: I read the interview prompt again before choosing a story about a project.
examples.zh: 我又读了一遍「面试答题提示」，才选了一个项目经历来讲。

words.enDefinition: a first call for people to meet and exchange basic information

examples.en: We arranged an introductory call to talk about the role before I sent anything.
examples.zh: 我们安排了一次「初次沟通电话」，先聊聊岗位，我再发材料。

examples.en: The introductory call was mainly about how the team was organized and where they worked.
examples.zh: 「初次沟通电话」主要聊了团队怎么分工，以及大家在哪里办公。

words.enDefinition: A presentation given after the organizers specifically ask someone to speak

examples.en: I added an invited talk from our regional student conference to the academic CV.
examples.zh: 我把在区域学生会议上做的一次「受邀报告」加进了学术履历。

examples.en: My invited talk was listed separately from the poster I presented that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我的「受邀报告」和那天下午的海报展示是分开列的。

words.expression: is now a good time to talk
words.lemma: is now a good time to talk
words.enDefinition: asks whether it is convenient to speak now
acceptedEnVariants: is now a good time to talk

examples.en: Hi Maya, is now a good time to talk about the library assistant role?
examples.zh: 玛雅你好，「现在方便聊聊图书馆助理岗位吗」？

examples.en: Is now a good time to talk, or should I ring back after lunch?
examples.zh: 「现在方便说话吗」，还是我午饭后再打来？

collocations: hello, is now a good time to talk?
is now a good time to talk about the role?
before we start, is now a good time to talk?

words.expression: is there anything else you need from me
words.lemma: is there anything else you need from me
words.zhGloss: 还有什么需要我提供的吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether you should supply any more information or help
acceptedZhAnswers: 还有什么需要我提供的吗
acceptedEnVariants: is there anything else you need from me

examples.en: Is there anything else you need from me before you confirm the time with your colleague?
examples.zh: 和你同事敲定时间前，「还有什么需要我提供的吗」？

examples.en: I've included both dates, but is there anything else you need from me for now?
examples.zh: 两个日期都写上了，目前「还有什么需要我提供的吗」？

collocations: is there anything else you need from me today?
is there anything else you need from me before the call?
before I go, is there anything else you need from me?

words.expression: it's not quite what I'm looking for
words.lemma: it's not quite what i'm looking for
words.zhGloss: 这和我想找的不太一样
words.enDefinition: says something does not match your aims or preferences
acceptedZhAnswers: 这和我想找的不太一样
acceptedEnVariants: it's not quite what I'm looking for

examples.en: It's not quite what I'm looking for because I'd like to do more fieldwork.
examples.zh: 「这和我想找的不太一样」，我想多做些实地工作。

examples.en: I'm afraid it's not quite what I'm looking for, as I'd prefer a research role.
examples.zh: 不好意思，「这和我想找的不太一样」，我更希望做研究类工作。

collocations: it's not quite what I'm looking for at the moment
I'm afraid it's not quite what I'm looking for
thanks, but it's not quite what I'm looking for

words.expression: I've decided not to pursue the role
words.lemma: i've decided not to pursue the role
words.zhGloss: 我决定不再考虑这个岗位
words.enDefinition: says you have chosen not to continue seeking the job
acceptedZhAnswers: 我决定不再考虑这个岗位
acceptedEnVariants: I've decided not to pursue the role

examples.en: I've decided not to pursue the role after talking it over with my placement supervisor.
examples.zh: 我和实习导师商量后，「决定不再考虑这个岗位」。

examples.en: I've decided not to pursue the role because I'm staying in town for another term.
examples.zh: 因为还要在本地多待一学期，「我决定不再考虑这个岗位」。

collocations: after some thought, I've decided not to pursue the role
for now, I've decided not to pursue the role
I've decided not to pursue the role after all

words.enDefinition: A service gathering job listings from other sites

examples.en: The job aggregator showed the same shop vacancy from three different sources.
examples.zh: 这个「招聘信息聚合平台」展示了来自三个不同来源的同一个店员岗位。

examples.en: I went to the original listing after spotting the role on a job aggregator.
examples.zh: 我在「招聘信息聚合平台」上看到这个职位后，打开了招聘原帖。

collocations: a listing on a job aggregator

words.enDefinition: A notification about a newly matching vacancy

examples.en: A job alert came through when the campus library posted a weekend vacancy.
examples.zh: 校园图书馆一发布周末岗位，我就收到一条「职位上新提醒」。

examples.en: I turned off one job alert after it kept sending jobs in another city.
examples.zh: 有一条「职位上新提醒」总给我推送外地岗位，我就把它关了。

words.enDefinition: A formal request to be considered for a job

examples.en: I opened my job application on the portal to finish the last two questions.
examples.zh: 我在求职门户里打开「求职申请」，继续答最后两道题。

examples.en: The library received my job application, but one of the attachments hadn't gone through.
examples.zh: 图书馆收到了我的「求职申请」，但有一个附件没传过去。

words.enDefinition: A place where employers post job listings

examples.en: I found a weekend library position on a job board for local students.
examples.zh: 我在面向本地学生的「招聘信息平台」上找到了一个周末图书馆岗位。

examples.en: The same job board also lists work at cafés and shops near campus.
examples.zh: 同一个「招聘信息平台」上也有学校附近咖啡店和商店的工作。

words.enDefinition: A UK office offering public job search support

examples.en: My friend booked a session at the job centre before looking for work again.
examples.zh: 我朋友重新找工作前，在「就业服务中心」约了一次咨询。

examples.en: The job centre by the station has a noticeboard with vacancies from local shops.
examples.zh: 车站旁的「就业服务中心」有块公告板，贴着本地商店的招聘信息。

collocations: make an appointment at the job centre

words.enDefinition: a document describing what a job involves

examples.en: The job description says I'll spend half my time helping visitors find their way around.
examples.zh: 「岗位说明」写着，我有一半时间要帮来访者找路。

examples.en: I downloaded the job description before asking my tutor what the position would involve.
examples.zh: 我下载了「岗位说明」，才去问导师这个职位具体做些什么。

words.enDefinition: A summary of several job postings sent together

examples.en: The job digest arrives on Mondays and includes a few openings near campus.
examples.zh: 「职位信息汇总」每周一发来，里面有几个学校附近的空缺岗位。

examples.en: I read the job digest over breakfast instead of checking the website each morning.
examples.zh: 我早餐时读一下「职位信息汇总」，就不用每天早上都看那个网站了。

collocations: a listing in the job digest

words.enDefinition: Information pointing to a possible job opportunity

examples.en: A classmate gave me a job lead at a local bookshop last week.
examples.zh: 上周一位同学给了我一条「工作机会线索」，是本地一家书店的。

examples.en: I added the job lead to my notes and checked it after class.
examples.zh: 我把这条「工作机会线索」记下来，下课后查了一下。

collocations: follow up on a job lead

words.enDefinition: The supply of jobs and people seeking them

examples.en: A careers adviser explained how the local job market changes when students leave for summer.
examples.zh: 就业顾问解释了学生暑假离校后，本地「就业市场」会怎么变化。

examples.en: I'm new to this city and don't know much about its job market.
examples.zh: 我刚到这座城市，对这里的「就业市场」不太了解。

words.enDefinition: A proposal to employ someone in a particular role

examples.en: I received a job offer from the library just before the new term began.
examples.zh: 新学期快开始时，我收到了图书馆的「录用通知」。

examples.en: The job offer listed the department and the hours for each weekend shift.
examples.zh: 「录用通知」列出了所属部门和每个周末班次的工作时长。

words.enDefinition: The chances of finding work in an area or field

examples.en: I asked former students about job prospects in publishing before choosing my final modules.
examples.zh: 选最后几门课前，我向校友打听了出版行业的「就业前景」。

examples.en: The report compared job prospects in three cities with direct trains from the university.
examples.zh: 报告比较了从学校坐火车可直达的三座城市的「就业前景」。

words.enDefinition: A specific event or experience that illustrates a relevant work ability

examples.en: The first question gave me time to share a job-related example from the café.
examples.zh: 第一道题让我有机会分享一个在咖啡馆工作时「与岗位相关的实例」。

examples.en: I used a job-related example to show how I handled an unexpected delay.
examples.zh: 我用一个「与岗位相关的实例」说明自己怎样处理突发延误。

words.enDefinition: A fraud aimed at people looking for work

examples.en: The workshop used a sample message to show how a job scam might begin.
examples.zh: 工作坊用一封示例消息演示了「求职诈骗」可能怎么开始。

examples.en: The careers office told me where to report a job scam involving a fake recruiter.
examples.zh: 就业办公室告诉我该向哪里举报冒充招聘人员的「求职诈骗」。

words.enDefinition: The process of looking for employment

examples.en: My job search began in January while I was still finishing my last course.
examples.zh: 我一月开始「求职」时，最后一门课还没上完。

examples.en: I started my job search close to campus because I don't have a car.
examples.zh: 我没有车，所以先从学校附近开始「找工作」。

words.enDefinition: Conditions used to decide which jobs to consider

examples.en: My job search criteria changed when I realised the last bus left at nine.
examples.zh: 发现末班公交九点就开走后，我调整了「求职筛选条件」。

examples.en: I shared my job search criteria with a friend who also needed weekend work.
examples.zh: 我把自己的「求职筛选条件」告诉了一位同样在找周末工作的朋友。

words.enDefinition: Tiredness caused by a long period of looking for work

examples.en: Job search fatigue set in after I spent several weeks checking the same websites.
examples.zh: 连着几周翻来覆去查同几个网站后，我开始有了「求职疲惫感」。

examples.en: We talked about job search fatigue at a peer meeting in the student centre.
examples.zh: 我们在学生中心的同伴交流会上聊了「求职疲惫感」。

words.enDefinition: A regular pattern of looking for work

examples.en: My job search routine changed when classes moved to the afternoons in the spring.
examples.zh: 春季学期的课挪到下午后，我的「日常求职安排」变了。

examples.en: I found a job search routine that fit around my shifts at the campus café.
examples.zh: 我找到了一个能配合校园咖啡店班次的「日常求职安排」。

collocations: stick to a job search routine

words.enDefinition: A group where people support one another while job hunting

examples.en: I joined a job search support group organised by students in their final year.
examples.zh: 我参加了毕业班学生组织的「求职互助小组」。

examples.en: The job search support group meets on Thursdays near the entrance to the library.
examples.zh: 「求职互助小组」每周四在图书馆入口附近见面。

collocations: join a job search support group
run a job search support group
attend a job search support group

words.enDefinition: A tool for organizing opportunities and next steps

examples.en: I added a column to my job search tracker for the links I wanted to revisit.
examples.zh: 我在「求职进度记录工具」里加了一列，放想回头再看的链接。

examples.en: The job search tracker helped me remember which employers I'd already looked up that week.
examples.zh: 「求职进度记录工具」帮我记住那周已经查过哪些雇主。

collocations: set up a job search tracker

words.enDefinition: A practical group session about finding work

examples.en: The job search workshop covered ways to find openings before they reach a major website.
examples.zh: 「求职工作坊」讲了怎样在大型网站发布招聘信息之前找到工作机会。

examples.en: I stayed after the job search workshop to ask which local employers regularly hire students.
examples.zh: 「求职工作坊」结束后，我留下来问了哪些本地雇主经常招学生。

collocations: sign up for a job search workshop

words.enDefinition: A person looking for employment

examples.en: As a first-time job seeker, I asked the careers office where to start.
examples.zh: 作为第一次找工作的「求职者」，我问学校就业办公室该从哪里着手。

examples.en: The event is open to any job seeker who lives in the city.
examples.zh: 这场活动向住在本市的所有「求职者」开放。

words.enDefinition: Watching someone at work to learn their role

examples.en: I arranged a morning of job shadowing with a librarian who studied here.
examples.zh: 我约了本校毕业的一位图书管理员，安排了一个上午的「跟岗观摩」。

examples.en: Job shadowing at the theatre showed me how the staff prepared for evening performances.
examples.zh: 在剧院「跟岗观摩」让我看到工作人员是怎么为晚场演出做准备的。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement where two people share one job

examples.en: The listing offered a job share with someone already working on Thursdays and Fridays.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着可以「两人分担一个岗位」，另一位员工固定在每周四和周五上班。

examples.en: I asked whether a job share would be possible during my final year.
examples.zh: 我问自己上最后一年学时，能不能和别人「分担一个岗位」。

words.enDefinition: An exercise recreating situations from a particular job

examples.en: The job simulation asked what I would do when two visitors needed help at once.
examples.zh: 「岗位情境模拟」问我，如果两位访客同时需要帮助，我会怎么办。

examples.en: I could see the instructions for the job simulation before the countdown started.
examples.zh: 倒计时开始前，我可以看到「岗位情境模拟」的说明。

collocations: take part in a job simulation

words.enDefinition: the name an organization gives to a particular job

examples.en: The job title sounded technical, but the duties were mostly helping visitors and answering phones.
examples.zh: 「职位名称」听起来很专业，但主要工作是接待来访者和接电话。

examples.en: I wrote down the job title because the library was hiring for two similar positions.
examples.zh: 图书馆在招两个很相似的岗位，所以我记下了这个「职位名称」。

words.enDefinition: information telling people how to access or attend an event

examples.en: The joining instructions said to wait in the lobby until the recruiter joined the call.
examples.zh: 「参会说明」写着，要在等候区里等招聘人员加入通话。

examples.en: I couldn't see the joining instructions on mobile, so I opened the message on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我用手机看不到「参会说明」，就改用笔记本电脑打开那封邮件。

words.enDefinition: introduces a detail intended to prevent misunderstanding

examples.en: Just to clarify, I'll be available by phone on Thursday but not in person.
examples.zh: 「我想澄清一下」，周四我能接电话，但没法到现场。

examples.en: Just to clarify, the role is based at the museum on the west side of campus.
examples.zh: 「我想说明一下」，工作地点是校区西侧的博物馆。

collocations: just to clarify, I meant Friday
just to clarify what I said earlier

words.expression: keep me in mind for future openings
words.lemma: keep me in mind for future openings
words.enDefinition: ask to be considered when another job becomes available
acceptedEnVariants: keep me in mind for future openings

examples.en: Please keep me in mind for future openings after I finish my degree in June.
examples.zh: 我六月完成学业，「以后有空缺请考虑我」。

examples.en: If my experience fits the team, could you keep me in mind for future openings?
examples.zh: 如果我的经历适合这个团队，「以后有空缺能考虑我吗」？

collocations: please keep me in mind for future openings
