feel free to keep me in mind for future openings
would you keep me in mind for future openings?

words.enDefinition: to make sure someone continues to receive relevant information and updates

examples.en: Please keep me in the loop if the room changes before tomorrow's workshop.
examples.zh: 如果明天培训前换了场地，请「让我随时知道进展」。

examples.en: I'll keep you in the loop while the supervisor checks the new schedule.
examples.zh: 主管核对新排班时，我会「让你随时知道进展」。

collocations: keep someone in the loop about changes
promise to keep someone in the loop
make sure to keep someone in the loop

words.enDefinition: retain someone's information for possible future use

examples.en: With your permission, we'll keep your details on file for future museum vacancies.
examples.zh: 如果你同意，我们会「留存你的联系资料」，供博物馆以后有岗位空缺时使用。

examples.en: We can keep your details on file if you want to hear about similar roles.
examples.zh: 如果你想了解类似岗位，我们可以「留存你的联系资料」。

collocations: ask to keep your details on file
keep your details on file with permission
keep your details on file for future roles

words.enDefinition: To avoid committing to just one choice

examples.en: Did you keep your options open while you were waiting for news from the museum?
examples.zh: 等美术馆消息的时候，你有没有「保留其他选择」？

examples.en: It's easier to keep your options open when you have several companies to explore.
examples.zh: 有几家公司可以了解时，更容易「保留多种选择」。

collocations: keep your options open for now
try to keep your options open
prefer to keep your options open

words.enDefinition: An important result someone produced or contributed to in a role

examples.en: My key achievement was getting the library's new returns guide ready before orientation.
examples.zh: 我的「主要成就」是在迎新前完成了图书馆新的还书指南。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to add one key achievement to each experience entry.
examples.zh: 顾问让我为每一项经历加上一条「主要成就」。

words.enDefinition: the most important things a worker is expected to do

examples.en: One of the key responsibilities is making sure hired equipment comes back in good condition.
examples.zh: 「主要职责」之一是确保租出去的设备完好归还。

examples.en: The advert lists the key responsibilities on the first page under the position title.
examples.zh: 招聘启事在第一页的职位名称下面列出了「主要职责」。

words.enDefinition: A search based on specific words entered

examples.en: I ran a keyword search for gallery work and found two local openings.
examples.zh: 我在「关键词搜索」里输入美术馆工作，找到了两个本地岗位。

examples.en: The keyword search brought up the same company under several different job titles.
examples.zh: 「关键词搜索」结果中，同一家公司出现在几个不同职位名称下。

collocations: a keyword search for local jobs

words.enDefinition: Repeating many search terms unnaturally to influence automated matching

examples.en: The class discussed keyword stuffing after reading a CV that repeated the same skills.
examples.zh: 全班看了一份反复列出相同技能的简历后，讨论了「关键词堆砌」。

examples.en: We rewrote the example to remove keyword stuffing and restore some context.
examples.zh: 我们改写了这个例子，删掉「关键词堆砌」的内容，补回了一点上下文。

words.enDefinition: the first formal meeting to introduce a project, its goals and responsibilities

examples.en: The kickoff meeting clarified who would look after the workshop bookings that term.
examples.zh: 「项目启动会」明确了那个学期由谁负责培训预约。

examples.en: I shared a short timetable at the kickoff meeting for the exhibition project.
examples.zh: 展览项目的「项目启动会」上，我分享了一份简短的进度表。

words.enDefinition: A screening question with an answer that rules someone out

examples.en: The recruiter explained how a knockout question could rule someone out before a manual review.
examples.zh: 招聘人员解释，「一票否决式筛选题」可能在人工审核之前就淘汰申请者。

examples.en: The workshop distinguished a knockout question from questions used only to collect information.
examples.zh: 工作坊区分了「一票否决式筛选题」和只用于收集信息的问题。

words.enDefinition: Figures describing employment, job openings, and related conditions

examples.en: Our adviser showed us labour market data for the cities closest to the university.
examples.zh: 就业顾问给我们看了离学校最近几座城市的「劳动力市场数据」。

examples.en: I used labour market data to compare job prospects in two parts of the country.
examples.zh: 我用「劳动力市场数据」比较了这个国家两个地区的就业前景。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大劳动力市场影响评估
words.enDefinition: A Canadian assessment of a proposed hire's labor market impact
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大劳动力市场影响评估

examples.en: The Canadian employer explained what the Labour Market Impact Assessment referred to in its email.
examples.zh: 加拿大雇主解释了邮件里提到的「加拿大劳动力市场影响评估」指什么。

examples.en: I asked which organization issued the Labour Market Impact Assessment for the job.
examples.zh: 我问这份工作的「加拿大劳动力市场影响评估」是哪个机构出具的。

collocations: a positive Labour Market Impact Assessment
a Labour Market Impact Assessment requirement
a Labour Market Impact Assessment decision

words.enDefinition: A lack of workers to fill available jobs

examples.en: The city report noted a labour shortage in some trades near the end of summer.
examples.zh: 市里的报告提到，夏末一些工种出现了「劳动力短缺」。

examples.en: The speaker discussed how the labour shortage had affected hiring at local hotels.
examples.zh: 演讲者谈到「劳动力短缺」怎样影响了本地酒店招聘。

words.enDefinition: Abilities to speak, understand, read, or write in particular languages

examples.en: I listed my language skills just below my software experience on the CV.
examples.zh: 我把「语言能力」列在简历的软件使用经验下方。

examples.en: The museum role asked for language skills that I could demonstrate during an interview.
examples.zh: 博物馆的岗位要求申请人具备可在面试中展示的「语言能力」。

words.enDefinition: To guide a piece of work from planning to completion

examples.en: I volunteered to lead a project that mapped accessible routes across campus.
examples.zh: 我主动「牵头负责一个项目」，绘制校园无障碍路线图。

examples.en: The adviser asked what I did to lead a project with three classmates.
examples.zh: 顾问问我与三位同学一起「牵头负责项目」时做了哪些工作。

collocations: lead a project from start to finish
lead a project for a client

words.enDefinition: to begin an explanation by giving the most important result or decision first

examples.en: I decided to lead with the conclusion before explaining the data on each slide.
examples.zh: 我决定「先讲结论」，再解释每张幻灯片上的数据。

examples.en: The adviser suggested that I lead with the conclusion because time was limited.
examples.zh: 因为时间有限，顾问建议我「先讲结论」。

collocations: lead with the conclusion in a briefing
choose to lead with the conclusion
learn to lead with the conclusion

words.enDefinition: a program designed to build skills for leading people or teams

examples.en: The leadership development program gave us opportunities to lead small projects with a mentor watching.
examples.zh: 「领导力培养项目」让我们有机会在导师观察下负责小项目。

examples.en: My supervisor suggested a leadership development program after I enjoyed organizing the volunteer team.
examples.zh: 发现我喜欢组织志愿者团队后，导师推荐了一个「领导力培养项目」。

words.enDefinition: Previous responsibilities involving guiding people or coordinating a group's work

examples.en: I used my leadership experience as club president to show how I handled disagreements.
examples.zh: 我用担任社团会长的「领导经历」说明自己如何处理分歧。

examples.en: The workshop helped me describe leadership experience from a project with four classmates.
examples.zh: 讲座帮助我描述了与四个同学合作完成项目时的「领导经历」。

words.enDefinition: A question worded to suggest the answer someone should give

examples.en: Our tutor turned a leading question into one that allowed more than one answer.
examples.zh: 导师把一个「引导性问题」改成了可以有多种回答的问题。

examples.en: The adviser pointed out how the leading question suggested a preferred response.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了这个「引导性问题」是怎样暗示期待的答案的。

words.enDefinition: To improve your understanding or behavior after doing something wrong

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to explain how we might learn from a mistake at work.
examples.zh: 导师让我们说说工作中可以怎样「从错误中吸取教训」。

examples.en: The interviewer wanted to know how I had managed to learn from a mistake.
examples.zh: 面试官想了解我是怎样「从错误中吸取教训」的。

collocations: learn from a mistake at work
help someone learn from a mistake
be willing to learn from a mistake

words.enDefinition: to find out additional information about a job and what it involves

examples.en: I said I would welcome the chance to learn more about the role.
examples.zh: 我说我希望有机会「进一步了解岗位」。

examples.en: I attended the session to learn more about the role before writing my application.
examples.zh: 写申请之前，我参加说明会「进一步了解岗位」。

collocations: an opportunity to learn more about the role
ask questions to learn more about the role
get in touch to learn more about the role

words.enDefinition: an agreement setting out what a student will learn and how

examples.en: We wrote a learning agreement covering the skills I wanted to develop at the archive.
examples.zh: 我们写了份「学习协议」，列出了我想在档案馆培养的技能。

examples.en: My supervisor and I revised the learning agreement once I had chosen a project.
examples.zh: 选好项目后，我和带教老师修改了「学习协议」。

words.enDefinition: an important stage that marks progress in learning a skill

examples.en: Running a short visitor tour was a learning milestone for me during the placement.
examples.zh: 带游客走一次简短的参观路线，是我实习中的一个「学习进度节点」。

examples.en: My supervisor called that first completed report a learning milestone in the training plan.
examples.zh: 带教老师说，完成这第一份报告是培训计划中的一个「学习进度节点」。

words.enDefinition: To enter nothing in a form field

examples.en: The guide says I can leave a field blank if it doesn't apply to me.
examples.zh: 指南写明，如果某一栏与我无关，可以「将这一栏留空」。

examples.en: What happens if I leave a field blank on the first page of the application?
examples.zh: 如果我在申请第一页「将某一栏留空」，会怎么样？

collocations: choose to leave a field blank
leave a field blank if it doesn't apply

words.enDefinition: The gradual buildup of leave over time

examples.en: The first page of the benefits guide explained leave accrual for people working weekends.
examples.zh: 福利指南第一页介绍了周末上班人员的「休假额度累积」方式。

examples.en: I asked when leave accrual would begin because my start date was moving.
examples.zh: 因为到岗日期要变动，我问什么时候开始「累积休假额度」。

words.enDefinition: Authorization to take requested time away from work

examples.en: The staff handbook explained who handles leave approval when the department manager is away.
examples.zh: 员工手册说明了部门经理不在时由谁负责「休假审批」。

examples.en: I asked how long leave approval usually takes when staff request a week off.
examples.zh: 我问员工申请休一周时，「休假审批」一般需要多久。

words.enDefinition: The amount of leave someone still has available

examples.en: The portal showed my leave balance after I booked two days off for exams.
examples.zh: 我因为考试请了两天假后，门户显示了我的「剩余休假额度」。

examples.en: I asked when my leave balance would first appear after starting the library job.
examples.zh: 我问在图书馆开始工作后，什么时候能第一次看到「剩余休假额度」。

words.enDefinition: a calendar showing when staff members are scheduled to be away from work

examples.en: The leave calendar showed that two desk workers would be away on Friday.
examples.zh: 「员工休假日历」显示，周五有两名柜台员工休假。

examples.en: I checked the leave calendar before asking for the same afternoon off.
examples.zh: 我先查了「员工休假日历」，再申请那个下午休假。

collocations: add a date to the leave calendar

words.enDefinition: A cash payment for unused leave

examples.en: The handbook explained when a leave payout could appear on an employee's final statement.
examples.zh: 手册说明了「未休假期折算款」什么时候可能出现在员工最后一份结算单上。

examples.en: I asked how the library recorded a leave payout if someone left before the summer.
examples.zh: 我问如果有人在暑假之前离职，图书馆会怎么记录「未休假期折算款」。

words.enDefinition: keep an opportunity available for the future

examples.en: I wanted to leave the door open for a role after I finish my placement.
examples.zh: 我想「保留以后合作的可能」，等实习结束再考虑相关岗位。

examples.en: We can leave the door open and talk again when weekend work becomes available.
examples.zh: 我们可以「保留以后合作的可能」，等有周末岗位再聊。

collocations: leave the door open for future contact
try to leave the door open
leave the door open for a later discussion

words.enDefinition: A recurring annual period used to manage leave

examples.en: The leave year at my new job runs from September to the following August.
examples.zh: 我新工作的「休假额度计算年度」从九月持续到次年八月。

examples.en: I asked which leave year applied to the time off I had already booked.
examples.zh: 我问已预约的休假计入哪个「休假额度计算年度」。

collocations: the start of the leave year
the end of the leave year

words.enDefinition: Something understood as a result of a previous experience

examples.en: My answer ended with one lesson learned from the canceled event.
examples.zh: 我在回答的最后说了一条活动取消后总结出的「经验教训」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked whether the lesson learned affected how I planned later events.
examples.zh: 面试官问，这条「经验教训」是否影响了后来我策划活动的方式。

words.expression: let me give you an example
words.lemma: let me give you an example
words.enDefinition: A phrase introducing a specific instance to explain a point
acceptedEnVariants: let me give you an example

examples.en: I said "Let me give you an example" before describing a busy afternoon at the desk.
examples.zh: 我先说「我来给您举个例子」，然后讲了服务台一个忙碌的下午。

examples.en: The student used "Let me give you an example" to introduce a story about their project.
examples.zh: 这位学生用「我来给您举个例子」引出自己的项目经历。

collocations: let me give you an example from work
let me give you an example of what I mean
let me give you an example from last term

words.enDefinition: An expression used to introduce the first point or example

examples.en: My answer began with "Let me start with" before I introduced our library project.
examples.zh: 我的回答先说「我先从……说起」，随后介绍了图书馆项目。

examples.en: I practiced following "Let me start with" with a brief description of my role.
examples.zh: 我练习在「我先从……说起」之后简要描述自己的角色。

collocations: let me start with a recent example
let me start with my role
let me start with the result

words.enDefinition: a letter asking an organization about possible work opportunities when no vacancy is advertised

examples.en: I sent a letter of interest to the museum before it posted summer vacancies.
examples.zh: 博物馆发布暑期空缺前，我先给它寄了「求职意向信」。

examples.en: My letter of interest asked whether the studio ever hired students for short projects.
examples.zh: 我的「求职意向信」询问这家工作室会不会请学生参与短期项目。

collocations: a letter of interest to an employer

words.enDefinition: a letter explaining why a person wants a particular opportunity or program

examples.en: The placement asked for a letter of motivation about working with young learners.
examples.zh: 实习项目要求提供一封「申请动机信」，说明为什么想和低龄学生一起工作。

examples.en: In my letter of motivation, I described how the placement fit my studies.
examples.zh: 我在「申请动机信」里说明了这项实习怎样与我的学业相衔接。

words.enDefinition: stay in contact with someone to coordinate shared work

examples.en: The assistant will liaise with security to arrange access for groups visiting after hours.
examples.zh: 助理会「与安保人员联络协调」，安排下班后到访的团体进场。

examples.en: I asked how often I'd liaise with staff from the other campus during term.
examples.zh: 我问学期内多久需要「与另一个校区的员工联络协调」一次。

collocations: liaise with members of the public

words.enDefinition: To communicate with people who have an interest in a project

examples.en: I learned to liaise with stakeholders who used the community center every week.
examples.zh: 我学会了「与利益相关方沟通」，他们每周都使用社区中心。

examples.en: My adviser showed me how to describe my role when I had to liaise with stakeholders.
examples.zh: 顾问教我如何描述我在需要「与利益相关方沟通」时承担的职责。

collocations: liaise with stakeholders on a project

words.enDefinition: The point where text ends one line and starts another

examples.en: An extra line break split my university name across two lines.
examples.zh: 多出来的一处「换行」把我学校的名称拆成了两行。

examples.en: I removed a line break so the dates stayed together on the page.
examples.zh: 我删掉一处「换行」，让日期留在同一行。

words.enDefinition: the manager directly responsible for supervising a person's day-to-day work

examples.en: My line manager helped me choose which part of the project to start.
examples.zh: 我的「直属经理」帮我决定先做项目的哪一部分。

examples.en: I told my line manager about the timetable clash before the rota was finalized.
examples.zh: 排班表定稿前，我把时间冲突告诉了「直属经理」。

words.enDefinition: The vertical distance between lines of text in a document

examples.en: I adjusted the line spacing so the bullets did not run together.
examples.zh: 我调整了「行距」，避免几条要点挤在一起。

examples.en: The line spacing differed between pages after I pasted in the new section.
examples.zh: 我粘贴新栏目后，两页的「行距」不一样了。

words.expression: link your experience to the role
words.lemma: link your experience to the role
words.zhGloss: 把经历与岗位联系起来
words.enDefinition: To explain how your past activities relate to the job
acceptedZhAnswers: 把经历与岗位联系起来
acceptedEnVariants: link your experience to the role

examples.en: The adviser asked you to link your experience to the role using one example from university.
examples.zh: 顾问让你用一个大学里的例子「把经历与岗位联系起来」。

examples.en: The opening question gives you a chance to link your experience to the role right away.
examples.zh: 开场问题让你有机会一开始就「把经历与岗位联系起来」。

collocations: link your experience to the role clearly
help link your experience to the role
learn to link your experience to the role

words.enDefinition: A record of articles, books, or other works someone has published

examples.en: I updated the list of publications after the journal released our article online.
examples.zh: 期刊在网上发表我们的文章后，我更新了「发表成果清单」。

examples.en: The sample academic CV puts its list of publications near the end of the document.
examples.zh: 那份学术履历样本把「发表成果清单」放在文件快结束的位置。

words.enDefinition: writing and running code while other people watch, often during an interview

examples.en: The panel explained how live coding worked before opening the shared browser editor.
examples.zh: 评审组先解释了「现场编程」怎么进行，再打开共享的浏览器编辑器。

examples.en: I practised live coding with a classmate so I could explain my decisions clearly.
examples.zh: 我和同学练习了「现场编程」，好把自己的决定解释清楚。

words.enDefinition: a demonstration that shows a product, process or project working in real time

examples.en: I prepared a live demo so the panel could see the map respond immediately.
examples.zh: 我准备了「现场演示」，让评审组看到地图即时响应的效果。

examples.en: The screen froze halfway through the live demo, so I showed a recording.
examples.zh: 「现场演示」到一半时画面卡住了，我就改放录像。

words.enDefinition: Notices about jobs available in a nearby area

examples.en: I checked the local job listings before taking the bus into town on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六坐公交进城前，我先查了「本地职位信息」。

examples.en: The library keeps a folder of local job listings beside the front desk.
examples.zh: 图书馆前台旁放着一本「本地职位信息」汇编。

words.enDefinition: An option limiting results to selected places

examples.en: The location filter helped me find work on the same bus route as my flat.
examples.zh: 「地点筛选条件」帮我找到了和我住处在同一条公交线路上的工作。

examples.en: I removed the location filter when I wanted to see openings in neighbouring towns.
examples.zh: 我想看看邻近小镇的岗位时，就清除了「地点筛选条件」。

collocations: a location filter for nearby jobs

words.enDefinition: a check of the activities and information recorded in a logbook

examples.en: At the logbook review, I explained what I had learned while helping the archive team.
examples.zh: 在「实践日志审阅」时，我解释了帮档案馆团队做事期间学到的内容。

examples.en: My tutor scheduled a logbook review before I moved to a different placement site.
examples.zh: 我换去另一个实习地点之前，导师安排了「实践日志审阅」。

words.enDefinition: working alone without other staff nearby

examples.en: The listing mentioned lone working because only one attendant is scheduled after eight at night.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到要「独自值守」，因为晚上八点后只安排一名工作人员。

examples.en: I asked whether lone working was part of opening the building on Saturday mornings.
examples.zh: 我问周六早上去开楼门时是不是要「独自值守」。

words.enDefinition: To try to find paid employment

examples.en: I plan to look for work near campus after the exam period ends.
examples.zh: 我打算考试周结束后在学校附近「找工作」。

examples.en: Where did you look for work when you first moved to the city?
examples.zh: 你刚搬到这座城市时，是在哪儿「找工作」的？

words.expression: look forward to hearing from you
words.lemma: look forward to hearing from you
words.enDefinition: to express politely that one hopes to receive a response
acceptedEnVariants: look forward to hearing from you

examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you about the next steps in the process.
examples.zh: 我「期待您的回复」，也想了解接下来有哪些步骤。

examples.en: The tutor said “I look forward to hearing from you” was a suitable closing here.
examples.zh: 导师说，这里可以用「期待您的回复」结尾。

collocations: I look forward to hearing from you soon
close with look forward to hearing from you
look forward to hearing from you about the role

words.enDefinition: To stop remembering what you were about to say

examples.en: It is easy to lose your train of thought when someone interrupts halfway through a story.
examples.zh: 有人讲到一半被打断时，很容易「思路突然中断」。

examples.en: My coach explained what to do if you lose your train of thought in an interview.
examples.zh: 教练介绍了面试中「思路突然中断」时可以怎么应对。

collocations: momentarily lose your train of thought
lose your train of thought mid-sentence
worry you might lose your train of thought

words.enDefinition: a preview image or video with fewer pixels than the original

examples.en: The low-resolution preview loads quickly, but the print layout shows the image details.
examples.zh: 「低分辨率预览」加载很快，印刷布局里能看到图像的细节。

examples.en: I attached a low-resolution preview because the full image was too large to email.
examples.zh: 完整图片太大，邮件发不过去，所以我附了一张「低分辨率预览」。

words.enDefinition: Text that software can extract and interpret from a file

examples.en: The test file contained machine-readable text that I could copy into another document.
examples.zh: 测试文件含有「机器可读文本」，我可以把这些字复制到另一份文档中。

examples.en: The adviser showed how to check for machine-readable text in the exported file.
examples.zh: 顾问演示了怎么检查导出的文件中是否有「机器可读文本」。

collocations: convert an image to machine-readable text

words.enDefinition: the central telephone service that directs calls within an organization

examples.en: I called the main switchboard to find out which team handled applications for the gallery.
examples.zh: 我打了「电话总机」，想弄清美术馆的申请归哪个团队管。

examples.en: The main switchboard put me through to the recruiter who had sent the invitation.
examples.zh: 「电话总机」帮我接通了发送邀请的招聘人员。

words.enDefinition: To keep the way you speak suitable for a formal interaction

examples.en: The coach showed how to maintain a professional tone while explaining a disagreement at work.
examples.zh: 教练示范了怎么在解释工作中的分歧时「保持专业语气」。

examples.en: We practiced how to maintain a professional tone when our partners asked difficult questions.
examples.zh: 搭档提出难题时，我们练习怎样「保持专业语气」。

collocations: maintain a professional tone when disagreeing

words.enDefinition: keep information written down correctly and up to date

examples.en: The residence receptionist must maintain accurate records of which students are holding borrowed keys.
examples.zh: 宿舍前台必须「准确记录」哪些学生借走了钥匙。

examples.en: Applicants should be able to maintain accurate records even when the office is very busy.
examples.zh: 即便办公室很忙，申请人也应该有能力「确保记录准确」。

collocations: maintain accurate records for a team

words.zhGloss: 加拿大续办期间保留身份
words.enDefinition: Canadian immigration status that continues during certain pending extension applications
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大续办期间保留身份

examples.en: The employment adviser explained why the Canadian guide mentioned maintained status.
examples.zh: 就业顾问解释了加拿大指南为什么提到了「加拿大续办期间保留身份」。

examples.en: I asked how maintained status differed from the dates on my permit.
examples.zh: 我问「加拿大续办期间保留身份」和许可证上写的日期有什么区别。

collocations: maintained status while an application is pending

words.enDefinition: To propose hiring someone for a job

examples.en: The manager said they hoped to make an offer before the end of the week.
examples.zh: 经理说，他们希望本周结束前「发出录用通知」。

examples.en: The university needed to check the opening was funded before it could make an offer.
examples.zh: 学校得先确认这个岗位有经费，才能「发出录用通知」。

collocations: be ready to make an offer
make an offer to a candidate

words.enDefinition: To look at someone's eyes while speaking or listening

examples.en: I tried to make eye contact with the person who asked the question.
examples.zh: 我试着和提问者「进行眼神交流」。

examples.en: The video showed when I tended to make eye contact during my answers.
examples.zh: 视频让我看到自己回答时通常什么时候会「进行眼神交流」。

collocations: make eye contact with the interviewer

words.enDefinition: additional hours worked to replace required time you missed

examples.en: I arranged make-up hours at the library after missing two sessions during the term.
examples.zh: 学期里有两次没去实习，我安排在图书馆把「要补的实习时数」做完。

examples.en: The tutor showed me how to record my make-up hours separately from the regular sessions.
examples.zh: 导师告诉我，怎么把「补做的实习时数」和常规实习分开记录。

words.enDefinition: To plan, monitor, and control spending within available funds

examples.en: I learned to manage a budget while organizing weekly events for the society.
examples.zh: 我在为社团组织每周活动时学会了「管理预算」。

examples.en: My CV explains how I helped manage a budget for our final exhibition.
examples.zh: 我的简历说明了我如何协助为毕业展「管理预算」。

collocations: manage a budget for an event
manage a budget of several thousand dollars

words.enDefinition: decide what to do first when important tasks compete for time

examples.en: The assistant must manage competing priorities when several lecturers ask for help at once.
examples.zh: 好几位讲师同时求助时，助理必须「分清这些要务的先后顺序」。

examples.en: I asked how the team would help me manage competing priorities during the busy weeks.
examples.zh: 我问最忙的那几个星期，团队会怎样帮我「排定多项要务的先后顺序」。

words.enDefinition: an employee being trained to take on management responsibilities

examples.en: The management trainee spent her first rotation learning how the depot planned its daily deliveries.
examples.zh: 这位「管理培训生」在第一轮轮岗中学习了配送中心怎么安排每天的送货。

examples.en: I met a management trainee who had recently moved from customer service into operations.
examples.zh: 我遇到了一位「管理培训生」，刚从客服轮岗到运营部门。

words.enDefinition: lifting, carrying, or moving objects using physical effort

examples.en: The advert mentions manual handling because the job includes moving boxes of donated books.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到有「人工搬运」，因为这份工作要挪装着捐赠书籍的箱子。

examples.en: I asked whether the manual handling duties were mainly in the storeroom or at events.
examples.zh: 我问「人工搬运」主要是在仓库里，还是在活动现场做。

words.enDefinition: Checking an application by a person

examples.en: The form went to manual review after the system couldn't match my course code.
examples.zh: 系统没能匹配我的课程代码，所以表单转入了「人工审核」。

examples.en: I was told which documents would be checked as part of the manual review.
examples.zh: 对方告诉我，「人工审核」会核查哪些材料。

collocations: send an application for manual review

words.enDefinition: to change a task's recorded status to show that its work is finished

examples.en: I waited for the supervisor's approval before I could mark a task as complete.
examples.zh: 我等主管批准后，才可以「把任务标为已完成」。

examples.en: The handbook shows where to mark a task as complete in the portal.
examples.zh: 手册指明了在平台上哪里可以「把任务标为已完成」。

collocations: mark a task as complete in the portal
be ready to mark a task as complete
click to mark a task as complete

words.enDefinition: The typical pay for comparable work in a market

examples.en: I looked up the market rate for similar library roles in the same city.
examples.zh: 我查了同一个城市相似图书馆岗位的「市场薪资水平」。

examples.en: The adviser showed me a local survey that listed the market rate for comparable jobs.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了一份当地的调查，里面列了类似岗位的「市场薪资水平」。

collocations: compare an offer with the market rate

words.enDefinition: a question asking a candidate to estimate the size or demand of a market

examples.en: The market-sizing question asked how many students might use a new print service.
examples.zh: 「市场规模估算题」问一项新的打印服务可能有多少学生使用。

examples.en: I began the market-sizing question by estimating the number of first-year students.
examples.zh: 我先估算一年级学生人数，以此开始回答「市场规模估算题」。

collocations: an example of a market-sizing question

words.enDefinition: A comprehensive record used to create shorter versions for specific jobs

examples.en: I keep a master resume with details from every project I have worked on.
examples.zh: 我保留了一份「简历总稿」，里面有我参与过的每个项目的详情。

examples.en: After the placement ended, I added my new duties to the master resume.
examples.zh: 实习结束后，我把新增的工作职责加入了「简历总稿」。

words.zhGloss: 给出同等条件的录用通知
words.enDefinition: To offer terms equal to another employer's
acceptedZhAnswers: 给出同等条件的录用通知

examples.en: The museum said it couldn't match an offer from the university library this term.
examples.zh: 博物馆说这学期无法「给出和大学图书馆同等条件的录用通知」。

examples.en: Could the department match an offer if another employer proposed a higher starting salary?
examples.zh: 如果另一家雇主给的起薪更高，系里能「给出同等条件的录用通知」吗？

collocations: be willing to match an offer

words.expression: may I put you on hold
words.lemma: may i put you on hold
words.zhGloss: 可以请你在线等一会儿吗
words.enDefinition: asks permission to pause a connected call briefly
acceptedZhAnswers: 可以请你在线等一会儿吗
acceptedEnVariants: may I put you on hold

examples.en: May I put you on hold while I check which recruiter sent the invitation?
examples.zh: 「可以请你在线等一会儿吗」？我查一下是哪位招聘人员发的邀请。

examples.en: May I put you on hold briefly while I find the coordinator's extension number?
examples.zh: 「可以请你在线等一会儿吗」？我找一下协调员的分机号码。

collocations: may I put you on hold for a moment?
may I put you on hold while I check?
before I transfer you, may I put you on hold?

words.enDefinition: A polite request for short thinking time before responding

examples.en: When the final question surprised me, I asked "May I take a moment?" before responding.
examples.zh: 最后一道题让我有些意外，我在回答之前问「我可以先想一下吗」。

examples.en: Our adviser suggested "May I take a moment?" for questions that need some thought.
examples.zh: 顾问建议，遇到需要想一想的问题时可以说「我可以先想一下吗」。

collocations: may I take a moment to think
may I take a moment to consider that
may I take a moment before answering

words.enDefinition: Money provided toward meals connected with work

examples.en: The offer specified a meal allowance for shifts that finished after eight in the evening.
examples.zh: 录用通知写明，晚上八点之后结束的班次有「餐费补贴」。

examples.en: Could you confirm whether the meal allowance covers lunch during days in the other branch?
examples.zh: 您能确认去另一家分馆上班时，「餐费补贴」包不包括午餐吗？

words.enDefinition: A change caused by an action that can be evaluated quantitatively

examples.en: I described the measurable impact of the guide with figures from our help desk.
examples.zh: 我用服务台的数据来描述那份指南产生的「可衡量的影响」。

examples.en: The reviewer asked whether my scheduling changes had a measurable impact on attendance.
examples.zh: 审阅者问我，调整日程是否对出席人数带来了「可衡量的影响」。

words.enDefinition: To reach a stated level of performance or output

examples.en: The extra study sessions helped us meet a target for first-year attendance.
examples.zh: 增设学习时段后，大一学生的出席人数帮助我们「达成指标」。

examples.en: My CV explains how I helped the team meet a target for survey responses.
examples.zh: 我的简历说明了我怎样帮助团队在回收问卷这一项上「达成指标」。

collocations: meet a target ahead of schedule

words.enDefinition: To finish work on time despite having little time to complete it

examples.en: I described how our team divided tasks to meet a tight deadline before orientation.
examples.zh: 我描述了迎新前团队如何分工，最终「赶上紧迫的截止期限」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how I checked my work while trying to meet a tight deadline.
examples.zh: 面试官问我，努力「赶上紧迫的截止期限」时是怎样检查工作的。

collocations: work together to meet a tight deadline
manage to meet a tight deadline

words.enDefinition: To do what an offer requires before confirmation

examples.en: The letter explained what I needed to provide to meet the conditions of the offer.
examples.zh: 录用函说明我需要提供什么才能「满足所列条件」。

examples.en: I asked how long I had to meet the conditions stated in the email.
examples.zh: 我问自己有多少时间「满足邮件中列出的条件」。

collocations: be able to meet the conditions

words.enDefinition: finish work on time when little time is available

examples.en: The student newspaper needs assistants who can meet tight deadlines before each issue goes out.
examples.zh: 学生报社需要能在每期发行前「在紧迫期限内完成工作」的助理。

examples.en: The role requires you to meet tight deadlines when last-minute changes come in from lecturers.
examples.zh: 这个岗位要求在讲师临时提出修改时，也能「在紧迫期限内完成」。

collocations: work together to meet tight deadlines
under pressure to meet tight deadlines

words.enDefinition: work or communication after a meeting to confirm decisions and carry out next steps

examples.en: I sent a meeting follow-up with the links and the two agreed dates.
examples.zh: 我发了封「会后跟进」邮件，里面有链接和两个商定日期。

examples.en: The meeting follow-up reminded us who would contact the students on the waiting list.
examples.zh: 「会后跟进」提醒了我们由谁联系候补名单上的学生。

words.enDefinition: an invitation giving recipients the details of a planned meeting, often through a calendar

examples.en: The meeting invite included a link to the document we would discuss.
examples.zh: 「会议邀请」里有我们要讨论的文档链接。

examples.en: I accepted the meeting invite once I confirmed that my shift ended before noon.
examples.zh: 确认班次中午前结束后，我接受了「会议邀请」。

words.enDefinition: A fixed response someone has learned to repeat from memory

examples.en: My tutor noticed that my memorized answer did not address the question.
examples.zh: 导师注意到我「背熟的回答」没有答到题目上。

examples.en: I changed one example because the memorized answer sounded unnatural when spoken.
examples.zh: 「背熟的回答」说出来不自然，所以我换了一个例子。

words.enDefinition: the greatest amount of memory a program is allowed to use

examples.en: The platform displayed a memory limit near the bottom of the problem description.
examples.zh: 平台在题目说明接近底部的位置显示了「内存用量上限」。

examples.en: I considered the memory limit before deciding whether to store every result.
examples.zh: 决定是否存下每个结果之前，我考虑了「内存用量上限」。

words.enDefinition: a result message saying that a program used more memory than permitted

examples.en: The platform reported “Memory Limit Exceeded” when the program tried to load every row.
examples.zh: 程序尝试载入所有行时，提交结果显示「超出内存用量上限」。

examples.en: I got “Memory Limit Exceeded” after adding a second copy of the dataset.
examples.zh: 我又存了一份数据集，接着就收到「超出内存用量上限」的提示。

words.zhGloss: 提到推荐人或推荐来源
words.enDefinition: to say in an application that someone referred you to an employer or vacancy
acceptedZhAnswers: 提到推荐人或推荐来源

examples.en: I asked the adviser whether I could mention a referral in my first paragraph.
examples.zh: 我问顾问能不能在第一段「提到推荐人或推荐来源」。

examples.en: The form showed me where to mention a referral from a current employee.
examples.zh: 表格标出了我可以在哪里「提到推荐人或推荐来源」，也就是给我推荐岗位的在职员工。

collocations: mention a referral in your letter
decide whether to mention a referral

words.enDefinition: To offer ongoing support and guidance to less experienced students

examples.en: I volunteered to mentor junior students who had just joined our debate society.
examples.zh: 我志愿「指导低年级学生」，他们刚加入我们的辩论社。

examples.en: My CV explains why I chose to mentor junior students during the summer break.
examples.zh: 我的简历说明了我为什么选择在暑假「指导低年级学生」。

collocations: mentor junior students in a lab
mentor junior students through a program

words.enDefinition: a scheduled conversation for getting advice from a mentor

examples.en: I used the mentoring session to compare two departments before choosing my final rotation.
examples.zh: 选最后一轮轮岗前，我在「导师指导会谈」里比较了两个部门。

examples.en: At my monthly mentoring session, we talked about which skills would transfer to another role.
examples.zh: 在每月的「导师指导会谈」上，我们谈了哪些技能可以用到另一个岗位上。

words.enDefinition: a job between junior and senior levels of responsibility

examples.en: I realised it was a mid-level position when I saw the experience they expected.
examples.zh: 看到他们要求的工作经验后，我才意识到这是个「中级岗位」。

examples.en: The mid-level position involved running small projects with support from a senior coordinator.
examples.zh: 这个「中级岗位」要在资深协调员的支持下负责小项目。

collocations: a mid-level position in the team

words.enDefinition: a meeting to review progress midway through a placement

examples.en: At my mid-placement review, we discussed how much time the archive project still needed.
examples.zh: 在「实习中期回顾」会上，我们谈了档案馆项目还需要多少时间。

examples.en: I brought examples of my work to the mid-placement review so we could discuss them.
examples.zh: 我带了几份工作样例去参加「实习中期回顾」，方便一起讨论。

words.enDefinition: very little guidance or monitoring from a supervisor

examples.en: The notice says assistants work with minimal supervision once they know the booking system.
examples.zh: 通知上写着，助理熟悉预约系统后，工作「很少需要督导」。

examples.en: I asked if minimal supervision meant the manager normally worked in a different building.
examples.zh: 我问「很少需要督导」是不是意味着经理平时在另一栋楼里上班。

words.enDefinition: The lowest score needed to pass an assessment

examples.en: The assessment page explained the minimum passing score before we started the practice questions.
examples.zh: 开始做练习题之前，测评页面说明了「最低通过分数」。

examples.en: I asked whether the same minimum passing score applied to both parts of the test.
examples.zh: 我问测试的两个部分是否采用相同的「最低通过分数」。

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount of placement time that must be completed

examples.en: The course handbook lists the minimum placement hours for each of our training modules.
examples.zh: 课程手册列出了每个培训单元的「最低实习时数」。

examples.en: I asked if the revised timetable would let me meet the minimum placement hours.
examples.zh: 我问改过的时间表能不能让我达到「最低实习时数」。

words.enDefinition: the lowest level of credentials or experience an employer will accept

examples.en: I read the minimum qualifications carefully because my diploma was earned in another country.
examples.zh: 我的文凭是在另一个国家拿的，所以我仔细读了「最低任职资格」。

examples.en: The minimum qualifications include a childcare certificate and previous work with young children.
examples.zh: 「最低任职资格」包括持有幼儿照护证书，以及有和幼儿共事的经验。

words.enDefinition: the person responsible for recording the main discussion and decisions in a meeting

examples.en: Our minute taker checked how to spell the names before writing the notes.
examples.zh: 「会议记录员」在记笔记前先核对了姓名怎么拼。

examples.en: The minute taker asked the chair to repeat the final decision slowly.
examples.zh: 「会议记录员」请主持人慢一点再说一遍最终决定。

words.enDefinition: An expected file that has not been included

examples.en: The portal flagged a missing attachment when I tried to review my application.
examples.zh: 我试着检查申请时，门户提示有一个「缺失的附件」。

examples.en: I added the missing attachment and checked that its filename appeared on the summary.
examples.zh: 我补上了「缺失的附件」，并确认摘要上显示了它的文件名。

collocations: a notice about a missing attachment

words.enDefinition: an invented project brief used for practice or to show how someone would approach a problem

examples.en: I used a mock brief from the course to design a poster series.
examples.zh: 我根据课程里的「模拟项目任务书」设计了一组海报。

examples.en: The reviewer knew the client was fictional because I labelled it a mock brief.
examples.zh: 我注明这是「模拟项目任务书」，评审就知道客户是虚构的。

collocations: a mock brief for a design task

words.enDefinition: A practice session that imitates a real job interview

examples.en: My roommate ran a mock interview before I applied for the campus library job.
examples.zh: 申请校图书馆的工作前，室友给我做了场「模拟面试」。

examples.en: The mock interview showed me how often I rushed through the end of an answer.
examples.zh: 这次「模拟面试」让我发现，自己经常匆匆结束回答。

collocations: get feedback after a mock interview

words.enDefinition: a practice interview that uses questions and exercises like those of a technical interview

examples.en: A classmate ran a mock technical interview with me before the placement fair.
examples.zh: 实习招聘会前，一名同学给我做了一次「模拟技术面试」。

examples.en: The careers office offered a mock technical interview using an online shared editor.
examples.zh: 就业指导办公室提供了一次「模拟技术面试」，使用在线共享编辑器。

collocations: prepare for a mock technical interview

words.enDefinition: A salary amount stated for one month

examples.en: The manager confirmed the monthly salary after we agreed on how many hours I'd work.
examples.zh: 我们商定工时后，经理确认了「月薪」。

examples.en: I asked whether the figure in the letter was a monthly salary or an annual amount.
examples.zh: 我问信里的数字是「月薪」还是一年的金额。

words.enDefinition: The personal reason someone decided to apply for a role

examples.en: I explained my motivation for applying by talking about the museum's community work.
examples.zh: 我谈到博物馆的社区工作，借此说明了自己的「应聘动机」。

examples.en: The panel asked about my motivation for applying before discussing my class projects.
examples.zh: 面试小组先询问我的「应聘动机」，然后才谈课程项目。

words.enDefinition: to reschedule a meeting for an earlier time or date

examples.en: I asked if we could move a meeting forward to the morning.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「提前开会」，把会议改到上午。

examples.en: We agreed to move a meeting forward by a day before the holiday.
examples.zh: 我们同意在假期前「提前开会」，把会议往前挪一天。

collocations: move a meeting forward by an hour
ask to move a meeting forward
move a meeting forward to Monday

words.enDefinition: To be allowed to continue in a selection process

examples.en: I had to upload a clear certificate before I could move to the next stage.
examples.zh: 我得先上传一份清晰的证书，才能「进入下一阶段」。

examples.en: The dashboard told me I could move to the next stage after the initial review.
examples.zh: 申请总览提示我，初审后可以「进入下一阶段」。

collocations: be invited to move to the next stage
move to the next stage of recruitment
be ready to move to the next stage

words.enDefinition: A single question that asks about several related points

examples.en: I wrote down two words to remember each part of the multi-part question.
examples.zh: 我记下两个词，提醒自己别漏答「多部分问题」中的任何一部分。

examples.en: The multi-part question asked what I did and what changed afterward.
examples.zh: 这道「多部分问题」问我做了什么，以及之后有什么变化。

words.enDefinition: A contact known to both people

examples.en: I noticed we had a mutual connection from the course I took last year.
examples.zh: 我注意到我们有个「共同认识的人」，是我去年上课认识的。

examples.en: A mutual connection at the library put me in touch with a former student.
examples.zh: 图书馆里一位「共同认识的人」帮我联系上了一名前学生。

collocations: be introduced by a mutual connection

words.enDefinition: to give variables names that make their roles or contents easy to understand

examples.en: I tried to name variables clearly so the interviewer could follow my approach.
examples.zh: 我尽量「给变量取清楚的名字」，方便面试官跟上我的思路。

examples.en: The feedback said I could name variables clearly instead of relying on single letters.
examples.zh: 反馈说，我可以「给变量取清楚的名字」，少用单个字母。

words.enDefinition: To focus on fewer kinds of opportunities

examples.en: How did you narrow your job search after finding so many listings yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天找到那么多招聘信息后，你是怎么「缩小求职范围」的？

examples.en: You can narrow your job search by choosing only the towns with direct trains.
examples.zh: 如果只选有直达火车的小镇，就能「缩小求职范围」。

collocations: narrow your job search by location
narrow your job search by industry
help you narrow your job search

words.enDefinition: To discuss changes to a job offer

examples.en: I wanted to negotiate an offer that would let me finish my Thursday evening course.
examples.zh: 我想「协商录用条件」，让自己能上完周四晚上的课。

examples.en: Can I negotiate an offer if the start date overlaps with my final exams?
examples.zh: 如果到岗日期撞上期末考试，我能「协商录用条件」吗？

collocations: be able to negotiate an offer
negotiate an offer with an employer

words.enDefinition: To discuss changes to benefits included with a job

examples.en: I wanted to negotiate benefits because the location made the commute more expensive than expected.
examples.zh: 工作地点让通勤比预想的更贵，所以我想「协商福利」。

examples.en: Could I negotiate benefits with the department after we agreed on the starting salary?
examples.zh: 商定起薪后，我能和系里「协商福利」吗？

collocations: negotiate benefits as part of an offer

words.enDefinition: To make professional connections with former students

examples.en: I went to the department's event to network with alumni who work in theatre.
examples.zh: 我去参加系里的活动，想「与在剧院工作的校友建立联系」。

examples.en: The club arranged an online evening for students to network with alumni living abroad.
examples.zh: 社团举办了一场线上晚会，让学生有机会「与在海外生活的校友建立联系」。

collocations: get a chance to network with alumni
network with alumni in your field

words.enDefinition: a person who has recently joined an employer

examples.en: The new hire joined us on Monday and spent the morning meeting the team.
examples.zh: 这位「新入职员工」周一加入，上午和团队成员一一见了面。

examples.en: Each new hire receives a copy of the duty roster for the first week.
examples.zh: 每位「新入职员工」都会收到一份第一周的值班表。

collocations: assign a buddy to a new hire

words.enDefinition: A list of tasks that need attention when someone starts work

examples.en: I used the new hire checklist to keep track of documents I had returned.
examples.zh: 我用「新员工手续清单」记录自己已经交回了哪些文件。

examples.en: The manager added the first week's introductions to my new hire checklist.
examples.zh: 经理把第一周的人员介绍加到了我的「新员工手续清单」中。

words.enDefinition: a job an organization has introduced for the first time

examples.en: The university advertised a newly created role to help students find local volunteering projects.
examples.zh: 学校招聘一个「新设岗位」，负责帮学生找本地志愿服务项目。

examples.en: I read the duties carefully because it was a newly created role without a predecessor.
examples.zh: 这是个「新设岗位」，此前没人做过，所以我认真读了岗位职责。

collocations: take on a newly created role
a newly created role in the team

words.enDefinition: a period of work scheduled mainly during the night

examples.en: The night shift at the residence desk would clash with my early class on Fridays.
examples.zh: 学生宿舍前台要上「夜班」，会影响我周五的早课。

examples.en: I asked whether the night shift ended before the buses started running again.
examples.zh: 我问「夜班」会不会在公交恢复运营之前就下班。

words.enDefinition: previous work experience is not a condition for applying

examples.en: The sign said 'No experience required,' so I asked about the weekend café shifts.
examples.zh: 告示写着「无需工作经验」，所以我去问了咖啡馆周末班的情况。

examples.en: I applied because the advert said 'No experience required' and classes had just ended.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着「无需工作经验」，我又刚上完课，就去申请了。

collocations: a sign saying no experience required
an ad marked no experience required
a role advertised with no experience required

words.enDefinition: no official credential is needed to apply

examples.en: The poster said 'No formal qualifications required,' but new staff had to complete training.
examples.zh: 海报写着「无需正式资质」，但新员工必须完成培训。

examples.en: The advert says 'No formal qualifications required,' so I asked which skills they valued.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着「无需正式资质」，所以我问他们看重哪些技能。

collocations: advertised with no formal qualifications required
roles with no formal qualifications required
listed as no formal qualifications required

words.enDefinition: tells the recipient a response is optional or unnecessary

examples.en: There's no need to reply to this email if the revised time suits you.
examples.zh: 如果新时间合适，这封邮件「不用回复」。

examples.en: There's no need to reply now because the coordinator has already confirmed your slot.
examples.zh: 协调员已经确认了你的时段，现在「不用回复」。

collocations: no need to reply to this email
no need to reply if you're happy with the time
no need to reply unless anything changes

words.enDefinition: Employee benefits provided otherwise than as cash pay

examples.en: The leaflet listed free language classes among the non-cash benefits available to new staff.
examples.zh: 传单把免费语言课列入了新员工可以享受的「非现金福利」。

examples.en: I asked which non-cash benefits were included with the museum's part-time roles.
examples.zh: 我问博物馆的兼职岗位包括哪些「非现金福利」。

words.enDefinition: an internship that does not earn academic credit

examples.en: I did a non-credit internship because I wanted experience in a different kind of workplace.
examples.zh: 我做了一段「不计学分的实习」，想在另一类工作环境中积累经验。

examples.en: My adviser explained that the non-credit internship wouldn't replace the course I needed to take.
examples.zh: 导师解释说，「不计学分的实习」不能顶替我需要修的那门课。

words.enDefinition: Not open to discussion or change

examples.en: The department said the weekday closing shift was non-negotiable because nobody else could cover it.
examples.zh: 部门说，平日打烊班没人能顶替，因此「不能协商」。

examples.en: I asked which parts of the written offer were non-negotiable before we discussed hours.
examples.zh: 谈工时之前，我问书面录用通知里哪些条款是「不可协商的」。

words.enDefinition: information or work that is not subject to confidentiality restrictions

examples.en: The studio told me which nonconfidential material I could include in my portfolio.
examples.zh: 工作室告诉我，哪些「非保密材料」可以放进我的作品集。

examples.en: I used nonconfidential material to explain my role without sharing the client's records.
examples.zh: 我用「非保密材料」说明自己做了什么，没有公开客户的记录。

words.enDefinition: a requirement about how well a system works or what constraints it must meet

examples.en: The interviewer asked for a nonfunctional requirement related to response time under heavy use.
examples.zh: 面试官要求给出一项关于高使用量下响应时间的「非功能需求」。

examples.en: I added a nonfunctional requirement about how long daily backups could take.
examples.zh: 我补充了一项「非功能需求」，规定每日备份最多可以用多长时间。

words.enDefinition: listeners who lack specialist knowledge of the subject being discussed

examples.en: I used an everyday example to explain my analysis to a nontechnical audience.
examples.zh: 我用了一个日常例子，给「无专业背景的听众」解释我的分析。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how I would describe the result for a nontechnical audience.
examples.zh: 面试官问，我会怎样面向「无专业背景的听众」介绍结果。

collocations: explain a concept to a nontechnical audience

words.enDefinition: Not chosen to proceed or receive the role

examples.en: The dashboard showed Not selected for the spring intake after the screening results came out.
examples.zh: 筛选结果出来后，申请总览显示我在春季招聘中「未获选」。

examples.en: I saw Not selected on one application, while the other one was still active.
examples.zh: 我看到一份申请显示「未获选」，另一份仍在处理中。

collocations: a candidate not selected for a role
mark an applicant as not selected

words.enDefinition: Currently open for people to submit applications

examples.en: The jobs page says “Now accepting applications” under the heading for weekend library roles.
examples.zh: 招聘页面在图书馆周末岗位的标题下写着「现已开始受理申请」。

examples.en: I saw “Now accepting applications” beside the vacancy I had been waiting to open.
examples.zh: 我在一直等着开放的职位旁看到「现已开始受理申请」。

collocations: now accepting applications for summer jobs

words.enDefinition: an assessment of how well someone uses and interprets numerical information

examples.en: The numerical reasoning test included a table comparing expenses across three university departments.
examples.zh: 「数值推理测验」里有一张比较大学三个部门开支的表格。

examples.en: I used the practice questions to learn the format of the numerical reasoning test.
examples.zh: 我做了练习题，熟悉「数值推理测验」的题型。

collocations: practise for a numerical reasoning test

words.enDefinition: extra hours that are only needed from time to time

examples.en: The role requires occasional overtime when visiting speakers stay late after a lecture.
examples.zh: 外来讲者讲完课后留到很晚时，这个岗位需要「偶尔加班」。

examples.en: I could manage occasional overtime as long as it didn't clash with my evening classes.
examples.zh: 只要不和夜课冲突，我可以接受「偶尔加班」。

words.enDefinition: work trips that take place only from time to time

examples.en: The research role includes occasional travel to schools where the team collects survey responses.
examples.zh: 这个研究岗位要「偶尔出差」，去团队收集问卷的学校。

examples.en: I asked how much notice I'd get for occasional travel once classes resumed.
examples.zh: 我问复课后需要「偶尔出差」时，会提前多久通知我。

words.enDefinition: Confirmation that required health checks for assigned work have been completed satisfactorily

examples.en: My placement coordinator asked whether the office had recorded my occupational health clearance.
examples.zh: 实习协调员问相关办公室是否已记录我「职业健康审核通过」。

examples.en: The hospital confirmed my occupational health clearance before sending instructions for my first day.
examples.zh: 医院确认我「职业健康审核通过」后，才发来实习第一天的安排。

words.enDefinition: Paid work outside a student's institution under applicable employment rules

examples.en: The student workshop discussed off-campus employment separately from jobs at the university.
examples.zh: 学生讲座把「校外就业」和学校里的工作分开讲解。

examples.en: I asked which part of the handbook explained off-campus employment during term.
examples.zh: 我问手册哪一部分介绍学期内的「校外就业」。

words.enDefinition: planned training separate from an apprentice's ordinary job duties

examples.en: My apprenticeship in England included off-the-job training through classes with a local college tutor.
examples.zh: 我在英格兰参加学徒项目时，跟本地学院的导师上课，接受「常规工作之外的培训」。

examples.en: The provider scheduled off-the-job training on Wednesday while another colleague covered my usual tasks.
examples.zh: 培训机构把「常规工作之外的培训」安排在周三，我平时的任务由另一位同事接手。

words.enDefinition: Requirements that must be met for the offer

examples.en: The portal listed the offer conditions at the top of the page in bold.
examples.zh: 门户把「录用前须满足的条件」用粗体列在页面顶部。

examples.en: I checked whether the offer conditions had changed after my references were sent.
examples.zh: 推荐材料发出后，我查看了「录用条件」是否有变化。

words.enDefinition: A letter formally stating the details of an offer

examples.en: The offer letter gave the expected start date and the name of my supervisor.
examples.zh: 「录用函」写明了预计到岗日期和我主管的姓名。

examples.en: I uploaded my signed offer letter to the same page where I'd applied.
examples.zh: 我把签好的「录用函」上传到当初申请岗位的那个页面。

words.enDefinition: An identifier for an offer entered in Canada's immigration Employer Portal

examples.en: The Canadian employer told me which line contained the offer of employment number.
examples.zh: 加拿大雇主告诉我哪一行写有「加拿大工作邀约编号」。

examples.en: I checked the spelling of my name beside the offer of employment number.
examples.zh: 我核对了「加拿大工作邀约编号」旁边我的姓名拼写。

collocations: provide an offer of employment number
confirm the offer of employment number
locate an offer of employment number

words.enDefinition: The employer is still accepting a response

examples.en: The message says the offer remains open until Monday, even though the office closes today.
examples.zh: 消息说，虽然办公室今天关门，这份「录用通知的有效期到周一」。

examples.en: Could you confirm whether the offer remains open while the start date is being discussed?
examples.zh: 在讨论到岗日期期间，能否确认这份「录用通知仍有效」？

collocations: the offer remains open until Friday
confirm that the offer remains open
the offer remains open for another week

words.enDefinition: Details setting out what an employer is offering

examples.en: I read the offer terms again after noticing the start date in the attachment.
examples.zh: 注意到附件里的到岗日期后，我又读了一遍「录用条款」。

examples.en: The revised offer terms listed a different work location from the one we first discussed.
examples.zh: 修订后的「录用条款」写的工作地点和我们最初谈的不一样。

words.enDefinition: An employer has taken back its offer

examples.en: The status changed to Offer withdrawn after the department cancelled the weekend position.
examples.zh: 部门取消周末岗位后，状态变成了「录用通知已撤回」。

examples.en: I saw Offer withdrawn in the portal and contacted the department to ask what happened.
examples.zh: 我在门户看到「录用通知已撤回」，就联系部门询问情况。

words.enDefinition: a period when someone must be ready to respond if needed

examples.en: The residence manager said an on-call shift meant keeping my phone close throughout the night.
examples.zh: 宿舍经理说，「待命班次」意味着整夜都得把手机放在身边。

examples.en: I can't take an on-call shift that evening because I'll be on a train.
examples.zh: 那天晚上我要坐火车，没法接「待命班次」。

words.enDefinition: Paid work at or connected with the institution someone attends

examples.en: The US adviser discussed on-campus employment using the student library as an example.
examples.zh: 美国的顾问以学生图书馆为例讲解了「校内就业」。

examples.en: I asked where the guide defined on-campus employment for international students.
examples.zh: 我问指南在哪里界定留学生的「校内就业」。

words.enDefinition: a job carried out at a specified workplace

examples.en: The gallery described it as an on-site role because most duties involve greeting visitors.
examples.zh: 美术馆把它列作「现场岗位」，因为主要工作是迎接到访者。

examples.en: An on-site role would be fine if I can cycle there between seminars.
examples.zh: 如果两节研讨课之间能骑车赶过去，「现场岗位」我也能接受。

words.enDefinition: a colleague assigned to help a new hire settle in and learn workplace routines

examples.en: My onboarding buddy showed me how the team booked study rooms for workshops.
examples.zh: 「入职带教伙伴」教我团队怎么为培训预约自习室。

examples.en: I asked my onboarding buddy which documents I should read before the first shift.
examples.zh: 我问「入职带教伙伴」，上第一班前应该先读哪些文件。

words.enDefinition: A collection of information and forms given to a new employee

examples.en: The onboarding packet included a map and a list of people to contact.
examples.zh: 「入职资料包」里有一张地图和一份联系人名单。

examples.en: I found the office hours on the first page of my onboarding packet.
examples.zh: 我在「入职资料包」的第一页找到了办公室开放时间。

words.enDefinition: Documents a new employee receives or completes when joining an organization

examples.en: My manager sent the onboarding paperwork after we agreed on my start date.
examples.zh: 我们确定入职日期后，经理发来了「入职手续文件」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could finish the onboarding paperwork before my first shift.
examples.zh: 我问能否在第一次上班前填完「入职手续文件」。

words.enDefinition: An interview involving one interviewer speaking with one candidate

examples.en: I had a one-on-one interview with the person who supervised the evening shift.
examples.zh: 我和负责晚班的主管进行了一场「一对一面试」。

examples.en: Our one-on-one interview covered the same topics we had discussed in the group session.
examples.zh: 这场「一对一面试」涉及我们在小组环节谈过的同样话题。

collocations: a one-on-one interview with a manager

words.enDefinition: A document presenting relevant education and work experience on one page

examples.en: The adviser helped me fit my summer work into a one-page resume.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我把暑期工作经历写进了「一页式简历」。

examples.en: I brought a one-page resume to each conversation at the careers fair.
examples.zh: 招聘会上，每次和人交谈时我都带了一份「一页式简历」。

words.enDefinition: a collection of work samples that people can view on the internet

examples.en: I updated my online portfolio with the signage project from my final semester.
examples.zh: 我把最后一学期做的导视项目补进了「在线作品集」。

examples.en: The recruiter opened my online portfolio while we talked about my photography work.
examples.zh: 我们聊到摄影作品时，招聘人员打开了我的「在线作品集」。

words.enDefinition: a question that has been raised but still needs an answer or decision

examples.en: Whether the desk should open on Sundays remained an open question after the meeting.
examples.zh: 柜台周日要不要开放，开完会仍是一个「尚待明确的问题」。

examples.en: I added an open question to the notes so we could return to it.
examples.zh: 我把一个「尚待明确的问题」记到会议记录里，方便之后再讨论。

words.expression: open to hearing about other roles
words.lemma: open to hearing about other roles
words.enDefinition: willing to receive information about different jobs
acceptedEnVariants: open to hearing about other roles

examples.en: I'm open to hearing about other roles if they fit around my placement days.
examples.zh: 如果和我的实习日不冲突，「我愿意了解其他岗位」。

examples.en: Are you open to hearing about other roles at the museum as they come up?
examples.zh: 博物馆有别的岗位时，「你愿意了解其他岗位吗」？

collocations: be open to hearing about other roles
remain open to hearing about other roles
still open to hearing about other roles

words.enDefinition: Willing to move somewhere else for a job

examples.en: I'm open to relocation after graduation, so I added two more cities to my search.
examples.zh: 毕业后我「愿意为工作搬迁」，所以把另外两座城市也纳入了搜索范围。

examples.en: I told my adviser I was open to relocation once my lease ended.
examples.zh: 我告诉顾问，租约结束后我「愿意为工作搬迁」。

collocations: open to relocation for the right role

words.enDefinition: Available for and interested in new employment

examples.en: The site lets me show that I'm open to work after my course finishes.
examples.zh: 这个网站可以让我标明，结课后我「会找工作」。

examples.en: I told a former colleague I was open to work from the start of July.
examples.zh: 我告诉一位前同事，从七月初开始我「愿意接受工作机会」。

collocations: show that you're open to work
let people know you're open to work
mark your profile as open to work

words.enDefinition: A Canadian permit generally allowing work without a specified employer

examples.en: The Canadian guide described which conditions could appear on an open work permit.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南介绍了「加拿大开放式工签」上可能有哪些限制条件。

examples.en: I asked how the open work permit was labeled on the sample document.
examples.zh: 我问文件样本上的「加拿大开放式工签」是怎么标注的。

collocations: apply for an open work permit
conditions on an open work permit

words.enDefinition: The first question used to start an interview or discussion

examples.en: The opening question was about how I became interested in the museum sector.
examples.zh: 「开场问题」问的是我怎么对博物馆行业产生兴趣的。

examples.en: I gave a short answer to the opening question before we discussed my experience.
examples.zh: 我们谈我的经历之前，我简短回答了「开场问题」。

words.enDefinition: the first sentence of a letter or other written text

examples.en: The opening sentence names the role and says where I saw the advertisement.
examples.zh: 「开头第一句」写了岗位名称，也交代了我从哪里看到招聘广告。

examples.en: I rewrote the opening sentence after my adviser noticed the job title was missing.
examples.zh: 顾问发现我没有写岗位名称后，我重写了「开头第一句」。

words.enDefinition: the first slide in a presentation, used to introduce the topic or speaker

examples.en: My opening slide had one photograph and the title of the campus project.
examples.zh: 我的「开场幻灯片」放了一张照片和校园项目的标题。

examples.en: I changed the opening slide after realizing the audience already knew the venue.
examples.zh: 发现听众已经熟悉这个场地后，我改了「开场幻灯片」。

words.enDefinition: chances to move into roles with more responsibility

examples.en: The listing mentioned opportunities for advancement from weekend assistant to a role with supervisory duties.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到有「晋升机会」，可从周末助理升到带人的岗位。

examples.en: I asked about opportunities for advancement because I'd like to stay after graduation.
examples.zh: 我想毕业后继续做，所以问了有没有「晋升机会」。

words.expression: opt in to a talent pool
words.lemma: opt in to a talent pool
words.enDefinition: To agree to be considered for future openings
acceptedEnVariants: opt in to a talent pool

examples.en: The final page asked whether I wanted to opt in to a talent pool.
examples.zh: 最后一页询问我是否想「主动加入人才库」。

examples.en: Did you opt in to a talent pool when you applied to the university?
examples.zh: 申请学校的岗位时，你有没有「主动选择加入人才库」？

collocations: choose to opt in to a talent pool
invite applicants to opt in to a talent pool
decline to opt in to a talent pool

words.zhGloss: 主动放弃参加福利计划
words.enDefinition: To choose not to receive offered benefits
acceptedZhAnswers: 主动放弃参加福利计划

examples.en: The portal showed where to opt out of benefits before I confirmed my choices.
examples.zh: 门户显示了确认选项之前可以在哪儿「主动放弃参加福利计划」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could opt out of benefits I already had through another plan.
examples.zh: 我问，其他计划已经为我提供的福利，能不能在这里「选择不参加」。

collocations: choose to opt out of benefits
be allowed to opt out of benefits
a form to opt out of benefits

words.enDefinition: to change a solution so it uses less time, memory or other resources

examples.en: I explained how I would optimize a solution if the input list became much longer.
examples.zh: 我解释了如果输入列表长很多，我会怎样「优化解法」。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to optimize a solution that already produced the right results.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们「优化解法」，这套解法已经能算出正确结果。

collocations: optimize a solution for memory use
look for ways to optimize a solution

words.enDefinition: A form field that may be left empty

examples.en: The form has an optional field for names used in previous jobs or courses.
examples.zh: 表单有个填写以往工作或上课时使用的姓名的「选填项」。

examples.en: I left the optional field for a second phone number blank and continued.
examples.zh: 我把第二个电话号码的「选填项」留空，然后继续填写。

words.enDefinition: US employment authorization for F-1 students to gain degree-related practical experience

examples.en: The US workshop explained how Optional Practical Training relates to a student's major.
examples.zh: 美国这场讲座解释了「美国专业实践许可」与学生所学专业的关系。

examples.en: I asked where Optional Practical Training appeared on the paperwork that my adviser sent.
examples.zh: 我问顾问发来的文件里哪里写着「美国专业实践许可」。

words.enDefinition: To arrange an event or campaign that raises money

examples.en: My CV describes how I helped organize a fundraiser for a local shelter.
examples.zh: 我的简历介绍了我怎样协助为当地一家收容机构「组织筹款活动」。

examples.en: We worked with two clubs to organize a fundraiser during the spring term.
examples.zh: 春季学期，我们和两个社团合作「组织筹款活动」。

words.enDefinition: additional tasks that a supervisor may assign as needed

examples.en: The listing says other duties as assigned, so I asked what else staff help with.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着「另有交办事项」，所以我问员工通常还要帮忙做什么。

examples.en: The phrase other duties as assigned appeared just after the list of regular tasks.
examples.zh: 常规任务清单后面紧跟着「另有交办事项」几个字。

collocations: a section on other duties as assigned

words.enDefinition: an automatic email sent when somebody is away from work

examples.en: The recruiter had an out-of-office reply asking people to contact a colleague about scheduling.
examples.zh: 招聘人员设了「不在岗自动回复」，说时间安排方面的问题请联系同事。

examples.en: I checked the return date in the out-of-office reply before sending a second message.
examples.zh: 我先在「不在岗自动回复」里看了一眼对方哪天回来，才发第二封邮件。

words.enDefinition: To briefly state the work that needed to be done

examples.en: I used one sentence to outline the task before explaining my choice of tool.
examples.zh: 我用一句话「概述任务」，再解释为什么选了那个工具。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to outline the task without listing every small detail.
examples.zh: 顾问让我「概述任务」，用不着列出每个小细节。

collocations: outline the task for the team

words.enDefinition: the required structure or presentation of a program's result

examples.en: The output format required one answer per line with no extra explanatory text.
examples.zh: 「输出格式」要求每行一个答案，不能加额外说明文字。

examples.en: I changed the spacing to match the output format in the sample.
examples.zh: 我调整了空格，以符合样例里的「输出格式」。

words.enDefinition: a task that has been assigned or planned but still needs to be done

examples.en: The supervisor gave me one outstanding task to complete before the office closed.
examples.zh: 办公室关门前，主管交给我一项「未完成的任务」。

examples.en: I moved each outstanding task onto the new list before leaving for the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末离开前，我把每项「未完成的任务」移进了新清单。

words.enDefinition: work travel that involves staying away overnight

examples.en: The role involves overnight travel twice a term to help run events at other campuses.
examples.zh: 这个岗位每学期有两次「需过夜的出差」，去其他校区协助办活动。

examples.en: I asked how much overnight travel was involved before committing to a full class schedule.
examples.zh: 把一学期的课排满之前，我问了工作有多少次「需过夜的出差」。

words.enDefinition: A marker forcing content to begin on a new page

examples.en: An unexpected page break left my project title at the bottom of the first page.
examples.zh: 一个没留意的「分页符」把我的项目标题留在了第一页底部。

examples.en: I moved the page break to keep the entire project entry together.
examples.zh: 我移动了「分页符」，让整条项目经历留在同一页。

words.enDefinition: The blank space between text and an edge of a page

examples.en: A wider page margin left room for notes during our resume workshop.
examples.zh: 更宽的「页边距」让我们在简历讲座上有地方记笔记。

examples.en: I checked the page margin because some letters looked too close to the edge.
examples.zh: 有些字母看起来离纸张边缘太近，我就检查了「页边距」。

words.enDefinition: short periods off during a shift that still count as paid time

examples.en: The role description says paid breaks are included in the hours shown on the schedule.
examples.zh: 岗位说明写着，排班表上的工时包含「带薪休息时间」。

examples.en: I asked about paid breaks because some shifts would last through the whole afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问了有没有「带薪休息时间」，因为有些班要上整个下午。

words.enDefinition: work experience for which the intern receives pay

examples.en: I picked a paid internship because I would need to cover my own travel costs.
examples.zh: 我选了「有薪实习」，因为得自己负担路费。

examples.en: The museum offers a paid internship for students helping with its summer exhibitions.
examples.zh: 博物馆提供「有薪实习」，招学生帮忙做夏季展览。

collocations: a paid internship at a museum

words.enDefinition: Approved time away from work with pay

examples.en: I checked which kinds of paid leave were listed for people working weekends.
examples.zh: 我查了给周末上班的人列出了哪些「带薪休假」。

examples.en: The manager pointed me to the page about paid leave before I accepted the offer.
examples.zh: 我接受录用通知之前，经理让我看介绍「带薪休假」的页面。

words.enDefinition: Paid time off to care for a new child

examples.en: The offer's benefits sheet listed paid parental leave alongside the other kinds of leave.
examples.zh: 录用福利说明把「带薪育儿假」与其他休假类型列在一起。

examples.en: I asked where to find the details about paid parental leave in the handbook.
examples.zh: 我问手册里哪里可以找到「带薪育儿假」的详细说明。

words.enDefinition: Official public holidays for which an employee receives pay

examples.en: The museum's benefits summary listed paid public holidays in a separate column from annual leave.
examples.zh: 博物馆的福利概览把「带薪公共假日」和年假分列在不同栏里。

examples.en: I asked which dates counted as paid public holidays at the branch I'd be joining.
examples.zh: 我问，我即将入职的分馆把哪些日期算作「带薪公共假日」。

collocations: a list of paid public holidays

words.enDefinition: A break during which a worker continues to be paid

examples.en: I checked whether my afternoon shift included a paid rest break in the middle.
examples.zh: 我查了下午班中间有没有「带薪休息时段」。

examples.en: The working hours table listed a paid rest break separately from the lunch break.
examples.zh: 工时表把「带薪休息时段」和午休分开列了。

words.enDefinition: Approved time away from work with pay during illness

examples.en: I read the section on paid sick leave before accepting the university's offer.
examples.zh: 接受学校的录用通知前，我读了「带薪病假」这一栏。

examples.en: The manager said that the offer summary explained paid sick leave for weekend staff.
examples.zh: 经理说，录用摘要说明了周末员工的「带薪病假」。

words.enDefinition: instruction for a job during time for which you are paid

examples.en: The campus shop offers paid training before new staff start working at the till.
examples.zh: 新员工开始做收银之前，学校商店提供「带薪培训」。

examples.en: I checked the dates of the paid training because I had two exams that week.
examples.zh: 我查了「带薪培训」的日期，因为那一周有两场考试。

words.enDefinition: A paid day away from work for volunteering

examples.en: The library offered a paid volunteer day to staff who helped at local events.
examples.zh: 图书馆给协助本地活动的员工提供一个「带薪志愿服务日」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could book a paid volunteer day for the campus food drive.
examples.zh: 我问能不能申请一个「带薪志愿服务日」，去帮忙做校园食品募捐。

words.enDefinition: a coding interview in which the candidate and another person work together on a task

examples.en: The pair programming interview felt like working through a small lab exercise together.
examples.zh: 「结对编程面试」感觉像两个人一起做一项小型实验练习。

examples.en: I asked how we would take turns coding during next week's pair programming interview.
examples.zh: 我问下周的「结对编程面试」将怎样轮流写代码。

collocations: prepare for a pair programming interview

words.enDefinition: An interview where several people question one candidate together

examples.en: The panel interview included two supervisors and someone from the training team.
examples.zh: 这场「多面试官面试」有两位主管和一位培训团队成员参加。

examples.en: During the panel interview, one person asked questions while the others took notes.
examples.zh: 在「多面试官面试」中，一人提问，其他人记笔记。

words.enDefinition: One person who sits on a group assessing candidates

examples.en: A second panel member asked how I handled competing requests at the library.
examples.zh: 另一位「面试小组成员」问我在图书馆如何处理互相冲突的请求。

examples.en: One panel member wanted to hear from me about the exhibition project.
examples.zh: 一位「面试小组成员」希望听我讲讲那个展览项目。

words.enDefinition: An application filled in and delivered on paper

examples.en: The library accepted a paper application when the online form was down that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午在线表单不能用，图书馆就收了「纸质申请」。

examples.en: I picked up a paper application at the front desk before my evening class.
examples.zh: 晚课前，我在前台领了一份「纸质申请」。

words.enDefinition: a topic set aside during a meeting so it can be addressed later

examples.en: The chair noted the equipment request as a parking lot item for next week.
examples.zh: 主持人把设备申请列为「暂缓讨论的议题」，留到下周。

examples.en: We returned to the parking lot item when the urgent decisions were finished.
examples.zh: 紧急决定都做完后，我们回头讨论了那个「暂缓讨论的议题」。

collocations: return to a parking lot item

words.enDefinition: a job with fewer hours than a full-time one

examples.en: I saw a part-time position at the campus café that fits around my Tuesday lectures.
examples.zh: 我看到学校咖啡馆在招「兼职岗位」，工作时间和周二的课不冲突。

examples.en: The arts centre offered a part-time position for two afternoons and one evening each week.
examples.zh: 艺术中心提供了一个「兼职岗位」，每周上两个下午和一个晚上的班。

words.enDefinition: to meet the requirements checked by every test in a given set

examples.en: The platform reports whether you pass all tests before showing the final score.
examples.zh: 平台先显示是否「通过所有测试」，再给出最终得分。

examples.en: I had to fix the output spacing before the program could pass all tests.
examples.zh: 我得先修正输出里的空格，程序才能「通过所有测试」。

collocations: check that changes pass all tests

words.enDefinition: a collection of work that viewers can open only with the correct password

examples.en: I sent a password-protected portfolio because one page was approved only for private review.
examples.zh: 由于有一页只批准私下审阅，我发送了「密码保护的作品集」。

examples.en: The recruiter asked how long the password-protected portfolio would stay available to them.
examples.zh: 招聘人员问，他们能访问这份「密码保护的作品集」多久。

collocations: a link to a password-protected portfolio

words.enDefinition: A grammatical form used to describe actions or states before now

examples.en: I rewrote the summer job entry in the past tense after leaving the role.
examples.zh: 暑期工作结束后，我把那段经历改用了「过去时」。

examples.en: The first bullet uses the past tense because I finished the project in May.
examples.zh: 第一条要点使用「过去时」，因为我在五月就完成了项目。

words.enDefinition: To wait briefly before beginning a response to a question

examples.en: I practiced how to pause before answering rather than filling the silence with words.
examples.zh: 我练习怎样「回答前停顿一下」，不要为了填补空白就随口说话。

examples.en: The interviewer told our group it was fine to pause before answering.
examples.zh: 面试官告诉我们小组，「回答前停顿一下」也没关系。

collocations: pause before answering a difficult question

words.enDefinition: A defined range of pay for certain roles

examples.en: The library listed one pay band for assistants and another for senior assistants.
examples.zh: 图书馆为助理和高级助理分别列了不同的「薪酬档位区间」。

examples.en: I wanted to know how the starting salary fit within the pay band shown.
examples.zh: 我想知道起薪在所列「薪酬档位区间」里处于什么位置。

collocations: the top of a pay band

words.enDefinition: Money available for paying staff

examples.en: The manager said the pay budget would need approval before she could change the offer.
examples.zh: 经理说，要调整录用内容，得先批准「薪酬预算」。

examples.en: The department's pay budget allowed for a slightly higher starting salary than I'd expected.
examples.zh: 系里的「薪酬预算」允许给出比我预期略高的起薪。

words.enDefinition: A designated level in an employer's pay structure

examples.en: The university assigned one pay grade to all the roles at that level.
examples.zh: 学校把那个层级的所有职位划在同一个「薪酬级别」。

examples.en: I asked where I could find the rates listed for the pay grade in the letter.
examples.zh: 我问到哪里可以查信中那个「薪酬级别」对应的薪资标准。

collocations: roles in the same pay grade

words.enDefinition: Movement to higher levels within a pay structure

examples.en: The staff handbook explained pay progression for employees who moved up the pay scale.
examples.zh: 员工手册说明了员工如何沿薪酬等级「晋档」。

examples.en: I asked how pay progression worked for people on part-time schedules at the library.
examples.zh: 我问图书馆兼职员工的「薪酬晋档」是怎么安排的。

words.enDefinition: A formal look at whether pay should change

examples.en: I asked when my first pay review would be after finishing the summer term.
examples.zh: 我问暑期学期结束后，什么时候会进行第一次「薪酬复核」。

examples.en: The offer letter mentioned a pay review after the first six months of work.
examples.zh: 录用函提到，入职满六个月后会进行一次「薪酬复核」。

words.enDefinition: A specific rate within a defined pay grade

examples.en: The offer listed my pay step underneath the grade for the library assistant role.
examples.zh: 录用通知在图书馆助理职位的薪级下方列了我的「薪点」。

examples.en: I asked which pay step would apply if the university counted my previous experience.
examples.zh: 我问学校如果认可我之前的经验，会适用哪个「薪点」。

collocations: move to the next pay step
place someone on a pay step
start at the first pay step

words.enDefinition: a collection of work samples saved as a PDF document

examples.en: My PDF portfolio contains four pages of project images and a short biography.
examples.zh: 我的「PDF格式作品集」包含四页项目图片和一段个人简介。

examples.en: The agency asked me to send a PDF portfolio instead of printing the pages.
examples.zh: 机构让我发一份「PDF格式作品集」，不用把页面打印出来。

words.enDefinition: A copy of a document saved in Portable Document Format

examples.en: The PDF version kept the layout I had checked on my laptop.
examples.zh: 「PDF版」保留了我在笔记本电脑上检查过的版式。

examples.en: I opened the PDF version to check every heading and email link.
examples.zh: 我打开「PDF版」，检查每个栏目标题和邮箱链接。

words.enDefinition: learning through exchanging knowledge or practising with people at a similar level

examples.en: We used peer learning to compare how different branches kept track of their bookings.
examples.zh: 我们通过「同伴互学」，比较不同分部如何记录预订。

examples.en: The program set aside an afternoon for peer learning before we began our second rotation.
examples.zh: 第二轮轮岗开始前，项目安排了一个下午做「同伴互学」。

words.enDefinition: public or private appreciation from people who work alongside someone

examples.en: The team channel has a space for peer recognition after a busy shift.
examples.zh: 团队频道里有地方可以在忙完一个班次后表达「同事间的认可」。

examples.en: The supervisor encouraged peer recognition when someone helped outside their usual role.
examples.zh: 有人主动帮忙做本职之外的工作时，主管鼓励大家表达「同事间的认可」。

words.enDefinition: A published work evaluated by experts before it was accepted

examples.en: My first peer-reviewed publication came out after several months of revisions with my supervisor.
examples.zh: 我和导师修改了几个月，第一篇「同行评审出版物」终于发表了。

examples.en: The peer-reviewed publication was listed under articles rather than under conference presentations.
examples.zh: 这篇「同行评审出版物」列在文章栏，没列在会议报告栏。

collocations: a peer-reviewed publication in a journal

words.enDefinition: While checks on an applicant are still outstanding

examples.en: The letter said my offer was still pending background checks before the start date.
examples.zh: 信上说，我的录用还要「等待背景核查完成」，才能按计划到岗。

examples.en: The offer remained pending background checks when I opened the portal again on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一再打开门户时，录用状态仍显示「等待背景核查完成」。

words.enDefinition: a choice expected to be made but not yet settled

examples.en: The pending decision about opening hours was mentioned in the shift notes.
examples.zh: 交班记录提到了关于开放时间「尚待作出的决定」。

examples.en: I asked who was responsible for the pending decision before booking the room.
examples.zh: 预订房间前，我问谁负责那项「尚待作出的决定」。

collocations: a pending decision on the schedule

words.enDefinition: A scheme providing income after retirement

examples.en: The offer summary linked to a page about the university's pension plan for staff.
examples.zh: 录用摘要附了一个页面链接，介绍学校教职工的「养老金计划」。

examples.en: I asked whether the pension plan listed in my letter was also for part-time staff.
examples.zh: 我问信中列出的「养老金计划」是否也适用于兼职员工。

words.enDefinition: The amount of growth expressed relative to the original value

examples.en: My bullet included the percentage increase in attendance after we moved the meeting online.
examples.zh: 我在要点里写了会议改到线上后，出席人数的「百分比增幅」。

examples.en: I checked the percentage increase against our registration records before adding it to my CV.
examples.zh: 写进简历前，我拿报名记录核对了「百分比增幅」。

words.enDefinition: extra pay based on how well someone does their job

examples.en: The advert mentions a performance bonus but doesn't say how success is measured.
examples.zh: 招聘启事说有「绩效奖金」，但没写表现怎么评估。

examples.en: I asked whether part-time staff could also earn a performance bonus at the end of term.
examples.zh: 我问兼职人员期末是否也能拿到「绩效奖金」。

words.enDefinition: a brief meeting to review someone's recent work and discuss any needed support

examples.en: My performance check-in focused on how confidently I handled difficult requests at the desk.
examples.zh: 我的「工作表现简谈」主要聊了我处理柜台棘手请求时发挥得怎么样。

examples.en: The manager moved my performance check-in to the first week of the new term.
examples.zh: 经理把「工作表现简谈」改到了新学期第一周。

words.enDefinition: a job offered without a set end date

examples.en: The museum listed one permanent position and two temporary jobs for summer visitors.
examples.zh: 博物馆发布了一个「长期岗位」，还有两个为夏季游客提供服务的临时岗位。

examples.en: I'm looking for a permanent position because my current contract ends next month.
examples.zh: 我在找「长期岗位」，因为现在的合同下个月就到期。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement assigning someone to an ongoing team after temporary rotations

examples.en: We discussed my permanent team assignment after I finished the last of my rotations.
examples.zh: 我完成最后一轮轮岗后，我们讨论了「轮岗后的定岗」。
