examples.en: The coordinator confirmed my permanent team assignment before I made plans to move closer.
examples.zh: 我打算搬近一点之前，协调员确认了我「轮岗后定岗」的团队。

words.enDefinition: authorization to give specified information or work to other people

examples.en: I obtained permission to share the illustrations before putting them on my website.
examples.zh: 把插图放上网站前，我取得了「分享许可」。

examples.en: The producer gave me permission to share only the original trailer from the project.
examples.zh: 制片人给了我「分享许可」，范围仅限该项目的原版预告片。

collocations: get permission to share the work

words.enDefinition: a document listing the qualities and qualifications needed for a role

examples.en: The UK charity attached a person specification listing the skills it expected applicants to have.
examples.zh: 这家英国慈善机构附了份「任职条件说明」，列出对申请人技能的要求。

examples.en: I printed the person specification and marked the requirements that were unclear to me.
examples.zh: 我打印了「任职条件说明」，标记了自己没弄懂的要求。

words.enDefinition: A day off for personal matters

examples.en: I asked whether a personal day could cover an appointment that conflicted with my shift.
examples.zh: 我问能不能用一天「个人事务假」去赴一个和班次冲突的预约。

examples.en: The benefits guide explained how to request a personal day through the staff portal.
examples.zh: 福利指南解释了怎样通过员工门户申请「个人事务假」。

words.enDefinition: The part of a form asking for personal details

examples.en: The personal information section was already filled in from my previous application at the university.
examples.zh: 「个人信息栏」已自动填入我上次申请这所学校岗位时提供的信息。

examples.en: I checked the personal information section and corrected a typo in my street name.
examples.zh: 我检查了「个人信息栏」，改正了街道名里的一个错字。

collocations: details in the personal information section

words.enDefinition: a project someone does for their own goals or interests independently of assigned work

examples.en: The first page features a personal project I completed during the summer break.
examples.zh: 第一页重点展示了我暑假完成的一个「个人项目」。

examples.en: I chose a personal project to show work outside my university course requirements.
examples.zh: 我选了一个「个人项目」，展示大学课程要求之外的作品。

words.enDefinition: A record containing employment documents and information about an individual worker

examples.en: The coordinator asked whether my training certificate belonged in my personnel file.
examples.zh: 协调员问我的培训证书是否应该放进「员工档案」。

examples.en: I checked that the date on my personnel file matched my contract.
examples.zh: 我核对了「员工档案」里的日期是否和合同一致。

collocations: add documents to a personnel file

words.enDefinition: An identifying number assigned to a worker within an organization

examples.en: The administrator asked for my personnel number when I picked up my badge.
examples.zh: 我领取工牌时，行政人员问了我的「员工工号」。

examples.en: My personnel number appeared beneath my name in the staff directory.
examples.zh: 员工名录上，我的「员工工号」显示在姓名下面。

words.enDefinition: the physical effort or activity a job involves

examples.en: The physical demands are listed separately from the training required for the theatre role.
examples.zh: 剧院岗位把「体力要求」和必需的培训分开列出。

examples.en: I asked about the physical demands before applying for the summer warehouse position.
examples.zh: 申请暑期仓库岗位前，我先问了有什么「体力要求」。

collocations: the physical demands of the role

words.enDefinition: To ask someone for their knowledge or advice

examples.en: Can I pick your brain about jobs in museums before I choose my final modules?
examples.zh: 选最后几门课之前，我能「向你请教」一下博物馆工作的情况吗？

examples.en: Could we pick your brain about how you got your first job in publishing?
examples.zh: 能不能「向你请教」一下，你是怎么找到第一份出版工作的？

collocations: pick someone's brain about a field
get a chance to pick someone's brain

words.enDefinition: to begin working on a task available for someone to take

examples.en: I offered to pick up a task that was left after the morning meeting.
examples.zh: 上午开完会还有一个任务没人接，我主动提出「接手一项任务」。

examples.en: At the start of the shift, each volunteer can pick up a task.
examples.zh: 每个志愿者上班时都可以「接手一项任务」。

collocations: offer to pick up a task
pick up a task from the list
available to pick up a task

words.enDefinition: To notice a signal suggesting what someone wants or means

examples.en: I learned to pick up on a cue that the panel wanted a shorter answer.
examples.zh: 我学会了「察觉到提示」，明白面试小组希望回答简短一点。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how to pick up on a cue without interrupting the person speaking.
examples.zh: 导师示范了怎样在不打断讲话者的情况下「察觉到提示」。

collocations: pick up on a cue from the interviewer
quickly pick up on a cue
learn to pick up on a cue

words.enDefinition: An agreement recording responsibilities and terms for a work placement

examples.en: My department checked the hours listed in the placement agreement before orientation.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会前，我的院系核对了「实习安排协议」里的时数。

examples.en: The placement agreement named my supervisor at the host organization.
examples.zh: 「实习安排协议」写明了我在实习接收机构的主管姓名。

words.enDefinition: the specific placement assigned to a student

examples.en: I checked my placement allocation and found that the site was on a direct bus route.
examples.zh: 我查了「实习分配结果」，发现有公交直达实习地点。

examples.en: The placement allocation sent on Friday listed the host and the name of my supervisor.
examples.zh: 周五发来的「实习分配结果」列出了接收单位和带教老师的名字。

words.enDefinition: the standards used to judge a student's performance on placement

examples.en: We discussed the placement assessment criteria before my supervisor watched me present the project.
examples.zh: 带教老师看我的项目汇报之前，我们讨论了「实习评估标准」。

examples.en: The placement assessment criteria included how clearly we recorded decisions in our weekly notes.
examples.zh: 「实习评估标准」包括能否在每周记录里把作过的决定写清楚。

words.enDefinition: a period set aside for a continuous run of placement days

examples.en: The summer placement block runs for four weeks without any classes scheduled on campus.
examples.zh: 暑期的「连续实习时段」为四周，期间学校没有排课。

examples.en: I found short-term accommodation near the school for the duration of my placement block.
examples.zh: 我在那所学校附近找了个短期住处，打算住完整个「连续实习时段」。

words.enDefinition: financial support provided to help a student cover placement costs

examples.en: I applied for a placement bursary to help cover longer train journeys that semester.
examples.zh: 我申请了「实习专项补助」，用来补贴那学期较远的火车通勤开支。

examples.en: The university told me when the placement bursary would be paid for the summer block.
examples.zh: 学校告诉我暑期连续实习期间的「实习专项补助」什么时候发。

words.enDefinition: the number of students a site can support on placement

examples.en: The hospital checked its placement capacity before agreeing to take another group of students.
examples.zh: 医院先确认了「可接收的实习人数」，才答应再接收一批学生。

examples.en: The museum's placement capacity went up once a second supervisor joined the team.
examples.zh: 第二名带教老师加入后，博物馆「可接收的实习人数」增加了。

words.enDefinition: A letter confirming the arrangement and details of a placement

examples.en: The faculty asked for a placement confirmation letter before recording my placement dates.
examples.zh: 院系请我提供「实习确认信」，然后才能记录实习日期。

examples.en: I checked whether my supervisor was named on the placement confirmation letter.
examples.zh: 我核对了「实习确认信」上有没有写主管的名字。

collocations: a copy of the placement confirmation letter

words.enDefinition: the person who arranges and coordinates training placements

examples.en: The placement coordinator helped me compare two sites with very different commuting times.
examples.zh: 「实习协调员」帮我比较了两家通勤时间差很多的实习单位。

examples.en: I told the placement coordinator when my seminar moved to our usual placement day.
examples.zh: 研讨课改到平时实习那天后，我告诉了「实习协调员」。

words.enDefinition: the days on which a placement starts and ends

examples.en: I compared my placement dates with the exam timetable before signing the department's form.
examples.zh: 签院系的表格前，我对照了「实习起止日期」和考试时间表。

examples.en: The host asked whether our placement dates could shift by a week in June.
examples.zh: 接收单位问，我们在六月的「实习起止日期」能不能挪一周。

words.enDefinition: costs someone incurs while taking part in a placement

examples.en: My placement expenses increased when the training site moved farther away from campus.
examples.zh: 实习地点搬到离学校更远的地方后，我的「实习开支」增加了。

examples.en: I saved the train receipts because the course office wanted a record of placement expenses.
examples.zh: 课程办公室要「实习开支」的记录，所以我留了火车票收据。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that lets a placement continue beyond its original end date

examples.en: I requested a placement extension so I could finish cataloging the last set of photographs.
examples.zh: 我申请「延长实习期」，好编完最后一组照片的目录。

examples.en: The course office confirmed my placement extension before I booked the return train.
examples.zh: 我订回程火车票前，课程办公室确认了我可以「延长实习期」。

words.enDefinition: comments on how a student is doing during a placement

examples.en: The placement feedback helped me make my notes easier for other team members to read.
examples.zh: 「实习反馈」帮我把笔记改得更容易让团队其他成员读懂。

examples.en: I asked for placement feedback early so I could change my approach before the project ended.
examples.zh: 我早点问了「实习反馈」，好在项目结束前调整自己的做法。

words.enDefinition: a guide to how a course or program runs placements

examples.en: I consulted the placement handbook when I couldn't remember who would mark the report.
examples.zh: 我记不清谁会给报告评分，就查了「实习手册」。

examples.en: The placement handbook had a checklist for students who were changing their training site.
examples.zh: 「实习手册」里有一张清单，供更换实习地点的同学使用。

words.enDefinition: a record of the time a student spends on placement

examples.en: I updated the placement hours log after each visit instead of waiting until Friday.
examples.zh: 我每次实习结束后都更新「实习工时记录表」，不等到周五。

examples.en: The tutor used my placement hours log to check which days I'd been there.
examples.zh: 导师用我的「实习工时记录表」核对我在哪几天到岗。

words.enDefinition: Specific skills or knowledge a student aims to gain during placement

examples.en: My supervisor and I reviewed the placement learning objectives during our first meeting.
examples.zh: 我和主管在第一次见面时一起核对了「实习学习目标」。

examples.en: The university asked us to attach placement learning objectives to the agreement.
examples.zh: 学校请我们把「实习学习目标」附在协议后面。

words.enDefinition: the process of matching students to suitable host organizations

examples.en: The placement matching process took my interests and the bus routes into account.
examples.zh: 「实习匹配」过程考虑了我的兴趣和公交线路。

examples.en: We supplied our preferred dates before the placement matching started for the summer period.
examples.zh: 暑期「实习匹配」开始前，我们提交了自己更希望实习的日期。

words.enDefinition: a student's preferred site or type of placement

examples.en: My placement preference was a small museum where I could work with collection records.
examples.zh: 我的「实习志愿」是一家小博物馆，能做馆藏记录方面的工作。

examples.en: I changed my placement preference after finding out how early the trains started running.
examples.zh: 弄清最早几点有火车后，我调整了「实习志愿」。

words.enDefinition: a written account of what a student did and learned on placement

examples.en: I explained how the exhibition changed over the summer in my placement report.
examples.zh: 我在「实习报告」里说明了展览在暑期是怎么调整的。

examples.en: The tutor read my placement report before asking what I would do differently next time.
examples.zh: 导师先读了我的「实习报告」，再问我下次会有哪些不同做法。

words.enDefinition: a schedule listing the shifts a student will work during placement

examples.en: During my placement at a UK hospital, I checked the placement rota before arranging travel.
examples.zh: 在英国一家医院实习时，我先查了「实习轮班表」，再安排出行。

examples.en: The placement rota changed when two students needed to attend a seminar on Friday.
examples.zh: 两名学生周五要参加研讨课，所以「实习轮班表」调整了。

words.enDefinition: the agreed limits of the student's activities during a placement

examples.en: I asked my supervisor to clarify the placement scope before I agreed to extra tasks.
examples.zh: 答应做额外任务前，我请带教老师明确「实习工作范围」。

examples.en: The placement scope covered maintaining the exhibition records and helping with scheduled public events.
examples.zh: 「实习工作范围」包括维护展览记录和协助已安排的公众活动。

words.enDefinition: the specific workplace where a placement takes place

examples.en: I visited my placement site on the weekend to make sure I knew the route.
examples.zh: 我周末去了一趟「实习地点」，确认自己认得路。

examples.en: The placement site changed halfway through the month, but my supervisor stayed the same.
examples.zh: 月中「实习地点」换了，不过带教老师没换。

words.enDefinition: a student working at an organization as part of a course

examples.en: I worked as a placement student at a UK gallery during my second year.
examples.zh: 第二学年，我以「校方课程实习生」的身份在英国一家美术馆工作。

examples.en: The placement student went back to university after finishing the project with our team.
examples.zh: 这位「校方课程实习生」和我们团队一起完成项目后就返校了。

words.enDefinition: the person overseeing a student's day-to-day work on placement

examples.en: My placement supervisor checked my progress each Friday and suggested a task for the following week.
examples.zh: 「实习带教人员」每周五检查我的进展，并建议下周做一项什么任务。

examples.en: I asked my placement supervisor whether I could sit in on the team's planning meeting.
examples.zh: 我问「实习带教人员」自己能不能旁听团队的计划会议。

words.enDefinition: an available place for a student to train

examples.en: I asked about a placement vacancy at the theatre after another student changed courses.
examples.zh: 另一名同学换了课后，我询问了剧院的「实习空缺」。

examples.en: The course coordinator emailed us about a placement vacancy that had opened up near campus.
examples.zh: 课程协调员发邮件告诉我们，学校附近有个「实习空缺」。

words.zhGloss: 校方导师到实习点探访
words.enDefinition: a visit by a course tutor to check how a placement is going
acceptedZhAnswers: 校方导师到实习点探访

examples.en: My school tutor arranged a placement visit to meet the team at the archive.
examples.zh: 学校导师安排了「到实习点探访」，和档案馆的团队见面。

examples.en: The tutor asked what I wanted to discuss during the placement visit on Thursday.
examples.zh: 学校导师问我，周四「到实习点探访」时我想讨论些什么。

words.enDefinition: a year of workplace experience within a university course

examples.en: At my UK university, I took a placement year between my second and final years.
examples.zh: 我在英国那所大学读书时，第二学年和最后一学年之间是「实习年」。

examples.en: After my placement year with an engineering firm, I chose a different final project topic.
examples.zh: 在工程公司度过「实习年」后，我给毕业项目换了个题目。

words.enDefinition: Clear writing that avoids unnecessary technical or complicated wording

examples.en: I rewrote my fieldwork entry in plain language for readers outside my department.
examples.zh: 我用「通俗表达」重写了田野调查经历，方便院系外的读者理解。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to describe the software in plain language.
examples.zh: 顾问让我用「通俗表达」描述那款软件。

words.enDefinition: a short explanation using accessible words and phrasing for readers without specialist knowledge

examples.en: My portfolio starts with a plain-language summary of the research question and the findings.
examples.zh: 我的作品集先用一份「通俗摘要」介绍研究问题和结果。

examples.en: I wrote a plain-language summary so applicants from outside the lab could follow it.
examples.zh: 我写了份「通俗摘要」，让实验室以外的申请人也能看懂。

words.enDefinition: asks the recipient to ignore the most recent email

examples.en: Please disregard my last email because the first time I suggested is no longer available.
examples.zh: 「请忽略我上一封邮件」，我最早提的那个时间现在没空了。

examples.en: Please disregard my last email and use the revised room number in this message.
examples.zh: 「请忽略我上一封邮件」，房间号以这封邮件里的新版为准。

collocations: please disregard my last email about Friday
please disregard my last email on this thread
please disregard my last email and use this one

words.enDefinition: a formal phrase introducing the document attached to an email or letter

examples.en: Please find attached my cover letter and two writing samples for the internship.
examples.zh: 「随信附上」申请该实习的求职信和两篇写作样本，请查收。

examples.en: The sample email opens with “Please find attached” before giving the file name.
examples.zh: 邮件样例以「随信附上」开头，然后写出文件名。

collocations: please find attached my cover letter
please find attached the requested documents
please find attached a copy of my portfolio

words.enDefinition: asks somebody to share new information as it becomes available

examples.en: Please keep me posted if the dates change while I'm away on placement.
examples.zh: 我外出实习期间，如果日期有变，「请及时告诉我」。

examples.en: Please keep me posted on the office move so I know where to go.
examples.zh: 办公室搬迁「有进展请告诉我」，这样我就知道该去哪儿。

collocations: please keep me posted on any changes
please keep me posted about the dates
please keep me posted as things progress

words.expression: please let me know either way
words.lemma: please let me know either way
words.zhGloss: 无论结果如何都请告诉我
words.enDefinition: asks for a reply regardless of the outcome
acceptedZhAnswers: 无论结果如何都请告诉我
acceptedEnVariants: please let me know either way

examples.en: Please let me know either way before Friday because I need to arrange childcare.
examples.zh: 「无论结果如何都请在周五前告诉我」，我得安排人照看孩子。

examples.en: Please let me know either way once the manager decides whether to hold the call.
examples.zh: 经理决定开不开这次电话会后，「无论结果如何都请告诉我」。

collocations: please let me know either way by Friday
please let me know either way when you can
please let me know either way about the visit

words.enDefinition: An official document reporting relevant information about a person's criminal record

examples.en: The coordinator asked which country had issued the police certificate on file.
examples.zh: 协调员问档案里的「警方出具的记录证明」是哪国签发的。

examples.en: The police certificate was kept separately from the rest of my paperwork.
examples.zh: 「警方出具的记录证明」和我的其他文件分开保管。

words.enDefinition: A record that someone has received or read a workplace policy

examples.en: I saved the policy acknowledgment after reading the rules about student records.
examples.zh: 读完关于学生档案的规定后，我保存了「规章收阅确认」。

examples.en: The administrator showed where each policy acknowledgment appeared in the employee portal.
examples.zh: 行政人员指给我们看，每份「规章收阅确认」在员工平台的哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: an entry that explains a project's context, process, contribution and results in a portfolio

examples.en: The portfolio case study explains how I tested two layouts with student volunteers.
examples.zh: 这份「作品集项目案例」说明了我怎样和学生志愿者一起测试两种布局。

examples.en: I added a portfolio case study about a group project from my final term.
examples.zh: 我加了一篇「作品集项目案例」，讲的是最后一个学期的小组项目。

words.enDefinition: a web address that leads to a collection of someone's work

examples.en: I tested the portfolio link on my phone before sending the application.
examples.zh: 发出申请前，我先用手机测试了「作品集链接」。

examples.en: The portfolio link in my email opens directly to the project I mentioned.
examples.zh: 邮件里的「作品集链接」会直接打开我提到的那个项目。

words.enDefinition: one piece of work chosen for inclusion in a portfolio

examples.en: I chose a portfolio piece from my first year to show how I improved.
examples.zh: 我选了一件大一作品「放进作品集」，展示自己后来有哪些进步。

examples.en: The recruiter asked which portfolio piece I had developed with classmates last spring.
examples.zh: 招聘人员问，「作品集中的哪一件作品」是我去年春天与同学一起完成的。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of selected work, often with feedback or a decision about a candidate

examples.en: The invitation said the portfolio review would take place before the final interview.
examples.zh: 邀请函说「作品集评审」会在最后一轮面试之前举行。

examples.en: I brought two printed samples to the portfolio review at the design school.
examples.zh: 我带了两份打印样本去设计学院参加「作品集评审」。

words.enDefinition: instructions about how to submit a portfolio and what it should contain

examples.en: The portfolio submission guidelines allow either a website link or a PDF file.
examples.zh: 「作品集提交规范」允许提供网站链接或 PDF 文件。

examples.en: I read the portfolio submission guidelines before deciding which work samples to include.
examples.zh: 挑选要收录的作品样本前，我读了「作品集提交规范」。

words.enDefinition: a guided presentation explaining selected pieces of work and how they were developed

examples.en: The tutor invited me to rehearse my portfolio walkthrough with students from another course.
examples.zh: 导师请我和另一门课的同学一起排练「作品集讲解」。

examples.en: I started the portfolio walkthrough with the project that best showed my design process.
examples.zh: 我先讲最能展示设计过程的项目，作为「作品集讲解」的开场。

words.enDefinition: A formal role in which someone is accountable for particular work

examples.en: My first position of responsibility was coordinating equipment for the campus radio station.
examples.zh: 我第一次「承担管理职责的职务」时，负责协调校广播站的设备。

examples.en: The sample CV gave one position of responsibility in a student society as an example.
examples.zh: 简历样本举了在学生社团「承担管理职责的职务」作为例子。

collocations: take on a position of responsibility

words.zhGloss: 英国工作资格核验通过通知
words.enDefinition: A UK notice confirming a positive employer check on work permission
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国工作资格核验通过通知

examples.en: The UK office explained what the Positive Verification Notice meant in my file.
examples.zh: 英国这家办事处解释了我档案里的「英国工作资格核验通过通知」是什么意思。

examples.en: I checked the date printed on the Positive Verification Notice with my adviser.
examples.zh: 我和顾问一起核对了「英国工作资格核验通过通知」上印的日期。

collocations: a Positive Verification Notice from the Home Office

words.enDefinition: Degree-related US practical training that takes place after the program ends

examples.en: The adviser discussed post-completion OPT during the workshop for students finishing their degrees.
examples.zh: 顾问面向即将完成学业的学生，在讲座上介绍了「美国毕业后实践许可」。

examples.en: I checked the dates listed for post-completion OPT in the copy she sent.
examples.zh: 我核对了她发来的副本上「美国毕业后实践许可」的日期。

words.enDefinition: An open Canadian work permit connected to completion of eligible study

examples.en: The workshop covered the post-graduation work permit separately from student work permissions.
examples.zh: 讲座把「加拿大毕业后工签」和在读学生的工作许可分开介绍。

examples.en: I asked where to find the expiry date on the post-graduation work permit.
examples.zh: 我问在哪里能找到「加拿大毕业后工签」上的到期日期。

collocations: conditions on a post-graduation work permit

words.zhGloss: 澳高教毕业后工作类别
words.enDefinition: An Australian Temporary Graduate visa stream for eligible higher education graduates
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳高教毕业后工作类别

examples.en: The university guide listed the Post-Higher Education Work stream under the Temporary Graduate visa.
examples.zh: 学校指南把「澳高教毕业后工作类别」列在临时毕业生签证下面。

examples.en: I asked what the Post-Higher Education Work stream label meant in the Australian guide.
examples.zh: 我问澳大利亚指南上的「澳高教毕业后工作类别」是什么意思。

collocations: apply under the Post-Higher Education Work stream
the Post-Higher Education Work stream of the Temporary Graduate visa
information on the Post-Higher Education Work stream

words.enDefinition: A presentation that shares project results through a displayed poster

examples.en: My CV includes a poster presentation from the undergraduate research day in May.
examples.zh: 我的简历写了五月本科生科研日的一次「海报展示」。

examples.en: I mentioned my poster presentation because it explained the survey work I had done.
examples.zh: 我提到了「海报展示」，因为它说明了我之前做的调查工作。

words.enDefinition: A response prepared or given during rehearsal for a real interview

examples.en: I recorded a practice answer to hear where I spoke too quickly.
examples.zh: 我录下「练习用的回答」，听听自己哪些地方说得太快。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to shorten the opening of my practice answer.
examples.zh: 顾问让我缩短「练习用的回答」的开头。

words.enDefinition: A sample assessment for getting used to the format

examples.en: I did the practice assessment to see how the page showed each question.
examples.zh: 我做了「模拟测评」，看看页面是怎么展示每道题的。

examples.en: The employer said the practice assessment would not appear in my application record.
examples.zh: 雇主说，「模拟测评」不会记入我的申请记录。

words.enDefinition: A test used to evaluate someone before hiring

examples.en: The pre-employment assessment included a short exercise based on tasks at the library.
examples.zh: 「录用前测评」包括一项以图书馆工作为背景的简短练习。

examples.en: I checked the device requirements before opening the pre-employment assessment on my laptop.
examples.zh: 用笔记本打开「录用前测评」之前，我先查看了设备要求。

words.enDefinition: a short session explaining arrangements before a placement begins

examples.en: At the pre-placement briefing, the tutor explained what to do if the host changed our hours.
examples.zh: 在「实习前说明会」上，导师讲了如果接收单位调整工时，该怎么处理。

examples.en: I took notes at the pre-placement briefing about who to contact during the summer.
examples.zh: 我在「实习前说明会」记下了暑期该联系哪些人。

collocations: take notes at a pre-placement briefing

words.enDefinition: a presentation recorded in advance for the audience to watch later

examples.en: The panel accepted a pre-recorded presentation because our schedules did not overlap.
examples.zh: 由于大家的时间对不上，评审组接受了「预先录制的展示」。

examples.en: I tested the captions before submitting my pre-recorded presentation through the portal.
examples.zh: 通过平台提交「预先录制的展示」之前，我检查了字幕。

words.enDefinition: An option to decline answering a question

examples.en: I selected Prefer not to say on one of the optional questions in the form.
examples.zh: 我在表单的一道选答题上选了「不愿透露」。

examples.en: The button labelled Prefer not to say was at the bottom of the list.
examples.zh: 标为「不愿透露」的按钮在列表最下方。

collocations: a prefer not to say option

words.enDefinition: The place where someone would most like to work

examples.en: I changed my preferred location after finding a flat near the main station.
examples.zh: 在中央车站附近找到公寓后，我改了自己的「意向工作地点」。

examples.en: The portal asked for my preferred location before it showed me any jobs.
examples.zh: 求职网站先让我填写「意向工作地点」，然后才显示职位。

words.enDefinition: To put together documents for a short, focused information session

examples.en: I helped prepare briefing materials for the advisers who welcomed new international students.
examples.zh: 我协助为迎接新留学生的顾问「准备简报材料」。

examples.en: We worked in pairs to prepare briefing materials before the student committee met.
examples.zh: 学生委员会开会前，我们两人一组「准备简报材料」。

collocations: prepare briefing materials for a meeting

words.enDefinition: To explain what a study or investigation discovered to others

examples.en: I learned to present findings at a seminar attended by students from different departments.
examples.zh: 我在各院系学生参加的研讨会上学会了「汇报研究结果」。

examples.en: My CV describes how I helped present findings to the project's community partners.
examples.zh: 我的简历介绍了我如何协助向项目的社区合作伙伴「汇报研究结果」。

words.enDefinition: A grammatical form used for current actions, states, or habits

examples.en: I used the present tense for my current job at the campus library.
examples.zh: 我用「现在时」描述目前在校园图书馆的工作。

examples.en: We checked that the present tense appeared only in entries for ongoing roles.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「现在时」是否只出现在仍在任职的经历里。

collocations: keep verbs in the present tense

words.enDefinition: explain what you found out while doing a placement

examples.en: You'll present your placement findings to the gallery team during the final afternoon session.
examples.zh: 最后一天下午的会议上，你会向美术馆团队「汇报实习中的发现」。

examples.en: How would you present your placement findings to someone who had never visited the site?
examples.zh: 你会怎样向从没去过实习单位的人「汇报实习中的发现」？

collocations: present your placement findings to the team
prepare to present your placement findings
present your placement findings at a review

words.enDefinition: to explain what you think should be done, usually with supporting reasons

examples.en: You have five minutes to present your recommendation before the panel asks questions.
examples.zh: 评审组提问前，有五分钟可以「陈述你的建议方案」。

examples.en: The tutor suggested that you present your recommendation before outlining the alternatives.
examples.zh: 导师建议先「陈述你的建议方案」，再概述其他选项。

collocations: present your recommendation to the panel
present your recommendation at the end

words.enDefinition: instructions explaining the topic, audience and requirements for a presentation task

examples.en: The presentation brief specified that each candidate should use no more than three slides.
examples.zh: 「展示任务说明」规定每名应聘者最多使用三张幻灯片。

examples.en: I checked the presentation brief to see whether we could refer to notes.
examples.zh: 我查阅了「展示任务说明」，看展示时能不能看笔记。

words.enDefinition: a task assessing how someone organizes and presents information to an audience

examples.en: The presentation exercise asked me to explain my findings to people outside my field.
examples.zh: 「展示表达测评」让我向不同专业的人讲解研究发现。

examples.en: I had ten minutes to prepare for the presentation exercise after reading the chart.
examples.zh: 读完图表后，我有十分钟准备「展示表达测评」。

words.enDefinition: a physical collection of printed work samples, often used for an in-person review

examples.en: I took a print portfolio to show the recruiter during the campus fair.
examples.zh: 我带了「纸质作品集」，在校园招聘会上给招聘人员看。

examples.en: The print portfolio includes full-page images so readers can see the poster details.
examples.zh: 「纸质作品集」里有整页图片，读者能看清海报细节。

words.enDefinition: A view showing how a document will look when printed

examples.en: I opened print preview and noticed that my email address had been cut off.
examples.zh: 我打开「打印预览」，发现自己的邮箱地址没显示完整。

examples.en: The print preview showed an extra page that was not visible in the editor.
examples.zh: 「打印预览」里多了一页，在编辑界面中看不到。

words.enDefinition: To decide which things need attention before others

examples.en: I described how I prioritize tasks when two events started at once.
examples.zh: 我描述了两场活动同时开始时，自己怎样「给任务排优先级」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how I learned to prioritize tasks at the service desk.
examples.zh: 面试官问我是在服务台怎样学会「给任务排优先级」的。

words.enDefinition: professional work provided free of charge, often for a public or charitable purpose

examples.en: The studio included some pro bono work for a local charity in its portfolio.
examples.zh: 工作室在作品集中收录了为本地慈善机构提供的「无偿专业服务」。

examples.en: I asked whether the theatre poster counted as pro bono work for my application.
examples.zh: 我问在申请材料里，剧院海报能不能算作「无偿专业服务」。

collocations: pro bono work for a nonprofit

words.enDefinition: A meeting to discuss someone's work during the initial employment period

examples.en: At the probation review, my supervisor asked which tasks I felt comfortable doing.
examples.zh: 「试用期考评」时，主管问我已经能熟练完成哪些工作。

examples.en: I brought a short list of completed tasks to the probation review.
examples.zh: 我带了一份已完成任务的简短清单去参加「试用期考评」。

words.enDefinition: An initial period used to assess suitability for a new job

examples.en: My contract gave the dates of the probationary period on the second page.
examples.zh: 我的合同第二页注明了「试用期」的起止日期。

examples.en: My supervisor arranged a meeting near the end of my probationary period.
examples.zh: 临近「试用期」结束时，主管安排了一次面谈。

collocations: the end of the probationary period

words.enDefinition: A question aimed at getting more detail or uncovering someone's reasoning

examples.en: A probing question prompted me to explain why I had changed the plan.
examples.zh: 一个「深入追问」让我解释了为什么要改变计划。

examples.en: I paused when the interviewer asked a probing question about my personal contribution.
examples.zh: 面试官就我的个人贡献提出一个「深入追问」时，我停顿了一下。

collocations: a probing question about the outcome

words.enDefinition: the ability to identify difficulties and find workable solutions

examples.en: The ad asks for problem-solving skills because equipment sometimes fails during student events.
examples.zh: 招聘启事要求有「解决问题的能力」，因为学生活动期间设备有时会出故障。

examples.en: The role mentions problem-solving skills for helping visitors when rooms or bookings change unexpectedly.
examples.zh: 岗位提到要有「解决问题的能力」，遇到房间或预订临时变动时能帮到来访者。

words.enDefinition: a clear description of a problem a project is meant to address

examples.en: The problem statement explains why visitors struggled to find the entrances after dark.
examples.zh: 「问题说明」解释了为什么访客在天黑后很难找到入口。

examples.en: I rewrote the problem statement after our interviews revealed a different main concern.
examples.zh: 访谈发现大家主要担心的是另一个问题，我于是重写了「问题说明」。

words.zhGloss: 继续推进其他候选人的流程
words.enDefinition: continue the hiring process with different applicants
acceptedZhAnswers: 继续推进其他候选人的流程

examples.en: We decided to proceed with other candidates whose schedules fit the role more closely.
examples.zh: 我们决定「继续推进其他候选人的流程」，他们的时间更符合岗位安排。

examples.en: The recruiter emailed to say the team would proceed with other candidates this time.
examples.zh: 招聘人员发来邮件，说团队这次会「继续推进其他候选人的流程」。

collocations: decide to proceed with other candidates
plan to proceed with other candidates
choose to proceed with other candidates

words.enDefinition: written or visual records showing the steps by which a project was completed

examples.en: My process documentation includes notes from the first meeting and pictures of the prototype.
examples.zh: 我的「过程记录」包括第一次会议的笔记和原型的照片。

examples.en: The portfolio links to process documentation for readers who want to see earlier versions.
examples.zh: 作品集里放了「过程记录」的链接，想了解早期版本的读者可以点开。

words.enDefinition: carry out the steps needed to fulfill customer orders

examples.en: The bookshop needs someone to process orders for textbooks before the first week of term.
examples.zh: 书店需要有人在学期第一周前「处理教材订单」。

examples.en: I asked whether I would process orders or mainly help customers on the shop floor.
examples.zh: 我问自己是要「处理订单」，还是主要在店里接待顾客。

words.enDefinition: A membership organization for people working in a field

examples.en: I found the local professional association while looking for events for trainee librarians.
examples.zh: 我在找面向见习图书管理员的活动时，找到了当地的「专业人士协会」。

examples.en: The professional association has a student membership and holds talks open to the public.
examples.zh: 这个「专业人士协会」有学生会员，还办面向公众开放的讲座。

collocations: a member of a professional association

words.enDefinition: A credential awarded for meeting standards in a field of work

examples.en: I listed the date of my professional certification next to its name.
examples.zh: 我把获得「专业认证」的日期写在认证名称旁边。

examples.en: One professional certification on my CV was due for renewal in December.
examples.zh: 我简历上的一项「专业认证」要在十二月续证。

words.enDefinition: Money toward approved career learning activities

examples.en: The role included a professional development allowance that I could use for approved courses.
examples.zh: 这个岗位有「职业发展补贴」，我可以用来参加经批准的课程。

examples.en: I asked whether the professional development allowance would cover joining a library association.
examples.zh: 我问「职业发展补贴」能不能用来支付加入图书馆协会的费用。

words.enDefinition: chances to develop knowledge and skills for your work

examples.en: The department advertises professional development opportunities such as workshops on interviewing research participants.
examples.zh: 院系的招聘启事提到有「职业能力提升机会」，比如有关研究访谈的工作坊。

examples.en: I asked what professional development opportunities would be available to a new archive assistant.
examples.zh: 我问刚入职的档案助理可以获得哪些「职业能力提升机会」。

words.enDefinition: a plan setting goals and activities for improving a person's work-related skills

examples.en: I added a spreadsheet course to my professional development plan after the review.
examples.zh: 评估后，我把一门电子表格课程加进了「职业发展计划」。

examples.en: The supervisor asked me to share my professional development plan before the next meeting.
examples.zh: 主管让我在下次开会前分享「职业发展计划」。

words.enDefinition: A formal affiliation with an association in a field of work

examples.en: I listed my student chapter affiliation as a professional membership on the CV.
examples.zh: 我在简历的「专业协会会员资格」一栏列出了自己所在的学生分会。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether my professional membership was still active this year.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「专业协会会员资格」今年是否仍然有效。

words.enDefinition: A set of contacts connected through work

examples.en: My professional network grew after I did some volunteer work at the film festival.
examples.zh: 我在电影节做了一些志愿服务后，「职业人脉网络」扩大了。

examples.en: She heard from her professional network that a new gallery would open next month.
examples.zh: 她从「职业人脉网络」得知，下个月会有一家新画廊开业。

words.enDefinition: A site for making and maintaining work contacts

examples.en: I found the editor through a professional networking site after reading her article.
examples.zh: 读完那位编辑的文章后，我通过「职业社交网站」找到了她。

examples.en: The careers adviser suggested using a professional networking site to find former students in publishing.
examples.zh: 就业顾问建议上「职业社交网站」，找在出版行业工作的校友。

collocations: create a profile on a professional networking site

words.enDefinition: A page summarizing someone's work background and interests

examples.en: I updated my professional profile so other graduates could see the course I'd taken.
examples.zh: 我更新了「职业社交资料」，方便其他毕业生看到我读过的课程。

examples.en: Her professional profile helped me understand how she moved from teaching into publishing.
examples.zh: 她的「职业社交资料」让我了解了她是怎样从教学转行到出版的。

words.enDefinition: a formal qualification for work in a particular profession

examples.en: The listing asks for a professional qualification, so I looked up the named credential.
examples.zh: 招聘启事要求有「职业资格」，我就去查了它点名的那项资质。

examples.en: I asked if my professional qualification from home would be relevant to this role.
examples.zh: 我问自己在老家取得的「职业资格」是否适用于这个岗位。

words.enDefinition: A person who can comment on someone's work or professional conduct

examples.en: I asked my placement supervisor to be my professional referee for the library job.
examples.zh: 我请实习主管担任我申请图书馆工作的「工作推荐人」。

examples.en: The coordinator confirmed that my professional referee had received the email.
examples.zh: 协调员确认我的「工作推荐人」已经收到了邮件。

words.enDefinition: official registration with a body that oversees a profession

examples.en: The clinic's listing asks for current professional registration with the body named in the advert.
examples.zh: 这家诊所的招聘启事要求在指定机构办理「执业注册」，而且注册须在有效期内。

examples.en: I contacted the employer to clarify which professional registration they expected for the position.
examples.zh: 我联系了雇主，想弄清这个岗位要求哪一种「执业注册」。

words.enDefinition: Abilities or qualities someone applies effectively in a work setting

examples.en: I talked about my professional strengths using examples from the library and the lab.
examples.zh: 我用在图书馆和实验室的例子来谈自己的「职业优势」。

examples.en: My adviser asked which of my professional strengths mattered most for this role.
examples.zh: 顾问问我有哪些「职业优势」对这份工作最重要。

words.enDefinition: A short introduction highlighting relevant background and strengths for a job

examples.en: My professional summary connects my lab experience with the data work listed in the posting.
examples.zh: 我的「职业概况」把实验室经历和招聘信息中的数据工作联系起来。

examples.en: The adviser suggested shortening my professional summary to three lines under my name.
examples.zh: 顾问建议把我名字下方的「职业概况」缩短到三行。

words.enDefinition: a respectful and appropriate manner of communicating in a work-related setting

examples.en: The adviser helped me keep a professional tone without making the letter sound stiff.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我保留了「专业得体的语气」，同时没让信读起来太生硬。

examples.en: I used a more professional tone when I revised the email to the recruiter.
examples.zh: 我修改发给招聘人员的邮件时，用了更「专业得体的语气」。

words.enDefinition: How well someone can use a language or skill

examples.en: I included a proficiency level next to each language on my CV.
examples.zh: 我在简历上的每种语言旁标出了「熟练程度」。

examples.en: The adviser asked how I had decided on my proficiency level for Excel.
examples.zh: 顾问问我如何判断自己的 Excel「熟练程度」。

words.enDefinition: able to use a skill or tool well

examples.en: The editor wants someone proficient in design software who can make changes without help.
examples.zh: 编辑想找一个「熟练掌握设计软件」的人，可以独立修改文件。

examples.en: I checked what they meant by proficient in Excel before deciding whether to apply.
examples.zh: 决定是否申请前，我确认了他们要求的「熟练掌握 Excel」具体指什么。

words.enDefinition: The setting controlling who can see a profile

examples.en: I changed my profile visibility before joining the university's professional networking group.
examples.zh: 加入学校的职业社交小组之前，我更改了「资料可见范围」。

examples.en: The settings page lets me check my profile visibility without changing any contact details.
examples.zh: 设置页面可以让我查看「资料可见范围」，无须修改联系方式。

words.enDefinition: people who have previously completed the same training program

examples.en: We met program alumni who now work in different departments at the same company.
examples.zh: 我们见了几位「项目往届学员」，他们现在在同一家公司的不同部门工作。

examples.en: I asked the program alumni how they had chosen a team after finishing their rotations.
examples.zh: 我问「项目往届学员」轮岗结束后是怎么选团队的。

words.enDefinition: the point at which someone finishes a training program

examples.en: I received a certificate of program completion after the manager reviewed my final project.
examples.zh: 经理评审完我的最终项目后，我拿到了「培养项目结业」证书。

examples.en: The form asks for the expected date of program completion before we arrange the next rotation.
examples.zh: 安排下一轮轮岗前，表格要求填写预计的「培养项目结业」日期。

words.enDefinition: An institution's letter confirming that a student has finished a program

examples.en: I asked whether the university could confirm the date on my program completion letter.
examples.zh: 我问学校能否确认「课程完成证明信」上的日期。

examples.en: The adviser discussed the program completion letter in the workshop on graduate work permits.
examples.zh: 顾问在介绍毕业后工签的讲座上提到了「课程完成证明信」。

collocations: a copy of the program completion letter

words.enDefinition: how far someone's work has advanced towards agreed objectives

examples.en: We reviewed progress against goals after the first month of my design placement ended.
examples.zh: 设计实习的第一个月结束后，我们「对照目标回顾了进展」。

examples.en: My mentor checked progress against goals before we agreed on the next project to try.
examples.zh: 定下接下来试做的项目之前，导师「对照目标检查了进展」。

words.enDefinition: a short report on what has been done and what is still underway

examples.en: I sent a progress update after finishing the first set of timetable changes.
examples.zh: 做完第一批时间表调整后，我发了条「进展更新」。

examples.en: The supervisor asked for a progress update before approving the next round of work.
examples.zh: 主管想先看一下「进展更新」，再批准下一轮工作。

words.enDefinition: an organized collection of records or files from completed projects

examples.en: I moved the old posters to a project archive after redesigning the portfolio.
examples.zh: 重新设计作品集后，我把旧海报移进了「项目归档」。

examples.en: The project archive includes original sketches that are no longer on public display.
examples.zh: 「项目归档」里还有一些已经停止公开展示的原始素描。

collocations: save files to a project archive

words.enDefinition: a document that states what a project should accomplish and what conditions it must meet

examples.en: The project brief asked us to design signs for visitors unfamiliar with the building.
examples.zh: 「项目任务说明」要求我们为不熟悉这栋楼的访客设计标识。

examples.en: I compared the completed posters with the original project brief before writing the case study.
examples.zh: 写案例前，我把完工的海报和最初的「项目任务说明」作了比较。

words.enDefinition: factors such as time, cost or materials that limit what a project can do

examples.en: The project constraints included a limited printing budget and an early installation deadline.
examples.zh: 「项目限制条件」包括印刷预算有限和安装截止日较早。

examples.en: I described the project constraints so readers understood why we chose recycled materials.
examples.zh: 我说明了「项目限制条件」，让读者理解我们为什么选择再生材料。

words.enDefinition: the circumstances around a project that help explain its purpose or decisions

examples.en: I added a short description of the project context before showing the final design.
examples.zh: 我先简要介绍了「项目背景」，再展示最终设计。

examples.en: The reviewer asked for more project context about who would use the service.
examples.zh: 评审想了解更多「项目背景」，尤其是谁会使用这项服务。

words.enDefinition: a list identifying people or organizations that contributed to a project

examples.en: I put the project credits under the photographs so the photographer was acknowledged.
examples.zh: 我把「项目人员署名」放在照片下方，写明了摄影者。

examples.en: The project credits name the classmates who helped write and edit the script.
examples.zh: 「项目人员署名」列出了帮忙编写和编辑脚本的同学。

collocations: be listed in the project credits

words.enDefinition: The dates showing when a project started and ended

examples.en: I found the project dates in our final report before updating my CV.
examples.zh: 更新简历前，我在最终报告里找到了「项目起止日期」。

examples.en: The project dates helped the reader see which projects I had completed recently.
examples.zh: 「项目起止日期」帮助读者看出哪些项目是我近期完成的。

words.enDefinition: A short explanation of what a project did and involved

examples.en: My project description names the tool we built and explains who used it.
examples.zh: 我的「项目描述」写出了我们制作的工具，并说明了使用者是谁。

examples.en: I removed two technical terms from the project description so readers could follow it.
examples.zh: 我从「项目描述」中删掉了两个专业术语，让读者更容易理解。

words.enDefinition: A result or change produced by carrying out a project

examples.en: My first draft describes the task but leaves out the project outcome.
examples.zh: 我的初稿只写了任务，漏写了「项目成果」。

examples.en: The project outcome was a bilingual guide that new volunteers still use.
examples.zh: 「项目成果」是一份双语指南，新志愿者现在还在用。

words.enDefinition: a brief description of what a project involves and why it was done

examples.en: The project overview gives the reader enough context to understand the images below.
examples.zh: 「项目概述」提供了足够的背景，帮助读者理解下面的图片。

examples.en: I moved the client description into the project overview when I revised the page.
examples.zh: 修改页面时，我把客户介绍移到了「项目概述」里。

words.enDefinition: an account of what someone learned from a project and what they would change

examples.en: My project reflection explains why I would test the route earlier next time.
examples.zh: 我在「项目反思」里说明了为什么下次会更早测试路线。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to focus my project reflection on one decision that mattered.
examples.zh: 导师让我围绕一个重要决定来写「项目反思」。

words.enDefinition: The work and activities included within the boundaries of a project

examples.en: I added one sentence explaining the project scope before listing my own tasks.
examples.zh: 列出个人任务前，我加了一句话说明「项目范围」。

examples.en: The reviewer asked me to describe the project scope in plain language.
examples.zh: 审阅者请我用通俗的话来描述「项目范围」。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization providing backing and oversight for a project

examples.en: Our project sponsor helped us agree on a realistic deadline with the placement team.
examples.zh: 「项目支持负责人」帮我们和实习团队商定了一个可行的期限。

examples.en: I met the project sponsor to discuss what the organization needed from our report.
examples.zh: 我和「项目支持负责人」见了面，讨论接收单位希望报告提供什么。

collocations: get support from the project sponsor

words.enDefinition: remaining on your feet for a long period

examples.en: The listing mentions prolonged standing because ushers stay near the theatre doors during performances.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到要「长时间站立」，因为演出期间引座员要守在剧院门口附近。

examples.en: The ticket counter listing mentions prolonged standing, so I asked how long shifts lasted.
examples.zh: 售票柜台的招聘启事提到要「长时间站立」，所以我问了每个班次有多长。

words.enDefinition: Documents or records showing that someone has permission to work

examples.en: The office asked which document I would use as proof of work authorization.
examples.zh: 办公室问我打算用哪份文件作为「工作许可证明」。

examples.en: I asked whether the employer still needed my proof of work authorization on file.
examples.zh: 我问雇主是否仍需要留存我的「工作许可证明」。

words.enDefinition: to check written material carefully for mistakes before sending or publishing it

examples.en: I printed the letter so I could proofread for errors away from my screen.
examples.zh: 我把信打印出来，好离开屏幕做一次「校读查错」。

examples.en: My friend offered to proofread for errors before I sent the final file.
examples.zh: 发出最终文件前，朋友主动帮我「校读查错」。

collocations: ask someone to proofread for errors

words.enDefinition: To check your job document for errors before sharing it

examples.en: The careers adviser offered to help me proofread your resume before the campus fair.
examples.zh: 校园招聘会前，职业顾问主动提出帮我「校对简历」。

examples.en: Our handout explains how to proofread your resume when the layout has changed.
examples.zh: 讲义说明了调整版式之后该怎么「校对简历」。

collocations: ask someone to proofread your resume
take time to proofread your resume

words.enDefinition: an example showing the corrections someone makes when checking written material

examples.en: I included a proofreading sample with visible corrections from a short newsletter draft.
examples.zh: 我附上了一份来自简讯初稿的「校对样本」，修改痕迹清晰可见。

examples.en: The editor asked whether the proofreading sample was from work I had completed independently.
examples.zh: 编辑问「校对样本」是不是我独立完成的。

words.enDefinition: A suggested date for starting work

examples.en: The manager's proposed start date was the first Monday after the spring break.
examples.zh: 经理「拟定的到岗日期」是春假结束后的第一个周一。

examples.en: I asked whether the proposed start date could move to the following week.
examples.zh: 我问「拟定到岗日期」能不能改到下一周。

collocations: set out the proposed start date

words.enDefinition: Salary adjusted to part of a full period or schedule

examples.en: The offer gave a prorated salary because the work would start halfway through April.
examples.zh: 因为四月过半才开始工作，录用通知列的是「按比例折算的薪资」。

examples.en: I asked how the prorated salary in the letter related to the full-time figure.
examples.zh: 我问信中的「按比例折算的薪资」和全职薪资金额是什么关系。

collocations: a prorated salary for part of a month

words.enDefinition: An organization that might employ someone in future

examples.en: I met a prospective employer at the arts fair and learned about their local studio.
examples.zh: 我在艺术展上见到一家「潜在雇主」，了解了他们在本地的工作室。

examples.en: The careers adviser asked what I wanted to know about each prospective employer.
examples.zh: 就业顾问问我想了解每家「潜在雇主」的哪些情况。

words.enDefinition: An offer that is not yet fully confirmed

examples.en: The university sent me a provisional offer while it checked my preferred start date.
examples.zh: 学校在核对我希望的到岗日期期间，先发来一份「暂定录用通知」。

examples.en: I asked which details on the provisional offer still needed to be confirmed.
examples.zh: 我问「暂定录用通知」上哪些细节还需要确认。

words.enDefinition: work intended to be viewed or used by people outside the organization

examples.en: The sample is public-facing work created for visitors to the campus museum.
examples.zh: 这个样本是为校园博物馆访客制作的「面向公众的作品」。

examples.en: I separated public-facing work from documents that only the committee had seen.
examples.zh: 我把「面向公众的作品」和只有委员会看过的文档分开。

words.enDefinition: a place where project files and their change history are openly available

examples.en: I linked to the public repository where the group had published our code.
examples.zh: 我添加了「公开代码仓库」的链接，那里面有小组发布的代码。

examples.en: The public repository contained the project files and a short description of my contribution.
examples.zh: 「公开代码仓库」里有项目文件，以及一段介绍我做了什么的文字。

collocations: publish code in a public repository

words.enDefinition: an example of work that has already been made public through publication

examples.en: I chose a published sample from my time working on the student newspaper.
examples.zh: 我选了一份在学生报工作期间写的「已发表的样本」。

examples.en: The editor asked whether I could link to the published sample in my application.
examples.zh: 编辑问我能否在申请材料里添加「已发表的样本」的链接。

collocations: a published sample of your writing

words.enDefinition: to move a scheduled meeting to a later time or date

examples.en: Could we push back a meeting booked for noon until after the workshop ends?
examples.zh: 能不能「把会议推迟」，原定中午开的这场会等培训结束后再开？

examples.en: I asked whether we could push back a meeting until the afternoon shift began.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「把会议推迟」，等下午班开始再开。

collocations: push back a meeting by thirty minutes
ask to push back a meeting
push back a meeting until Friday

words.enDefinition: to disagree or object in a way that remains respectful

examples.en: I had to push back politely when the new deadline overlapped with my shift.
examples.zh: 新的截止时间和我的班次冲突，我只好「礼貌地提出异议」。

examples.en: The adviser showed us how to push back politely when a request seemed unrealistic.
examples.zh: 顾问示范了请求不太现实的时候，怎样「礼貌地提出异议」。

collocations: push back politely on a deadline
feel able to push back politely

words.enDefinition: To move the planned first working day later

examples.en: I asked if we could push back the start date until my exam week ended.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「推迟到岗日期」，等考试周结束再上班。

examples.en: The department had to push back the start date because the building was closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 楼在封闭维修，所以部门不得不「推迟到岗日期」。

collocations: ask to push back the start date
agree to push back the start date
push back the start date by a week

words.enDefinition: move a planned call to a later time

examples.en: Could we push the call back to Friday so I can stay for the whole lab?
examples.zh: 能不能「把通话时间推迟到周五」，这样我就能上完整节实验课？

examples.en: We had to push the call back because the recruiter was still at another event.
examples.zh: 招聘人员还在参加另一场活动，所以我们只好「把通话时间推迟」。

collocations: push the call back by half an hour
push the call back until Friday
ask to push the call back

words.enDefinition: To speak favorably about someone to help them

examples.en: My old supervisor offered to put in a good word with the gallery manager.
examples.zh: 以前的主管主动提出帮我在画廊经理面前「说几句好话」。

examples.en: Did anyone put in a good word for you at the bookshop near campus?
examples.zh: 有没有人在学校附近那家书店「替你说过好话」？

collocations: offer to put in a good word
put in a good word for a friend
put in a good word with a manager

words.enDefinition: asks for or describes a call being connected to somebody

examples.en: Could you put me through to the recruiter who arranged the call for tomorrow?
examples.zh: 「能帮我接通负责安排明天那通电话的招聘人员吗」？

examples.en: Reception put me through to the hiring team after I explained why I was calling.
examples.zh: 我说了打电话的缘由后，前台「帮我接通了招聘团队的电话」。

collocations: could you put me through to recruitment?
please put me through to the coordinator
the operator put me through to reception

words.zhGloss: 把技能用到实际工作中
words.enDefinition: to use abilities one has learned to do something real
acceptedZhAnswers: 把技能用到实际工作中

examples.en: The position would let me put skills into practice outside my usual classroom exercises.
examples.zh: 这个岗位能让我在课堂练习之外「把技能用到实际工作中」。

examples.en: I wanted to put skills into practice while helping the team prepare its exhibition.
examples.zh: 我想一边帮团队准备展览，一边「把技能用到实际工作中」。

collocations: put skills into practice at work
an opportunity to put skills into practice
put skills into practice on a project

words.expression: put the hiring process on hold
words.lemma: put the hiring process on hold
words.enDefinition: temporarily stop work on hiring for a role
acceptedEnVariants: put the hiring process on hold

examples.en: The department decided to put the hiring process on hold while it reviewed the budget.
examples.zh: 院系决定审核预算期间「暂停招聘流程」。

examples.en: We had to put the hiring process on hold because the opening date changed.
examples.zh: 开业日期改了，我们只好「暂停招聘流程」。

collocations: decide to put the hiring process on hold
temporarily put the hiring process on hold
have to put the hiring process on hold

words.enDefinition: Outcomes that can be expressed in numbers or other measurable terms

examples.en: The instructor asked for quantifiable results, so I added the attendance figures.
examples.zh: 老师要求给出「可量化成果」，于是我加上了出席人数。

examples.en: Our quantifiable results included shorter waiting times at the campus service desk.
examples.zh: 我们的「可量化成果」包括缩短了校园服务台的等候时间。

words.enDefinition: to express a result in measurable numbers rather than only in words

examples.en: I used attendance records to quantify an outcome from the event I organized.
examples.zh: 我查阅了出勤记录，给我组织的活动「量化成果」。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether I could quantify an outcome from the campus project.
examples.zh: 导师问我，能不能把校园项目的一项「成果用数字说明」。

words.enDefinition: To express the results of your work using relevant numbers

examples.en: The workshop showed how to quantify your achievements using details from everyday jobs.
examples.zh: 讲座展示了怎样用日常工作的具体数据来「量化自己的成就」。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to explain how I would quantify your achievements for the mentoring project.
examples.zh: 顾问让我解释，在指导项目这一段经历里我会怎样「量化自己的成就」。

collocations: use figures to quantify your achievements

words.enDefinition: a brief advance notice about something that another person should know

examples.en: I sent a quick heads-up about the printer before the evening shift started.
examples.zh: 晚班开始之前，我发消息「简单提前告知」了一下打印机的情况。

examples.en: The coordinator gave us a quick heads-up about roadworks near the main entrance.
examples.zh: 协调员「简单提前告知」我们，主入口附近正在修路。

collocations: a quick heads-up about a change

words.enDefinition: To mention a worry about a potential difficulty or problem

examples.en: I explained why I chose to raise a concern before we changed the schedule.
examples.zh: 我解释了为什么在调整日程之前选择「提出顾虑」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how I would raise a concern in front of a busy team.
examples.zh: 面试官问我，面对正忙着的团队，我会怎样「提出顾虑」。

collocations: raise a concern with a supervisor

words.enDefinition: a group of data records kept in their original form before cleaning or processing

examples.en: The raw dataset included some blank entries and a few dates in different formats.
examples.zh: 「原始数据集」里有几项空值，还有几个格式不同的日期。

examples.en: I saved a separate copy of the raw dataset before building the chart.
examples.zh: 制作图表前，我另存了一份「原始数据集」。

words.enDefinition: To agree on a solution after each side gives something up

examples.en: I described how we managed to reach a compromise about the club's budget.
examples.zh: 我讲了大家是怎样在社团预算上「达成妥协」的。

examples.en: My answer explained how I helped two classmates reach a compromise during the project.
examples.zh: 我在回答中解释了项目期间怎样帮助两位同学「达成妥协」。

collocations: reach a compromise with a colleague
work together to reach a compromise

words.enDefinition: To ask people you know for information or help

examples.en: When did you reach out to your network about work at the local theatre?
examples.zh: 你是什么时候「联系人脉」，打听本地剧院工作机会的？

examples.en: Did you reach out to your network before you started looking in another city?
examples.zh: 开始在另一座城市找工作前，你有「联系自己的人脉」吗？

collocations: reach out to your network for leads
decide to reach out to your network
reach out to your network for advice

words.enDefinition: A copy that can be viewed without making changes

examples.en: I could open a read-only copy of my application after the employer closed the form.
examples.zh: 雇主关闭表单后，我还能打开申请的「只读副本」。

examples.en: The read-only copy included the answers I had submitted but did not allow changes.
examples.zh: 「只读副本」包含我提交的答案，但无法修改。

words.zhGloss: 把刚记下的内容念给你听
words.enDefinition: repeat information you just noted to check it
acceptedZhAnswers: 把刚记下的内容念给你听

examples.en: I'll read that back to you to make sure I wrote the address down correctly.
examples.zh: 我「把刚记下的地址念给你听」，确认没写错。

examples.en: Could I read that back to you before we hang up and I book my train?
examples.zh: 挂电话和订火车票之前，「我能把刚记下的内容念给你听吗」？

collocations: let me read that back to you
can I read that back to you?
I'll read that back to you slowly

words.enDefinition: to examine program text you have not worked with before in order to understand it

examples.en: I had to read unfamiliar code before I could explain its output.
examples.zh: 我得先「阅读不熟悉的代码」，才能解释它的输出。

examples.en: The interview tested how quickly I could read unfamiliar code without any documentation.
examples.zh: 面试考查我在没有文档时能多快「阅读不熟悉的代码」。

collocations: read unfamiliar code with a debugger

words.enDefinition: The ease with which people can read and understand text

examples.en: We compared the readability of two versions with different section headings.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两份栏目标题不同的简历的「易读性」。

examples.en: The adviser said longer bullets were hurting the readability of my CV.
examples.zh: 顾问说简历要点写得太长，影响了「易读性」。

words.enDefinition: Complete and prepared to be sent

examples.en: My application looked ready to submit after I checked the names on both attachments.
examples.zh: 核对两个附件的文件名后，我的申请看起来「可以提交了」。

examples.en: The portal marked my application as ready to submit once I answered the last question.
examples.zh: 我答完最后一道题后，门户把我的申请标为「可以提交」。

collocations: check whether a form is ready to submit
mark an application as ready to submit

words.enDefinition: To apply for the same job on another occasion

examples.en: Can I reapply for a role if it opens again in the new term?
examples.zh: 如果同一个职位下学期重新开放，我能「再次申请」吗？

examples.en: I decided to reapply for a role at the museum when it was advertised again.
examples.zh: 博物馆重新发布这个职位时，我决定「再次申请」。

collocations: choose to reapply for a role
wait to reapply for a role
be allowed to reapply for a role

words.enDefinition: To remember a particular event rather than a general pattern

examples.en: I checked my placement notes to recall a specific incident involving a late delivery.
examples.zh: 我翻看实习笔记，想「回想一件具体的事」，和一次交货延迟有关。

examples.en: The practice question asked you to recall a specific incident from a group project.
examples.zh: 练习题请你「回想一件具体的事」，可以选一个小组项目里的经历。

collocations: try to recall a specific incident
help someone recall a specific incident
recall a specific incident from work

words.enDefinition: someone who finished their studies a short time ago

examples.en: As a recent graduate, I wanted a job that still offered some training.
examples.zh: 作为「刚毕业的人」，我想找一份还能提供一些培训的工作。

examples.en: The publisher is looking for a recent graduate who is interested in editing textbooks.
examples.zh: 出版社想找个对教材编辑有兴趣的「刚毕业的人」。

collocations: a role for a recent graduate

words.enDefinition: a slide presenting a proposed decision or course of action

examples.en: The recommendation slide explains why I chose the cheaper option for the pilot.
examples.zh: 「建议方案幻灯片」解释了我为什么为试点选了更便宜的方案。

examples.en: I added one comparison figure to the recommendation slide before presenting to the panel.
examples.zh: 向评审组展示前，我在「建议方案幻灯片」上加了一个对比数字。

words.enDefinition: Roles a service suggests based on your preferences

examples.en: I found a nearby museum among the recommended jobs on my account page.
examples.zh: 我在账户页面的「推荐职位」里看到了附近一家博物馆的岗位。

examples.en: My recommended jobs became more relevant once I switched the location to Bristol.
examples.zh: 把地点改成布里斯托尔后，我收到的「推荐职位」更合适了。

words.enDefinition: To resume communication with someone you knew before

examples.en: The event gave me a chance to reconnect with a contact from my placement.
examples.zh: 这次活动让我有机会「重新联系一位实习期间认识的人」。

examples.en: I used the alumni directory to reconnect with a contact from my final year.
examples.zh: 我通过校友名录「重新联系上了最后一年认识的一位旧识」。

collocations: try to reconnect with a contact
reconnect with a contact from university
an opportunity to reconnect with a contact

words.enDefinition: to put a decision into a written or electronic record for later reference

examples.en: I asked the minute taker to record a decision about the updated schedule.
examples.zh: 我请会议记录员「记录一项决定」，是关于更新排班表的。

examples.en: The template has a separate line to record a decision after each discussion.
examples.zh: 模板留了一行，供每项讨论结束后「记录一项决定」。

collocations: record a decision in the minutes
make sure to record a decision

words.enDefinition: To become calm again after feeling upset or nervous

examples.en: A short pause can help you recover your composure after an unexpected question.
examples.zh: 遇到出乎意料的问题时，短暂停顿能帮助你「恢复镇定」。

examples.en: My tutor showed me how to recover your composure without rushing the next sentence.
examples.zh: 导师教我怎样「恢复镇定」，不用急着说下一句。

collocations: take time to recover your composure

words.enDefinition: contact initiated by recruiters to identify potential candidates

examples.en: I wasn't expecting recruiter outreach before I'd finished the final year of my course.
examples.zh: 我没想到课程最后一年还没读完，就有「招聘人员主动联系」我。

examples.en: I tracked recruiter outreach separately from jobs I had found and applied for myself.
examples.zh: 我把「招聘人员主动联系」和自己找到并申请的岗位分开记录。

collocations: a message prompted by recruiter outreach

words.enDefinition: the group responsible for finding and coordinating candidates

examples.en: I called the recruiting team after noticing two different dates in the invitation.
examples.zh: 我发现邀请里有两个不同的日期，就给「招聘团队」打了电话。

examples.en: The recruiting team told me which inbox to use for questions about scheduling.
examples.zh: 「招聘团队」告诉我，有关时间安排的问题该发到哪个邮箱。

collocations: a member of the recruiting team

words.enDefinition: A company that matches workers with employers

examples.en: I asked the careers adviser whether the recruitment agency worked with local museums.
examples.zh: 我问就业顾问，这家「招聘中介机构」和本地博物馆有没有合作。

examples.en: A recruitment agency in town puts new graduates in touch with nearby employers.
examples.zh: 镇上的一家「招聘中介机构」会帮应届生联系附近的雇主。

words.enDefinition: a person who organizes the practical steps of hiring

examples.en: The recruitment coordinator sent an updated calendar invitation after the panel changed its schedule.
examples.zh: 评审组调整时间后，「招聘协调员」发来了更新的日历邀请。

examples.en: I told the recruitment coordinator that I couldn't take calls during my lab sessions.
examples.zh: 我告诉「招聘协调员」，做实验课时我没法接电话。

collocations: a message from the recruitment coordinator

words.enDefinition: A recurring period in which an employer recruits

examples.en: The recruitment cycle starts much earlier for some publishers than it does for theatres.
examples.zh: 有些出版社的「招聘周期」比剧院开始得早很多。

examples.en: The careers adviser explained when museums usually begin their recruitment cycle for summer work.
examples.zh: 就业顾问介绍了博物馆的暑期岗位「招聘周期」通常什么时候开始。

words.enDefinition: An explanation of how applicants' information is used

examples.en: I read the recruitment privacy notice before deciding which optional details to include.
examples.zh: 我先读了「招聘隐私通知」，再决定填写哪些选填信息。

examples.en: The recruitment privacy notice explains which information is shared with the hiring panel.
examples.zh: 「招聘隐私通知」说明了哪些信息会与招聘小组共享。

collocations: a link to the recruitment privacy notice

words.zhGloss: 隐去可能暴露身份的信息
words.enDefinition: to remove or cover information that could allow someone to identify a person or organization
acceptedZhAnswers: 隐去可能暴露身份的信息

examples.en: My supervisor asked me to redact identifying details before saving a shareable work sample.
examples.zh: 主管让我先「隐去可能暴露身份的信息」，再保存可以分享的作品样本。

examples.en: I learned to redact identifying details when preparing interview notes for the portfolio.
examples.zh: 整理要放进作品集的采访笔记时，我学会了怎样「隐去可能暴露身份的信息」。

collocations: redact identifying details from a document
ask someone to redact identifying details

words.zhGloss: 隐去敏感信息的作品样本
words.enDefinition: an example of past work with confidential or identifying details removed or covered
acceptedZhAnswers: 隐去敏感信息的作品样本

examples.en: My supervisor approved a redacted work sample from the report I wrote last spring.
examples.zh: 主管批准我用去年春天写的报告提供一份「隐去敏感信息的作品样本」。

examples.en: The employer said a redacted work sample would be suitable for the first review.
examples.zh: 雇主说，可以用「隐去敏感信息的作品样本」参加初审。

collocations: a redacted work sample from a report

words.enDefinition: To make a job or operation take less time to finish

examples.en: Our team combined two forms to reduce processing time for equipment requests.
examples.zh: 我们团队把两份设备申请表合二为一，从而「缩短处理时间」。

examples.en: I noted how we helped reduce processing time without removing any required checks.
examples.zh: 我写明了我们如何在保留必要检查的情况下帮助「缩短处理时间」。

words.zhGloss: 展示短片镜头分工说明
words.enDefinition: a list explaining the creator's contribution to individual shots or segments in a showreel
acceptedZhAnswers: 展示短片镜头分工说明

examples.en: My reel breakdown identifies the scenes I animated while working with two classmates.
examples.zh: 我的「展示短片镜头分工说明」标出了我和两名同学合作时负责制作动画的场景。

examples.en: The reviewer asked for a reel breakdown covering the clips in my submission.
examples.zh: 评审请我为提交的视频片段提供一份「展示短片镜头分工说明」。

words.enDefinition: to improve how code is organized without changing its observable behaviour

examples.en: I asked if I could refactor the code after getting the tests to pass.
examples.zh: 测试通过之后，我问能不能「重构代码」。

examples.en: The reviewer suggested I refactor the code to separate data loading from calculations.
examples.zh: 评审建议我「重构代码」，把加载数据和计算分开。

collocations: refactor the code into smaller functions

words.enDefinition: Information about someone who can provide a reference

examples.en: I checked my referee details before saving the last page of the form.
examples.zh: 保存表单的最后一页之前，我核对了「推荐人资料」。

examples.en: The portal asked for referee details but let me add them at a later stage.
examples.zh: 求职门户要求填写「推荐人资料」，但允许我之后再填。

words.enDefinition: Permission for an employer to contact one's references

examples.en: The last page asked for reference check consent before the full application could be submitted.
examples.zh: 提交完整申请之前，最后一页要求我「同意核查推荐信息」。

examples.en: I read the reference check consent section carefully to see what it covered.
examples.zh: 我仔细读了「推荐信息核查授权」那一栏，看看核查范围是什么。

words.enDefinition: A form asking a referee to provide information about an applicant

examples.en: My former manager asked who had sent the reference questionnaire about me.
examples.zh: 前经理问这份关于我的「推荐信息问卷」是谁发的。

examples.en: The reference questionnaire asked how long we had worked together at the library.
examples.zh: 「推荐信息问卷」问我们在图书馆一起工作了多久。

words.enDefinition: to state or refer to the specific title of the job in application materials

examples.en: My adviser asked me to reference the job title in the first sentence.
examples.zh: 顾问要我在第一句「写明岗位名称」。

examples.en: I made sure to reference the job title in both the email and the attachment.
examples.zh: 我在邮件和附件里都确认「写明了岗位名称」。

collocations: reference the job title in the opening
reference the job title in the subject line

words.enDefinition: An employer's scheme for staff to recommend candidates

examples.en: My former colleague said her company had a referral programme for open roles.
examples.zh: 我以前的同事说，她所在的公司有针对空缺职位的「员工内推计划」。

examples.en: The referral programme was described on a separate page from the public vacancy list.
examples.zh: 「员工内推计划」的说明和公开岗位列表放在不同的页面上。

words.enDefinition: To think carefully about a past event and what it taught you

examples.en: The interviewer asked me to reflect on an experience where I changed my mind.
examples.zh: 面试官让我「反思一段经历」，就是我曾改变主意的那一次。

examples.en: I used the practice session to reflect on an experience from my summer placement.
examples.zh: 我利用模拟面试「反思一段经历」，来自自己的暑期实习。

collocations: reflect on an experience at work
take time to reflect on an experience
reflect on an experience from university

words.enDefinition: a regular record of what you learn from your experiences

examples.en: I kept a reflective journal to record what surprised me each week at the archive.
examples.zh: 我写「反思日志」，记下每周在档案馆遇到的意外发现。

examples.en: My reflective journal helped me remember why I changed my approach halfway through the placement.
examples.zh: 「反思日志」帮我想起实习中途为什么换了做法。

words.enDefinition: reviewing your own work to improve how you do it

examples.en: Our tutor encouraged reflective practice by asking what we would do differently in the same situation.
examples.zh: 导师用问题启发我们做「反思性实践」，想想同样情况下自己会换什么做法。

examples.en: Reflective practice helped me notice why some discussions with the placement team went better than others.
examples.zh: 「反思性实践」让我发现，为什么有些和实习团队的讨论比其他时候更顺畅。

collocations: build in time for reflective practice

words.enDefinition: To practice saying a response before the real conversation

examples.en: I used a voice recorder to rehearse an answer about my summer placement.
examples.zh: 我借助录音设备「预先练习回答」，话题是我的暑期实习。

examples.en: We took turns so each of us could rehearse an answer and get feedback.
examples.zh: 我们轮流来，每个人都可以「预先练习回答」，再听听反馈。

collocations: rehearse an answer with a friend
rehearse an answer before an interview

words.enDefinition: A stated reason an application was not accepted

examples.en: The portal didn't display a rejection reason for the position at the campus library.
examples.zh: 求职门户没有显示这个校园图书馆职位的「申请被拒原因」。

examples.en: I saw a rejection reason next to my application after the initial screening ended.
examples.zh: 初筛结束后，我在申请旁边看到了「申请被拒原因」。

words.enDefinition: Classes a student has taken that relate to particular work

examples.en: I kept statistics and database design under relevant coursework for the analyst position.
examples.zh: 申请分析师岗位时，我在「相关课程」里保留了统计学和数据库设计。

examples.en: She moved relevant coursework below her degree because it explained her technical background.
examples.zh: 她把「相关课程」移到学位下方，因为这些课能说明她的技术背景。

words.enDefinition: past work or activities that relate to the role

examples.en: I asked whether my campus radio work counted as relevant experience for the role.
examples.zh: 我问我在校园电台做过的事算不算这个岗位的「相关经历」。

examples.en: The shop accepts relevant experience from volunteering as well as from previous paid jobs.
examples.zh: 这家商店认可从志愿服务和以往有薪工作中积累的「相关经历」。

words.enDefinition: Abilities that relate directly to the work being sought

examples.en: I put spreadsheet analysis under relevant skills for the finance internship.
examples.zh: 我申请财务实习时，把电子表格分析放在「相关技能」一栏。

examples.en: The workshop showed how to back up relevant skills with specific examples.
examples.zh: 讲座示范了如何用具体事例佐证「相关技能」。

words.enDefinition: Help with moving for a new job

examples.en: I asked whether relocation assistance covered a move from the other side of the city.
examples.zh: 我问从城市另一边搬家是否在「搬迁援助」范围内。

examples.en: The offer summary described relocation assistance separately from the salary for my new role.
examples.zh: 录用摘要把「搬迁援助」和我新岗位的薪资分开说明。

words.enDefinition: a coworker who usually works from another location instead of a shared office

examples.en: I sent the photographs to a remote colleague before the exhibition opened.
examples.zh: 展览开幕前，我把照片发给了一位「远程办公的同事」。

examples.en: A remote colleague joined the discussion by video while we used the meeting room.
examples.zh: 我们在会议室讨论，一位「远程办公的同事」通过视频加入。

collocations: share files with a remote colleague

words.enDefinition: a job done away from the employer's workplace

examples.en: The remote position would let me work from home once I finished the training.
examples.zh: 培训结束后，这个「远程办公岗位」允许我居家工作。

examples.en: I checked the hours because the remote position was based in a different time zone.
examples.zh: 我查了工作时间，因为这个「远程办公岗位」的团队在另一个时区。

words.enDefinition: to take out words or phrases that add no useful information

examples.en: The tutor asked me to remove filler from the first two sentences.
examples.zh: 导师让我把前两句里的「赘词删去」。

examples.en: I needed to remove filler so the project example stood out more clearly.
examples.zh: 我得「删去赘词」，让项目例子更醒目。

collocations: revise a paragraph to remove filler

words.enDefinition: To make a closed application active again

examples.en: The administrator offered to reopen an application after confirming that the upload had failed.
examples.zh: 确认上传失败后，管理员提出可以「重新开放这份申请」。

examples.en: I asked whether the department could reopen an application so I could correct one answer.
examples.zh: 我问部门能不能「重新开放申请」，让我改一道题的答案。

words.enDefinition: do another placement after an earlier attempt did not count

examples.en: I asked whether I could repeat a placement after the first attempt was interrupted.
examples.zh: 第一次实习中途被打断后，我问能不能「重做一次实习」。

examples.en: The course office explained how to repeat a placement if the original hours were incomplete.
examples.zh: 课程办公室说明了原来的实习时数没做够时，怎么「重做一次实习」。

collocations: be allowed to repeat a placement

words.enDefinition: To express the same response in a different and clearer way

examples.en: The tutor asked me to rephrase an answer that was difficult to follow.
examples.zh: 导师让我把一段不容易听懂的答案「换个说法重述」。

examples.en: I practiced how to rephrase an answer without changing any of the facts.
examples.zh: 我练习怎样在保留原有事实的情况下「换个说法重述答案」。

collocations: ask someone to rephrase an answer
rephrase an answer in simpler language

words.enDefinition: respond to the person concerned without involving other recipients

examples.en: The coordinator asked me to reply directly rather than send my availability to the full panel.
examples.zh: 协调员让我「直接回复」本人，别把空闲时间发给整个评审组。

examples.en: I could reply directly to the manager once the recruiter shared the correct address.
examples.zh: 招聘人员给了正确地址后，我就可以「直接回复」经理。

words.enDefinition: to tell the relevant person what issue is preventing work from moving forward

examples.en: I used the team channel to report a blocker with the room booking form.
examples.zh: 我在团队频道「报告了阻碍进度的问题」，说明预约表出了什么问题。

examples.en: The supervisor asked us to report a blocker before changing any agreed deadlines.
examples.zh: 主管要求我们先「报告阻碍进度的问题」，再改商定的截止时间。

collocations: report a blocker to your manager
use the task board to report a blocker

words.enDefinition: be directly accountable to a particular manager or supervisor

examples.en: The listing says I'll report directly to the museum manager instead of the events coordinator.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着，我会「直接向博物馆经理汇报」，不是向活动协调员汇报。

examples.en: Our student assistants report directly to the head librarian on the days they work.
examples.zh: 学生助理在上班的日子「直接向图书馆馆长汇报」。

collocations: report directly to the team lead

words.enDefinition: To inform a designated office about changes in one's employment

examples.en: The adviser explained whom to contact to report employment changes during practical training.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了进行专业实践时，应联系谁「报告就业变更」。

examples.en: I asked where the form for students to report employment changes was listed.
examples.zh: 我问供学生「报告就业变更」的表格列在哪里。

collocations: report employment changes to the school
instructions on how to report employment changes

words.enDefinition: To arrive at the workplace ready to begin

examples.en: The email told me when to report for work at the second library branch.
examples.zh: 邮件告诉我什么时候去图书馆第二分馆「报到」。

examples.en: I was asked to report for work at the front desk before nine on Monday.
examples.zh: 对方让我周一九点前到前台「报到」。

collocations: be asked to report for work

words.enDefinition: to work under the direct supervision of a specified person

examples.en: I report to the evening supervisor whenever I cover shifts at the main desk.
examples.zh: 我去总服务台代班时，都会「向晚班主管汇报工作」。

examples.en: During the holidays, student assistants report to whichever manager is on duty.
examples.zh: 放假期间，学生助理「向当班的经理汇报工作」。

collocations: report to the head of operations

words.enDefinition: Directions for arriving at the workplace to start

examples.en: The attached reporting instructions told me which entrance to use before the office opened.
examples.zh: 所附「报到须知」告诉我办公室开门前该走哪个入口。

examples.en: I reread the reporting instructions to find the name of the person meeting me.
examples.zh: 我重读了「报到须知」，想找来接我的人的姓名。

words.enDefinition: the formal relationship showing whom a worker or team reports to

examples.en: The diagram shows the reporting line from the assistants to the duty manager.
examples.zh: 这张图显示了助理向值班经理汇报的「汇报关系」。

examples.en: I asked how my reporting line would change when I moved to another team.
examples.zh: 我问转到另一个团队后，我的「汇报关系」会怎么变。

collocations: a change in your reporting line

words.enDefinition: The place where a new worker should first arrive

examples.en: The letter gave a reporting location on campus rather than the branch in town.
examples.zh: 信上给的「报到地点」在校园里，不是在市区的分店。

examples.en: I checked the reporting location because the library has two entrances on different streets.
examples.zh: 图书馆的两个入口在不同街上，所以我核对了「报到地点」。

words.enDefinition: The time a new worker is expected to arrive

examples.en: The reporting time was earlier than the start of my shift on the schedule.
examples.zh: 「报到时间」比排班表上的上班时间早。

examples.en: Could you confirm the reporting time for everyone starting at the museum next Monday?
examples.zh: 您能确认下周一在博物馆开始工作的人员的「报到时间」吗？

words.enDefinition: A job listing published again after an earlier posting

examples.en: I recognised a reposted job because the description matched one I'd read last month.
examples.zh: 我认出这是个「重新发布的职位」，因为它和我上月看过的职位描述一样。

examples.en: The reposted job appeared near the top of the results on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 周一早上，那个「重新发布的职位」出现在搜索结果的前几条。

words.enDefinition: ask to move from one training site to another

examples.en: I decided to request a placement transfer when my commute increased to two hours.
examples.zh: 通勤变成要两个小时后，我决定「申请更换实习单位」。

examples.en: The tutor explained who to contact if I needed to request a placement transfer.
examples.zh: 导师告诉我，如果需要「申请更换实习单位」，该联系谁。

collocations: need to request a placement transfer
request a placement transfer to another site
decide to request a placement transfer

words.enDefinition: To ask for a change addressing an access need

examples.en: The portal explains how to request an adjustment when filling in the online form.
examples.zh: 求职门户说明了填写在线表单时如何「申请无障碍调整」。

examples.en: I wanted to request an adjustment because the document viewer didn't work with my screen reader.
examples.zh: 材料查看器和我的屏幕阅读器不兼容，所以我想「申请无障碍调整」。

collocations: request an adjustment for an assessment
a way to request an adjustment

words.enDefinition: to ask for permission to use a work system or see its records

examples.en: I had to request system access before checking room availability from the desk.
