examples.zh: 我得「申请系统访问权限」，才能在柜台查看房间是否空闲。

examples.en: The guide says to request system access through the internal support form.
examples.zh: 指南说，要用内部支持表格「申请系统访问权限」。

collocations: request system access for a new employee

words.enDefinition: to ask a manager or employer for a period away from work

examples.en: I used the staff portal to request time off before my final project presentation.
examples.zh: 毕业项目展示之前，我在员工平台上「申请休假」。

examples.en: The handbook says to request time off through the supervisor who prepares the schedule.
examples.zh: 手册说要通过负责排班的主管「申请休假」。

collocations: request time off through the portal
request time off for an appointment

words.enDefinition: A file that must accompany the application

examples.en: The upload page has one required attachment and space for three optional files.
examples.zh: 上传页面有一个「必交附件」，还能加三个选交文件。

examples.en: I couldn't submit until I replaced the required attachment with a readable copy.
examples.zh: 我把那个「必交附件」换成清晰的副本后，才可以提交。

words.enDefinition: A form field that must be completed

examples.en: The portal highlighted a required field I had missed on the final page.
examples.zh: 门户高亮标出了最后一页上我漏填的一个「必填项」。

examples.en: I couldn't continue until I entered a telephone number in the required field.
examples.zh: 我在「必填项」里填上电话号码后，才能继续。

words.enDefinition: The form in which information must be entered

examples.en: I found the required format for dates beside the first box on the page.
examples.zh: 我在页面第一个输入框旁边找到了日期的「指定格式」。

examples.en: The required format for the document was shown beneath the upload button in small text.
examples.zh: 材料的「指定格式」用小字显示在上传按钮下面。

words.enDefinition: abilities an employer expects every suitable applicant to have

examples.en: I had most of the required skills, but the spreadsheet test was new to me.
examples.zh: 「必备技能」我大多具备，只是没做过电子表格测试。

examples.en: The required skills include using a till and speaking clearly with people over the phone.
examples.zh: 「必备技能」包括会用收银机，以及能在电话里和人清楚地沟通。

words.enDefinition: Evidence an applicant has to supply

examples.en: The portal listed the required supporting evidence beside the eligibility questions on the first page.
examples.zh: 求职门户在第一页的资格问题旁列出了「必交证明材料」。

examples.en: I checked which documents counted as required supporting evidence before contacting the records office.
examples.zh: 联系档案办公室前，我查了哪些文件可以作为「必交证明材料」。

words.enDefinition: Past involvement in systematic inquiry or the collection and analysis of evidence

examples.en: I added my research experience from the lab to the version for graduate applications.
examples.zh: 我把在实验室的「科研经历」加进了申请研究生用的版本。

examples.en: Her research experience includes interviews with students who commute to the campus.
examples.zh: 她的「科研经历」包括采访通勤到校的学生。

words.enDefinition: Topics or questions that someone is interested in investigating

examples.en: I listed my research interests near the top of the academic CV.
examples.zh: 我在学术履历靠近开头的地方列出了「研究兴趣」。

examples.en: My supervisor asked whether my research interests had changed since the fieldwork.
examples.zh: 导师问这次田野调查后我的「研究兴趣」是否变了。

words.enDefinition: an internship involving work on a research project

examples.en: I spent my research internship comparing how local newspapers reported changes to the bus routes.
examples.zh: 我在「科研实习」期间比较了本地几家报纸是如何报道公交线路变化的。

examples.en: The research internship ended with a short presentation about the records we had reviewed.
examples.zh: 「科研实习」以一场简短的汇报收尾，讲的是我们查过的记录。

words.enDefinition: A list of candidates who may be considered later

examples.en: The notification said I was on the reserve list for the library assistant role.
examples.zh: 通知说我在图书馆助理职位的「候补名单」上。

examples.en: I asked whether the reserve list applied to future openings or only this vacancy.
examples.zh: 我问「候补名单」也适用于将来的空缺，还是只适用于这个岗位。

collocations: be placed on a reserve list
select someone from a reserve list

words.enDefinition: To address customers' concerns and help reach an acceptable solution

examples.en: The part-time job taught me to resolve customer complaints calmly during busy shifts.
examples.zh: 在这份兼职中，我学会了在忙碌时冷静地「解决顾客投诉」。

examples.en: I worked with a supervisor to resolve customer complaints about incorrect library charges.
examples.zh: 我和主管一起「解决顾客投诉」，处理图书馆收费出错的问题。

words.enDefinition: To give an employer a reply about an offer

examples.en: The portal explained how to respond to an offer from a university department.
examples.zh: 门户说明了如何「回复大学一个部门发出的录用通知」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could respond to an offer by email before the portal closed.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在门户关闭前用邮件「回复录用通知」。

collocations: respond to an offer by email
time to respond to an offer

words.enDefinition: The last time a corrected application may be sent

examples.en: The resubmission deadline appeared at the top of my application after it was returned.
examples.zh: 申请被退回后，「重新提交截止时间」显示在申请顶部。

examples.en: I checked the resubmission deadline before asking the student records office for another copy.
examples.zh: 向学生档案办公室再要一份副本前，我先查看了「重新提交截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: To send an existing application again

examples.en: Can I resubmit an application after replacing the document that the department couldn't open?
examples.zh: 更换部门打不开的文件后，我可以「重新提交申请」吗？

examples.en: The portal gave me one day to resubmit an application with the corrected certificate.
examples.zh: 门户给了我一天时间，让我用更正后的证书「重新提交申请」。

collocations: give someone time to resubmit an application
be able to resubmit an application

words.enDefinition: to send your work again after changing it or after an earlier submission

examples.en: The instructions say you can resubmit your solution before the window closes.
examples.zh: 说明说，在提交窗口关闭前可以「重新提交你的解法」。

examples.en: You will need to resubmit your solution after saving the corrected file.
examples.zh: 保存改好的文件后，你需要「重新提交你的解法」。

collocations: resubmit your solution before the deadline
be allowed to resubmit your solution
resubmit your solution after correcting it

words.enDefinition: To return to an unfinished application

examples.en: I logged in again to resume an application I had started before my shift.
examples.zh: 我重新登录，想接着「填完上班前开始写的申请」。

examples.en: Can I resume an application on another device after saving the questions I've answered?
examples.zh: 保存已答的问题后，我能换一台设备「继续填写申请」吗？

words.enDefinition: An unfinished version of a document summarizing a job applicant's background

examples.en: My resume draft still had notes beside the entries I needed to check.
examples.zh: 我的「简历初稿」仍在待核实的条目旁留有备注。

examples.en: I shared a resume draft with my roommate before visiting the careers center.
examples.zh: 去就业中心前，我把「简历初稿」发给了室友。

words.enDefinition: The opening area displaying a job applicant's name and contact information

examples.en: I moved my phone number into the resume header beside my email address.
examples.zh: 我把电话号码移到了「简历页首」，放在邮箱地址旁边。

examples.en: My resume header took up too much room at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 我的「简历页首」占用了页面顶部太多空间。

collocations: include your email in the resume header

words.enDefinition: Terms that signal skills, tools, or experience relevant to a role

examples.en: I chose resume keywords that reflected both the posting and my actual experience.
examples.zh: 我选择的「简历关键词」既呼应了招聘信息，也符合我的实际经历。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the resume keywords matched the tools I had used.
examples.zh: 顾问问这些「简历关键词」是否与我实际使用过的工具相符。

words.enDefinition: Automated extraction of details from a job applicant's document

examples.en: The test showed that resume parsing placed my department in the wrong field.
examples.zh: 测试显示，「简历信息解析」把我的院系放进了错误的栏目。

examples.en: Our workshop compared resume parsing results from two versions of the same file.
examples.zh: 讲座上，我们比较了同一文件两个版本的「简历信息解析」结果。

words.enDefinition: An assessment of how clearly and effectively a document presents relevant experience

examples.en: I booked a resume review to ask whether my project descriptions made sense.
examples.zh: 我预约了「简历审阅」，想问一下我的项目描述是否容易理解。

examples.en: During the resume review, we found two different dates for the same job.
examples.zh: 在「简历审阅」时，我们发现同一份工作写了两个不同的日期。

words.enDefinition: A sample document with a reusable layout for summarizing experience

examples.en: I downloaded a resume template from the careers center and replaced the example text.
examples.zh: 我从就业中心下载了「简历模板」，换掉了其中的示例文字。

examples.en: The resume template had space for two projects below the education section.
examples.zh: 这份「简历模板」在教育背景栏下方留出了两个项目的位置。

words.enDefinition: an offer from a placement employer to come back for another role

examples.en: I received a return offer from the museum for a full-time position after graduation.
examples.zh: 我收到了博物馆在「实习后发的返聘邀约」，请我毕业后去做全职。

examples.en: The supervisor said a return offer might be possible for the next summer internship period.
examples.zh: 带教老师说，实习结束后，他们可能会发「返聘邀约」，请我明年夏天回来。

words.enDefinition: a meeting to discuss an employee's return after a period away from work

examples.en: My supervisor arranged a return-to-work meeting after I came back from sick leave.
examples.zh: 病假结束后，主管安排了一次「复工沟通会」。

examples.en: At the return-to-work meeting, we discussed which duties I could start with.
examples.zh: 「复工沟通会」上，我们谈了我可以先做哪些工作。

words.enDefinition: Sent back so that errors can be fixed

examples.en: The portal marked my application as Returned for correction after finding a date mismatch.
examples.zh: 求职门户发现日期不一致后，将我的申请标为「已退回待更正」。

examples.en: One application was returned for correction because a required page had been left blank.
examples.zh: 一份申请由于必填页面留空，「被退回待更正」。

collocations: mark a submission as returned for correction

words.enDefinition: an intern who comes back after a previous internship with the same employer

examples.en: As a returning intern, I spent less time learning how the archive was organized.
examples.zh: 作为「再次来实习的学生」，我不用花那么多时间熟悉档案馆的布局。

examples.en: A returning intern showed our group where the team kept examples from earlier projects.
examples.zh: 一位「再次来实习的学生」给我们小组指了指团队以前的项目案例放在哪里。

collocations: a returning intern from last year

words.enDefinition: A repeated check of a worker's employment authorization in US records

examples.en: Human resources asked which date was shown for reverification in my record.
examples.zh: 人力资源部门问我的档案里「重新核验就业许可」的日期是哪天。

examples.en: I found the reverification note next to the date of my appointment.
examples.zh: 我在预约日期旁找到了「重新核验就业许可」的备注。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement that lists the most recent entry first

examples.en: I listed my campus jobs in reverse chronological order so the latest one appeared first.
examples.zh: 我按「时间倒序」列出校内工作经历，把最近的一份放在最前面。

examples.en: Our adviser showed us two education sections written in reverse chronological order.
examples.zh: 顾问给我们看了两份按「时间倒序」写的教育背景栏。

collocations: list jobs in reverse chronological order
arrange entries in reverse chronological order
present experience in reverse chronological order

words.enDefinition: A page showing entries so they can be checked

examples.en: I spotted the wrong phone number on the review screen and went back to edit it.
examples.zh: 我在「提交前核对页面」发现电话号码不对，就返回去改了。

examples.en: The review screen showed my answers and the names of the documents I had attached.
examples.zh: 「提交前核对页面」显示了我的答案和所附材料的文件名。

words.enDefinition: To examine the details before deciding about an offer

examples.en: I took the evening to review the offer once I got home from class.
examples.zh: 我下课回家后，花了一晚上「仔细查看录用内容」。

examples.en: Can I review the offer on the portal before confirming that I've received it?
examples.zh: 我能先在门户上「仔细查看录用内容」，再确认已收到吗？

collocations: take time to review the offer
a chance to review the offer

words.enDefinition: An offer with changes to its earlier details

examples.en: The revised offer reflected the new start date we had agreed on by phone.
examples.zh: 「修改后的录用通知」写入了我们电话里商定的新到岗日期。

examples.en: I received a revised offer after pointing out that the office location was incorrect.
examples.zh: 我指出办公地点有误后，收到了一份「修改后的录用通知」。

words.enDefinition: to consider a previous decision again, often after circumstances or information change

examples.en: We agreed to revisit a decision after checking how many students actually registered.
examples.zh: 我们同意查清实际注册人数之后，再「重新讨论一项决定」。

examples.en: The new figures led the team to revisit a decision about desk coverage.
examples.zh: 有了新数据，团队决定「重新讨论一项决定」，也就是柜台怎么排人。

collocations: revisit a decision with new information
revisit a decision at the next meeting

words.enDefinition: return to a discussion after leaving it for a while

examples.en: Could we revisit the conversation once I know where my placement will be based?
examples.zh: 等我知道要去哪儿实习，能不能「再谈这个话题」？

examples.en: We agreed to revisit the conversation after the museum confirmed its plans for the summer.
examples.zh: 我们说好等博物馆确认暑期安排后，「再谈这个话题」。

collocations: come back and revisit the conversation

words.enDefinition: Permission under applicable immigration rules to take up employment

examples.en: The UK employer asked what I could show as evidence of my right to work.
examples.zh: 英国雇主问我能提供什么来证明自己的「合法工作资格」。

examples.en: Our adviser explained where the guidance talked about the right to work.
examples.zh: 顾问指出指南在哪里介绍了「合法工作资格」。

collocations: evidence of a right to work

words.enDefinition: The UK process for employers to verify someone's permission to work

examples.en: The British university recorded the date of my right to work check before orientation.
examples.zh: 英国这所大学在入职介绍会前记录了我的「工作资格核验」日期。

examples.en: I asked which office conducted the right to work check for placement students.
examples.zh: 我问哪个办公室为实习学生做「工作资格核验」。

collocations: carry out a right to work check
complete a right to work check
a right to work check result

words.enDefinition: A code giving a UK employer access to online work rights information

examples.en: I asked who would receive my right to work share code at the university.
examples.zh: 我问大学里谁会收到我的「工作资格查询分享码」。

examples.en: The UK guidance used a sample right to work share code to explain the online check.
examples.zh: 英国指南用一个「工作资格查询分享码」样本说明怎样进行在线核验。

collocations: provide a right to work share code
generate a right to work share code
use a right to work share code

words.enDefinition: an account of what each person was responsible for in shared work

examples.en: The role breakdown lets readers tell which parts I designed and which my partner wrote.
examples.zh: 「各成员的分工说明」让读者看出哪些部分是我设计的，哪些是搭档写的。

examples.en: I added a role breakdown because the project involved people from three courses.
examples.zh: 这个项目有三门课的同学参加，我加了一份「各成员的分工说明」。

collocations: a role breakdown for the team

words.enDefinition: Recruitment for a position has been called off

examples.en: The portal showed Role cancelled after the department changed its plans for the summer.
examples.zh: 部门调整暑期计划后，求职门户显示「岗位招聘已取消」。

examples.en: I read Role cancelled next to one of the roles on my candidate dashboard.
examples.zh: 我在申请总览的一个职位旁看到了「岗位招聘已取消」。

words.enDefinition: A short account of the work someone does in a role

examples.en: My role description explains what I did at the library during evening shifts.
examples.zh: 我的「岗位职责描述」说明了我在图书馆上晚班时做了什么。

examples.en: The adviser shortened the role description to make room for one achievement.
examples.zh: 顾问缩短了「岗位职责描述」，以腾出位置写一项成果。

words.enDefinition: a short summary of a job's main purpose

examples.en: The role overview made it clear that most of the work was done off campus.
examples.zh: 「岗位概览」写得很清楚，大部分工作在校外做。

examples.en: I read the role overview to see whether the job involved working with children.
examples.zh: 我读了「岗位概览」，看看这份工作是否需要和孩子打交道。

words.enDefinition: an activity in which participants act out assigned roles in a simulated situation

examples.en: The role-play exercise asked me to explain a late delivery to a customer.
examples.zh: 「角色扮演练习」让我向一位顾客解释为什么送货晚了。

examples.en: I received a short description of my part before the role-play exercise began.
examples.zh: 「角色扮演练习」开始前，我收到了一段简短的角色说明。

collocations: take part in a role-play exercise

words.enDefinition: Applications accepted and handled as they arrive

examples.en: The employer accepts rolling applications and reviews forms in the order they arrive.
examples.zh: 雇主「滚动受理申请」，按表单收到的顺序审核。

examples.en: I asked whether rolling applications would continue after the next group of positions was advertised.
examples.zh: 我问下一批职位发布后，是否还会「滚动受理申请」。

words.enDefinition: Flexibility to change what has been proposed

examples.en: I asked whether there was room to negotiate on the day I would start.
examples.zh: 我问到岗日期有没有「协商空间」。

examples.en: The department said there was little room to negotiate because the hours were fixed.
examples.zh: 部门说工时是固定的，所以「协商空间」很小。

words.enDefinition: work shifts that change regularly from one schedule to another

examples.en: The role includes rotating shifts, so the same person does not always cover weekends.
examples.zh: 这个岗位有「轮换班次」，所以不会总是同一个人周末值班。

examples.en: I couldn't commit to rotating shifts until I got my timetable for next semester.
examples.zh: 在拿到下学期的课表前，我没法确定自己能不能接受「轮换班次」。

words.enDefinition: a discussion after a rotation about what happened and was learned

examples.en: We took notes for the rotation debrief after completing our final project with the sales team.
examples.zh: 完成和销售团队合作的最后一个项目后，我们做了笔记，准备「轮岗总结交流」。

examples.en: During the rotation debrief, I described the part of the project I found most useful.
examples.zh: 在「轮岗总结交流」时，我讲了项目中自己觉得最有用的部分。

words.enDefinition: a timetable showing when someone will work with each team

examples.en: I checked the rotation schedule before booking travel to the branch across the city.
examples.zh: 订票去城市另一边的分部前，我查了「轮岗时间表」。

examples.en: The rotation schedule lists where we'll work each month and who will supervise us.
examples.zh: 「轮岗时间表」列出了每月的工作地点和负责带教的人。

words.enDefinition: a training program where participants work in several roles or teams

examples.en: I chose a rotational program because I wanted experience in both design and operations.
examples.zh: 我选择了「轮岗培养项目」，因为想在设计和运营两个方面积累经验。

examples.en: The rotational program includes time in three departments before trainees choose a specialist team.
examples.zh: 在选择专门的团队前，培训生会在「轮岗培养项目」里到三个部门工作。

words.enDefinition: an approximate schedule that can be refined when more details are known

examples.en: I brought a rough timeline to the meeting so the team could suggest dates.
examples.zh: 我带去一份「大致时间安排」，让团队在会上提出建议日期。

examples.en: The rough timeline left two weeks for checking the exhibition materials before printing.
examples.zh: 「大致时间安排」在印刷前留了两周核对展览材料。

words.enDefinition: To manage the arrangements and practical work for an event

examples.en: I volunteered to run an event for students who stayed on campus during the break.
examples.zh: 我主动为假期留在校园的学生「组织活动」。

examples.en: My CV explains how I helped run an event that drew eighty students.
examples.zh: 我的简历介绍了我如何协助「组织活动」，吸引八十名学生参加。

words.enDefinition: an error that happens while a program is running

examples.en: The runtime error happened when the code tried to read an empty list.
examples.zh: 代码尝试读取空列表时，出现了「运行时错误」。

examples.en: The platform showed a runtime error on one case but accepted the other tests.
examples.zh: 平台显示其中一个用例有「运行时错误」，其他测试都通过了。

words.enDefinition: the longest time a program is allowed to run before being stopped

examples.en: My first solution worked, but it exceeded the runtime limit for longer inputs.
examples.zh: 我的第一个解法能得到结果，但处理较长输入时超过了「运行时间上限」。

examples.en: I checked the runtime limit before choosing which sample to test first.
examples.zh: 我先查了「运行时间上限」，再决定先测哪个样例。

words.enDefinition: A change to the amount of salary

examples.en: The second letter showed a salary adjustment after the department checked my previous experience.
examples.zh: 系里核查我以前的经验后，第二封信显示有一项「薪资调整」。

examples.en: I asked whether the salary adjustment would appear in the final offer before I signed.
examples.zh: 我问签署前能不能在最终录用通知里看到「薪资调整」。

words.enDefinition: The pay a candidate hopes to receive

examples.en: The hiring manager asked about my salary expectations after describing the duties of the job.
examples.zh: 招聘经理介绍完岗位职责后，问我「薪资期望」是多少。

examples.en: I asked whether I could discuss salary expectations once I knew the exact hours.
examples.zh: 我问能不能等确定具体工时后再谈「薪资期望」。

words.enDefinition: Discussion aimed at agreeing on pay for a job

examples.en: The salary negotiation took place after the department made its first offer by email.
examples.zh: 部门通过邮件发来初步录用通知后，双方进行了「薪资谈判」。

examples.en: I discussed my previous library work during the salary negotiation for the new role.
examples.zh: 就新岗位进行「薪资谈判」时，我谈到了之前在图书馆的工作。

words.enDefinition: the span between the lowest and highest salaries listed for a job

examples.en: The salary range appears near the bottom of the listing, just above the benefits.
examples.zh: 「薪资范围」在招聘启事靠下的位置，就在福利说明上面。

examples.en: I asked whether the salary range applied to the part-time version of the role.
examples.zh: 我问这个「薪资范围」是否也适用于兼职岗位。

words.enDefinition: Looking up typical pay for particular jobs

examples.en: My salary research showed that the same role paid differently in the two cities.
examples.zh: 我的「薪资调研」显示，同一岗位在两座城市的待遇不同。

examples.en: The careers office offers links to reports that are useful for salary research.
examples.zh: 学校就业办公室提供了一些有助于「薪资调研」的报告链接。

collocations: a starting point for salary research

words.enDefinition: A study collecting information about what workers earn

examples.en: I found a salary survey that broke down pay by city and type of employer.
examples.zh: 我找到一份「薪酬调查」，按城市和雇主类型细分了薪资。

examples.en: The salary survey included recent graduates who had joined local publishing firms that year.
examples.zh: 这份「薪酬调查」纳入了当年入职本地出版社的应届毕业生。

collocations: take part in a salary survey

words.enDefinition: a limited set of data provided as an example or for practice

examples.en: I loaded the sample dataset to see how the records had been organized.
examples.zh: 我加载了「示例数据集」，查看记录是怎样组织的。

examples.en: The sample dataset contained fewer entries than the one used for final marking.
examples.zh: 「示例数据集」里的条目比用于最终评分的数据集少。

words.enDefinition: a short part taken from a longer document or work sample

examples.en: I sent a sample excerpt because the full report ran to forty pages.
examples.zh: 完整报告有四十页，所以我只发了一段「样本节选」。

examples.en: My sample excerpt starts with the section where I explain the research method.
examples.zh: 我的「样本节选」从我说明研究方法的那一节开始。

collocations: a sample excerpt from a report

words.enDefinition: example data provided to show how a program receives information

examples.en: I copied the sample input into my editor to check how the program responded.
examples.zh: 我把「示例输入」复制到编辑器里，看看程序会怎样响应。

examples.en: The prompt included sample input with three rows of ordinary student attendance data.
examples.zh: 题目给的「示例输入」有三行普通的学生出勤数据。

words.enDefinition: an example result showing what a program should produce for a given input

examples.en: The sample output showed that the result needed to appear on one line.
examples.zh: 「示例输出」显示，结果需要放在一行上。

examples.en: I compared my first result with the sample output in the instructions.
examples.zh: 我把第一次运行的结果与说明中的「示例输出」做了对照。

words.enDefinition: Search settings stored for future use

examples.en: I opened a saved search instead of typing the same keywords again on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上打开了一个「已保存的搜索」，省得再输同样的关键词。

examples.en: The site let me give each saved search a name so I could tell them apart.
examples.zh: 网站让我给每个「已保存的搜索」起个名字，这样可以区分开。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement that lets readers locate important details quickly

examples.en: The adviser suggested a scannable layout so recruiters could find my project work quickly.
examples.zh: 顾问建议用「便于扫读的版式」，方便招聘人员快速找到我的项目经历。

examples.en: The scannable layout put headings in bold and left space between sections.
examples.zh: 「便于扫读的版式」把栏目标题加粗，并在栏目之间留出空白。

words.enDefinition: A digital image made from a paper document

examples.en: I uploaded a scanned copy of the certificate I received after finishing the course.
examples.zh: 我上传了结课后收到的证书的「扫描件」。

examples.en: The scanned copy showed the seal more clearly after I adjusted the brightness.
examples.zh: 我调了亮度后，「扫描件」上的印章更清楚了。

words.enDefinition: The tasks and decisions a person is expected to handle

examples.en: I explained my scope of responsibility by listing the decisions I could make independently.
examples.zh: 我列出自己能独立作出的决定，说明「职责范围」。

examples.en: The scope of responsibility grew when I started organizing shifts for new volunteers.
examples.zh: 我开始给新志愿者排班后，「职责范围」扩大了。

words.enDefinition: A guide describing how different levels of performance will be rated

examples.en: The mock interview used a scoring rubric with separate scores for each answer.
examples.zh: 这次模拟面试用「评分细则」给每个回答单独打分。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how to read a scoring rubric before we assessed sample answers.
examples.zh: 我们给示例答案评分之前，导师解释了怎样读「评分细则」。

words.enDefinition: A difference between information revealed by screening and the information provided

examples.en: The coordinator asked about a screening discrepancy involving my previous job title.
examples.zh: 协调员问到一处「筛查结果与资料不符」，涉及我以前的职位名称。

examples.en: I sent a letter confirming the correct dates to explain the screening discrepancy.
examples.zh: 我发了一封确认正确日期的信，解释为何「筛查结果与资料不符」。

words.enDefinition: The result of an initial assessment of an application

examples.en: The screening outcome appeared in the portal before I received any further instructions.
examples.zh: 我还没收到后续说明，「筛选结果」就已经显示在门户里了。

examples.en: I checked whether the screening outcome listed a reason or just the next step.
examples.zh: 我看了「筛选结果」有没有写明原因，还是只列出下一步。

words.enDefinition: A company that checks records on behalf of an organization

examples.en: The human resources team told me which screening provider handled the report.
examples.zh: 人力资源团队告诉我是哪家「筛查服务机构」处理了这份报告。

examples.en: I asked the screening provider whether the report used my latest address.
examples.zh: 我问「筛查服务机构」，报告是否用了我的最新地址。

words.enDefinition: A question used to assess applicants at first

examples.en: One screening question asked whether I could work at both branches of the library.
examples.zh: 有一道「初筛问题」问我能不能在图书馆两家分馆工作。

examples.en: I read each screening question carefully before selecting my answer from the list.
examples.zh: 我仔细读完每道「初筛问题」，才从列表里选答案。

words.enDefinition: To find listings using the role's name

examples.en: The portal lets me search by job title when I know exactly what I want.
examples.zh: 明确想找什么工作时，我可以在平台上「按职位名称搜索」。

examples.en: Did you search by job title or just enter the name of the company?
examples.zh: 你是「按职位名称搜索」的，还是只输入了公司名称？

collocations: search by job title on a portal
choose to search by job title
search by job title and location

words.enDefinition: The maximum distance searched around a location

examples.en: I set the search radius to ten kilometres around the station in my town.
examples.zh: 我把「搜索半径」设为小镇车站周围十公里。

examples.en: The jobs page showed more listings after I increased the search radius on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上调大「搜索半径」后，求职页面显示了更多职位。

words.enDefinition: A word or phrase entered for searching

examples.en: I changed the search term from museum to gallery and got different results.
examples.zh: 我把「搜索词」从博物馆改成美术馆，结果就不一样了。

examples.en: That search term was too broad to find the kind of work I wanted.
examples.zh: 那个「搜索词」范围太广，搜不到我想找的那类工作。

words.enDefinition: work available during a particular time of year

examples.en: I did seasonal work at a visitor centre between the end of exams and September.
examples.zh: 我考完试到九月份之间，在游客中心做了份「季节性工作」。

examples.en: The shop offers seasonal work when it needs extra staff during the winter holidays.
examples.zh: 冬季假期需要更多人手时，这家商店会招人做「季节性工作」。

words.enDefinition: The interview following an employer's first interview in the same process

examples.en: My second-round interview included questions about decisions I made during my placement.
examples.zh: 我的「第二轮面试」问到了一些我在实习时作过的决定。

examples.en: The second-round interview focused more on teamwork than my first meeting did.
examples.zh: 相比第一次面谈，「第二轮面试」更关注团队合作。

words.enDefinition: a temporary move to another role, team, or organization

examples.en: After the graduate scheme, I went on secondment to the museum's regional team in Wales.
examples.zh: 毕业生培养项目结束后，我被「短期借调」到博物馆在威尔士的区域团队。

examples.en: My mentor returned from secondment and told us what she learned at the partner organization.
examples.zh: 导师「短期借调」回来，给我们讲了她在合作机构学到的东西。

words.enDefinition: An agreement setting terms for temporary work with another team or organization

examples.en: The secondment agreement named the department that would host me for a term.
examples.zh: 「借调协议」写明了我将去哪个部门工作一个学期。

examples.en: I asked whether the secondment agreement showed the date I would return.
examples.zh: 我问「借调协议」上有没有标明我返回原部门的日期。

words.enDefinition: A visual line that separates parts of a document

examples.en: I added a section divider between the education and experience sections.
examples.zh: 我在教育背景栏和经历栏之间加了一条「栏目分隔线」。

examples.en: The section divider was hard to see on the printed copy of my CV.
examples.zh: 我的纸质简历上，「栏目分隔线」不太看得清。

words.enDefinition: A short title that identifies the content of a section

examples.en: I used the same font for each section heading on my CV.
examples.zh: 简历里的每个「栏目标题」我都用了同一种字体。

examples.en: The section heading made it easier to find my experience with community projects.
examples.zh: 「栏目标题」让人更容易找到我参与社区项目的经历。

words.enDefinition: The sequence in which parts of a document appear

examples.en: I changed the section order to put lab projects before campus jobs.
examples.zh: 我调整了「栏目顺序」，把实验室项目放在校内工作前面。

examples.en: The adviser asked why I had used a different section order this time.
examples.zh: 顾问问我为什么这次用了不同的「栏目顺序」。

words.enDefinition: official permission to access protected places or information after checks

examples.en: The archive listing mentions security clearance for staff who access the restricted collection.
examples.zh: 档案馆的招聘启事提到，接触限制阅览馆藏的员工需要「安全审查许可」。

examples.en: I asked when security clearance would be checked for the role at the airport.
examples.zh: 我问机场的这个岗位会在什么时候核验「安全审查许可」。

words.enDefinition: Choose every option that fits your situation

examples.en: The form says to select all that apply when choosing the days I can work.
examples.zh: 选择可以上班的日期时，表单提示「勾选所有适用项」。

examples.en: For the languages question, I had to select all that apply from one list.
examples.zh: 填写语言问题时，我得在列表里「勾选所有适用项」。

collocations: select all that apply to your situation

words.enDefinition: A short list of projects chosen to illustrate relevant experience

examples.en: I listed two selected projects instead of describing every assignment from that course.
examples.zh: 我只列了两个「精选项目」，没有描述那门课的每项作业。

examples.en: The selected projects demonstrate different skills even though both came from the same placement.
examples.zh: 尽管这两个「精选项目」来自同一段实习经历，但它们体现了不同的技能。

words.enDefinition: a placement the student finds and arranges independently

examples.en: My self-arranged placement came from a conversation with a manager at the local arts centre.
examples.zh: 和本地艺术中心一位经理聊过后，我找到了这份「自行联系的实习」。

examples.en: I sent the course office the dates and contact details for my self-arranged placement.
examples.zh: 我把「自行联系的实习」的日期和联系方式发给了课程办公室。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of your own performance or progress

examples.en: My self-assessment explained where I felt confident and where I still needed more practice.
examples.zh: 我的「自我评估」说明了哪些方面有把握，哪些方面还需要多练。

examples.en: I compared my self-assessment with the feedback from my supervisor before the final review.
examples.zh: 最终评审前，我把自己的「自我评估」和带教老师的反馈作了对照。

words.enDefinition: A form for reporting one's own demographic information

examples.en: The self-identification form appeared separately from the questions about my education and work history.
examples.zh: 「个人背景自报表」和教育及工作经历的问题分开显示。

examples.en: I checked whether the self-identification form could be left blank on the candidate portal.
examples.zh: 我查看了「个人背景自报表」能否在求职门户上留空。

words.enDefinition: someone who takes initiative without waiting for instructions

examples.en: The ad asks for a self-starter who can spot what needs doing without reminders.
examples.zh: 招聘启事要找「能主动开展工作的人」，不用提醒就能看出什么事该做。

examples.en: The coffee cart needs a self-starter because no supervisor is there in the mornings.
examples.zh: 咖啡餐车早上没有主管在场，所以需要「能主动开展工作的人」。

words.enDefinition: to share an unfinished version with a group so they can read or comment on it

examples.en: I offered to send around a draft before we finalized the visitor guide.
examples.zh: 访客指南定稿前，我主动提出「把草稿发给大家看」。

examples.en: The team lead will send around a draft of the new shift notes tomorrow.
examples.zh: 团队负责人明天会「把草稿发给大家看」，内容是新版的交班记录。

collocations: send around a draft for comments
offer to send around a draft
send around a draft before the meeting

words.zhGloss: 把你的空闲时间发过来
words.enDefinition: send a list of times when you are free
acceptedZhAnswers: 把你的空闲时间发过来

examples.en: Could you send over your availability for Thursday when you receive your placement timetable?
examples.zh: 拿到实习时间表后，你能「把周四的空闲时间发过来」吗？

examples.en: Please send over your availability by email so I can find a suitable time.
examples.zh: 请「把你的空闲时间发到我邮箱」，这样我就能找个合适的时间。

collocations: send over your availability for next week
send over your availability by email

words.enDefinition: a job demanding a high level of experience or responsibility

examples.en: The senior position included reviewing budgets and making decisions about which projects would go ahead.
examples.zh: 这个「高级岗位」要审核预算，还要决定哪些项目可以推进。

examples.en: I hadn't realised how much experience the senior position called for until I read the listing.
examples.zh: 看完招聘启事，我才知道这个「高级岗位」需要这么多经验。

collocations: a senior position in the department

words.enDefinition: how smoothly words and ideas move within or between sentences

examples.en: Reading the letter aloud helped me hear where the sentence flow became awkward.
examples.zh: 把信读出来后，我听出了哪里「句子衔接」不顺。

examples.en: The tutor suggested moving one phrase to improve the sentence flow in that paragraph.
examples.zh: 导师建议挪动一个短语，改善那段的「句子衔接」。

words.enDefinition: The current signed-in session has run out

examples.en: I saw Session expired on the screen after returning to my application after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后回到申请页面时，我看到屏幕提示「会话已过期」。

examples.en: The message Session expired appeared when I clicked the button to continue filling in the form.
examples.zh: 我点击按钮继续填表时，出现了「会话已过期」的提示。

words.enDefinition: to make clear what people should expect from one another or from a task

examples.en: We used the kickoff meeting to set expectations about how often we would report progress.
examples.zh: 我们用启动会「明确预期要求」，约定多久汇报一次进度。

examples.en: I asked the supervisor to set expectations for how quickly we should reply.
examples.zh: 我请主管「明确预期要求」，告诉我们应该多久内回复。

words.enDefinition: To give enough background for someone to understand what follows

examples.en: I used two sentences to set the scene before explaining what I changed.
examples.zh: 我先用两句话「交代背景」，再解释自己作了哪些改变。

examples.en: My adviser asked me to set the scene by naming the project and team.
examples.zh: 顾问让我先说项目和团队的名字，以此「交代背景」。

collocations: set the scene for a story
use one sentence to set the scene

words.zhGloss: 美国学生就业信息平台
words.enDefinition: A US government portal for reporting certain practical training details
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国学生就业信息平台

examples.en: My university's guide referred to the SEVP Portal in its training section.
examples.zh: 我的大学在指南的实践培训一节里提到了「美国学生就业信息平台」。

examples.en: I asked the adviser which email address was linked to the SEVP Portal.
examples.zh: 我问顾问「美国学生就业信息平台」绑定了哪个电子邮箱。

words.enDefinition: to show only one open application window to others in an online meeting

examples.en: I chose to share a window so the interview panel saw only my editor.
examples.zh: 我选择「共享某个窗口」，这样评审组只能看到我的编辑器。

examples.en: The platform showed me how to share a window during the online presentation.
examples.zh: 平台指示了在线展示时怎样「共享某个窗口」。

collocations: share a window with the panel

words.enDefinition: a network or online storage space used by several members of a group

examples.en: I saved the updated room list in the shared drive before leaving.
examples.zh: 我离开前，把更新后的房间清单存到了「共享存储盘」。

examples.en: The team keeps booking forms in a separate folder on the shared drive.
examples.zh: 团队把预约表放在「共享存储盘」里的一个单独文件夹里。

collocations: save a file to a shared drive
store documents on a shared drive

words.enDefinition: an editor that several people can access and use together

examples.en: I typed the function in a shared editor while the interviewer watched.
examples.zh: 我在「共享编辑器」里输入函数，面试官同步查看。

examples.en: The link opened a shared editor that already contained the prompt and examples.
examples.zh: 链接打开了一个「共享编辑器」，里面已有题目和示例。

words.enDefinition: an online board that several participants can view or mark on together

examples.en: The shared whiteboard let me draw the diagram while the interviewer added labels.
examples.zh: 在「共享白板」上，我画示意图的同时，面试官可以加标签。

examples.en: I reopened the shared whiteboard after the meeting to read my own notes.
examples.zh: 开完会我又打开「共享白板」，查看自己写的笔记。

words.enDefinition: the transfer of responsibility and information from one work shift to the next

examples.en: We mentioned the room change during shift handover so the next team knew.
examples.zh: 我们在「班次交接」时提了换房间的事，让下一班团队知情。

examples.en: The shift handover usually takes place at the reception desk just before lunch.
examples.zh: 「班次交接」通常在午饭前不久于接待台进行。

collocations: report an issue during shift handover

words.enDefinition: A reduced list of employers worth considering

examples.en: I added the gallery to my shortlist of employers after visiting its new space.
examples.zh: 参观画廊的新场地后，我把它加进了「重点关注的雇主名单」。

examples.en: My shortlist of employers now has three places I could easily reach by train.
examples.zh: 我的「重点关注的雇主名单」里现在有三家坐火车很方便就能到的单位。

collocations: add a company to a shortlist of employers

words.enDefinition: Selected to be considered further from a larger group

examples.en: The portal showed I was shortlisted along with other applicants for the campus job.
examples.zh: 门户显示，我和其他几位求职者一起「入围」了这个校园岗位。

examples.en: I wasn't shortlisted for the first role, but the second was still under review.
examples.zh: 我没「入围」第一个岗位，但第二个岗位的申请还在审核中。

words.enDefinition: Selecting a smaller group for closer consideration

examples.en: Shortlisting began after the last batch of applications arrived on the closing date.
examples.zh: 截止当天最后一批申请送达后，开始了「筛选入围人选」的工作。

examples.en: The university listed a week for shortlisting before the next stage was due.
examples.zh: 大学在下一阶段预定开始前安排了一周「筛选入围人选」。

words.enDefinition: to demonstrate that skills learned in one setting can be used in another

examples.en: The adviser asked me to show transferable skills from my café job in the letter.
examples.zh: 顾问要我在信里「展示可迁移的技能」，也就是在咖啡馆工作时学到的本领。

examples.en: I used my volunteer work to show transferable skills that matched the museum role.
examples.zh: 我用志愿经历「展示了与博物馆岗位相符的可迁移技能」。

collocations: use examples to show transferable skills
show transferable skills in an application

words.enDefinition: To demonstrate the knowledge or understanding gained from an experience

examples.en: One good way to show what you learned is to describe a later decision.
examples.zh: 要「展示你学到了什么」，一个好办法是描述之后作出的一项决定。

examples.en: The question gave you a chance to show what you learned from the first project.
examples.zh: 这道题给你机会「展示你学到了什么」，尤其是从第一个项目中。

collocations: show what you learned from a setback
show what you learned through an example
explain how to show what you learned

words.enDefinition: a short video combining excerpts from someone's work to demonstrate their skills

examples.en: My showreel starts with three clips from the campus television project last spring.
examples.zh: 我的「作品展示短片」开头是去年春天校园电视项目的三个片段。

examples.en: The studio asked for a showreel that showed my editing and motion graphics work.
examples.zh: 工作室想看一段能展示剪辑和动态图形作品的「作品展示短片」。

words.enDefinition: Pay received for a qualifying period of sickness

examples.en: I asked how sick pay would be calculated for staff working different hours each week.
examples.zh: 我问每周工时不同的员工，「病假工资」会怎么算。

examples.en: The staff booklet had a separate section on sick pay during the first year.
examples.zh: 员工手册单独介绍了入职第一年的「病假工资」。

words.enDefinition: To sign a document and send it back

examples.en: The manager asked me to sign and return the offer letter before Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 经理让我周五下午之前在录用函上「签字后交回」。

examples.en: I checked which page I needed to sign and return through the university's portal.
examples.zh: 我查了哪一页需要「签字后通过学校门户交回」。

collocations: sign and return the offer letter
sign and return the document online

words.enDefinition: To sign a document using digital means

examples.en: Can I sign electronically if I'm still abroad when the letter comes through?
examples.zh: 录用函发来时如果我还在国外，我可以「以电子方式签署」吗？

examples.en: The university let me sign electronically and then download the completed document from the portal.
examples.zh: 学校允许我「以电子方式签署」，然后从门户下载签好的文件。

words.enDefinition: the word or phrase used to end a letter or email before the sender's name

examples.en: My cover letter used a formal sign-off followed by my full name.
examples.zh: 我在求职信里先写了正式的「信末落款语」，再写上全名。

examples.en: The adviser suggested changing the sign-off because it sounded too casual for the firm.
examples.zh: 顾问建议换一个「信末落款语」，因为原来的写法对这家公司来说有点随便。

words.enDefinition: officially approve the time that a student recorded on placement

examples.en: My supervisor agreed to sign off on placement hours before she left for the break.
examples.zh: 带教老师同意放假离开前「审核确认实习时数」。

examples.en: I asked who could sign off on placement hours when the usual supervisor was absent.
examples.zh: 我问平时的带教老师不在时，谁可以「审核确认实习时数」。

collocations: ask someone to sign off on placement hours
a supervisor can sign off on placement hours
sign off on placement hours at the end

words.enDefinition: The latest time a document can be signed

examples.en: The signature deadline was printed at the bottom of the letter in small text.
examples.zh: 「签署截止时间」用小字印在信的最下方。

examples.en: I asked whether the signature deadline would change after the start date was revised.
examples.zh: 我问到岗日期改了之后，「签署截止时间」会不会变。

words.enDefinition: The space provided for a signature

examples.en: I had to scroll down to see the signature field at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 我得向下滚动，才能看见页面最下面的「签名栏」。

examples.en: The portal highlighted the signature field when I tried to submit the completed document.
examples.zh: 我试着提交填好的文件时，门户高亮标出了「签名栏」。

words.enDefinition: A one-time bonus for joining an employer

examples.en: The signing bonus appeared in the offer summary below the figure for starting salary.
examples.zh: 「签约奖金」列在录用摘要中的起薪金额下方。

examples.en: I asked when the signing bonus would be paid if I accepted the offer.
examples.zh: 我问如果接受录用通知，「签约奖金」什么时候发。

words.enDefinition: The date a document is signed

examples.en: I entered the signing date next to my name on the last page.
examples.zh: 我在最后一页姓名旁边填了「签署日期」。

examples.en: I checked that the signing date matched the day the portal received the document.
examples.zh: 我确认了「签署日期」和门户收到文件的日期一致。

words.enDefinition: A web link opening a document for signing

examples.en: The signing link opened the offer letter with the correct start date this time.
examples.zh: 这次「线上签署链接」打开的录用函上，到岗日期是对的。

examples.en: I requested a new signing link after the original one stopped working that morning.
examples.zh: 原来的链接那天早上失效了，我申请了新的「线上签署链接」。

words.enDefinition: to reduce a problem's complexity so that it is easier to work with

examples.en: I removed repeated entries from the example to simplify the problem at first.
examples.zh: 开始时，我把示例中重复的条目去掉，以「把问题简化」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked whether assuming a fixed input size would simplify the problem.
examples.zh: 面试官问，假定输入大小固定，能不能「把问题简化」。

words.enDefinition: a space for practising tasks in a simulated setting

examples.en: The simulation lab let our placement group practise realistic conversations before meeting the host team.
examples.zh: 在见接收单位的团队前，我们实习小组在「模拟实训室」练习了贴近真实场景的对话。

examples.en: I left my notes in the simulation lab after the pre-placement practice session ended.
examples.zh: 实习前练习结束后，我把笔记落在「模拟实训室」了。

collocations: a session in the simulation lab

words.enDefinition: A design placing the main content in one vertical column

examples.en: I switched to a single-column layout because the shorter lines broke my project titles.
examples.zh: 我换成了「单栏版式」，因为之前每行太短，把项目名称断开了。

examples.en: A single-column layout made it easier to follow my education and experience in order.
examples.zh: 「单栏版式」让人更容易按顺序阅读我的教育背景和经历。

words.enDefinition: An interview asking how someone would respond to hypothetical work situations

examples.en: During the situational interview, I explained what I would do if instructions conflicted.
examples.zh: 在「情境面试」中，我说明了如果指令有冲突，我会怎么做。

examples.en: The practice situational interview used a scenario about two clients needing help at once.
examples.zh: 这场模拟「情境面试」设定了两位客户同时需要帮助的场景。

words.enDefinition: an assessment asking how someone would respond to work-related situations

examples.en: The situational judgement test used a scenario about two tasks with the same deadline.
examples.zh: 「情境判断测验」用了一个情景，两项任务的截止时间相同。

examples.en: I checked whether the situational judgement test required one answer or a full ranking.
examples.zh: 我确认了「情境判断测验」是只选一个答案，还是给所有选项排序。

words.enDefinition: to outline how you might solve something before working out all the details

examples.en: I took a minute to sketch an approach on the shared whiteboard.
examples.zh: 我花了一分钟在共享白板上「勾勒一个解法」。

examples.en: The interviewer suggested I sketch an approach before starting to write the function.
examples.zh: 面试官建议我先「勾勒一个解法」，再开始写函数。

collocations: sketch an approach at the whiteboard
take time to sketch an approach

words.enDefinition: A UK work visa route for sponsored employment in eligible jobs

examples.en: The adviser explained which page described the Skilled Worker visa in the UK guidance.
examples.zh: 顾问指出英国指南哪一页介绍了「英国技术工作者签证」。

examples.en: The employer's letter named the Skilled Worker visa but gave no further details.
examples.zh: 雇主的信写出了「英国技术工作者签证」的名称，没有给更多细节。

collocations: sponsorship for a Skilled Worker visa
conditions of a Skilled Worker visa

words.enDefinition: A document organized around abilities rather than individual roles or dates

examples.en: My skills-based CV groups my tutoring and mentoring work under communication skills.
examples.zh: 我的「技能型简历」把辅导和指导经历都放在沟通技能一栏。

examples.en: The careers workshop compared a skills-based CV with one grouped by job title.
examples.zh: 就业指导讲座把「技能型简历」和按职位划分的简历作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a practical display showing that someone can perform a task

examples.en: I gave a skills demonstration on sorting incoming archive material at the final training session.
examples.zh: 最后一节培训课上，我做了场「技能演示」，展示如何整理新送来的档案资料。

examples.en: The tutor used the skills demonstration to assess whether I could explain the catalog system clearly.
examples.zh: 导师通过「技能演示」，评估我能否把编目系统解释清楚。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚紧缺技能签证
words.enDefinition: An Australian employer-sponsored temporary visa for eligible skilled workers
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚紧缺技能签证

examples.en: The Australian employer explained why its guide mentioned the Skills in Demand visa.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚雇主解释了它的指南为什么会提到「澳大利亚紧缺技能签证」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the workshop covered the Skills in Demand visa.
examples.zh: 我问讲座哪一部分介绍了「澳大利亚紧缺技能签证」。

collocations: a Skills in Demand visa application
sponsorship for a Skills in Demand visa

words.enDefinition: a short practical session for developing a particular ability

examples.en: I joined a skills workshop on presenting project results during my graduate training program.
examples.zh: 在毕业生培养项目里，我参加了一场关于汇报项目成果的「技能工作坊」。

examples.en: The skills workshop gave our placement group time to practise explaining decisions in plain language.
examples.zh: 「技能工作坊」让我们实习小组有时间练习用通俗语言解释自己的决定。

words.enDefinition: a meeting with a manager above someone's direct supervisor

examples.en: The skip-level meeting gave our team time to ask the department manager questions.
examples.zh: 「跨级沟通会」给了团队向部门经理提问的时间。

examples.en: I prepared one question about training before attending my first skip-level meeting.
examples.zh: 第一次参加「跨级沟通会」之前，我准备了一个有关培训的问题。

words.enDefinition: a display mode that shows slides to an audience at presentation size

examples.en: I switched to slide show view before the interview panel joined the online call.
examples.zh: 评审组加入在线通话前，我切换到了「放映视图」。

examples.en: The slides filled the screen once I started slide show view on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我在笔记本电脑上启用「放映视图」后，幻灯片铺满了屏幕。

words.enDefinition: says an unexpected situation needs your attention

examples.en: Something has come up at my placement, so I can't take the call at three.
examples.zh: 我实习那边「临时有事」，三点没法接电话。

examples.en: I'm afraid something has come up and I'll need to move our chat to tomorrow.
examples.zh: 不好意思，「我临时有事」，得把咱们聊天的时间改到明天。

collocations: something has come up at work
something has come up this morning

words.enDefinition: apologizes for taking time to answer a message

examples.en: Sorry for the delayed reply, but I've been in the lab without access to email.
examples.zh: 「抱歉回复晚了」，我一直在实验室，没法看邮件。

examples.en: I'm sorry for the delayed reply, but I can still take the Thursday slot.
examples.zh: 「抱歉回复晚了」，不过我还是可以约周四那个时段。

collocations: sorry for the delayed reply this week
I'm sorry for the delayed reply
sorry for the delayed reply to your message

words.enDefinition: apologizes for giving someone little time to prepare

examples.en: Sorry for the short notice, but the hiring manager is free an hour earlier today.
examples.zh: 「临时通知不好意思」，今天用人经理能提前一小时聊。

examples.en: I'm sorry for the short notice, but I can't take today's call after all.
examples.zh: 「临时通知不好意思」，我今天还是没法接那通电话了。

collocations: sorry for the short notice about the change
I'm sorry for the short notice
sorry for the short notice on this

words.zhGloss: 按发布时间从新到旧排序
words.enDefinition: To display the newest listings first
acceptedZhAnswers: 按发布时间从新到旧排序

examples.en: I usually sort by most recent when I check the university job board.
examples.zh: 我查看学校招聘板时，通常会「按发布时间从新到旧排序」。

examples.en: Can we sort by most recent so the new library jobs are at the top?
examples.zh: 我们能「按发布时间从新到旧排序」，把图书馆新发布的岗位放到最上面吗？

collocations: choose to sort by most recent
set the page to sort by most recent

words.enDefinition: how an algorithm's memory use grows as the input size increases

examples.en: I mentioned the space complexity after explaining how the program stored the results.
examples.zh: 我解释程序如何存储结果之后，提到了「空间复杂度」。

examples.en: The panel asked whether using another list would affect the space complexity.
examples.zh: 评审组问，再用一个列表会不会影响「空间复杂度」。

collocations: discuss the space complexity of an algorithm

words.enDefinition: notes attached to a slide to help the presenter remember what to say

examples.en: I stored the exact figures in my speaker notes instead of adding them to the slide.
examples.zh: 我把精确数字记在「演讲者备注」里，没放到幻灯片上。

examples.en: The panel could see my slides, but the speaker notes stayed on my screen.
examples.zh: 评审组能看到我的幻灯片，「演讲者备注」只显示在我的屏幕上。

collocations: show speaker notes in presenter view

words.enDefinition: The speed at which a person speaks during a conversation

examples.en: My speaking pace picked up when I reached the end of the story.
examples.zh: 我讲到故事快结束时，「说话速度」加快了。

examples.en: The practice helped me find a speaking pace that still sounded natural.
examples.zh: 练习帮我找到一种听起来仍然自然的「说话速度」。

words.enDefinition: A job board that serves a narrow field

examples.en: I found screen production work on a specialist job board for the media industry.
examples.zh: 我在传媒行业的「行业招聘平台」上找到了影视制作的工作。

examples.en: The careers adviser showed us a specialist job board for local arts organisations.
examples.zh: 就业顾问给我们介绍了一个为本地艺术机构服务的「行业招聘平台」。

collocations: advertise on a specialist job board
a listing from a specialist job board

words.enDefinition: A review that identifies possible spelling errors in text

examples.en: I ran a spell check before trying to fit everything onto one page.
examples.zh: 我试着把内容压缩到一页之前，先运行了「拼写检查」。

examples.en: The spell check flagged an organization name that I had spelled correctly.
examples.zh: 「拼写检查」标出了一个我其实拼对了的机构名称。

words.enDefinition: a workday divided into separate periods with a long break

examples.en: The café offered me a split shift with three hours off between lunch and dinner.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆给我安排了「分段班次」，午餐和晚餐班之间休息三小时。

examples.en: A split shift would give me enough time to attend my afternoon seminar on campus.
examples.zh: 「分段班次」能给我留出足够的时间去学校上下午的研讨课。

words.enDefinition: UK authorization for an organization to sponsor eligible migrant workers

examples.en: The UK employer explained which part of the process involved its sponsor licence.
examples.zh: 英国雇主解释了流程中的哪个环节涉及其「英国雇主担保资质」。

examples.en: I asked about the sponsor licence mentioned in the employer's information pack.
examples.zh: 我问了雇主资料包中提到的「英国雇主担保资质」。

words.enDefinition: A worker whose employment-related immigration permission is supported by a sponsor

examples.en: The guidance defined sponsored worker in a section about employer responsibilities.
examples.zh: 指南在雇主责任一节解释了「受雇主担保的员工」。

examples.en: I asked who managed records for a sponsored worker at the organization.
examples.zh: 我问机构里谁管理「受雇主担保的员工」的档案。

words.enDefinition: An employer formally supporting a person's employment-related immigration case

examples.en: I checked the official name of the sponsoring employer against the letter.
examples.zh: 我根据文件核对了「担保雇主」的正式名称。

examples.en: The sponsoring employer sent my placement coordinator a copy of the confirmation.
examples.zh: 「担保雇主」给我的实习协调员发了一份确认文件副本。

words.enDefinition: a task that tests the use of spreadsheet tools to calculate, organize or analyze information

examples.en: The spreadsheet exercise asked me to total the attendance figures for each group.
examples.zh: 「电子表格练习」要求我算出各组出勤人数的合计。

examples.en: I added a short note explaining my formulas in the spreadsheet exercise.
examples.zh: 我在「电子表格练习」里加了条简短说明，解释自己用了哪些公式。

words.enDefinition: A guide explaining an organization's workplace procedures and expectations

examples.en: The first section of our staff handbook explains how to report an absence.
examples.zh: 我们的「员工手册」第一节说明了如何报备缺勤。

examples.en: I checked the staff handbook to find the office opening hours.
examples.zh: 我查了「员工手册」，想知道办公室的开放时间。

words.enDefinition: A visible card used to show someone's identity as an employee

examples.en: I checked the spelling on my staff ID badge before leaving the office.
examples.zh: 离开办公室前，我核对了「员工工牌」上的名字拼写。

examples.en: The receptionist told me where to collect my staff ID badge on Monday.
examples.zh: 接待员告诉我周一去哪里领取「员工工牌」。

collocations: pick up your staff ID badge

words.enDefinition: a meal provided for people working at a business

examples.en: The restaurant offers a staff meal on evenings when you work past closing time.
examples.zh: 晚上上班超过打烊时间，餐厅会提供一份「员工餐」。

examples.en: I checked whether the staff meal was available before or after the dinner shift.
examples.zh: 我查了一下「员工餐」是在晚餐班之前吃，还是下班后吃。

words.enDefinition: a board or page used to display announcements for staff

examples.en: The staff noticeboard showed which entrance we should use during the repair work.
examples.zh: 「员工公告栏」标明了维修期间我们该走哪个入口。

examples.en: I put a shift swap request on the staff noticeboard beside the office door.
examples.zh: 我把换班请求贴在办公室门旁的「员工公告栏」上。

collocations: put a message on the staff noticeboard

words.enDefinition: How often staff leave and are replaced

examples.en: A graduate mentioned high staff turnover when we talked about jobs in local museums.
examples.zh: 我们聊到本地博物馆的工作时，一位毕业生提到那里「员工流动」频繁。

examples.en: I asked how staff turnover had changed since the studio moved to the city.
examples.zh: 我问工作室搬到城里后，「员工流动」有什么变化。

words.enDefinition: different start dates assigned to different people or groups

examples.en: The program uses staggered start dates so each placement team can train smaller groups.
examples.zh: 项目采用「错开的开始日期」，让各实习团队能分小组培训。

examples.en: With staggered start dates, some trainees arrived in June and others started in July.
examples.zh: 由于「开始日期错开」，有些培训生六月到岗，有些七月才开始。

collocations: a program with staggered start dates

words.enDefinition: a brief team meeting typically used to share progress and identify obstacles

examples.en: At the stand-up meeting, each person shared what they planned to finish that day.
examples.zh: 「简短进度会」上，每个人说了当天准备完成什么。

examples.en: I mentioned the missing booking records at our regular stand-up meeting on Monday.
examples.zh: 我在周一例行「简短进度会」上提到了缺失的预约记录。

words.enDefinition: the typical daytime hours when an office operates

examples.en: The position follows standard business hours, which clash with two of my afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 这个岗位在「常规办公时间」上班，刚好和我两门下午的课冲突。

examples.en: The print shop wants someone who can work standard business hours throughout the summer.
examples.zh: 这家印刷店想找一个整个夏天都能在「常规办公时间」上班的人。

words.enDefinition: a topic included regularly on the agenda for a series of meetings

examples.en: The room booking update became a standing agenda item during the exam period.
examples.zh: 考试期间，房间预约的最新情况成了「固定议程事项」。

examples.en: The chair made the equipment check a standing agenda item for our weekly meeting.
examples.zh: 主持人把设备检查列为周会的「固定议程事项」。

collocations: a standing agenda item on safety

words.enDefinition: A technique that structures examples around situation, task, action, and result

examples.en: I used the STAR method to order my story about a busy shift.
examples.zh: 我用「情境任务行动结果法」理顺了自己在忙碌班次中的经历。

examples.en: The STAR method helped me explain what changed after we made the decision.
examples.zh: 「情境任务行动结果法」帮我说清团队作出决定后发生了什么变化。

collocations: an example using the STAR method

words.enDefinition: The date someone begins work in a role

examples.en: The start date in the letter fell in the week after my last exam.
examples.zh: 信上的「到岗日期」在我最后一场考试结束后一周。

examples.en: I received a separate message about my start date after signing the offer letter.
examples.zh: 签完录用函后，我另外收到一条关于「到岗日期」的消息。

words.enDefinition: A contract provision stating when the employment arrangement begins

examples.en: The start date clause had a different date from the one in the email.
examples.zh: 「入职日期条款」上的日期与邮件上的不同。

examples.en: I checked the start date clause before confirming my availability for the first shift.
examples.zh: 确认第一班能否出勤前，我核对了「入职日期条款」。

words.enDefinition: code given at the start of a programming task to help the participant get started

examples.en: The starter code provided a function name and a few lines of sample data.
examples.zh: 「起始代码」给了函数名和几行示例数据。

examples.en: I read the starter code before making any changes to the shared file.
examples.zh: 改动共享文件之前，我先阅读了「起始代码」。

words.enDefinition: The pay set for the start of employment

examples.en: The offer letter lists a different starting salary from the one quoted on the phone.
examples.zh: 录用函列出的「起薪」和电话里报的不一样。

examples.en: I asked when the starting salary would first be reviewed by the department.
examples.zh: 我问部门什么时候会首次重新评估「起薪」。

words.enDefinition: To tell someone what happened or what a task achieved

examples.en: My tutor reminded me to state the result before ending the story.
examples.zh: 导师提醒我在讲完这段经历之前「说明结果」。

examples.en: I used one figure to state the result of the new booking system.
examples.zh: 我用一个数字「说明结果」，介绍新预订系统的成效。

collocations: state the result in one sentence
state the result before moving on

words.enDefinition: To express the central idea you want someone to remember

examples.en: The handout says to state your main point before giving details about your example.
examples.zh: 讲义说应先「说清你的重点」，然后再讲例子细节。

examples.en: I asked my partner whether it helped to state your main point earlier.
examples.zh: 我问搭档，提前「说清重点」有没有帮助。

collocations: state your main point in one sentence

words.enDefinition: a structured account of what a project or task is doing at a particular time

examples.en: My status report covered completed bookings, missing forms and the next deadline.
examples.zh: 我的「状态报告」写了已完成的预约、缺的表格和下一个截止日期。

examples.en: The team added a note about equipment delays to the weekly status report.
examples.zh: 团队在每周的「状态报告」里加了一条设备延误说明。

words.enDefinition: There has been no change in the recorded status

examples.en: I saw Status unchanged when I opened the dashboard after the document review.
examples.zh: 材料审核后，我打开申请总览，看到了「状态未变」。

examples.en: Uploading the revised copy of my certificate left the status unchanged on the portal.
examples.zh: 我上传了更正后的证书副本，但求职门户里的「状态未变」。

words.enDefinition: remain connected by phone while waiting

examples.en: The receptionist asked me to stay on the line while she checked the extension.
examples.zh: 前台请我「保持通话」，她去查一下分机号码。

examples.en: I could stay on the line until someone from recruitment was free to speak.
examples.zh: 我可以「先不挂断」，等招聘部门有人有空接电话。

collocations: ask someone to stay on the line
stay on the line a moment longer

words.enDefinition: An extension of US practical training tied to a qualifying STEM degree

examples.en: I asked how the STEM OPT extension was labeled in the notice.
examples.zh: 我问通知里的「美国STEM实践许可延期」用的是什么名称。

examples.en: Our adviser discussed the STEM OPT extension in a workshop for science graduates.
examples.zh: 顾问在面向理科毕业生的讲座上介绍了「美国STEM实践许可延期」。

collocations: apply for a STEM OPT extension
approval of a STEM OPT extension

words.enDefinition: to follow or execute a program line by line to see what it does

examples.en: I asked for a moment to step through the code with the sample values.
examples.zh: 我请大家稍等，让我用示例值「逐步跟踪代码」。

examples.en: The interviewer suggested I step through the code to find where the count changed.
examples.zh: 面试官建议我「逐步跟踪代码」，找出计数值是在哪里变的。

collocations: step through the code line by line
use a debugger to step through the code
step through the code with an example

words.enDefinition: To keep a response focused on what was actually asked

examples.en: I used the prompt on my notes to stick to the question during practice.
examples.zh: 练习时，我看着笔记上的题目，提醒自己「紧扣问题」。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to stick to the question when talking about the launch.
examples.zh: 顾问让我谈到发布活动时「紧扣问题」。

collocations: try to stick to the question
remember to stick to the question

words.enDefinition: replacing goods that have been sold or used up

examples.en: The early shift is mainly stock replenishment before customers arrive at the campus shop.
examples.zh: 早班主要是在顾客到校内商店之前「补货」。

examples.en: The advert mentions stock replenishment as well as answering questions on the shop floor.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到，除了在店里回答顾客的问题，还要「补货」。

words.enDefinition: To remove unnecessary steps so work moves more efficiently

examples.en: I helped streamline a workflow by combining the two forms we used every week.
examples.zh: 我把每周用的两份表格合并，协助「精简工作流程」。

examples.en: The first bullet explains how I helped streamline a workflow at the library desk.
examples.zh: 简历第一条要点解释了我如何帮助图书馆服务台「精简工作流程」。

words.enDefinition: An interview exploring tasks someone enjoys and naturally does well

examples.en: The strengths-based interview explored which aspects of my campus job I found most rewarding.
examples.zh: 「优势导向面试」探讨了校内工作中哪些方面最让我觉得有收获。

examples.en: The adviser used a strengths-based interview to ask which activities gave me energy.
examples.zh: 顾问通过「优势导向面试」，询问我做什么事会感到有干劲。

words.enDefinition: a task that pushes someone beyond their current skills

examples.en: My supervisor offered a stretch assignment to help me practise leading the weekly briefing.
examples.zh: 带教老师给了我一项「挑战性成长任务」，让我练习主持每周例会。

examples.en: I took on a stretch assignment during my final rotation with the design team.
examples.zh: 我在设计团队做最后一轮轮岗时，接了一项「挑战性成长任务」。

words.zhGloss: 一批实力很强的申请人
words.enDefinition: a group of candidates with good skills or qualifications
acceptedZhAnswers: 一批实力很强的申请人

examples.en: The recruiter said there was a strong pool of applicants for the weekend position.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说，周末岗位吸引了「一批实力很强的申请人」。

examples.en: We chose from a strong pool of applicants, including several people with library experience.
examples.zh: 我们从「一批实力很强的申请人」里选人，其中有几位有图书馆工作经验。

collocations: attract a strong pool of applicants
choose from a strong pool of applicants
have a strong pool of applicants

words.enDefinition: An interview using standard questions and scoring to compare candidates

examples.en: In our structured interview practice, every student answered the same questions in order.
examples.zh: 练习「结构化面试」时，每位学生都依次回答同一组问题。

examples.en: The structured interview used the same rating scale for everyone who applied.
examples.zh: 这场「结构化面试」对所有应聘者使用相同的评分标准。

words.enDefinition: training organized around a fixed plan or sequence of activities

examples.en: I looked for structured training because I wanted to know what I'd learn each month.
examples.zh: 我在找「有计划的培训」，因为想提前知道每个月会学什么。

examples.en: The company provides structured training for graduates through lessons, projects, and scheduled feedback sessions.
examples.zh: 公司通过课程、项目和定期反馈会，为毕业生提供「有计划的培训」。

words.enDefinition: a period of supervised classroom teaching for a trainee teacher

examples.en: During my student teaching placement, I met the class teacher each afternoon to review lessons.
examples.zh: 「教学实习」期间，我每天下午和班上的老师一起回顾当天的课。

examples.en: My student teaching placement was at a school within cycling distance of the university.
examples.zh: 我的「教学实习」在一所离大学不远的学校，可以骑车过去。

collocations: a student teaching placement in a primary school

words.enDefinition: A supervised work assignment completed as part of a study program

examples.en: My adviser explained how the student work placement fitted into the course schedule.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「学生课程实习」在课程安排中是怎样衔接的。

examples.en: I checked whether the student work placement dates matched my university paperwork.
examples.zh: 我核对了「学生课程实习」日期与学校文件是否一致。

words.enDefinition: Dependent on approval before being confirmed

examples.en: The start date was subject to approval because the department was changing its term schedule.
examples.zh: 部门在调整学期安排，所以到岗日期「须经批准」。

examples.en: The manager said the extra hours were subject to approval from the department head.
examples.zh: 经理说，额外工时「须经部门负责人批准」。

collocations: a start date subject to approval

words.zhGloss: 以推荐人核查通过为条件
words.enDefinition: Depending on satisfactory references about the applicant
acceptedZhAnswers: 以推荐人核查通过为条件

examples.en: The offer was subject to references, so the library asked for my former supervisor's details.
examples.zh: 录用「以推荐人核查通过为条件」，所以图书馆要了我前任主管的联系方式。

examples.en: The letter said the post was subject to references from my two most recent employers.
examples.zh: 信中写明，这份工作「以最近两家雇主提供的推荐信息通过核查为条件」。

words.enDefinition: A message showing that a submission went through

examples.en: I waited for the submission confirmation before closing the tab on my phone.
examples.zh: 我等到「提交确认通知」后，才关掉手机上的标签页。

examples.en: The submission confirmation showed the role, the date and the name of the department.
examples.zh: 「提交确认通知」列出了职位、日期和部门名称。

words.enDefinition: The system did not accept or finish the submission

examples.en: The message Submission failed appeared even though I had filled in every required field.
examples.zh: 尽管我填了所有必填项，系统还是提示「提交失败」。

examples.en: I saw Submission failed and checked whether a copy of my answers was still saved.
examples.zh: 我看到「提交失败」，就查看回答有没有保存副本。

words.enDefinition: A stored entry showing that materials were sent

examples.en: I opened the submission record to check that both attachments had gone through.
examples.zh: 我打开「提交记录」，确认两个附件都提交成功了。

examples.en: The submission record listed the day I sent the revised form to the department.
examples.zh: 「提交记录」列出了我向部门提交修订表单的日期。

collocations: a submission record for an application

words.enDefinition: The exact date and time a submission was recorded

examples.en: My submission timestamp showed that the form went through just before the page closed.
examples.zh: 我的「提交时间戳」显示，表单在页面关闭前不久就送达了。

examples.en: I compared the submission timestamp with the time shown in my confirmation message.
examples.zh: 我对照了「提交时间戳」和确认消息里的时间。

collocations: a submission timestamp on the confirmation

words.enDefinition: To send more information requested for an application

examples.en: The department gave me until Friday to submit additional information about my degree course.
examples.zh: 部门让我在周五之前「补交关于学位课程的信息」。

examples.en: Can I submit additional information through the candidate portal after the initial review?
examples.zh: 初审后，我能通过求职门户「补交信息」吗？

collocations: ask an applicant to submit additional information
submit additional information before the deadline

words.enDefinition: To send application materials by email

examples.en: The library said I could submit by email if the attachment page stopped working.
examples.zh: 图书馆说，如果附件页面无法使用，我可以「通过电子邮件提交」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could submit by email or had to use the portal.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「通过电子邮件提交」，还是必须用求职门户。

collocations: allow applicants to submit by email

words.enDefinition: Label introducing the date something was submitted

examples.en: The dashboard showed Submitted on Friday next to the form for the evening job.
examples.zh: 晚班职位的表单旁，申请总览显示「提交于」周五。

examples.en: I copied the date next to Submitted on because the confirmation message had disappeared.
examples.zh: 确认通知找不到了，我就抄下了「提交于」旁边的日期。

collocations: the value next to submitted on

words.enDefinition: to give a short account of the most important results of an investigation

examples.en: I used one slide to summarize key findings from the campus travel survey.
examples.zh: 针对校园出行调查，我用一张幻灯片「概括主要发现」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked me to summarize key findings without reading from the report.
examples.zh: 面试官让我不照着报告念，「概括主要发现」。

collocations: summarize key findings in a slide
use a chart to summarize key findings

words.enDefinition: a period of work experience during the summer break

examples.en: My summer internship ended two weeks before my final year of university began.
examples.zh: 我的「暑期实习」在大学最后一学年开始前两周结束。

examples.en: I looked for a summer internship near home because I was staying with family.
examples.zh: 暑假我和家人一起住，所以就在家附近找「暑期实习」。

words.enDefinition: oversee the work of a group of employees

examples.en: The role asks you to supervise a team of student workers in the equipment room.
examples.zh: 这个岗位要求在器材室「管理一支学生员工团队」。

examples.en: I was surprised that the weekend manager had to supervise a team of twelve.
examples.zh: 我没想到周末值班经理要「管理一支团队」，而且有十二个人。

collocations: train someone to supervise a team

words.enDefinition: practice carried out under the guidance of an experienced person

examples.en: We began with supervised practice in the teaching lab before the course supervisor reviewed our work.
examples.zh: 我们先在教学实验室做「带教指导下的实践」，然后由课程导师评审成果。

examples.en: My schedule lists two afternoons of supervised practice with an experienced workshop technician each week.
examples.zh: 我的时间表上每周有两个下午，和经验丰富的工坊技术员一起做「带教指导下的实践」。

words.enDefinition: an agreement about how someone will be guided and supported

examples.en: Our supervision agreement set out how often my workplace tutor and I would meet.
examples.zh: 「带教安排协议」写明了我和单位的带教老师多久见一次面。

examples.en: I reread the supervision agreement after my usual contact moved to another team.
examples.zh: 平时联系的人调去另一个团队后，我重读了「带教安排协议」。

words.enDefinition: experience overseeing the work of other people

examples.en: The café asks for supervisory experience because the person will lead the evening team.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆要求有「带人管理经验」，因为这个人要带晚班团队。

examples.en: I asked if organizing shifts for student volunteers counted as supervisory experience for the role.
examples.zh: 我问给学生志愿者排班算不算这个岗位要求的「带人管理经验」。

words.enDefinition: a written statement showing how an applicant meets the requirements of a role or opportunity

examples.en: The university asked for a supporting statement outlining how I met the selection criteria.
examples.zh: 学校要求我提供一份「岗位胜任陈述」，阐明我怎样满足筛选条件。

examples.en: I used my supporting statement to explain the responsibilities I had during my placement.
examples.zh: 我在「岗位胜任陈述」里解释了自己实习期间承担的职责。

collocations: a supporting statement against the selection criteria

words.enDefinition: to exchange scheduled work periods with another person

examples.en: We agreed to swap shifts so I could attend the afternoon lab session.
examples.zh: 我们同意「互相换班」，让我能参加下午的实验课。

examples.en: I asked if we could swap shifts before the rota was finalized.
examples.zh: 排班表定下来前，我问能不能「互相换班」。

words.enDefinition: an interview where candidates explain how they would design a software system for a given purpose

examples.en: The system design interview asked me to outline a service for reserving study rooms.
examples.zh: 「系统设计面试」让我画出学习室预约服务的大致方案。

examples.en: I practised a system design interview with someone from the computing society.
examples.zh: 我和计算机社团的一名成员练习了「系统设计面试」。

collocations: prepare for a system design interview
questions in a system design interview

words.enDefinition: to adapt a cover letter to a particular job or employer

examples.en: I learned to tailor a cover letter by using details from the actual posting.
examples.zh: 我学会了利用招聘启事里的具体信息「按岗位调整求职信」。

examples.en: The adviser showed us how to tailor a cover letter without changing the facts.
examples.zh: 顾问教我们怎样在不改动事实的情况下「按岗位调整求职信」。

collocations: tailor a cover letter to the role
tailor a cover letter to each employer
tailor a cover letter for an internship

words.enDefinition: A document emphasizing experience relevant to a specific job or employer

examples.en: My tailored resume puts the tutoring experience first because the job involves teaching.
examples.zh: 这份工作的内容涉及教学，所以我的「岗位定制简历」把辅导经历放在最前面。

examples.en: The tailored resume for the lab role highlights my work with survey data.
examples.zh: 这份「岗位定制简历」突出介绍了我处理调查数据的经历，以应聘实验室岗位。

words.enDefinition: To pause briefly before deciding what to say or do

examples.en: The panel said I could take a moment to think before answering the last question.
examples.zh: 小组说回答最后一道题之前，我可以「先想一下」。

examples.en: I learned to take a moment to think when the wording of a question surprised me.
examples.zh: 遇到出乎意料的提问时，我学会了「先想一下」。

collocations: feel free to take a moment to think
take a moment to think before speaking
take a moment to think before you answer

words.enDefinition: an evaluation that candidates complete independently away from the interview before a due date

examples.en: The employer emailed me a take-home assessment after our first technical call.
examples.zh: 第一次技术通话后，雇主发来一份「限期独立完成的测评」。

examples.en: The take-home assessment asked for a short report using the supplied dataset.
examples.zh: 「限期独立完成的测评」要求用提供的数据集写一份简短报告。

words.expression: take me off your mailing list
words.lemma: take me off your mailing list
words.zhGloss: 把我从你的邮件列表里移除
words.enDefinition: stop sending someone messages meant for a mailing group
acceptedZhAnswers: 把我从你的邮件列表里移除
acceptedEnVariants: take me off your mailing list
remove me from your mailing list

examples.en: Could you take me off your mailing list for weekend roles now that I've moved?
examples.zh: 我搬家了，能「把我从周末岗位的邮件列表里移除」吗？

examples.en: Please take me off your mailing list because I've already found a summer position.
examples.zh: 我已经找到暑期岗位了，「请把我从你的邮件列表里移除」。

collocations: please take me off your mailing list
could you take me off your mailing list?
take me off your mailing list for those alerts

words.enDefinition: to write an official record of the main points and decisions in a meeting

examples.en: The coordinator asked me to take minutes because our usual note taker was away.
examples.zh: 平时做记录的人不在，协调员让我「做会议纪要」。

examples.en: I learned to take minutes without trying to write down every word spoken.
examples.zh: 我学会了「做会议纪要」，不必在会上一字不漏地记。

words.enDefinition: to accept responsibility for completing a task and dealing with issues along the way

examples.en: The supervisor asked me to take ownership of a task that needed two approvals.
examples.zh: 主管让我「主动负责一项任务」，这项任务需要两次审批。

examples.en: I offered to take ownership of a task relating to the workshop's attendance records.
examples.zh: 我主动提出「负责一项任务」，处理培训的出勤记录。

collocations: take ownership of a task from start to finish
be willing to take ownership of a task
ask someone to take ownership of a task

words.enDefinition: To accept accountability for an action, decision, or outcome

examples.en: I described how I chose to take responsibility for sending the wrong file.
examples.zh: 我讲了自己如何选择「承担责任」，为发错文件这件事负责。

examples.en: The interviewer asked when I had learned to take responsibility without being asked.
examples.zh: 面试官问我什么时候学会了主动「承担责任」。

words.enDefinition: To start doing something without waiting to be asked

examples.en: I gave an example of when I had to take the initiative without a supervisor nearby.
examples.zh: 我举了个例子，说明没有主管在场时，我怎样「主动采取行动」。

examples.en: My adviser wanted to know what made me take the initiative on the project.
examples.zh: 顾问想知道是什么促使我在项目中「主动采取行动」。

collocations: take the initiative on a project

words.zhGloss: 把这个问题留待会后谈
words.enDefinition: to move the current topic out of a meeting or group conversation for separate discussion
acceptedZhAnswers: 把这个问题留待会后谈

examples.en: I suggested we take this offline because the room booking issue needed more time.
examples.zh: 场地预约问题需要更多时间，我建议「把这个问题留待会后谈」。

examples.en: The chair said we could take this offline and focus on today's agenda.
examples.zh: 主持人说，可以「把这个问题留待会后谈」，先专注今天的议程。

collocations: suggest that we take this offline

words.enDefinition: A group of candidates an employer may consider later

examples.en: The recruiter kept my details in a talent pool for future openings at other branches.
examples.zh: 招聘人员把我的资料留在「人才储备库」里，以备其他分店今后有空缺。

examples.en: The employer asked whether I wanted to stay in its talent pool after this hiring round.
examples.zh: 这轮招聘后，雇主问我是否希望继续留在他们的「人才储备库」里。

words.enDefinition: An industry someone intends to focus on

examples.en: I chose publishing as my target sector after talking with two former students.
examples.zh: 和两位校友聊过后，我选了出版作为「目标行业」。

examples.en: My adviser asked me to name a target sector before we looked for employers.
examples.zh: 在我们找雇主之前，就业顾问让我先说出一个「目标行业」。

words.enDefinition: a cover letter written to address a specific vacancy and its requirements

examples.en: My targeted cover letter refers to the two evening shifts mentioned in the posting.
examples.zh: 我这封「针对岗位写的求职信」提到了招聘启事里的两个晚班。

examples.en: The tutor showed how a targeted cover letter could connect coursework to this role.
examples.zh: 导师示范了怎样在一封「针对岗位写的求职信」里，把课程经历与这个岗位联系起来。

collocations: a targeted cover letter for each role

words.enDefinition: Prior work teaching, tutoring, or guiding people in their learning

examples.en: My teaching experience includes leading two tutorials for first-year biology students.
examples.zh: 我的「教学经历」包括为生物专业一年级学生带领两次辅导课。

examples.en: I moved teaching experience higher on the page for the summer tutoring position.
examples.zh: 申请暑期辅导岗位时，我把「教学经历」往页面上方移了。

words.enDefinition: a calendar used to coordinate a group's meetings, shifts or deadlines

examples.en: I added my availability to the team calendar before the new rota was drafted.
examples.zh: 新排班表开始拟定前，我在「团队日历」里填了空闲时间。

examples.en: The team calendar shows who is covering the bookings desk on Friday.
examples.zh: 「团队日历」显示周五由谁顶替预约柜台的班。

collocations: add a meeting to the team calendar

words.enDefinition: a shared space in a messaging app for a team to communicate

examples.en: I posted the corrected schedule in the team channel after speaking to my supervisor.
examples.zh: 和主管谈过之后，我把改好的排班表发到了「团队沟通频道」。

examples.en: The team channel is where we post changes that affect all desk staff.
examples.zh: 我们在「团队沟通频道」发布会影响所有柜台员工的变更。

collocations: post an update in the team channel
pin a message in the team channel

words.enDefinition: a document defining a team's shared purpose, roles and agreed ways of working
