examples.en: The team charter explains who can approve changes to the workshop schedule.
examples.zh: 「团队协作章程」写明了谁可以批准修改培训安排。

examples.en: We updated the team charter after a new group of students joined.
examples.zh: 一批新同学加入后，我们更新了「团队协作章程」。

words.enDefinition: the assignment of enough team members to keep work or a service running

examples.en: I checked team coverage before asking whether I could leave an hour earlier.
examples.zh: 我先看了「团队值守安排」，再问自己能不能提前一小时走。

examples.en: The supervisor adjusted team coverage after a student worker cancelled their evening shift.
examples.zh: 一名学生员工取消晚班后，主管调整了「团队值守安排」。

words.enDefinition: a list of team members with their contact details or roles

examples.en: I used the team directory to find the right person for room bookings.
examples.zh: 我用「团队通讯录」找到了负责房间预约的人。

examples.en: The team directory was updated after two new student workers joined our group.
examples.zh: 两名新的学生员工加入后，「团队通讯录」更新了。

collocations: look someone up in the team directory

words.enDefinition: The ways team members interact, communicate, and influence one another

examples.en: The example showed how two new members changed our team dynamics that semester.
examples.zh: 这个例子说明，那学期两名新成员如何改变了我们的「团队互动模式」。

examples.en: I asked about team dynamics after hearing how the team divided its work.
examples.zh: 听完团队的分工介绍后，我问了他们的「团队互动模式」。

words.enDefinition: a brief informal gathering to exchange information or coordinate immediate work

examples.en: We held a team huddle before opening the reception desk to visitors.
examples.zh: 接待台对访客开放前，我们开了个「团队短碰头会」。

examples.en: The supervisor used the team huddle to share the plan for a busy afternoon.
examples.zh: 主管在「团队短碰头会」上介绍了下午繁忙时段的安排。

words.enDefinition: an email inbox monitored by several people who handle messages together

examples.en: I checked the team inbox for replies from students who had booked the workshop.
examples.zh: 我查了「团队共用收件箱」，看看预约培训的学生有没有回复。

examples.en: The manager asked me to reply from the team inbox during my afternoon shift.
examples.zh: 经理让我上下午班时用「团队共用收件箱」回复邮件。

collocations: send a message to the team inbox

words.enDefinition: a person who coordinates a team's work and guides its members

examples.en: The team lead passed the smaller jobs to those of us working afternoons.
examples.zh: 「团队负责人」把小任务分给我们这些上下午班的人。

examples.en: I checked the priority with the team lead before rearranging my tasks.
examples.zh: 重新安排任务前，我向「团队负责人」核实了优先级。

words.enDefinition: shared expectations for how people behave and work together on a team

examples.en: One of our team norms is to post schedule changes where everyone can see them.
examples.zh: 把改期信息发到大家都能看到的地方，是我们的「团队共同遵守的习惯」之一。

examples.en: The supervisor explained the team norms to the students starting that week.
examples.zh: 主管给那周刚入职的学生讲了「团队共同遵守的习惯」。

words.enDefinition: a meeting where a team reviews a recent period of work and plans improvements

examples.en: Our team retrospective focused on why visitors had queued at the wrong entrance.
examples.zh: 「团队复盘会」主要讨论访客为什么会在错误的入口排队。

examples.en: I wrote down one practical change during the team retrospective after the workshop.
examples.zh: 培训后的「团队复盘会」上，我记下了一项可实行的改进。

collocations: take part in a team retrospective

words.enDefinition: The number of people who belong to a particular team

examples.en: The first bullet states the team size and explains what I coordinated.
examples.zh: 第一条要点写明了「团队人数」，并说明我协调了哪些工作。

examples.en: I left out the team size because the CV already mentioned all four roles.
examples.zh: 简历已提到全部四个分工，所以我省略了「团队人数」。

words.enDefinition: a task or set of questions used to evaluate technical skills for a role

examples.en: The technical assessment asked me to inspect two layouts and explain my recommendation.
examples.zh: 「技术能力测评」让我查看两种布局，说明我推荐哪一种以及理由。

examples.en: I received the result of my technical assessment the day after submitting it.
examples.zh: 提交「技术能力测评」后的第二天，我收到了结果。

words.enDefinition: listeners who already know the specialized concepts relevant to a topic

examples.en: I included more detail about the measurements because the panel was a technical audience.
examples.zh: 评审组是「具有专业背景的听众」，所以我多讲了一些测量细节。

examples.en: The guide gave an example of explaining uncertainty to a technical audience.
examples.zh: 指南举例说明怎样向「具有专业背景的听众」解释不确定性。

collocations: explain findings to a technical audience

words.enDefinition: an interview assessing the technical knowledge and skills needed for a role

examples.en: The technical interview included questions about how I had tested a class project.
examples.zh: 「技术面试」问到了我如何测试一个课程项目。

examples.en: I booked the technical interview for an afternoon when I had no lectures.
examples.zh: 我把「技术面试」约在一个没课的下午。

collocations: a technical interview for an internship

words.enDefinition: a round in a hiring process that focuses on technical skills or judgment

examples.en: The recruiter said the technical round would take place after the first interview.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说，「技术面试轮」会安排在第一轮面试之后。

examples.en: I asked how the technical round differed from the conversation with the hiring manager.
examples.zh: 我问「技术面试轮」和同招聘经理的谈话有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: an early recruitment check to assess whether a candidate has basic technical skills

examples.en: The technical screening covered a few questions about the software mentioned in the posting.
examples.zh: 「技术初筛」问了几个与招聘启事所列软件相关的问题。

examples.en: I received another invitation after passing the technical screening for the summer placement.
examples.zh: 通过暑期实习的「技术初筛」后，我收到了另一份邀请。

words.enDefinition: The part of a CV that lists job-related technical abilities

examples.en: I moved the programming languages to a separate technical skills section below my projects.
examples.zh: 我把编程语言移到项目经历下方，单列「技术技能栏」。

examples.en: The technical skills section was hard to scan until I grouped the tools by purpose.
examples.zh: 原先「技术技能栏」不便浏览，我便按用途给工具分了组。

words.enDefinition: an example showing how someone explains a technical topic or process in writing

examples.en: The lab asked for a technical writing sample that explained a method clearly.
examples.zh: 实验室要求提供一份能把方法讲清楚的「技术写作样本」。

examples.en: I chose a technical writing sample from an instruction sheet I had prepared.
examples.zh: 我从以前做过的说明单中选了一份「技术写作样本」。

words.expression: tell me about a time when
words.lemma: tell me about a time when
words.enDefinition: A lead-in requesting an example of something someone did before
acceptedEnVariants: tell me about a time when

examples.en: The interviewer began with "Tell me about a time when" and asked about missing a deadline.
examples.zh: 面试官以「请讲一次你曾……的经历」开头，问起没赶上截止日期的情况。

examples.en: I recognized "Tell me about a time when" as a prompt for a specific example from the past.
examples.zh: 我知道「请讲一次你曾……的经历」是在让人举出一个过去的具体例子。

collocations: tell me about a time when you led a team
tell me about a time when you made a mistake
tell me about a time when you had to ask for help

words.enDefinition: A prompt inviting a short introduction to a candidate's background

examples.en: When the interviewer said, "Tell me about yourself," I began with my current degree.
examples.zh: 面试官让我「介绍一下自己」时，我先说了自己正在读的学位。

examples.en: We practiced how to respond to "Tell me about yourself," starting with our most recent experience.
examples.zh: 我们练习怎样回答「请介绍一下自己」，从最近的经历讲起。

collocations: a response to "Tell me about yourself."

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚临时毕业生签证
words.enDefinition: An Australian visa allowing eligible graduates to stay and work temporarily
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚临时毕业生签证

examples.en: The Australian adviser presented the Temporary Graduate visa during a workshop for final-year students.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这位顾问在面向毕业年级学生的讲座上介绍了「澳大利亚临时毕业生签证」。

examples.en: I checked which section of the letter referred to the Temporary Graduate visa.
examples.zh: 我核对了信里哪一节提到「澳大利亚临时毕业生签证」。

words.enDefinition: a job intended to last a limited time

examples.en: The library advertised a temporary position to cover staff leave during the exam period.
examples.zh: 图书馆招了一个「临时岗位」，在考试期间顶替休假的员工。

examples.en: A temporary position would suit me because I'm spending next semester at another university.
examples.zh: 我下学期要去另一所学校，所以「临时岗位」挺适合我。

words.enDefinition: a time set aside provisionally for an appointment

examples.en: The coordinator held a tentative slot for Tuesday while I checked my placement timetable.
examples.zh: 我查实习时间表的时候，协调员先留了一个周二的「暂定时段」。

examples.en: I left the tentative slot free until the recruiter sent a definite time.
examples.zh: 招聘人员发来敲定的时间前，我都空着那个「暂定时段」。

words.enDefinition: an internship carried out while regular classes are in session

examples.en: I arranged a term-time internship on Fridays, when my course has no scheduled classes.
examples.zh: 我把「学期内实习」安排在周五，那天我的课程没排课。

examples.en: The gallery's term-time internship fits around lectures and runs until the spring break.
examples.zh: 美术馆的「学期内实习」能灵活避开上课时间，一直持续到春假。

words.enDefinition: limited to the weeks when classes are in session

examples.en: The campus café advertised the job as term-time only, leaving the winter break free.
examples.zh: 校内咖啡馆的招聘启事写着「仅学期内工作」，寒假不用上班。

examples.en: I asked whether the role was term-time only because I'll be away in July.
examples.zh: 我问这个岗位是否「仅学期内工作」，因为七月份我不在这儿。

collocations: available on a term-time only basis

words.enDefinition: To check whether a particular part of a product works properly

examples.en: I helped test a feature that let students renew books from their phones.
examples.zh: 我协助「测试一项功能」，让学生可以用手机续借图书。

examples.en: We asked five volunteers to test a feature before the campus app was released.
examples.zh: 校园应用发布前，我们请五位志愿者「测试一项功能」。

words.enDefinition: a defined situation with inputs and expected behaviour used to assess a system

examples.en: I added one test case for a list containing two copies of the same value.
examples.zh: 我加了一个「测试用例」，检验列表里有两个相同值的情况。

examples.en: The first test case checked the result against figures supplied in the prompt.
examples.zh: 第一个「测试用例」用题目给出的数字核对结果。

words.enDefinition: a setup or program that runs tests and provides the support needed to check results

examples.en: The platform supplied a test harness that called my function with sample inputs.
examples.zh: 平台提供了「测试执行框架」，用示例输入调用我的函数。

examples.en: I left the test harness unchanged and edited only the function under review.
examples.zh: 我保留了「测试执行框架」，只修改了正在评审的函数。

words.enDefinition: a collection of related tests run together to check software behaviour

examples.en: The test suite finished in a few seconds after I submitted the revised code.
examples.zh: 我提交改好的代码后，「测试套件」几秒钟就运行完了。

examples.en: I ran the test suite once more before handing in the exercise.
examples.zh: 交练习前，我又运行了一次「测试套件」。

collocations: add a case to the test suite

words.enDefinition: A period in which a test may be taken

examples.en: The test window opens on Monday and closes before the end of the week.
examples.zh: 「测试开放时段」从周一开始，在本周结束前截止。

examples.en: I checked the test window so I could choose a day without classes.
examples.zh: 我查了「测试开放时段」，这样能选一天没课的时间。

words.enDefinition: The position of text relative to a margin, center, or other reference

examples.en: The text alignment changed when I pasted the job titles from another document.
examples.zh: 我从另一份文件粘贴职称后，「文本对齐」方式变了。

examples.en: We checked the text alignment so each employment date lined up on the right.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「文本对齐」方式，让每段任职日期都在右边对齐。

words.enDefinition: Automatic movement of text to the next line within a space

examples.en: The text wrapping pushed the second half of my job title onto another line.
examples.zh: 「文本自动换行」把我职位名称的后半部分挤到了下一行。

examples.en: I checked the text wrapping after making the right-hand column slightly narrower.
examples.zh: 我把右栏调窄了一点，然后检查了「文本自动换行」情况。

words.enDefinition: thanks somebody for being direct and honest about something

examples.en: Thank you for being upfront about the travel involved, even before I applied.
examples.zh: 你在我申请前就把出差的情况说清楚了，「谢谢你坦诚说明」。

examples.en: Thank you for being upfront about the delay while your office moves buildings.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你坦诚说明」办公室搬迁期间会有延误。

collocations: thank you for being upfront about the change
thank you for being upfront about the hours
thank you for being upfront with me

words.enDefinition: expresses appreciation for someone making contact

examples.en: Thank you for reaching out about the gallery role, which sounds like a good fit.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你主动联系我」，美术馆的岗位听上去挺适合我。

examples.en: Thank you for reaching out again, as I missed your first message during exams.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你又联系了我」，我考试期间漏看了你第一封邮件。

collocations: thank you for reaching out about the role
thank you for reaching out to me
thank you for reaching out again

words.enDefinition: a polite closing thanking the reader for considering a request or application

examples.en: Thank you for your consideration of my application for the library assistant position.
examples.zh: 「感谢您审阅我的申请」，我想申请的是图书馆助理岗位。

examples.en: The sample uses “Thank you for your consideration” as its final full sentence.
examples.zh: 样本的最后一句完整的话是「感谢您审阅我的申请」。

collocations: close with thank you for your consideration
write thank you for your consideration
end the email with thank you for your consideration

words.enDefinition: thanks the person who organized a phone conversation

examples.en: Thanks for arranging the call with the manager while the coordinator was on leave.
examples.zh: 协调员休假期间，「谢谢你安排我和经理通话」。

examples.en: Thanks for arranging the call today so I could ask about the office location.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你安排今天这次通话」，让我能问问办公室在哪里。

collocations: thanks for arranging the call today
thanks for arranging the call with the manager
thanks for arranging the call at short notice

words.enDefinition: thanks somebody for remaining patient through a delay or problem

examples.en: Thanks for bearing with me while I found a quieter place to take the call.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你耐心等我」找到一个安静点的地方接电话。

examples.en: Thanks for bearing with me while I checked which days I could come in.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你耐心等我」查清自己哪几天能过去。

collocations: thanks for bearing with me through the delay
thanks for bearing with me while I check
thanks for bearing with me today

words.expression: thanks for getting back to me
words.lemma: thanks for getting back to me
words.enDefinition: thanks someone for responding after being contacted
acceptedEnVariants: thanks for getting back to me

examples.en: Thanks for getting back to me about the address so I know which building to use.
examples.zh: 关于地址，「谢谢你回复我」，我现在知道该去哪栋楼了。

examples.en: Thanks for getting back to me so quickly while you were organizing the open day.
examples.zh: 你还在忙开放日的事，「谢谢你这么快回复我」。

collocations: thanks for getting back to me so quickly
thanks for getting back to me about the date
thanks for getting back to me this morning

words.enDefinition: thanks someone for agreeing to speak by phone

examples.en: Thanks for taking my call today, especially with the careers fair starting this afternoon.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你今天接我电话」，特别是下午就要开始办就业展。

examples.en: Thanks for taking my call at short notice to clear up the two addresses.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你临时抽空接我电话」，帮忙弄清两个地址的事。

collocations: thanks for taking my call today
thanks for taking my call so quickly
thanks for taking my call at short notice

words.expression: thanks for taking the time to meet with me
words.lemma: thanks for taking the time to meet with me
words.zhGloss: 谢谢您抽时间与我见面
words.enDefinition: A polite expression of appreciation at the end of a meeting
acceptedZhAnswers: 谢谢您抽时间与我见面
acceptedEnVariants: thanks for taking the time to meet with me

examples.en: I closed with "Thanks for taking the time to meet with me" before gathering my notes.
examples.zh: 我最后说「谢谢您抽时间与我见面」，然后收好了笔记。

examples.en: I practiced saying "Thanks for taking the time to meet with me" as I left the room.
examples.zh: 我练习离开房间时说「谢谢您抽时间与我见面」。

collocations: thanks for taking the time to meet with me today
thanks for taking the time to meet with me in person
and thanks for taking the time to meet with me this morning

words.enDefinition: expresses gratitude for being considered or remembered for something

examples.en: Thanks for thinking of me for the summer job at the museum ticket desk.
examples.zh: 博物馆售票处招暑期员工，「谢谢你想到我」。

examples.en: Thanks for thinking of me again after we met at last year's open day.
examples.zh: 咱们去年开放日见过，「谢谢你又想到了我」。

collocations: thanks for thinking of me for the role
thanks for thinking of me again
thanks for thinking of me when this came up

words.expression: thanks for walking me through that
words.lemma: thanks for walking me through that
words.zhGloss: 谢谢你一步步给我讲解
words.enDefinition: thanks someone for explaining something step by step
acceptedZhAnswers: 谢谢你一步步给我讲解
acceptedEnVariants: thanks for walking me through that

examples.en: Thanks for walking me through that so I know exactly where to go on arrival.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你一步步给我讲解」，我现在知道到了该去哪儿了。

examples.en: Thanks for walking me through that by phone while I couldn't open the email.
examples.zh: 我当时打不开邮件，「谢谢你在电话里一步步给我讲解」。

collocations: thanks for walking me through that on the phone
thanks again for walking me through that
thanks for walking me through that so carefully

words.enDefinition: thanks somebody for accommodating a change or constraint

examples.en: Thanks for your flexibility with the time while I finish my project presentation on Thursday.
examples.zh: 周四我要完成项目展示，「谢谢你愿意灵活调整」时间。

examples.en: Thanks for your flexibility about the venue, as I can get to campus more easily.
examples.zh: 「谢谢你愿意灵活调整」地点，我到校区更方便。

collocations: thanks for your flexibility with the time
thanks for your flexibility on this
thanks for your flexibility about the date

words.enDefinition: says the file expected with a message did not arrive

examples.en: The attachment didn't come through, but I can see the time in your message.
examples.zh: 「附件没收到」，不过我能看到你正文里写的时间。

examples.en: It looks like the attachment didn't come through when the calendar invitation was forwarded.
examples.zh: 日历邀请转发过来时，好像「附件没一并收到」。

collocations: it looks like the attachment didn't come through
the attachment didn't come through this time
I'm afraid the attachment didn't come through

words.enDefinition: says a call reached voicemail when nobody answered

examples.en: The call went to voicemail after a few rings, so I sent a short email.
examples.zh: 铃响了几声后，「电话转到语音信箱了」，我就发了一封简短的邮件。

examples.en: I checked the time zone again when the call went to voicemail on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 周五下午「电话转到语音信箱了」，我就又查了查时区。

collocations: the call went to voicemail immediately
the call went to voicemail after a few rings
the call went to voicemail again

words.enDefinition: says an email could not be delivered and was returned

examples.en: The email bounced back, so I checked whether I had copied the address correctly.
examples.zh: 「邮件被退回了」，我就检查了一下地址有没有抄对。

examples.en: The email bounced back after I replied to the address on the old invitation.
examples.zh: 我回复到旧邀请里的地址后，「邮件被退回了」。

collocations: the email bounced back straight away
the email bounced back from that address

words.enDefinition: says a poor phone connection is interrupting the audio

examples.en: The line is breaking up, so could you repeat the name of the recruiter?
examples.zh: 「电话声音断断续续」，能再说一遍招聘人员的名字吗？

examples.en: Sorry, the line is breaking up again now that I've stepped into the station.
examples.zh: 不好意思，我一进车站，「电话声音又断断续续了」。

collocations: sorry, the line is breaking up
the line is breaking up on my end
the line is breaking up again

words.enDefinition: says a phone line is already in use

examples.en: The line is busy again, so I'll try the recruitment office after lunch.
examples.zh: 「电话又占线了」，我午饭后再打给招聘办公室。

examples.en: Try the direct number after two if the line is busy during lunch.
examples.zh: 如果午饭时「电话占线」，就两点后试试直拨电话。

collocations: the line is busy at the moment

words.enDefinition: A phrase introducing the most important lesson from an experience

examples.en: I used "The main takeaway was" to finish my answer about a mistake.
examples.zh: 我用「我最大的收获是」来收尾，回答的是我曾犯过的一个错误。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to complete "The main takeaway was" with one lesson I could explain.
examples.zh: 导师让我在「我最大的收获是」后面接一条我能解释清楚的经验。

collocations: the main takeaway was the need for clearer roles
the main takeaway was that planning helped
the main takeaway was about communication

words.expression: the timing isn't right for me
words.lemma: the timing isn't right for me
words.zhGloss: 现在对我来说时机不合适
words.enDefinition: explains that current circumstances make it a bad time
acceptedZhAnswers: 现在对我来说时机不合适
acceptedEnVariants: the timing isn't right for me

examples.en: The timing isn't right for me while I finish my placement in another city.
examples.zh: 我还在外地完成实习，「现在对我来说时机不合适」。

examples.en: Unfortunately, the timing isn't right for me, but I'd like to talk after graduation.
examples.zh: 可惜「现在对我来说时机不合适」，但我希望毕业后能再聊聊。

collocations: I'm afraid the timing isn't right for me
the timing isn't right for me this semester
unfortunately, the timing isn't right for me

words.expression: there seems to have been a mix-up
words.lemma: there seems to have been a mix-up
words.enDefinition: says something appears to have been confused or incorrectly arranged
acceptedEnVariants: there seems to have been a mix-up

examples.en: There seems to have been a mix-up because I received someone else's booking details.
examples.zh: 「好像哪里弄混了」，我收到了别人的预约信息。

examples.en: There seems to have been a mix-up with the dates in our calendar invitations.
examples.zh: 我们的日历邀请里，日期「好像弄混了」。

collocations: there seems to have been a mix-up with the dates
there seems to have been a mix-up with the booking
I'm afraid there seems to have been a mix-up

words.enDefinition: to say what you are thinking while you are working something out

examples.en: The interviewer asked me to think aloud while I tested the sample values.
examples.zh: 面试官请我在测试示例值时「边想边说」。

examples.en: I find it easier to think aloud when I start with a small example.
examples.zh: 我从一个小例子开始时，更容易做到「边想边说」。

collocations: think aloud while solving a problem

words.enDefinition: a small image preview representing a larger picture, video or page

examples.en: The thumbnail showed the final poster before visitors clicked through to the project.
examples.zh: 访客点进项目之前，「缩略图」上显示的是最终的海报。

examples.en: I replaced the thumbnail with a clearer crop of the same design.
examples.zh: 我用同一设计中裁得更清楚的图替换了「缩略图」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of time available or permitted to complete an activity

examples.en: The time allowance included both the presentation and any questions from the panel.
examples.zh: 「分配的时长」包括展示以及评审组提问。

examples.en: I checked the time allowance before deciding how many examples I could discuss.
examples.zh: 我先查了「分配的时长」，再决定能讲几个例子。

words.enDefinition: pay equal to one and a half times the usual rate

examples.en: The theatre listing says staff earn time and a half when they cover certain holidays.
examples.zh: 这家剧院的招聘启事写着，员工在某些节假日顶班能拿「一点五倍工资」。

examples.en: I asked which shifts qualified for time and a half at the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我问校内商店哪些班次可拿「一点五倍工资」。

words.enDefinition: a task designed to be completed within a specified amount of working time

examples.en: The time-boxed assignment was due Friday, but we were asked to spend only two hours.
examples.zh: 这项「限定用时的任务」周五截止，实际只要求我们用两小时完成。

examples.en: The time-boxed assignment helped the panel see what I would prioritize first.
examples.zh: 这项「限定用时的任务」让评审组看出我会优先做什么。

words.enDefinition: how a program's required steps grow as the input size increases

examples.en: The interviewer asked how the time complexity changed when I added the inner loop.
examples.zh: 面试官问我加上内层循环后，「时间复杂度」怎么变。

examples.en: I compared the time complexity of both solutions on a diagram at the board.
examples.zh: 我在白板上用图比较了两种解法的「时间复杂度」。

words.enDefinition: a result message saying that a program ran longer than the permitted time

examples.en: The result said “Time Limit Exceeded” after the platform checked the largest input.
examples.zh: 检测完一组里最大的数据后，结果显示「超出运行时限」。

examples.en: I saw “Time Limit Exceeded” twice before trying a less repetitive approach.
examples.zh: 我连续两次看到「超出运行时限」，后来试了重复计算更少的办法。

words.enDefinition: Time off given in exchange for extra hours worked

examples.en: The manager said the policy on time off in lieu was in the staff handbook.
examples.zh: 经理说，关于「加班后补休」的规定在员工手册里。

examples.en: I asked how to record time off in lieu after covering an extra evening shift.
examples.zh: 我问多顶了一个晚班后，该怎么登记「加班后的补休」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of time a change prevents people from spending

examples.en: I estimated the time savings from replacing two forms with a single checklist.
examples.zh: 我估算了用一张清单取代两份表格后「节省的时间」。

examples.en: The project bullet uses time savings to explain why the new tool mattered.
examples.zh: 项目要点用「节省的时间」说明新工具的价值。

words.enDefinition: An assessment that has a fixed time limit

examples.en: I chose a quiet computer room before starting the timed assessment for the library role.
examples.zh: 开始图书馆职位的「限时测评」前，我选了一间安静的机房。

examples.en: The timed assessment showed how many minutes I had left in the top corner.
examples.zh: 「限时测评」页面上方的角落里显示了还剩多少分钟。

words.enDefinition: Words that introduce context before someone describes the main point

examples.en: I said "To give you some background" before explaining why the student group needed help.
examples.zh: 我先说「先介绍一下背景」，再解释为什么这个学生小组需要帮助。

examples.en: The tutor shortened the part that followed "To give you some background" in my practice answer.
examples.zh: 导师缩短了我练习回答中「先介绍一下背景」后面的内容。

collocations: to give you some background on the project
to give you some background on the team
to give you some background, we had two shifts

words.enDefinition: a formal opening for a letter when the specific reader's name is unknown

examples.en: The reference letter began with “To Whom It May Concern” before the first paragraph.
examples.zh: 推荐信的第一段前面用了「致相关负责人」作称呼。

examples.en: I asked whether “To Whom It May Concern” was too formal for this application.
examples.zh: 我问在这份申请里用「致相关负责人」会不会太正式。

collocations: begin with to whom it may concern
use to whom it may concern
address a letter with to whom it may concern

words.enDefinition: The quality of someone's voice that conveys an attitude or feeling

examples.en: The coach noticed my tone of voice became softer when I explained the mistake.
examples.zh: 教练注意到我解释那次错误时，「说话语气」变柔和了。

examples.en: My roommate said the same words sounded different in another tone of voice.
examples.zh: 室友说，同样的话换一种「说话语气」就会听起来不一样。

words.enDefinition: The highest pay in a particular band

examples.en: The recruiter said the amount in my letter was the top of the pay band.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说，信里的金额已经是「薪酬区间上限」。

examples.en: I asked what experience was needed to start at the top of the pay band.
examples.zh: 我问要有什么经验，起薪才能达到「薪酬区间上限」。

collocations: start at the top of the pay band
reach the top of the pay band
pay at the top of the pay band

words.enDefinition: The combined value of pay and employer benefits

examples.en: The offer summary listed total compensation separately from the amount paid in cash.
examples.zh: 录用摘要把「薪酬福利总值」和现金支付金额分开列了。

examples.en: I asked whether the travel allowance was included in the total compensation figure shown.
examples.zh: 我问列出的「薪酬福利总值」里有没有算上交通补贴。

words.enDefinition: To monitor how far work has moved toward completion

examples.en: I used a shared board to track progress across five student teams.
examples.zh: 我用共享看板为五个学生团队「跟踪进度」。

examples.en: My adviser asked how I helped track progress before the exhibition opened.
examples.zh: 顾问问我在展览开幕前怎样协助「跟踪进度」。

collocations: use a spreadsheet to track progress

words.enDefinition: to use extra memory in order to make a program or calculation faster

examples.en: I explained that keeping a lookup table would let us trade space for time.
examples.zh: 我解释说，保留查找表可以「用空间换时间」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked when it made sense to trade space for time in this solution.
examples.zh: 面试官问这个解法在什么情况下适合「用空间换时间」。

collocations: decide to trade space for time
trade space for time with a lookup table
an opportunity to trade space for time

words.enDefinition: To teach new workers the skills or procedures their jobs require

examples.en: I helped train new staff on the returns system after my first semester.
examples.zh: 第一学期过后，我协助书店就退货系统「培训新员工」。

examples.en: My CV says I volunteered to train new staff at the campus café.
examples.zh: 我的简历写着，我曾主动帮校园咖啡馆「培训新员工」。

words.enDefinition: someone learning to teach through study and school experience

examples.en: As a trainee teacher, I met my school mentor after each lesson to discuss it.
examples.zh: 作为「受训教师」，我每次上完课都和学校导师见面交流。

examples.en: The trainee teacher asked the school mentor for feedback on her first lesson plan.
examples.zh: 「受训教师」请学校导师对自己的第一份教案给点反馈。

words.enDefinition: A record that someone confirms they received or completed training

examples.en: The portal showed my training acknowledgment after the library completed the orientation.
examples.zh: 图书馆办完入职介绍后，平台显示了我的「培训完成确认」。

examples.en: I asked whether the training acknowledgment was linked to my department's safety session.
examples.zh: 我问「培训完成确认」是否关联院系的安全培训。

words.enDefinition: An agreement setting terms for the training someone will receive

examples.en: The training agreement listed which supervisor would oversee my workplace learning.
examples.zh: 「培训协议」写明哪位主管负责指导我的在岗学习。

examples.en: I checked the training agreement to see where the training would take place.
examples.zh: 我查看了「培训协议」，想知道培训在哪里进行。

words.enDefinition: one self-contained part of a training course or program

examples.en: The first training module introduced the systems we'd use to record our project work.
examples.zh: 第一个「培训单元」介绍了我们用来记录项目工作的系统。

examples.en: I finished the training module before joining the team at the branch library.
examples.zh: 去分馆加入团队前，我完成了这个「培训单元」。

words.enDefinition: an organization that delivers the formal instruction for a training program

examples.en: The employer put me in touch with the training provider that ran the study sessions.
examples.zh: 雇主帮我联系了组织学习课程的「培训机构」。

examples.en: I asked the training provider how its classes would fit around my shifts.
examples.zh: 我问「培训机构」他们的课怎么安排，能避开我的班次。

words.enDefinition: a record of training someone has undertaken and their progress

examples.en: My supervisor updated my training record after I finished the second workshop at the depot.
examples.zh: 我上完配送中心的第二场工作坊后，带教老师更新了「培训记录」。

examples.en: The coordinator checked my training record before sending me to a different placement team.
examples.zh: 协调员先查了我的「培训记录」，才把我安排到另一个实习团队。

words.enDefinition: Money toward travel costs incurred for work

examples.en: The offer included a travel allowance for visits to museums outside the city.
examples.zh: 录用通知包括去市外博物馆出差的「差旅补贴」。

examples.en: I asked whether the travel allowance covered the train fare between the two branches.
examples.zh: 我问「差旅补贴」是否能支付两个分馆之间的火车票。

words.enDefinition: repayment of expenses from travel connected with work

examples.en: The theatre offers travel reimbursement when staff have to visit its other sites.
examples.zh: 员工需要去其他场地时，剧院提供「出行费用报销」。

examples.en: I asked if travel reimbursement covered train tickets to the company's training centre.
examples.zh: 我问去公司培训中心的火车票能不能算在「出行费用报销」里。

words.enDefinition: help from an employer with the cost of courses

examples.en: The hospital lists tuition assistance for employees taking courses related to their current roles.
examples.zh: 医院的招聘启事写着，员工上和目前岗位相关的课可获「雇主学费补助」。

examples.en: I asked whether the tuition assistance covered short courses as well as degree programs.
examples.zh: 我问短期课程是否也能获得「雇主学费补助」，还是只有学位课程才行。

words.enDefinition: A design that places main content in two vertical columns

examples.en: The two-column layout put my skills and work history side by side.
examples.zh: 「双栏版式」把我的技能和工作履历并排列出。

examples.en: I switched away from the two-column layout after two titles wrapped awkwardly.
examples.zh: 两个标题换行后看起来不顺眼，所以我换掉了「双栏版式」。

words.enDefinition: A role that has not been publicly listed

examples.en: My tutor heard about an unadvertised vacancy at a gallery near the university.
examples.zh: 我导师听说学校附近一家美术馆有个「未公开招聘的空缺」。

examples.en: The shop manager told me about an unadvertised vacancy when I asked about summer work.
examples.zh: 我去问暑期工作时，店长告诉我有个「未公开招聘的空缺」。

words.enDefinition: sales-based pay with no stated maximum amount

examples.en: The listing offers uncapped commission, so I asked how the basic hourly pay worked.
examples.zh: 招聘启事说「提成上不封顶」，于是我问基本时薪怎么算。

examples.en: The shop advertises uncapped commission for staff who help customers choose broadband packages.
examples.zh: 这家店在招聘帮助顾客选择宽带套餐的员工，注明「提成上不封顶」。

words.enDefinition: An offer with no outstanding requirements to meet

examples.en: The library issued an unconditional offer once it had all the information it needed.
examples.zh: 图书馆拿到所需的全部信息后，发出了「无附加条件的录用通知」。

examples.en: I asked whether the email was an unconditional offer or whether any checks were outstanding.
examples.zh: 我问邮件是「无附加条件的录用通知」，还是有审核没完成。

words.enDefinition: A record showing which uniform items a worker has received

examples.en: My uniform issue record showed one shirt and an apron from the café.
examples.zh: 我的「制服领用记录」显示，我从咖啡馆领了一件衬衫和一条围裙。

examples.en: The manager updated the uniform issue record when I exchanged the shirt size.
examples.zh: 我换衬衫尺码时，经理更新了「制服领用记录」。

words.enDefinition: the employer supplies the clothing worn for the job

examples.en: The listing says 'Uniform provided,' so I asked how shoe sizes were handled.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着「提供工作制服」，所以我问工作鞋的尺码怎么选。

examples.en: I noticed 'Uniform provided' at the bottom of the ad for the museum shop.
examples.zh: 我在博物馆商店的招聘启事底部看到「提供工作制服」。

words.enDefinition: a test that checks the behaviour of a small, individual part of a program

examples.en: I wrote a unit test for the helper function before changing its implementation.
examples.zh: 我在改辅助函数的实现前，为它写了一个「单元测试」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked why my unit test did not cover the empty input.
examples.zh: 面试官问，我的「单元测试」为什么没有覆盖输入为空的情况。

words.enDefinition: a placement found and organized by the university

examples.en: I chose a university-arranged placement because I was new to the city and its employers.
examples.zh: 我刚到这座城市，不熟悉当地的用人单位，所以选择了「学校安排的实习」。

examples.en: The university-arranged placement was close to campus, which made the weekly meetings easier to attend.
examples.zh: 「学校安排的实习」离学校近，每周的会议更容易参加。

words.enDefinition: A university website with career information and services

examples.en: I used the university careers portal to book a place at the employer session.
examples.zh: 我通过「高校就业服务门户」预约了雇主说明会的席位。

examples.en: The university careers portal still showed events for graduates after I finished the course.
examples.zh: 我结课后，「高校就业服务门户」仍会显示面向毕业生的活动。

collocations: log in to the university careers portal
register on the university careers portal
resources on the university careers portal

words.enDefinition: a video omitted from public listings which users can typically view using its link

examples.en: The application accepted an unlisted video as long as the link worked for reviewers.
examples.zh: 申请方接受「不公开列出的视频」，只要评审能通过链接打开。

examples.en: I sent the panel a link to an unlisted video showing my design process.
examples.zh: 我给评审组发了一个「不公开列出的视频」链接，视频展示了我的设计过程。

words.enDefinition: a pause during a shift for which you are not paid

examples.en: The schedule has an unpaid break between the morning session and the afternoon workshop.
examples.zh: 早上的活动和下午的工作坊之间，排班表安排了「不计薪的休息时间」。

examples.en: I checked whether the unpaid break would be included in the total hours shown.
examples.zh: 我查了「不计薪的休息时间」是否会算在显示的总工时里。

words.enDefinition: an internship that does not pay a wage

examples.en: I checked whether I could afford to do an unpaid internship during the break.
examples.zh: 我算了算，看看自己能不能负担假期做「无薪实习」的开销。

examples.en: The department listed an unpaid internship at a community radio station near campus.
examples.zh: 院系列了一项「无薪实习」，地点在学校附近的社区电台。

words.enDefinition: Approved time away from work without pay

examples.en: I asked about unpaid leave because my course includes a short trip in June.
examples.zh: 我问了「无薪休假」的事，因为课程包含六月的一次短途出行。

examples.en: The department explained how to request unpaid leave for days outside my annual allowance.
examples.zh: 部门说明了超出年假额度的日子怎样申请「无薪休假」。

words.enDefinition: an example of work that has not been published

examples.en: The application accepted an unpublished sample as long as I explained its context.
examples.zh: 申请方接受「未发表的样本」，但需要我说明作品背景。

examples.en: I selected an unpublished sample that I had written specifically for my course.
examples.zh: 我选了一个专门为课程写的「未发表的样本」。

collocations: an unpublished sample of your work

words.enDefinition: An attached file that cannot be read

examples.en: The portal flagged an unreadable attachment and gave me a chance to replace it.
examples.zh: 门户标出了一个「无法读取的附件」，并允许我更换。

examples.en: The department asked for a new copy after noticing an unreadable attachment in my application.
examples.zh: 部门发现我的申请里有个「无法读取的附件」后，让我再交一份副本。

words.enDefinition: work that is not yet available to the public or its intended audience

examples.en: I left the unreleased work out of my portfolio until the studio approved it.
examples.zh: 工作室批准之前，我没有把「尚未公开的作品」放进作品集。

examples.en: The recruiter said they did not need to see any unreleased work from clients.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说，他们不需要看客户的任何「尚未公开的作品」。

words.enDefinition: Changes made but not yet stored

examples.en: The portal warned me about unsaved changes when I tried to close the tab.
examples.zh: 我准备关掉标签页时，门户提醒我还有「未保存的更改」。

examples.en: I went back because I didn't want to lose the unsaved changes to my answers.
examples.zh: 我返回上一页，因为不想丢掉答案中「未保存的更改」。

words.enDefinition: A copy of a document without signatures

examples.en: I accidentally downloaded the unsigned copy instead of the file we had signed.
examples.zh: 我不小心下载了「未签字的副本」，没下载我们已经签好的文件。

examples.en: The unsigned copy was still attached to the original message from the library.
examples.zh: 图书馆最早发的那条消息里仍然附着「未签字的副本」。

words.enDefinition: to change the shared display of tasks to show their current status

examples.en: I had to update the task board after finishing the afternoon bookings.
examples.zh: 办完下午的预约后，我得「更新任务看板」。

examples.en: The coordinator asked me to update the task board before we started the meeting.
examples.zh: 协调员让我在开会之前「更新任务看板」。

collocations: update the task board after a meeting
remember to update the task board

words.enDefinition: To revise information in an existing application

examples.en: Can you update your application if you change your address during the recruitment process?
examples.zh: 如果在招聘期间搬家，还能「更新你的申请资料」吗？

examples.en: The portal lets you update your application until the employer begins reviewing it.
examples.zh: 雇主开始审核之前，你可以在求职门户上「更新申请资料」。

collocations: log in to update your application
update your application before the deadline

words.enDefinition: To send a new file in place of another

examples.en: Can I upload a replacement file without losing my answers to the application questions?
examples.zh: 我能「上传替换文件」，同时保留申请问题的答案吗？

examples.en: I had to upload a replacement file after noticing I'd attached my older transcript.
examples.zh: 我发现自己加的是旧成绩单，只好「上传替换文件」。

collocations: choose to upload a replacement file
allow someone to upload a replacement file
upload a replacement file before submitting

words.enDefinition: A message confirming a file upload succeeded

examples.en: I waited for the upload confirmation before moving on to the last page.
examples.zh: 我等到「上传确认通知」后，才继续到最后一页。

examples.en: The upload confirmation gave the name of each file the portal had received.
examples.zh: 「上传确认通知」列出了门户收到的每个文件名。

words.enDefinition: The system did not finish receiving a file

examples.en: The portal displayed Upload failed just as I was about to submit the form.
examples.zh: 我正准备提交表单时，门户提示「上传失败」。

examples.en: My screen said Upload failed, but the attachment appeared when I refreshed the page.
examples.zh: 我的屏幕显示「上传失败」，但刷新后附件就出现了。

words.enDefinition: How much of a file has been uploaded

examples.en: I kept the tab open while the upload progress went from halfway to complete.
examples.zh: 「上传进度」到了一半后，我继续开着标签页，等上传完成。

examples.en: The upload progress stayed at zero until I switched to the campus Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 我切到校园 Wi-Fi 前，「上传进度」一直是零。

words.enDefinition: To present dates in the same form throughout a document

examples.en: The reviewer reminded me to use consistent dates across all three experience entries.
examples.zh: 审阅者提醒我在三条经历里「统一日期格式」。

examples.en: The sample shows how to use consistent dates when listing ongoing and past roles.
examples.zh: 样本示范了同时列出在职和已结束的经历时怎样「统一日期格式」。

words.enDefinition: A rule that unused allowances expire without carrying over

examples.en: I asked whether the use-it-or-lose-it policy applied to the volunteer day in the offer.
examples.zh: 我问录用通知里的志愿服务日是否适用「额度到期作废政策」。

examples.en: The use-it-or-lose-it policy was explained near the end of the staff benefits guide.
examples.zh: 员工福利指南快结尾的地方说明了「额度到期作废政策」。

collocations: be subject to a use-it-or-lose-it policy

words.enDefinition: A job that is available for someone to fill

examples.en: The bookshop put a sign in the window when it had a vacancy.
examples.zh: 书店有「职位空缺」时，在橱窗里贴了招聘告示。

examples.en: I asked the librarian whether the vacancy was still listed on the university website.
examples.zh: 我问图书管理员，那个「空缺职位」是不是还挂在学校网站上。

collocations: a vacancy at a local shop

words.enDefinition: The employer has found someone for the role

examples.en: The original page displayed Vacancy filled when I checked the listing on the weekend.
examples.zh: 我周末查看招聘信息时，原页面显示「职位已招到人」。

examples.en: I saw Vacancy filled beside the library role even though my application still appeared.
examples.zh: 虽然还看得到我的申请，但图书馆职位旁已经显示「职位已招到人」。

collocations: mark a listing as vacancy filled

words.enDefinition: to test whether an idea taken as true is supported by available evidence

examples.en: I used the survey to validate an assumption that students wanted a later shuttle.
examples.zh: 我用问卷来「验证一项假设」，即学生希望接驳车运营到更晚。

examples.en: The panel asked how I would validate an assumption before relying on the estimate.
examples.zh: 评审组问，在采用估算值之前，我会怎样「验证一项假设」。

words.enDefinition: A message showing an entry failed a check

examples.en: I got a validation error because I entered letters in the student number field.
examples.zh: 因为在学号栏输入了字母，我收到了「校验错误」提示。

examples.en: The validation error disappeared when I changed the date to the format shown below.
examples.zh: 我按下方显示的格式修改日期后，「校验错误」提示就消失了。

words.enDefinition: working times or amounts that change from week to week

examples.en: The advert lists variable hours because the number of events changes from week to week.
examples.zh: 招聘启事注明「工时不固定」，因为每周活动的数量不同。

examples.en: I could work variable hours during the break, but my term schedule is fixed.
examples.zh: 假期我可以接受「不固定的工时」，但我学期内的时间是固定的。

words.enDefinition: Pay that can change based on stated conditions

examples.en: The offer separated variable pay from the amount guaranteed for each month.
examples.zh: 录用通知把「浮动薪酬」和每月保证支付的金额分开列了。

examples.en: I asked how variable pay was calculated for staff working at different locations.
examples.zh: 我问在不同地点工作的员工，「浮动薪酬」是怎么算的。

words.enDefinition: the ability to explain ideas and understand others in conversation

examples.en: The tour guide role needs verbal communication skills to explain directions in a busy building.
examples.zh: 导览岗位需要「口头沟通能力」，以便在繁忙的大楼里把路线讲清楚。

examples.en: The ad mentions verbal communication skills because staff often talk to families over the phone.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到「口头沟通能力」，因为员工经常要在电话里和家属沟通。

words.enDefinition: An offer communicated by speaking instead of writing

examples.en: I got a verbal offer over the phone while I was walking home from class.
examples.zh: 我下课走回家的路上接到电话，收到了「口头录用通知」。

examples.en: The manager made a verbal offer and said the written details would follow that afternoon.
examples.zh: 经理发出了「口头录用通知」，说当天下午会发来书面细节。

collocations: confirm a verbal offer in writing

words.enDefinition: an assessment of how well someone understands written information and reasons from it

examples.en: The verbal reasoning test asked whether each conclusion followed from the text provided.
examples.zh: 「文字推理测验」问每个结论能不能从给出的文字推导出来。

examples.en: I read the rules for the verbal reasoning test before opening the first passage.
examples.zh: 打开第一段材料前，我读了「文字推理测验」的规则。

collocations: prepare for a verbal reasoning test

words.enDefinition: To check that an employer is genuine

examples.en: My adviser showed me how to verify an employer using the company's official website.
examples.zh: 就业顾问教我如何通过公司官网「核实雇主身份」。

examples.en: The career portal lets students verify an employer before sharing any contact information.
examples.zh: 就业门户让学生在分享任何联系方式前先「核实雇主身份」。

collocations: take time to verify an employer

words.enDefinition: A list or record of changes to a document over time

examples.en: I used the version history to recover a bullet I had deleted.
examples.zh: 我用「版本记录」找回了自己删掉的一条要点。

examples.en: The version history helped me confirm which document the adviser had reviewed.
examples.zh: 「版本记录」帮我确认顾问审阅的是哪一份文档。

collocations: restore a file from version history

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚签证权益核验
words.enDefinition: An Australian online check of visa information and conditions
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚签证权益核验

examples.en: The Australian employer explained which conditions a VEVO check would show.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚雇主解释了「澳大利亚签证权益核验」会显示哪些条件。

examples.en: I asked where to see the date of my VEVO check.
examples.zh: 我问在哪里能看到我的「澳大利亚签证权益核验」日期。

collocations: a copy of the VEVO check

words.enDefinition: a link granting permission to view a file or page without allowing edits

examples.en: I sent a view-only link so the employer could open the slides without changing them.
examples.zh: 我发了「仅供查看的链接」，雇主能打开幻灯片，但不能修改。

examples.en: The adviser tested the view-only link from a browser without my account signed in.
examples.zh: 顾问在没有登录我的账号的浏览器里测试了「仅供查看的链接」。

words.enDefinition: To see files already sent to the portal

examples.en: Where can I view uploaded files before submitting a new application on this site?
examples.zh: 在这个网站上提交新申请前，我可以在哪里「查看已上传的文件」？

examples.en: I clicked to view uploaded files and spotted a document with the wrong filename.
examples.zh: 我点击「查看已上传的文件」，发现有一份材料的文件名不对。

collocations: log in to view uploaded files
view uploaded files in the portal

words.enDefinition: An online event connecting job seekers and employers

examples.en: I took part in a virtual career fair from my room during reading week.
examples.zh: 我在阅读周从宿舍参加了一场「线上招聘会」。

examples.en: The virtual career fair had separate video rooms for each employer and a shared schedule.
examples.zh: 「线上招聘会」给每家雇主安排了独立的视频会议室，大家共用一份日程表。

collocations: register for a virtual career fair

words.enDefinition: an internship carried out online from a different location

examples.en: My virtual internship involved weekly video meetings with a design team in another city.
examples.zh: 我做「线上实习」时，每周和另一座城市的设计团队开视频会。

examples.en: I chose a virtual internship because I couldn't move away from campus that semester.
examples.zh: 那学期我没法搬离学校，所以选了「线上实习」。

collocations: a virtual internship with a remote team

words.enDefinition: Formal support an employer or organization provides for a visa case

examples.en: I asked what the employer meant by visa sponsorship in its message.
examples.zh: 我问雇主在消息里所说的「签证担保」是什么意思。

examples.en: The adviser explained why the visa sponsorship question was separate from my qualifications.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么「签证担保」的问题与我的资历分开询问。

words.enDefinition: a recorded message callers hear before leaving voicemail

examples.en: The voicemail greeting gave the recruiter's return date and the address of the shared inbox.
examples.zh: 「语音信箱问候语」说了招聘人员哪天回来，还给了共用邮箱的地址。

examples.en: I updated my voicemail greeting before applying so employers would know they had reached me.
examples.zh: 申请前我更新了「语音信箱问候语」，好让雇主知道自己打给了对的人。

words.enDefinition: Sharing information that is not required

examples.en: The form described the questions about personal background as voluntary disclosure in a separate note.
examples.zh: 这份表单单独注明，个人背景问题属于「自愿披露」。

examples.en: I asked whether voluntary disclosure meant I could skip the section and still continue.
examples.zh: 我问「自愿披露」是否意味着我可以跳过这一栏继续。

words.enDefinition: Unpaid work or activities carried out to help an organization or community

examples.en: I listed my volunteer experience at the community kitchen below my summer job.
examples.zh: 我在暑期工作下方列出了在社区厨房的「志愿服务经历」。

examples.en: Her volunteer experience shows she has already worked with children from different age groups.
examples.zh: 她的「志愿服务经历」说明她曾和不同年龄段的孩子打过交道。

words.enDefinition: a project that someone undertakes without pay to support an organization or community

examples.en: I used a volunteer project from the food bank to demonstrate my scheduling skills.
examples.zh: 我用食物银行的一个「志愿服务项目」展示自己的排班能力。

examples.en: The volunteer project gave me experience working with people from several different courses.
examples.zh: 「志愿服务项目」给了我和不同课程的同学一起工作的经验。

words.enDefinition: A request to explain relevant past roles or activities in sequence

examples.en: The interviewer said "Walk me through your experience." I began with my campus job.
examples.zh: 听到「请梳理一下你的经历」后，我先从校内工作讲起。

examples.en: The prompt "Walk me through your experience" gave me room to explain why I switched roles.
examples.zh: 「请梳理一下你的经历」这道题让我有机会说明自己为什么换了岗位。

collocations: begin with "Walk me through your experience."
a response to "Walk me through your experience."

words.enDefinition: An introduction arranged by someone both parties know

examples.en: My tutor made a warm introduction to an editor who used to take our course.
examples.zh: 导师给我做了次「熟人引荐」，介绍我认识一位也上过我们课程的编辑。

examples.en: It was easier to ask about the field after a warm introduction from a classmate.
examples.zh: 经同学「引荐」后，再向对方打听行业情况就容易多了。

words.expression: we don't have an update yet
words.lemma: we don't have an update yet
words.zhGloss: 我们暂时还没有新消息
words.enDefinition: says there is no new information available so far
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们暂时还没有新消息
acceptedEnVariants: we don't have an update yet

examples.en: We don't have an update yet because the manager is still away this week.
examples.zh: 经理这周还没回来，所以「我们暂时还没有新消息」。

examples.en: We don't have an update yet on the dates, but I'll check again tomorrow.
examples.zh: 关于日期「我们暂时还没有新消息」，但我明天会再查一次。

collocations: we don't have an update yet from the team
I'm afraid we don't have an update yet
we don't have an update yet on the dates

words.enDefinition: A connection with someone you know only casually

examples.en: The speaker used an old classmate as an example of a weak tie.
examples.zh: 演讲者举了以前同班但并不熟的同学这个例子，来说明什么是「弱关系」。

examples.en: I heard about both openings through weak ties I made in my first year.
examples.zh: 这两个岗位都是我通过大一认识的「泛泛之交」打听到的。

words.enDefinition: restricted to Monday through Friday of a usual week

examples.en: The position was listed as weekdays only, so I could keep coaching on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写着「仅限工作日」，我就能继续在周六当教练。

examples.en: I can work weekdays only once the university sports season starts again next month.
examples.zh: 学校的运动赛季下个月重新开始后，我就「只能在工作日上班」了。

words.enDefinition: work scheduled for Saturdays or Sundays

examples.en: The gift shop advertised weekend work, which would fit around my classes during the week.
examples.zh: 礼品店在招「周末工作」的人，这样不会和我平时的课冲突。

examples.en: I can do weekend work as long as I have enough notice to move things around.
examples.zh: 只要提前告诉我，让我有时间调整安排，我就能做「周末工作」。

words.enDefinition: a meeting arranged to greet someone joining a workplace or team

examples.en: The welcome meeting gave me a chance to meet people from the other shift.
examples.zh: 「入职欢迎会」让我有机会认识另一个班次的人。

examples.en: I wrote down the team members' names during the welcome meeting last Monday.
examples.zh: 上周一参加「入职欢迎会」时，我记下了团队成员的名字。

words.enDefinition: A response with a logical order that listeners can follow

examples.en: A well-structured answer helped the panel see how each step led to the result.
examples.zh: 「条理清楚的回答」让面试小组明白了各个步骤怎么带来结果。

examples.en: I practiced turning my scattered notes into a well-structured answer about teamwork.
examples.zh: 我练习把零散的笔记整理成「条理清楚的回答」，用于团队合作的话题。

collocations: a well-structured answer to a question

words.enDefinition: Money an employer provides for well-being expenses

examples.en: The wellness allowance covered part of the cost of my local sports centre membership.
examples.zh: 这笔「身心健康补贴」承担了我加入本地体育中心的部分费用。

examples.en: I checked whether the wellness allowance was still included in the revised offer.
examples.zh: 我确认了修改后的录用通知里还有没有「身心健康补贴」。

words.enDefinition: A question asking someone to identify their strong abilities or qualities

examples.en: For "What are your strengths?" I picked one skill I had used in two roles.
examples.zh: 回答「你有哪些优势」时，我选了一项在两个岗位上都用过的技能。

examples.en: I practiced answering "What are your strengths?" with a story about organizing our exhibition.
examples.zh: 我练习用筹办展览的经历回答「你有哪些优势」。

collocations: answer "What are your strengths?" with an example

words.enDefinition: A question asking about the action that immediately followed an event

examples.en: The interviewer asked "What did you do next?" after I described the missing files.
examples.zh: 我说完文件丢失的情况后，面试官问「接下来你做了什么」。

examples.en: I heard "What did you do next?" and explained why I spoke to the supervisor.
examples.zh: 听到「接下来你做了什么」，我解释了为什么要去找主管。

collocations: follow up with "What did you do next?"

words.expression: what did you learn from that experience
words.lemma: what did you learn from that experience
words.zhGloss: 那段经历让你学到什么
words.enDefinition: A question asking someone to reflect on lessons from past events
acceptedZhAnswers: 那段经历让你学到什么
acceptedEnVariants: what did you learn from that experience

examples.en: After I explained the delay, the interviewer asked "What did you learn from that experience?" and waited.
examples.zh: 我说明延误的原因后，面试官问「那段经历让你学到了什么」，然后等我回答。

examples.en: I explained a communication lesson when asked "What did you learn from that experience?"
examples.zh: 模拟面试时，我用一条沟通方面的经验回答「那段经历让你学到了什么」。

collocations: ask "What did you learn from that experience?"
answer "What did you learn from that experience?"
follow up with "What did you learn from that experience?"

words.enDefinition: a phrase introducing the reason a role or organization is appealing to the writer

examples.en: What draws me to this role is the chance to help digitize local archives.
examples.zh: 「吸引我选择这个岗位的地方」是能参与本地档案的数字化。

examples.en: What draws me to this placement is the chance to work with community groups.
examples.zh: 「吸引我选择这项实习的地方」是能有机会与社区团体合作。

collocations: what draws me to this role
what draws me to your organization
explain what draws me to the position

words.enDefinition: Words used to introduce a clearer explanation of a point

examples.en: I said "What I mean is" before explaining exactly how we shared the work.
examples.zh: 我先说「我的意思是」，然后具体解释我们怎样分工。

examples.en: The coach noticed I kept saying "What I mean is" even when my meaning was clear.
examples.zh: 教练发现即使我已经说得很清楚，也还在反复说「我的意思是」。

collocations: what I mean is that the deadline changed
what I mean is that we shared the work
what I mean is, I handled the records

words.enDefinition: a question asking how the answer or outcome might change under different conditions

examples.en: The panel asked a what-if question about the service running during a power cut.
examples.zh: 评审组问了一个「假设性问题」，假设停电时服务还要运行。

examples.en: I answered a what-if question about demand doubling at the start of term.
examples.zh: 我回答了一个「假设性问题」，假设开学时需求翻倍。

collocations: a what-if question about rising demand

words.expression: what interests you about this role
words.lemma: what interests you about this role
words.enDefinition: A question about which parts of a role appeal to someone
acceptedEnVariants: what interests you about this role

examples.en: When I heard "What interests you about this role?", I mentioned the chance to work with visitors.
examples.zh: 听到「这个岗位哪里吸引你」时，我提到了与来访者打交道的机会。

examples.en: I practiced answering "What interests you about this role?" without repeating the whole job description.
examples.zh: 练习回答「这个岗位哪里吸引你」时，我尽量避免重复整个职位描述。

collocations: ask "What interests you about this role?"
a response to "What interests you about this role?"
practice answering "What interests you about this role?"

words.enDefinition: A question asking someone to identify their biggest area for improvement

examples.en: When I heard "What is your greatest weakness?", I talked about learning to delegate tasks.
examples.zh: 听到「你最大的不足是什么」时，我谈了自己如何学习把任务交给别人。

examples.en: I practiced answering "What is your greatest weakness?" with an example of something I was improving.
examples.zh: 我用一件自己正在改进的事练习回答「你最大的不足是什么」。

collocations: practice answering "What is your greatest weakness?"
a response to "What is your greatest weakness?"

words.expression: what makes you a good fit for this role
words.lemma: what makes you a good fit for this role
words.zhGloss: 你为什么适合这个岗位
words.enDefinition: A question asking why someone's background matches the role
acceptedZhAnswers: 你为什么适合这个岗位
acceptedEnVariants: what makes you a good fit for this role

examples.en: I heard "What makes you a good fit for this role?" and mentioned my tutoring work.
examples.zh: 听到「你为什么适合这个岗位」，我提到了自己的辅导工作。

examples.en: I answered "What makes you a good fit for this role?" with one clear example.
examples.zh: 我用一个清楚的例子回答「你为什么适合这个岗位」。

collocations: ask "What makes you a good fit for this role?"
a response to "What makes you a good fit for this role?"
prepare for "What makes you a good fit for this role?"

words.enDefinition: A question asking what gives someone energy or purpose at work

examples.en: I talked about helping others when the interviewer asked "What motivates you?"
examples.zh: 被问到「什么让你有工作动力」时，我谈到了帮别人解决小问题。

examples.en: My answer to "What motivates you?" came from a project I had enjoyed at university.
examples.zh: 我用大学里一个自己喜欢的项目来回答「什么让你有工作动力」。

collocations: prepare a response to "What motivates you?"

words.expression: what time zone is that in
words.lemma: what time zone is that in
words.zhGloss: 那个时间是哪个时区的
words.enDefinition: asks which time zone a stated time refers to
acceptedZhAnswers: 那个时间是哪个时区的
acceptedEnVariants: what time zone is that in

examples.en: You suggested three on Thursday, but what time zone is that in for the call?
examples.zh: 你建议周四三点通话，但「那个时间是哪个时区的」？

examples.en: Before I add it to my calendar, what time zone is that in?
examples.zh: 在加到日历之前，我想问「那个时间是哪个时区的」？

collocations: what time zone is that in exactly?
just to check, what time zone is that in?
and what time zone is that in?

words.expression: what was your role in the team
words.lemma: what was your role in the team
words.enDefinition: A question asking what someone personally contributed to a team
acceptedEnVariants: what was your role in the team

examples.en: I described the rota when asked "What was your role in the team?" at the interview.
examples.zh: 面试时被问到「你在团队中负责什么」，我介绍了排班表。

examples.en: To answer "What was your role in the team?" I explained which meetings I led.
examples.zh: 回答「你在团队中负责什么」时，我说明了自己主持过哪些会议。

collocations: ask "What was your role in the team?"
answer "What was your role in the team?"
follow up with "What was your role in the team?"

words.enDefinition: a question or heading used to identify successful parts of an activity

examples.en: The manager asked what went well during our first week at the temporary desk.
examples.zh: 经理问我们临时柜台第一周「哪些地方做得好」。

examples.en: I listed what went well before suggesting any changes to the handover.
examples.zh: 我先列出「哪些地方做得好」，再提出交接方面的改动。

words.enDefinition: A question inviting someone to reconsider an earlier choice or action

examples.en: When she asked "What would you do differently?", I said I would clarify the deadlines first.
examples.zh: 她问「你会换成什么做法」时，我说自己会先确认各个截止时间。

examples.en: The follow-up "What would you do differently?" led us to discuss how I asked for feedback.
examples.zh: 「你会换成什么做法」这个追问让我们谈起我怎样征求反馈。

collocations: ask "What would you do differently next time?"
follow up with "What would you do differently?"

words.expression: when should I expect to hear back
words.lemma: when should i expect to hear back
words.zhGloss: 我大概什么时候能收到回复
words.enDefinition: asks when a reply is likely to arrive
acceptedZhAnswers: 我大概什么时候能收到回复
acceptedEnVariants: when should I expect to hear back

examples.en: When should I expect to hear back once the team has finished reviewing applications?
examples.zh: 团队审完申请以后，「我大概什么时候能收到回复」？

examples.en: Before I leave, when should I expect to hear back about the next step?
examples.zh: 我走之前还想问一句，关于下一步，「我大概什么时候能收到回复」？

collocations: when should I expect to hear back about the role?
when should I expect to hear back from you?
roughly, when should I expect to hear back?

words.expression: where do you see yourself in five years
words.lemma: where do you see yourself in five years
words.zhGloss: 五年后有什么职业规划
words.enDefinition: A question about someone's plans or career expectations several years ahead
acceptedZhAnswers: 五年后有什么职业规划
acceptedEnVariants: where do you see yourself in five years

examples.en: When asked "Where do you see yourself in five years?", I explained which skills I hoped to develop.
examples.zh: 听到「五年后有什么职业规划」时，我说了自己希望培养哪些技能。

examples.en: I answered "Where do you see yourself in five years?" by describing the work I wanted.
examples.zh: 我用自己想做什么样的工作回答了「五年后有什么职业规划」。

collocations: ask "Where do you see yourself in five years?"
answer "Where do you see yourself in five years?"
prepare for "Where do you see yourself in five years?"

words.enDefinition: the current situation or stage of a process

examples.en: Could you let me know where things stand with the library role we discussed?
examples.zh: 能告诉我我们聊过的图书馆岗位「目前有什么进展」吗？

examples.en: The coordinator called to explain where things stand while the team waits for approval.
examples.zh: 团队还在等审批，协调员打电话说明了「目前的进展」。

collocations: let me know where things stand

words.enDefinition: asks which phone number somebody wants you to use

examples.en: Which number should I call if the recruiter is working from home that morning?
examples.zh: 如果招聘人员那天上午在家办公，「我该打哪个号码」？

examples.en: Before we hang up, which number should I call if I need to reschedule?
examples.zh: 挂电话前确认一下，如果需要改时间，「我该打哪个号码」？

collocations: which number should I call on Thursday?
which number should I call to reach you?
just to check, which number should I call?

words.enDefinition: Empty areas that separate text or design elements on a page

examples.en: I added more white space between my education and experience sections.
examples.zh: 我在教育背景栏和经历栏之间增加了「留白」。

examples.en: The sample used white space to make each job entry easy to spot.
examples.zh: 样本通过「留白」让每段工作经历都容易找到。

collocations: make effective use of white space

words.enDefinition: a task in which someone works out ideas or a solution on a whiteboard

examples.en: I used a small table to organize my thoughts during the whiteboard exercise.
examples.zh: 在「白板作答练习」中，我画了一个小表格来理清思路。

examples.en: The interviewer explained the whiteboard exercise before asking me to draw the first step.
examples.zh: 面试官先说明了「白板作答练习」，然后请我画出第一步。

words.enDefinition: an interview in which candidates show their thinking through work on a physical or virtual board

examples.en: The whiteboard interview began with a diagram of a simple library booking system.
examples.zh: 「白板面试」从画一个简单图书馆预约系统的图开始。

examples.en: I checked whether the whiteboard interview would use a shared board or paper.
examples.zh: 我核实了「白板面试」是用共享白板还是用纸。

words.expression: who should I address this to
words.lemma: who should i address this to
words.enDefinition: asks whose name should appear as the addressee
acceptedEnVariants: who should I address this to

examples.en: Who should I address this to if the original recruiter is away next week?
examples.zh: 如果原来联系的招聘人员下周不在，「我该把这封信写给谁」？

examples.en: I've written the message, but who should I address this to in the office?
examples.zh: 邮件我已经写好了，但「我该写给办公室里的谁」？

collocations: who should I address this to on your team?
who should I address this to when I email?
quick question, who should I address this to?

words.expression: who will I be speaking with
words.lemma: who will i be speaking with
words.enDefinition: asks who the other person on an arranged call will be
acceptedEnVariants: who will I be speaking with

examples.en: Who will I be speaking with when I ring the office on Monday morning?
examples.zh: 我星期一上午打给办公室时，「会和谁通话」？

examples.en: Who will I be speaking with on Thursday when the recruiter is out of town?
examples.zh: 周四招聘人员不在城里，「我会和谁通话」？

collocations: who will I be speaking with tomorrow?
who will I be speaking with on the call?
before I ring, who will I be speaking with?

words.enDefinition: identifies which person is expected to make the call

examples.en: Can we confirm who's calling whom so we don't both wait by the phone?
examples.zh: 能确认一下「谁给谁打电话」吗？免得我们都守着电话等。

examples.en: I checked who's calling whom before leaving the library to find a quieter place.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「谁给谁打电话」，才离开图书馆去找个安静些的地方。

collocations: make sure we know who's calling whom

words.expression: why do you want to work here
words.lemma: why do you want to work here
words.zhGloss: 你为什么想在这里工作
words.enDefinition: A question asking what draws someone to a particular employer
acceptedZhAnswers: 你为什么想在这里工作
acceptedEnVariants: why do you want to work here

examples.en: My answer to "Why do you want to work here?" mentioned the museum's outreach work with schools.
examples.zh: 回答「你为什么想在这里工作」时，我提到了博物馆面向学校的推广活动。

examples.en: When asked "Why do you want to work here?", I mentioned a community program I had visited.
examples.zh: 听到「你为什么想在这里工作」时，我提到了自己参观过的社区项目。

collocations: answer "Why do you want to work here?"
prepare for "Why do you want to work here?"
a response to "Why do you want to work here?"

words.enDefinition: open to gaining new skills or knowledge

examples.en: The shop wants someone willing to learn how to repair zips and replace buttons.
examples.zh: 这家店要找一个「愿意学习」怎么修拉链、换纽扣的人。

examples.en: You don't need to know the software yet if you're willing to learn it.
examples.zh: 你现在不用会用这个软件，只要「愿意学」就行。

collocations: someone who is willing to learn

words.enDefinition: To take an application out of consideration

examples.en: I decided to withdraw an application after finding out the shifts clashed with my classes.
examples.zh: 发现班次和课表冲突后，我决定「撤回申请」。

examples.en: The portal explained how to withdraw an application without deleting the whole candidate account.
examples.zh: 求职门户说明了如何「撤回申请」并保留求职者账户。

words.enDefinition: The spread of information through personal conversations

examples.en: I heard about the bookshop vacancy by word of mouth while waiting for a bus.
examples.zh: 等公交时，我听到人们「口头转告」书店有空缺，就知道了这份工作。

examples.en: Some students found out about the weekend roles through word of mouth at the library.
examples.zh: 一些学生是在图书馆听别人「口头转告」，才知道有周末岗位。

words.enDefinition: make plans that fit the other person's commitments

examples.en: I can work around your schedule if Friday is particularly busy at the office.
examples.zh: 如果周五办公室特别忙，我可以「配合你的日程安排」。

examples.en: We're happy to work around your schedule while you finish your end-of-term exams.
examples.zh: 你备考期末的这段时间，我们很乐意「配合你的日程安排」。

collocations: happy to work around your schedule
try to work around your schedule
flexible enough to work around your schedule

words.enDefinition: The date on which a particular permission to work is due to end

examples.en: The adviser pointed out my work authorization expiry date on the copy I brought.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了我带的副本上哪一处写着「工作许可到期日」。

examples.en: I checked the work authorization expiry date against the date entered in the staff portal.
examples.zh: 我把「工作许可到期日」与员工平台登记的日期核对了一下。

collocations: check the work authorization expiry date
record the work authorization expiry date
confirm your work authorization expiry date

words.enDefinition: A question asking if someone may legally work

examples.en: The work authorization question appeared on a separate page from the previous employment section.
examples.zh: 「工作许可问题」和以往工作经历那一栏分在不同页面。

examples.en: I read the note under the work authorization question before choosing an answer.
examples.zh: 选择答案前，我先读了「工作许可问题」下方的说明。

collocations: a work authorization question on the form

words.enDefinition: What a visa holder is permitted to do for work in Australia

examples.en: The Australian employer asked about my work entitlements before confirming the placement.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚雇主在确认实习前问了我「在澳获准工作的范围」。

examples.en: The adviser showed where the online record listed my work entitlements.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看在线档案的哪里列出了我「在澳获准工作的范围」。

words.enDefinition: A record of jobs a person has held over time

examples.en: I checked my work history for the dates of two short summer jobs.
examples.zh: 我查了自己的「工作履历」，核对两份短期暑期工作的日期。

examples.en: The CV lists my work history separately from the jobs I did as a volunteer.
examples.zh: 简历把我的「工作履历」和志愿工作分开列出。

words.enDefinition: A limit on how many hours a person may work

examples.en: Our adviser pointed to the work hours cap in the Australian guidance.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我们看澳大利亚指南里的「工作时数上限」。

examples.en: I asked which dates the guide used when discussing the work hours cap.
examples.zh: 我问指南介绍「工作时数上限」时使用的是哪些日期。

collocations: a work hours cap during term
a work hours cap for visa holders

words.enDefinition: carry out tasks without regular help or supervision

examples.en: The app developer must work independently while the rest of the team is abroad.
examples.zh: 其他团队成员都在国外时，应用开发人员必须「独立工作」。

examples.en: The role lets me work independently once I understand how the archive is organized.
examples.zh: 等我弄清档案是怎么整理的，这个岗位就可以「独立工作」了。

words.enDefinition: course learning that integrates academic study with work practices

examples.en: My Australian course includes work-integrated learning through a design project with a local charity.
examples.zh: 我在澳大利亚的课程有「工学结合」项目，其中包括和本地慈善机构合作的设计任务。

examples.en: The work-integrated learning elective uses simulated workplace projects alongside regular seminars on campus.
examples.zh: 这门「工学结合」选修课既有模拟职场项目，也有在学校上的常规研讨课。

words.enDefinition: the place where a job is carried out

examples.en: I checked the work location and found it was on the other side of town.
examples.zh: 我查了「工作地点」，发现它在城市的另一边。

examples.en: The listing names the main work location but mentions an occasional shift elsewhere.
examples.zh: 招聘启事写明了主要「工作地点」，但提到偶尔要去别处上班。

words.enDefinition: do your job on officially recognized holidays

examples.en: The listing asks whether student guides can work on public holidays during the summer.
examples.zh: 招聘启事询问学生导览员夏天能否「在公共假日上班」。

examples.en: I asked how often front desk staff would need to work on public holidays.
examples.zh: 我问前台员工多久要「在公共假日上班」一次。

collocations: required to work on public holidays
available to work on public holidays
asked to work on public holidays

words.enDefinition: An identifier used to refer to a particular work permit application

examples.en: The adviser asked which letter showed my work permit application number from Canada.
examples.zh: 顾问问哪封信上写有我申请加拿大许可的「工作许可申请编号」。

examples.en: I matched the work permit application number on the letter to my case details.
examples.zh: 我把信上的「工作许可申请编号」与自己的申请记录核对了一下。

collocations: confirm the work permit application number
enter a work permit application number
look up your work permit application number

words.enDefinition: Restrictions or terms printed on or associated with a permit

examples.en: I checked the work permit conditions before discussing my placement with the university.
examples.zh: 跟学校谈实习之前，我核对了「工作许可证所列条件」。

examples.en: The adviser showed where the work permit conditions appeared on the Canadian sample.
examples.zh: 顾问指出加拿大的样本在哪里写了「工作许可证所列条件」。

collocations: a change to work permit conditions

words.enDefinition: An official document granting a person permission to work under specified conditions

examples.en: I checked the name on my work permit before showing it to HR.
examples.zh: 把「工作许可证」给人力资源部门看之前，我核对了上面的姓名。

examples.en: The coordinator asked whether the work permit listed my work location.
examples.zh: 协调员问「工作许可证」上有没有写我的工作地点。

words.enDefinition: An extension of how long an existing work permit remains valid

examples.en: I asked which date the work permit extension notice referred to in my file.
examples.zh: 我问自己档案里「工作许可延期」通知指的是哪个日期。

examples.en: The student workshop explained how to recognize a work permit extension letter.
examples.zh: 学生讲座介绍了怎样识别「工作许可延期」通知信。

words.enDefinition: Formal approval for a placement connected to a course of study

examples.en: My university emailed the work placement approval before the placement coordinator contacted me.
examples.zh: 实习协调员联系我之前，学校发邮件通知我的「实习安排获批」。

examples.en: I asked whether the work placement approval showed my placement dates and location.
examples.zh: 我问「实习安排获批」的文件是否写了实习日期和地点。

collocations: a letter showing work placement approval

words.enDefinition: The features someone wants in a job

examples.en: I adjusted my work preferences to show that I was free only on weekends.
examples.zh: 我修改了自己的「工作偏好」，标明只有周末有空。

examples.en: Did the careers adviser ask you about your work preferences before suggesting those companies?
examples.zh: 就业顾问推荐那几家公司之前，有问过你的「工作偏好」吗？

words.enDefinition: Conditions limiting the employment a person may undertake under their permission

examples.en: The adviser explained where to find the work restrictions in my current record.
examples.zh: 顾问指出在目前的记录中哪里能找到「工作限制」。

examples.en: My coordinator asked whether the notice described any work restrictions for the placement.
examples.zh: 协调员问通知是否说明了这份实习的任何「工作限制」。

words.enDefinition: an example of what someone has produced, used to demonstrate their skills

examples.en: The recruiter asked for a work sample that showed how I presented research findings.
examples.zh: 招聘人员想看一份能展示我怎样汇报研究结果的「工作成果样本」。

examples.en: I chose a work sample from a project I had finished last term.
examples.zh: 我从上学期完成的一个项目里选了一份「工作成果样本」。

words.enDefinition: A test using an example of tasks from the role

examples.en: The work sample test asked me to sort a short set of library records.
examples.zh: 「工作样例测试」让我整理一小组图书馆记录。

examples.en: I read the instructions for the work sample test before starting the cataloguing exercise.
examples.zh: 开始编目练习前，我先读了「工作样例测试」的说明。

words.enDefinition: perform tasks in stressful or demanding conditions

examples.en: People in the ticket office sometimes work under pressure when several events start together.
examples.zh: 几场活动同时开始时，售票处的人有时要「在压力下工作」。

examples.en: The description says you'll work under pressure on Fridays when the café is busiest.
examples.zh: 岗位说明写着，星期五咖啡馆最忙，你要「在压力下工作」。

collocations: work under pressure in a busy setting

words.enDefinition: An immigration visa category associated with taking up employment

examples.en: I asked the adviser which work visa the employer had mentioned in the email.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，雇主在邮件中提到的是哪种「工作签证」。

examples.en: The information session explained what a work visa was in that country.
examples.zh: 说明会介绍了「工作签证」在那个国家指什么。

words.enDefinition: an agreement among team members about practical rules for how they will work together

examples.en: Our working agreement says to mark urgent requests clearly in the team inbox.
examples.zh: 我们的「协作约定」要求在团队共用收件箱里明确标出紧急请求。

examples.en: I suggested updating the working agreement after we changed our meeting schedule.
examples.zh: 变更开会时间后，我建议更新「协作约定」。

words.zhGloss: 能实际运用的基础知识
words.enDefinition: enough understanding of something to use it for everyday tasks
acceptedZhAnswers: 能实际运用的基础知识

examples.en: The role asks for a working knowledge of spreadsheets so you can update simple records.
examples.zh: 这个岗位要求「懂基本的电子表格操作」，能更新简单的记录。

examples.en: I have a working knowledge of photo editing from helping with the student newsletter.
examples.zh: 我帮学生通讯做过编辑，「懂基本的照片编辑操作」。

collocations: a working knowledge of office software
require a working knowledge of something

words.enDefinition: the usual arrangement of the days or hours someone works

examples.en: The working pattern includes short shifts on weekdays and a longer shift every other Saturday.
examples.zh: 「工作时间安排」是工作日上短班，每隔一周的周六上一个长班。

examples.en: I asked if my working pattern could change when the new term began.
examples.zh: 我问新学期开始后，自己的「工作时间安排」能不能调整。

words.enDefinition: The way someone generally organizes and carries out their work

examples.en: I used my campus job to illustrate my working style during busy weeks.
examples.zh: 我用校内工作举例，说明自己在繁忙时的「工作方式」。

examples.en: The panel asked how my working style changed when I worked with others.
examples.zh: 面试小组问我，与人合作时自己的「工作方式」有什么变化。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚涉童工作审查
words.enDefinition: Australian screening for people who work with children in relevant roles
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚涉童工作审查

examples.en: The Australian placement coordinator asked about my Working with Children Check at orientation.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会上，澳大利亚的实习协调员问起我的「澳大利亚涉童工作审查」。

examples.en: The school showed where to find the Working with Children Check details in its checklist.
examples.zh: 学校指出在清单哪里能找到「澳大利亚涉童工作审查」的相关信息。

collocations: a Working with Children Check for volunteers
check a Working with Children Check number
a valid Working with Children Check

words.enDefinition: the distribution of work so that no person or group carries too much

examples.en: We reviewed workload balance after one person received three large bookings to process.
examples.zh: 有人接连分到三个大预约后，我们检查了「工作量分配平衡」。

examples.en: My supervisor changed the rota to improve workload balance across the desk team.
examples.zh: 主管调整了排班，让柜台团队的「工作量分配更加平衡」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of work handled within a given period

examples.en: The adviser asked whether I had figures for the office's workload volume.
examples.zh: 顾问问我是否有关于办公室「处理的工作量」的数据。

examples.en: The workload volume made it easier to understand the scale of my role.
examples.zh: 「处理的工作量」的数据让人更容易理解我的工作规模。

words.enDefinition: a specific ability needed to perform a task at work

examples.en: The training group chose one workplace competency to practise during each week of the placement.
examples.zh: 培训小组每周选一项「岗位胜任能力」在实习中练习。

examples.en: The supervisor described clear record keeping as a workplace competency for the admin rotation.
examples.zh: 带教老师说，做好清晰的记录是行政轮岗的一项「岗位胜任能力」。

words.enDefinition: usual expectations for appropriate and considerate conduct at work

examples.en: The induction covered workplace etiquette for staff using the shared kitchen and meeting rooms.
examples.zh: 入职介绍讲了员工使用共用厨房和会议室时的「职场礼仪」。

examples.en: I asked a colleague about workplace etiquette before bringing food into the training room.
examples.zh: 带食物进培训室前，我先问了同事相关的「职场礼仪」。

words.enDefinition: A form where workers declare health information relevant to assigned work

examples.en: I asked my coordinator who would receive the workplace health declaration for the placement.
examples.zh: 我问协调员，谁会收到这次实习的「工作健康申报表」。

examples.en: The workplace health declaration was filed separately from the rest of my onboarding forms.
examples.zh: 「工作健康申报表」与其他入职表格分开归档。

words.enDefinition: an experienced colleague who gives informal guidance at work

examples.en: My workplace mentor helped me think about which teams I might want to try next.
examples.zh: 「职场导师」帮我考虑接下来可以去哪些团队试试。

examples.en: I met my workplace mentor once a month to talk about skills I'd like to develop.
examples.zh: 我每月和「职场导师」见一次面，聊聊想培养的技能。

collocations: get advice from a workplace mentor

words.enDefinition: a set of related tasks that forms one part of a larger effort

examples.en: Our workstream handled visitor information while another group prepared the display cases.
examples.zh: 我们负责的「一组相关工作任务」围绕访客信息，另一个小组负责布置展柜。
