examples.en: I asked which workstream owned the rollout of the new room guides.
examples.zh: 我问新版场地指南的推出归哪「一组相关工作任务」负责。

words.expression: would you like me to elaborate
words.lemma: would you like me to elaborate
words.enDefinition: A polite question offering to give more detail about something
acceptedEnVariants: would you like me to elaborate

examples.en: I asked "Would you like me to elaborate?" after summarizing how the repair request was handled.
examples.zh: 我概述了维修请求是怎样处理的，然后问「您想听我展开说说吗」。

examples.en: My tutor suggested "Would you like me to elaborate?" after a brief answer about teamwork.
examples.zh: 导师建议，团队合作的话题简短回答后可以问「您想听我展开说说吗」。

collocations: ask "Would you like me to elaborate?"
say "Would you like me to elaborate on that?"
offer "Would you like me to elaborate on my role?"

words.expression: would you mind sending that again
words.lemma: would you mind sending that again
words.zhGloss: 可以麻烦你再发一次吗
words.enDefinition: politely asks somebody to resend something
acceptedZhAnswers: 可以麻烦你再发一次吗
acceptedEnVariants: would you mind sending that again

examples.en: Would you mind sending that again in a format I can open on my phone?
examples.zh: 「可以麻烦你再发一次吗」？换成我的手机能打开的格式。

examples.en: Would you mind sending that again to the university address I gave you earlier?
examples.zh: 「可以麻烦你再发一次吗」，发到我之前给你的学校邮箱。

collocations: would you mind sending that again by email?
would you mind sending that again as a PDF?
when you have a moment, would you mind sending that again?

words.enDefinition: To bring your reply to a brief and natural conclusion

examples.en: The tutor showed how to wrap up your answer without repeating the whole story.
examples.zh: 导师示范了怎样「结束回答」，用不着把整个故事再讲一遍。

examples.en: The guide suggests using one brief sentence to wrap up your answer.
examples.zh: 指南建议用一句简短的话「结束你的回答」。

collocations: wrap up your answer with the result
learn to wrap up your answer

words.enDefinition: A written response agreeing to take an offer

examples.en: My written acceptance included the start date that we'd discussed on the phone.
examples.zh: 我在「书面确认接受录用」时写明了电话里谈过的到岗日期。

examples.en: I saved a copy of my written acceptance alongside the offer letter from the library.
examples.zh: 我把「书面确认接受录用」的副本和图书馆发来的录用函放在一起。

words.enDefinition: the ability to share information clearly in writing

examples.en: The role calls for written communication skills because the assistant answers most questions by email.
examples.zh: 岗位要求有「书面沟通能力」，因为助理主要通过邮件回答问题。

examples.en: The listing mentions written communication skills for turning meeting notes into short updates.
examples.zh: 招聘启事提到要有「书面沟通能力」，能把会议笔记整理成简短的进展说明。

words.enDefinition: An offer communicated in writing

examples.en: The written offer arrived the morning after my call with the library manager.
examples.zh: 我和图书馆经理通话后的第二天早上，「书面录用通知」就发来了。

examples.en: I checked the hours in the written offer against what we'd discussed by phone.
examples.zh: 我把「书面录用通知」里的工时和电话里谈过的工时对照了一下。

words.enDefinition: A UK document summarizing the principal details of a job

examples.en: The UK employer sent a written statement of employment particulars before my first shift.
examples.zh: 英国雇主在我第一次上班前发来一份「书面雇佣条款说明」。

examples.en: I checked the workplace address in my written statement of employment particulars before orientation.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会前，我核对了「书面雇佣条款说明」里的工作地点地址。

collocations: provide a written statement of employment particulars
read the written statement of employment particulars
issue a written statement of employment particulars

words.enDefinition: a grading result showing a program finished but returned an incorrect result

examples.en: The platform showed “Wrong Answer” even though my program ran without an error.
examples.zh: 虽然我的程序运行时没有报错，平台还是显示「答案错误」。

examples.en: I got “Wrong Answer” when the program sorted names in the opposite order.
examples.zh: 程序按相反顺序排列姓名时，结果显示「答案错误」。

words.enDefinition: a person who receives a message intended for somebody else

examples.en: I sent the timetable to the wrong recipient because two recruiters had the same first name.
examples.zh: 两位招聘人员的名字一样，我把时间表「发错了收件人」。

examples.en: The company realized I was the wrong recipient when I asked which vacancy they meant.
examples.zh: 我问他们指的是哪个岗位时，公司才发现「邮件发错了人」。

collocations: send an email to the wrong recipient

words.enDefinition: the number of years spent doing a particular kind of work

examples.en: The job asks for two years of experience, so I checked whether placements count.
examples.zh: 这份工作要求「两年工作经验」，所以我查了一下实习算不算。

examples.en: The ad asks for several years of experience supervising staff in a busy shop.
examples.zh: 招聘启事要求有「数年工作经验」，具体是在繁忙的商店里带员工。

collocations: at least two years of experience

words.enDefinition: invites a candidate to submit another application in the future

examples.en: You're welcome to apply again when the library advertises more student assistant positions next term.
examples.zh: 下学期图书馆再招学生助理时，「欢迎你再申请」。

examples.en: You're welcome to apply again once the next round of summer jobs has opened.
examples.zh: 下一批暑期岗位开始接受报名后，「欢迎你再申请」。

collocations: you're welcome to apply again next year
you're welcome to apply again for another role
you're welcome to apply again when positions open
